tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 kaM tshang yab sras dang dpal spungs dgon pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar dad pa'i pad+ma rgyas byed/

tei:div.tei:p: sras 1 byed sal ceje ba ‘

dkar chagagacig ke tshang yab sras kyi rnam thar dwangs gsal shel gyi me long /1 'go brjod/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 3re dpal ldan karma pa'i skyes rabs/ ༷ ༷ 7ri dbu zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan gyi lo rgyus/ ༷ 124 dpal rgyal dbang karma pa na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ ༷ 265 tā yi si tu na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ 81༄ 'jam mgon kong sprul na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ 1004 zhwa dmar na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ ༷128ra rgyal tshab na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ ༷༷ ༷ 140⑫༷gnas nang dpa' bo na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ 160 10 tre ho na rim gyi mdzad rnam/ ༷ 1531 ) mjug bsdus pa'i gtam/ ༷ ༷ ༷166gnyis/ rje btsun bla ma si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar dad pa'i sa bon/ ༷ ༷ 167gsum/ mdo khams gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs 1

thub bstan chos 'khor gling / ༷ ༷ ༷ 2161 gdan sa 'phel bgrib kyi skor/ 226shā spru la sku khag gi sku phreng rim byon skor/ ༷ 236ri spar khang dang rten gtso bo'i skor/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 2414 bshad sprub kyi bstan pa bskyangs tshul skor/ ༷ 263ba tshes dus sprub mchod kyi skor/ ༷ ci73༄ dgon lag dang sde 'khor gyi skor/ 2794 deng gi gnas tshul skor/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 284ra dgon pa'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ ༷ 289mjug byang ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ 309

'go brjod/bcu1 /na mo gu ru karma kā yatshogs gnyis rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ gzugs sku yid bzhin nor bu gang / /chos dbyings mkha' la rtag gsal ba/ /karma pa la snying nas 'dud/ /sa bcu dbang phyug mi pham mgon/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi phrin las la/ /dgongs nas bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin pa/ /tā yi si tu'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gsang chen bka' sdud rdo rje 'chang / /bka' rnying bstan pa'i srog shing che/ /bstan snying 'chad dang spel mkhas pa/ /'jam mgon gar dbang zhabs la 'dud/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la rtag tu gzigs/ /ma 'gag snying rje'i rdo rje 'chang / /sku gsum dbyer med karma pa//zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin la 'dud/ /gang gi gsang gsum phrin las mchog /mi zad srid mthar spel ba po/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam pa mchog /rim byon 'khrul pa bul la 'dud/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho las/ /yang zab yid bzhin nor bu mchog /blangs mdzad 'gro ba'i ded dpon che/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med kyang /rtsod dus 'gro ba 'dul slad du/ /mi zad sprul bsgyur spel ba po/ /bye ho jim par byon la 'dud/ /de ltar rigs drug sprul pa'i ska/ 1 dus gsum ji ltar byon rnams kyi/ /rnam par thar pa'i yon tan la/ /bdag yid mi phyed snying nas dad/ /gzhan dag snyigs 3

ma'i rang mdangs la sa/ /sangs rgyas gsungs la'ang skyon 'dog cing / /sar ba/nas 'phags pa'i yon tan yang / /bdud rigs sems kyis rnyeg par byas/ /bdag gi rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /mchog gsum dpung gnyen du drangs nas/ /log lta'i smag rum dpyis 'byin pa'i/ /dwangs gsal me long 'dir ba kad bya/ /de la rgya ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga yi bdag nyid bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lab dam pa lus can rnams kyi mgon skyab dang dpung gnyen zla med pa ni dpal ldan karma pa nyid yin la/ de'i ngo bo ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can rnams 'dren pa'i dgos pa khyad par can mthong nas mi skyo bas 'jug pa spro ba chen po dang brtson pa dang / don dang 'byung ba chen po ste rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'bras bu byang chub dang sems can la dmigs pa'i thugs bskyed pa ji lta bar bslab pa'i lam la thugs kyi dgongs pa skad gcib gi cha tsam yang g.yel ba med par sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyun mi chad pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi phan bde'i gzhir gyur pa'i byed las ldan pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /rang bzhin ni rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdagadakyil 'khor kun gyi ga rtsa rba/ chos sku'i sto na pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang gnyis su med pa longs spyod rdzogs skur rigs lnga dang zhi khro'i 4

rnam pas zhing khams grangs med khyab pa'o/ /thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pas sprul pa'i sku 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas/ sa ra ha la sogs pas gdul bya las da nga sna tshogs pa la tha ra pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad pa la/ba/ngas can 'dir kag mar rgyal pos 'dul bar dgongs nas srong btsan sgam po sogs chos rgyal/ paṇa grub kyi —sgyu dul bar dgongs nas slob dpon pad+ma dang jo bo rje yab sras sogs/ sru sa pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 'dul ba dgongs nas gshen sgom re thul can dang /shud ke'i ban rgan/ kha rag sgom pa sogs gzhan yang sprul pa bgrang ba las 'das pas sems can gyi khams dbang dang 'tshams pa'i chos ston te 'gro ba rnams 'dren par mdzad/ slar yang bdag cag gi ston pas byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nur mdo sde ting 'dzin rgyal po yongs su gtad nas/ de nyid byang phyogs su spel ba'i lung dang smon lam dus su babs tshe/ rgyal bas bstan pa'i theg pa ma lus pa gang zag gcig gis 'dzin pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags pa zhes bod yul gyi ston par byon pa'i phrin las spel bar dgongs nas/ bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas dang byang sems phal che ba'i sprul bsgyur zla 'od gzhon nu de'i 'khor gyi tshul du 'du ba'i nang nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni mi mchog dus gsum mkhyen par gyur to/ /5

de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang ngung sems ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam ngas mthon mthing gi rtsad pan dbu la gsol te rgyal ba de dag gi phrin las 'dzin par dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas byang sems ma byon bar du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi chad par byon pa la karma pa zhes mtshan gsol ba srid pa gsum du snyan par grags so/ /de nyid kyis sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid spubs du ma'i sgo nas spel bar mdzad pa'i byir/ sprul pa dang yang sprul bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig bstan pa las mchog tu gyur pa sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga yi bdag nyid mchog gi sprul pa'i sku lnga dang / rgyal dbang karma pa nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i ka tshang yab sras zhes 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rgyun mar byon zhing 'byon par 'gyur ba'i rnam thar tshang ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdoms kyis kung gsungs par mi nus mod/ tshur mthong gdul bya'i snang ngor shar tshul rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa sngar gyi chos 'byung deb ther rnams dang khyad par kun mkhyen bla ma si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bka' 'bum du bzhugs pa'i bka' brgyud rnam tha ra nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba las cher gsal/ 'dir dus snyigs ma lnga brdo ba'i skye bo rnams kyi 'phags chen dam pa ye shes mchog brnyes pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi legs nyes lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar bsal ba'i mdzad phrin gang 'dul sna tshogs su bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan 6

ma nges bzhin du/ rang nyid bskal pa mang por ma dag pa'i las la spyod pa'i bag chag mthu brtas pa'i dbang gis grub pa'i dbang shes la snang tshad bden 'dzin a 'bas kyis rtag brtan bzung ba bdag dang bdag 'dras rnam par tha ra pa'i bar skabs 'gar log lta phra mo skye ba mthong zhing thos pas1 de dag lam du bzung ba ni log pa'i g.yang sa chen po ste/ khams gsum gyi sems —can thams cad kyi srog bcad pa las ni byang chub sems dpa' gcig la ngag dang yid kyi sgro skur byung ba rnam smin che ba'i phyir/ 'gro ba 'dren pa kams kyi mdzad phrin dang sprul pa'i rol gar cir yang bsgyur ba la log rtog skad cig kung mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan gang shes nyung ngur smra ba bya'o/ /dpal ldan karma pa'i skyes rabs/de yang dpal ldan karma pa'i skyes rabs brgyad dang / bcu gcig dang bcu gsum sogs ni slob dpon pad+ma'i lung gis zin pa yin la1 de phyin ji lta bu snyams na/ sangs rgyas nyid ni gzugs skur snang ba dang mi snang ba gang gi dus na khyad par cung zad kyang med par chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las mi g.yo ba chos sku dang nam gdul bya'i khams dang rgyud dag pa'i tshe gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung ba longs sprul gnyis 'byung bas nges pa med mod/ spyir nam mkha' zad pa med ltar 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs bskyed la zad pa med pa'i lgir karma pa'i sprul rgyud kyang zad pa med do/ /7

tshur mthong gi gdul bya'i ngor 'phags chen rnams kyi lung gis zin pa yang 'di ltar mchis te/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon pos 'phrang phus brag las yo rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lung bstan gyi gter yig shog ser spyan drangs pa las 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar seng ge'i rnam 'phrul karma pa bye ba phrag brgya byon nas sems 6na gyi don mdzad do//zhes pa dang / grub chen nyag ras se bos khams glo dgon du lha khang bzhengs nas der rdo rje 'chang nas phag mo gru pa'i bar bla rabs bdun gyi sku bzhengs pa'i nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag dang /gzhan yang phyi ma'i dus gangs can sogs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji ltar 'byung ba'i lung bstan gyi yi ge mdzad nas grub chen nyid kyi dbu skras bsdams te lha khang de nyid kyi ka ba'i nang gter du sbas pa/ dus phyes grub chen nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhal slob grub chen chu phur ba shu ku rin chen gyis dkar chag lung bstan skra mdud kyis bsdams pa de nyid glo dgon gyi gtsug lag khang gi ka ba nas spyan drangs pa'i yi ger/dang por/ zhwa nag can rabs bdun 'byon pa de rnam gzigs sogs sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi nom par 'phrul pa dang / de nas brgyad 'byung ba de sa snying sogs byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de nas bcu gnyis 'byung ba de gdung ba sel ba sogs rang sangs rgyas bcu gnyis kyi rnam par 8

'phrul pa dang / de nas bcu drug 'byung ba ni dga' bo sogs nyan thos bcu drug gi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de nas lnga brgya 'byung ba ni dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de nas stong dang gnyis 'byung ba ni bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong dang sems pa gnyis kyi rnam 'phrul yin la/ tha ma 'dir karma pa zhwa nag can gtsug gtor can gcig 'byon pas/ de 'byon pa dang 'dzam gling 'dir byams mgon mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa dang dus mchu ngas zus lung bstan gyi yi ge gsal ba yod 'dug gzhan yang dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal nas mtshur phu 'dir zhwa nag can gsum 'ong zhes bka' bstsal ba'i zhwa nag can gsum ni karma pa tā dang / rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje gsum 'byung bar lung bstan la/ grub chen karma bka'i zhal nas/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir zhwa nag can karma pa'i ming dang ldan pa'i skye ba bcu gcig 'byung bar lung bstan pa las/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dang /karma sha gnyis bgrang na bcu gcig nyid dang / mi bgrang na zhwa nag 6na karma pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i skye ba bcu gsum 'byung bar lung bstan la/ rje karma bka'i gsung 'di dang mthun par gu ru pad+ma'i gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa dang / rat+na gling pa'i shog ser las kyang karma pa'i sku skye de dag gi gsang mtshan dang bcas te lung bstan kyang snang ngo / /'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 9

sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi chad pa 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa ni/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /nyid kyi rnam spur zhig zhu zhus pas/ /skye 'chi med pa sems la dbang thob kyang / /dbang med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba sngol slad du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis srid par nyid mtshams sbyor/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi chad/ /de la gyis gsungs/ khyad par rje btsun rdzogs pa'i bangs rgyas karma pa bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rjes na rim bcu bdun gyi thang sku mdzad de bcu bzhi par theg pa mchog gi rdo rje sogs na rim bzhi'i mtshan bcas bstsal yod pas rje karma pa'i sprul pa'i sku rim byon 'di dag gi rnam par spur pa la the tshom dang som nyi'i dri mas nam yang lhad par mi bya'o/ /sprir yang rje dus mkhyen dang / grub chen pa bsha rang byung rdo rje/ mi bskyod rdo rje rnams kyi gsung las sprul pa dang yang sprul bgrang las 'das pa zhig byon par bshad pas/zhing kha sa sprul pas khyab pa dang / rab 'byams zhing gi bdag po/ bsam brjod re ba las 'das pa zhes gsol 'debs las byung ba lhar ro/ /gzhan yang mdo teng nge 'dzin rgyal po las nga 'das lo ni nyis stong na gdong dmar yul du bstan pa 'byung / spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra/ karma pa zhes bya ba 'byung / ting 'dzin dbang thob 10

'gro ba 'dul/ mthong thos dran reg bde la 'god/ zhes sogs dang / mdo lang kar gshegs pa las rab byung chas la zhwa nag can1 stong gi bstan pa ma nub bar/ 'gro ba'i don la rgyun chad med/ ces sogs dang / ang de las/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud dge spyong dge ba 'phel zhes bya ba de ni mthu che ba/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ shes rab che ba/ brtul zhugs che ba/ mang du thos pa/ de'i ming ni dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes bya'o/ zhes sogs dang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las ming ni ka dang ma yi thog mtha' can/ bstan pa gsal byed skyes bu 'byung bar 'grur/ zhes sogs dang / yo rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rdo: rang bzhin dbang chen yab yum gyi: ngo bo rnam par 'phrul pa ste: 'phrin las spran ras ba/zigs dbang nyid: ma 'ongs mtha' mar gyur pa na: sprul pa du mas 'gro ba 'dren: zhes sogs dang / yo rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter byon las spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung gi rnam 'phrul sa: dga' ldan gnas nas sems can don du 'phos: dang po'i gsang spyod dus gsum mkhyen zhes grags: dbangartags rigs kyi rtsad pan zhwa nag 'dzin: skad cig re la sems can dpag med 'dren: de dag mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams:skye ba 'di 'phos 'phags pa'i drung du skye: zhes pa la sogs pa'i mdo sngags kyi lung du ma las shin tu gsal bar gsungs/ de ltar 11

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas karma pa chen po de bod yul kha ba can 'dir gdul dka' 'dul phyir gdod bcas mi yi sha tshugs su sprul pa'i skur byon te gdul bya'i khams dbang dang 'tshams pa'i gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /dbu zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan gyi lo rgyus/de nas dbu zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan gyi lo rgyus ni/ rje na rim brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rjes 'di ltar gsungs te/ de yang dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa de nyid bskal pa dpag cing gzhal du med pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i gong rol nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po'i lam gyi sgo nas mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa yin pa las/ dang po rnal 'byor rgyud du mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya bar byed pa la'ang /dang po phyogs bcu dang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ba na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i ngo bo rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur zhing thob pas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba nyid kyis/ de yang dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'gyur gyi gegs byed pa'i sgrib gsum gnas ngan len gyi rnyeg pa'i cha thams cad rdo rje'i chus bkrus shing da ga par byas pa'i rjes la/ rin chen 'byung gnas da bu rgyan gyi dbang gis srid pa dang zhi ba gnyis kyi mtha' gnyis las rnam par rgyal ba'i mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi seng ge'i khri chen por/ oṃ 12

sub studha ba su zhes khams gsum la 'khor lo bskyur ba'i rgyal po chen por rdo rje ren po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs bcings pas/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge'i khri chen po las bzhengs pa med pa de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i lha tshogs spums cad mngon par 'dud cing phyag 'tshal ba'i go 'phangs nod par 'gyur ba yin te/de yang rnal 'byor rgyud 'dir de kho na nyid rnam pa lnga bsgoms pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas ma thag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che'i rtsod pan bcings pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba ni grub chen kun dga' snying pos rdo rje 'byung bar/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ i badz+ra rat+na a t+ta dka zhes bya bas rdo rje rin po che'i rtsad pan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ba dang / kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang pos chos kyi ye shes ni bskyed/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sna tshogs pas phrin las la rab tu bzhag nas babs te sngar bskyed pa'i ri yi rgyal po ri rab kyi rtse mo na gnas pa'i khang pa brtsigs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che las byas pa'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsod nams las nges par 'byung ba'i seng ge'i gdan la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du byin gyis brlabs te zhal bzhi pa'i tshul du bzhag par gyur pa bsam zhing / mi 13

bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang phyogs bzhir re re zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyin du byin gyis brlabs la bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung bas sngon byung ston pa'i nom thar rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len gyi sgo nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa de nyid rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i rgyud dum bu dang po'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rjes thogs der/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ngo bo'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal por che1nga 'a gsol ba'i rdo rje rin po che'i dbu rgyan nam/ ze'u ka'i rtsad pan dang /dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur bcings pa yin la rtsod pan dang dar da stongs kyi khog la'ang mi bskyod pa dang / rin 'byung dang / 'od dpag med dang / don grub dang / rnam snang gi da bye bas kha jog nag po dang / ser po/ ljang ku/ dkar po/ dmar po sogs lnga char 'byung ba las kha dog de lnga dang mthun pa'i dar dpyangs dbu la 'ching dgos so/ /zhes dgongs nas/ dang por mi bskyod pas dag pa'i rtsad pan nam dar dpyangs nag po'i 'ching bar mdzad pa yin te/ sngon byung dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku tshe de nyid kyi rnam thar las kyang ling nag po me tog rlum 14

brtsigs kyi ri mo can gyi dbu zhwa nag po dbu la gsol zhes pa dang / grub chen karma pabs sha zhwa nag po 'di lta bu sngon chad sus kyang gyon par ma myong ba'i zhwa/ ces gsungs pa'i don yang — de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas de/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyal por mnga' gso' ba'i dbu rgyan nam/ dar dpungs sam/rtsad pan nam/ bod kyi grong tshig star na/ zhwa mo zhes brjed pas/ rtsad pan 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal po ste khri thog pa'am/ gdan sa pa ste rigs drug pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' ma gtogs/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas gzhan pa rnams kyi dbu la 'ching ba mi dbang na/ sems can gzhan rnams kyi mgo bor bcings kyang / 'bras dus kyi rdo rje rin po che'i rtsad pan dang / dar dpyangs dang zhwa nag gi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur thob par mi 'gyur yang / de ltar bcings pa na lam dus kyi rdo rje rin po che'i rtsad pan gyi dbang bskur thob par 'gyur ba yod de/ grub chen karma bka'i zhal slob rtogs ldan grub thob yo rgyan pa la sogs pa rnams la gnang ba lta bu'o/ /de lha bu'i rtsad pan gyi khog la'ang yum gyi dbye bas/ dbyings phyug ma/mā ma ki/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams kyi kha dog lnga'i rtsad pan 'ching bar 'gyur ba las/ sngags bla med ltar na de dag kyang rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma'i bdag nyid du gyur ba las/ sngon byung 15

dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku tshe de nyid kyi rnam spur las rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma'i dbu skra las grub pa'i rdo rje dang rin po che'i rtsad pan nam/ dar dpyangs te phal skad du zhwa nag dbu la gsol bar grags la/ des na dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa ste rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' 'di nyid kyi cod pan gyi kha dog ni kha dog spums cad pa las 3gyur ba med pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rigs kyi cha nas nag po ga rtsa bor 'jog kyang / don la dkar ser la sogs rnam pa thams cad pa'i kha ngog rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral bar grub pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas rang rang gi rgyal sar dbang bskur ba la rdo rje rtsad pan gyis dbang bskur dgos pa 'di sngags kyi theg par ma zad rgyu yi theg par yang grags te/ dga' ldan nas lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar 'dzam bu'i gling du byon pa na/ rang gi rtsad pan sangs rgyas byams pa'i mgo bo bcings te rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas deng sang dga' ldan du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi mdzad pa dang por 'jug bzhin par bzhugs pa 'di nyid do/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyal sa chen po la bka'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i sangs rgyas ni/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa bo na las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas shes bya'i khong na med do/ /'o na mngon pa byang chub pa lngas dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa rnam 16

par snang mdzad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa la don yod grub pa'i ngo za'i karma pa'am phrin las pa'i mib gi dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje rtse mor/ mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /theg pa chen po chos kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /chos kyi gnas ni yongs su gyur/ /ces dang / de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de la mtshan ji lhar du grags snyams na/ rtse mor/ /gang zhig don kun 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sngon gyi don kun 'grub par byed/ /bcom ldan kun tu bzang po dang / /rdo rje las ni bla na med/ /rdo rje dbyings ni bstan pa'i bdag /rnam par snang mdzad bla na med/ /de dag gsang ba'i mtshan yin la/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni gnas skabs thob1 /ces 'byung la/ des na dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa de nyid rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'bor gyi dbang phyug tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa na1 karma badz+ra mā lca 6 gyi mtshan/ phrin las kyi rdo rje phreng ba zhes pa'i ming kho na nges bzung du sbyar ba yin la/sangs rgyas gzhan la ming gi dbang bskur ba la ni/ de ltar nges bzung bya ba ma yin te/ rang rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha de nyid kyi rigs kyi ming gi dbang bskur ba yin te/ slob dpon kun snying gi rdo rje 'byung bar/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur ba yang rdo rje de rang gi mgo bor bzhag la/ yo badz+ra sa te sto/ a bhi dka 17

mi/ badz+ra nā ma a snyed ka ta/ ces rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di blang bar bya'o/ /rang gi ming ba/nga yin pa la kye zhes sbyar ba bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud la brten nas mngon par sangs rgyas pa la rdo rje cod pan nam/ dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas khams gsum gyi 'khor lor bsgyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la yang / brtsam ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rtsad pan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba spu dad du mdzad cing / de yang cod pan gyi dbang ni phung po lnga sbyong ba'i mi bskyod pa/ don 'grub/ rin 'byung / snang mtha'/ dam snang gi ngo bo'i rang bzhin rdo rje rtsad pan/ ljang gu/ nag po/ dmar po dkar po 'ching bar mdzad la/de nyid kyi phyir grub chen karma pa sna nyid kyis kyang / rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbu zhwa dkar ser dmar lngang sna tshogs mnabs te rtogs ldan gyi slob ma so so'i mgo bor 'ching bar mdzad pa la/rtogs ldan zhwa dmar can/ rtegs ldan zhwa dkar can/rtogs ldan zhwa ser can sogs mang du 'byung ba rnams dang / der ma zad stag gi mgo thod dang / gzig gi mgo thod dang / dom gyi mgo thod kyi rtsad pan slob ma'i mgo bor bcings pa'i dbang bskur ba mdzad pas rtogs ldan stag mgo ba dang / gzig mgo 18

ba dang / dom mgo ba zhes grags pa yang byung la/ gzig gi mgo nun sogs kyi rdo rje ris po che'i rtsad pan gyi dbang bskur ba sogs kyang rang cag gi spyod yul du ma grur pa'i rdo rje'i rgyud sde chen po rnams su 'byung ba ni ches gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul lo/ /dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba ni rlung bcu rnam par dag pa'i phar phyin bcu'i ngo bo'i nus ma bcu'i bdag nyid can gyi dar dpyangs nag po gnyis1 dmar po gnyis/ dkar po gnyis1 ser po gnyis/ ljang gu gnyis te bcu'i dbang bskur ba mdzad/ de yang grub chen karma bsna nyid kyi zhwa mgur las/ dar sna lnga dang ldan pa ni/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brda'/ /zhes 'byung la/ des na cod pan la kha dog lnga'i bdag nyid kyi rigs lnga so so'i sku dang phyag mtshan dang / sa bon can gyi rdo rje cod pan nam/ dbu rgyan nam/ zhwa nag rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa 'byung la/ rdo rje dar dpyangs la'ang nus ma bcu dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa'i sku gzugs phyag mtshan sa bon can gyi dar dpyangs mtha' yas pa 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ 'jam dpal da byangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mo go gan dang / tā ming rgyal po sogs rgya hor gyi rgyal po rnams kyis karma pa la rdo rje rid po che'i cod pan nag po dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bzo khyad mi 'dra ba du ma nun bsod nams kyi phyir phul ba las kyang nam zhig rgyal po de 19

dag kyang brtsam ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug dang /bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lor mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa na rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyal por gyur ba gdon mi za ba nyid kyi phyir/rgya hor gyi rgyal po de dag gis karma pa la mchod jis kyi dngos po dman pa re la'ang yul gru chen po gzhal du med pa'i rin spung can gyi mchod pas mchod pa ni rdo rje pha rol du phyin pa'i mchod pa bla na med pa'o/ /thes gsungs pa 'di dag ni sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul pa med pa ste khungs btsun zhing byin brlabs kyi tshan ka mchog dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sngon rabs mkhas pas gtan la phab pa'am/ /yang na ye shes dgongs pas ma gzigs pa'i/ /rgan po'i ngag sgros lta bu'i lo rgyus ni/ /dman la 'grim mod dam pa'i btang stoms gnas/ /tshogs gnyis bral ba'i gang zag mchog dman 'gas/ /zang zing bsdus pa'i cod pan tsam mthong na/ /yi da bzhin dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu la/ /rdo bar 'dzin pas rang nyid dbul dang mtshungs/ /'di ni rdo rje'i gsang ba zab mo'i tshig /rdo rje'i sar gnas mi bskyod rjes bkal ba/ /rdo rje'i rigs can rnams kyi khyad nor te/ /skal chad rtog ge rnams kyis 'dir ma gzigs/ /de ltar rgyal dbang karma pa nyid la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas phrin 20

las kyi dbang bskur ba'i rtags kyi phyag rgya zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan dbu la gsol ba'i tshe/ zhal mjal ba/ mchod pa'i sprin spro ba/ gsol 'debs dang smon lam la brtson pa de dag gi 'bras bu ni/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis gong gi dbu zhwa'i lo rgyus de dag mdor bsdus tshigs bcad du bstan pa'i 'phror 'di ltar gsungs te/ de nas zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa yi/ /karma pa zhes mchog gi sprul sku ni1 /sangs rgyas phrin las ma rdzogs de srid du/ /'gro 'dren karma'i phrin las rgyun mi chad/ /yang ni rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje dang / /de bzhin ga shegs pa la sogs karma pa1 /mchog gi sprul sku rgyun mar byung 'ga' la/ /'jam pa'i da byangs kyi rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba'i/ /rgya nag stang go rgyal pos phul ba yi/ /zhwa nag gser mdongs nor bu spras pa de/ /dbu laXbazhes nas 'dzam bu gling pa yi/ /skye 'gro'i tshogs la spyan ras gzigs kyi skur/ /mngon sum zhal bstan mdzad pa'i dus nyid la/ /skal ldan blo mig dag pa'i snang ba la/ /da bu rgyan dbus nas brtsam ldan 'od dpag med/ /rigs bdag tshul gyi gzhan la bstan par mdzad/ 1de lta'i dbu rgyan mthing ga rmad byung 'di1 /skal mchog rnams kyis mthong ba'i mod nyid la/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan stsol bar mdzad/ /skal med sdig can dag gis mthong ba'i tshe/ /bskal stong sogs bsag sdig sgrib 'dzad par byed/ /21

tshe 'di'i phun tshogs ji ltar 'dod pa rnams/ khyod la dmigs nas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang zhwa nag lan gcig mthong ba'i skad cig gis grangs bgrang ba'i bskal par ngan song gi skye sgo chod pa dang / gsung gcig thos pas lha mi'i skye ba 'bum thob ces grub chen karma bka'i zhal gyis bzhes pa sogs rgyal dbang na rim thams cad kyi gsung gsang mang du yod 'dug kyang 'dir de tsam du bdus so/ /'ga' zhig gis 'dul ba sogs dang mi mthun pas zhwa nag po skyon du bzung na theg pa thun mong la zhwa'i brda' mtshon gsal ba med cing 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub rnams rten 'brel gyi dgongs pas kha dog dang bzo dbyibs kyis so so'i grub mtha'i mtshan ma tsam du 'dzin / 'di ni gsang sngags kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i brda' mtshon yin tshul rgyas pa gong bsal ltar ro/ /de ma mjal ba'i phan yon sogs bla na med par the tshom na ston pa sangs rgyas mchog nas kyang gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa'i ngor bde dgyes sogs kyi skur bzhengs nas grangs med 'gro ba kad cig la 'dren par mdzad pa bzhin gsang sngags ni thabs mang la da ka' ba med pa'i tshul soms shig la las rgya hor gyi rgyal po rnams kyis phul ba'i las zhwa tsam mo snyam na1 sangs rgyas dang byang sems grangs med pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i rgyal sar dbang 22

bskur zhing cod pan 'ching ba la mi yi rgyal phran 'gas go sar bzhag pa tsam gyis las zhwa sogs la bstos pa med kyang / byang sems chen po kams kye sprul bsgyur rgyal po 'gas rin po che'i cod pan phul nas bde' tha bas du mas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i zhu ba po mdzad pas yon mchod gnyis ka smon lam rnam par dag pa'i thugs rje can yin pas mjal ba tsam gyis gong smras phan yon de dag 'byung bar gdon mi za'o/ /de bzhin rgyal da bang karma pa'i sprul bsgyur ya sras rnams las/ zhwa dmar dang si tu'i rtsad pan dmar po'i rdo rje rin po che'i rgyan can rgyal tshab kyi rtsad pan dmar ser rnams kyang rgyal ba karma pa nyid dang da byer sked par bstan 'gro'i don chen skrub cig pa'i bka' brtag gi rtsad pan thugs bskyed rten 'byung /smon lam dang bcas chos kyi rgyal sar mnga' gsol ba'i mtshan ma yin pas rgyal ba nyid dang rnam par dbyer med mchis so/ /gzhan yang dpal rgyal dbang karma pa la bla sprul su dang gang la'ang ma 'dra ba'i dbu zhwa nag po zhig bzhes dgos pa ni/ dpal karma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa dgung lo bcu drug par chos 'khor ka brag ces pa ba /'a gdams kyi dgon pa na rngog lo'i slob ma tre bo mchog gi bla ma dkung lo bdun cu pa nas mkhan po dang / slob dpon chag seng ge brag las rab tu byung / dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan gsol/ gtsug phud dor 23

ba'i tshe ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis mkha' 'gro ma bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbu skra nyag ma re las byas pa'i iṇ+ḍa snru ti'i zhwa nag gi rtsad pan dbu la gsol te dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus su mdzad pa'i phyir/ karma pa zhes mtshan gsol ba bla slob kun gyis gzigs pas de nas bzung dbang rtags rigs kyi cod pan de dbu la rang grub tu yod pa yin na'ang / snyigs dus kyi gdul bya sems can ma rig pa dus gsum 'tshang che ba'i stabs kyis mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du 'di 'dra khrig go snyam pa'i mjal ba'i skal ba dman pa rnams la de mtshon byed kyi dbu zhwa nag po mnabs/ zhes chos 'byung mang po las zha mthun par gsungs pa ma zad/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rtsad pan bzang po mthon ka'i rtser/ /skra mchog mthon ka chen po 'chang / /nor bu bzang po 'od chags ldan/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes dang / yo rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rdo rje'i lung las/ /i shā ming can cod pan nag po 'dzin/ 1mtha' dmag bzlog cing rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel/ /zhes dang / yang yo rgyan chen pos/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa'i sras gcig pu/ /rgyal ba'i da bang po zhwa nag rtsad pan 'dzin/ /bod yu gdul byar dgongs te nges par 'byon/ /zhes sogs dus gsum rgyal 24

ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus kyi bdag nyid/ dpal karma pa zhes yongs grags pa'i sku'i phreng ba ji snyed cig byon pa rnams gang 'dul 'phrin las kyi sgo nas rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don ci yang mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag yin/ 'di rnams kyi 'phrin las ga rtsa bo ni mthong grol zhwa nag rin po che 'di nyid yin/ 'di ni dus gsum gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan ldan rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / sangs rgyas gnyis pa gu ru rin po che gnyis kyis lung bstan pa ltar/ rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng spums cad kyi dbur rgyan du bzhugs pa yin/ 'on kyang sgrib pa chung ba'i skyes bu las can kha shas las/ thams cad kyis mjal ba ma yin/ da sto dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa 'di ni/ karma pa sku phreng lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa/ rgya nag tu phebs te mchod gnas su gyur skabs chos rgyal chen po'i bsod nams bzang po'i spyan ras kyis/karma pa'i dbur dbu zhwa nag po zhig bzhes pa rgyun du mjal bas/de la dpe byas te mthong grol 'di nyid bsod nams kyi zhing sar bskrun pa yin/ de nas bzung tshang mas mjal rgyu yod pa 'di byung / 'di nyid la gang zag so so'i las skal dang mthun par mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma yong gi yod/ kha shas kyis dbu zhwa nyis brtsegs bzhes pa dang / la las 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa/'ga' res 'ja' 'od kyi klong na gsal ba sogs shin tu mang /25

'di'i mtshon don yang / mdog mthing nag tu mthong ba ni/ chos nyid la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda dang / sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i brda ru rtse mo gsum du snang ba/ tshad med bzhis 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda ru ngo sgo gru bzhi pa la sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa ni 'phrin las bzhis gdul bya'i don spyod pa dang / sprin ris kyi brgyan pa ni thugs rje phrin las phyogs lhung rmad pas kun la khyab pa'i brda dang / thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i rang rtags su khyung gshog gis mdzes pa/ chos sku'i rgyal sar dbang brnyes shing / gcig shes kun grol gyi mkhyen pa'i rtsal rdzogs te 'od gsal 'khor yug gis ting 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba'i rtags su nyi zla nor bu'i tog gis spras pa sogs ye shes kyi rol pa 'gog tu med pa khro na'o/ 1 da ni rgyal dbang na rim gyi 'khrungs yul dang mtshan dang sku tshe'i tshad tsam 'dir bri bar bya ste/dpal rgyal dbang karma pa na rim gyi mdzad rnam/dang po rje dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ mdo khams tre shod du sgom pa rdo rje mgon dang lha thog bza' sgang lcang ming 'dren gyi sras su lcags stag lor 'khrungs/ mes po sgom pa stong dpon shes rab mgon po dang yab la lha mo rang byung ma dang rnying ma'i chos skor 'ga' zhus/ grub rtags thon te brag la zhabs rjes byung /rang gi sku dgra btul/ rgya bar be+e ro dang dpal 'dzin sogs la 26

bram ze mchog sred kyi mgon po zhus zhes rje karma phrin las pas gsungs/ dgung lo bcu drug la bye bo mchog gi bla ma las rab tu byung / gtsug phud dor ba'i tshe ye shes kyi ḍā gi ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis mkha' 'gro'i dbu skra las byas pa'i zhwa nag gi cod pan bcings te sangs rgyas spums cad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus su mdzad pa'i phyir karma pa zhes mtshan gsol bar gzigs pas phyis dbu zhwa nag po mnabs/ jo bo rje'i slob ma yol chos dbang dang / kra ra ba sogs bsten nas jo bo nas brgyud pa'i gad mas pa ma lus pa gsan/ nyi shu la da bus su phebs nas stod lung rgya dmar ba dang / phya pa chos kyi seng ge las byams chos dang dbu tshad bslabs/ mal 'dul 'dzin las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sha rwa ba dang shes rab rdo rje la lo drug gi ring bka' gdams gsan1 dpal rga lo/ bla ma a seng / spen phug pa skya mo spang kha ba/ grub chen rdzong pa/ brag dkar ba rnams la bod yul na spyir grags pa'i gzhung man ngag thams cad gsan/dgung lo sum cu par rje dwags po mjal nas chos thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs chod/ sgom tshul la'ang chos mang du gsan/ sgam por lo gsum bsgoms pas yon tan dpag med 'khrungs/ chos rjes lung bstan te zangs ri tes phu/ phag mo gru/ 'ol kha sogs su bsgoms/ mon dom tshad dang jo mo gangs su bsgoms pas dag 27

pa'i gzigs snang mtha' ya sa/ rje ras chung pa dang lhan cig skyes sgron sogs mi la'i dngos slob bdun gyi gdams ngag tshang sprugs su rdzogs/ 'phan yul ja bzang brag gzhu'i lha ri rgyal po/ byug po sogs su bsgoms pas grub rtags mang du thon/ zhe gnyis la gru bzhir tshogs pa bskyangs/ rje dwags pos gzhan la ma gnang ba'i bskyed rim lhan cig skyes ma dang rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med gnang nas bu khyod skrub pa khams kyi ka po gangs rar phyis 'gro don dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab par 'byung ngo / zhes lung bstan pa ltar nga lnga la ke po dang du phebs te 'og min mkha' spyod sku yi gdan sa dang po ke po gnas nang phyag btab/ mnal 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa rgyun chad med pa de nas byung / chos rjes de mkhyen nas lung bstan par 'dug bka' bzhin skrub pa'i byin rlabs kung yin te 'ong gsungs/ bka' babs kyi bu bzhi sogs slob ma'ang bgrang las 'das pa 'dus/ gnas dang gang zag 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis srid mtha'i bar du sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi chad pa sogs pegs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'go bo grub gnas 'di nyid nas byung ba yin la karma ka chang zhes bya ba'i mtshan don yang ke gnas 'di nyid las byung ba zhes gar dbang grub pas /sungs so/ /dkung lo drug cu par khams li thang du 'dab spang phug dgon pa btab/ ji—de ltar ka po gnas nang dang 28

'dab sgang phug sogs su lo nyi shu tsam bzhugs/ dgung lo don bzhi pa la 'bri klung phyogs su phebs nas gdan sa bar pa karma dgon dang / don bdun bzhes pa'i tshe gling gi sgar mal du dgon pa btab/ zhang rin po ches de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyo da pa'i rnam par rol ba yin no/ /zhes 'dud par mdzad de deng sang drug pa seng ger grags pa ni zhang dang paṇa chen shākya kas lung bstan yin/ brgyad cu bzhes pa'i tshe mtshur phu'i mchod khang gong ma mdzad / brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhes par ma 'ongs pa na yon bdag dgon pa'ang rgyal po gcig tu skye bar gyur/ de 'khor dang bcas pa la nged kyi phan 'dog pa 'ongs gsung pa sogs rlar sprul pa'i sku dngos su 'byon par lung bstan te sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /'das ma 'ongs da lta rnams su chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyis lung bstan pa rnams de kho na ltar thog tu babs pas dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes rgyal khams su grags la mtshan yang de skad du grags so/ /gnyis pa grub thob karma pa'i ni/ rje dus mkhyen zhing du gshegs kha yang srid dngos su 'byon rgyu'i zhal chems star/ mdo khams 'bri chu'i rgyud du yab rgyal dbang tshun tsha dang yum sems mang skyid kyi sras su shing byi lo sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu dgu lon tshun chad sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab spums cad thugs la rang shar 29

byung bas bla ma mang por bsten ma dgos/ bla ma'i ga rtsa bo rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rgyud 'dzin gyi bka' babs 'gro mgon ras chen gyi slob ma rgyal sras spom brag pa yin/ rab tu byung tshe dpal chen po chos kyi bla ma zhes mtshan gsol/ ka:thog pa byams pa 'bum las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sku tshe stod kyi sgrub gnas ga rtsa bo shar phyogs spung ri yin/ byang chub sems dang rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pa slob dpon pad+ma dang rna ma dbyer med par bstan nas 'dzam gling 'dul bar mdzad pas karma la zhes yongs su grags pa'ang de nas byung / mtshur phur lo drug bzhugs te gdan sa zhig gso dar rgyas spu mdzad/ gnam mtsho phyug mos gser gyi bum pa phul te zhabs la btud/ lha mos ke tshang gi chos rgyud 'tshin pa cig yin phyin sprub tha bas mi shes kyang sdong grogs thams cad bgyis par srog snying phul/ de nas chu byi lor hor du phebs dgos pa'i brda du byung ba ltar dgung lo ba gnyis par hor yul du phyag btegs/ pho brang 'u tor byon nas rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis rnyed bkur gzab cing rgyas pa zhus/ der yod kyi mu stegs pa dang 1 zin shing la sogs pa'i rtog ge ba'i slob dpon rnams byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul gyis btul zhing pham par mdzad/ thams cad la sku bzhi'i ngo sprod dang dbang lu nga khrid bka' rgya cher bstsal te chos la bkod/ gi chur dngam dpal ser po phyag stong spyan stong zhal gzigs pa sku skye 30

phyi ma gnyis kyi 'phrin las kyi brda dgongs/ go pe las yod mchod 'phrod pas rtag tu 'u tor bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang rje nyid kyis 'byung 'gyur gyi bde dogs thams cad mngon par mkhyen cing / zhal gyis ma bzhes/ lcags sprel lor rgyal po go be la se chen han rgyal po'i khri la da khod nas/ lcags bya lor grub thob chen po la 'byon dgos pa'i lung bcas pho nya mngags te gshed ma la gtad pas grub thob chen pos grub rtags bstan te gshed ma khag gcig khrig bskyugs te shi/ mtshon cha rnams dum bur 'thor pas rgyal po go be la khros te gshed ma rnams bsad/grub thob chen po chu la bskyur baXdang me la bsregs/ mtshon dang dug la sogs pas sku la drag po'i khrims chad ci rigs par spyar yang rin po che'i sku zil ji rgyas kyis sku la nyam ngal gang yang ma byung / skabs 'di grub thob rin po che'i zhal tshom la spug pa btags te dpyang thag btang bas nga karma sha og tshom chod/khyod rgya nag rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud chod gsungs pas zhal tshom chad/de'i bden tshig gis rgya'i rgyal rgyud kyang chad pa sogs lo rgyus du ma zhig ngag rgyun du gleng srol yod/ sa byi lor bod kyi phyogs su phyag btegs/ phebs lam du can mkhar nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs dbon sde mang po 'dus nas rin po che mjal/ so sor dgon pa 'debs par zhus kyang ma gnang / shing kun mkhar dang nye 31

bar rgya yul gyi lha 'dre mang pos bar chad brtsams pa la rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis thams cad zil gyis mnan pa bcas rgya hor mi nyag yu gur la sogs pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus nas bun du bkol ba na/ yi dam dbang gyur snang srid dbang du bsdus/ /sog po mu stegs rgyal po'i dregs pa btul/ /mi chu dug mtshon 'byung po'i nus pa bcom/ /karma bka'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces tshigs su bcad pa'i gsol 'debs sho lo ka gcig gis karma bka'i skabs de'i mdzad pa rnams phyogs bsdoms rags tsam byas pa ltar/ karma pas rgya hor gyi bla ma mdzad pa'i thog ma 'di nas byung / rgya bod hor gsum/ yu gur mi nyaga'ajang la sogs pa'i yul gru skad rigs tha dad pa'i mi rigs mang po'i rgyal khams thams cad la chos dar dkar po'i 'phrin las chen po'i sgo nas 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas thu tshe 'di'i gdul bya re zhig rdzogs par nye ba gzigs pa'i dus su gnam sa bangs kyi ka ba lta bu grub thob chen po yo rgyan pa rin chen dpal thugs rgyal dang bcas mtshur phur karma pa mjal du byung / ba la dang por lta stongs mdzad pas khong dpon slob rnams ba 1ba pa dang / ga yo ba dang / 'phar ba sogs byung / de nas yo rgyan pa'i dgongs tshul rnams mngon mkhyen thogs pa med pa mang po gsungs pas yo rgyan pa rin po che'i khengs dregs kyi thugs spobs spums cad rtsa ba nas 32

zhi/ ma 'ongs pa'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dang o rgyan pa rin po che'i gdul bya gar yod sogs lung bstan gsung gleng zhib rgyas su mdzad rjes bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams dang / sku gsum ngo sprod kyi phyag dpe/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag gcig bcas yo rgyan rin po cher gtad de 'di rnams khyed kyis mgo 'don byed dgos pa zhig yong bas de la gtod/ nga dang myur du 'phrad dgos gsungs/ de nas mi ring ba gdul bya'i don du sprul pa'i sku shes bya kun la mkhas pa zhig gnam nas bya babs pa bzhin myur du 'ong jo gsungs/dbon rin po che la gdan sa gtad de dgung grangs brgyad cu pa la dbongs pa chos dbyings su stom par bzhugs so/ /bstan brtsas mdzad pa'ang bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gnyis tsam yod par grags/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdan sa gong 'og bar gsum du dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa sogs 'dzam gling du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i blob ma'i tshogs shin tu mang bas blos gzhal bar mi nus so /gsum pa rje rang byung rdo rje ni/ la sto da kyi mang yul gung thang gi rtsa phur yab ston pa chos dpal dang yum jo mo g.yang 'dren spyo sras su shing pho sprel lor mngal gyi dri mas ma gos pa lta bur 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum bzhi nas rdo ba'i khri chung ngu la bzhugs 33

nas byis pa rnams la sku gsum ngo sprod sogs zab chos gsung ba dang / /spru ma smig rgyu 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /snang ba bden pas stong pa kho bos rtogs/ /ma rtogs byis pa khyed rnams snying re rje/ /zhes gsungs pa ni tshigs bcad gsungs pa'i thog ma'o/ /dgung lo lnga par sngar karma sha don rgyud kyi bstan pa gtad/phyag dpe dang zhwa nag sogs bstsal nas bkas mngags pa ltar grub thob chen po o rgyan pa rin chen dpal la rin po che karma pa 'byon pa la 'od kyi dra bas khengs pa sogs gzigs snang shin tu bsal ba mang po byung / bdun pa la mkhan po kun ldan shes rab las rab tu byung / phyis gzhon nu byang chub las bsnyen par rdzogs/ o rgyan pa sogs bla ma brgya dang bcu gsum tsam bsten/ bod gangs can la bzhugs pa'i chos la ma gsan pa dang mi mkhyen pa gcig kyang med/ khyad par gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis ka'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ mtshur phur phyag btegs par lam du lha 'dre du mas bsu ba zhus la sngags bdag gis chu mig dwangs gtsang zhig phul/ mtshur phur phebs ma thag ma mgon rnams shin tu dgyes pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa gzigs pas ma mgon gyis bstod pa mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu bzhes par karma lha steng phyag btab ste 'dus sde btsugs/ tsha ba sgang sogs mang por byon pas gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu ba zhabs tog rgya chen po byas/ mi ma yin rnams 34

bka' la btags pas kol ti'i 'khrugs pa chen po yang zhi bar mdzad/ der ji ma la mdzod spur thim par gzigs pas rdzogs pa chen po'i don thams cad rtogs shing rdzogs chen snying thig gi yig cha mdzad/ mnal lam du mdo sde'i bstan brtsas mdzad/ kun spyod kyi 'grel pa mdzad tshe mkha' 'gros mchod/ 'khor dang snyan grags mi bzod par sngags pa brgyad kyis phur par gshin rje bsgrubs nas mthu byas pas dgra nag zhal gsum phyag drug gis sngags sgra sgrogs shing de'i rigs sngags bzlog phur pa dibs te sngags pa thams cad shi/ rong btsan kha ba dkar por byon nas nas yig mdzad/ rtsa ring o rgyan rin po che dang dngos su mjal nas dbang lung rdzogs par gnang 1 khams phyogs su byon te 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas dbus su byon pa na gzhi bdag thams cad dang / khyad par thang lhas bsu ba rgya cher zhus/ lha sar jo bo la gser gyi gdugs phul tshe phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa sogs thugs snang bzang po shar/ dgung lo so lngar mtshur phu'i skung na bzhugs kabs phyi nang gi gza' skar dus spyor thams cad gzigs te rtsis kun btus pa'i bstan brtsos mdzad/ bon gyi chos 'byung las lcags rta lor bon ri pa 'brug sras kyis karma pa dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa la rje rang byung zhabs kyis bon ri'i gnas sgo phye te brag la nyi zla rang byon gyi rtags dang 35

zhabs rjes mang po bzhag ces so/ /de nas mtshur phur phebs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ lcags lug lor hor rgyal po thog the mur 'ja' yan du rgyal po nas sngon karma bkar mong gol rgyal pos phul nas ma bzhes pa'i gser gyi tham ka 'ja' zer ma 'bul ba bcas spyan 'dren par dbus su 'byor te chu sprel lor hor yu la du chibs bsgyu ra/ rgya bod kyi phebs lam du 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ rgyal po'i pho brang du rgyal blon 'khor bcas la dbang bskur ba'i tshe khong rnams kyi so so'i rtogs pa gang shar mkhyen te lan btsal bas thams cad mngon pa mkhyen pa la ha las te mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ de nas thugs rje chen po'i lung bstan dang 1rgyal po chen po'i lung gis khyod chos kyi dbang phyug lags pas bdag la rig 'dzin pad+ma'i tshe chu bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de lta na bod kyi bsam yas nas 'don dgos gsungs nas lan gcig bod du 'byon par chas pas rgang ma chen pos chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas karma pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cho lo sogs phul/ de nas gdan sa mtshur phur phebs/dgun bsam yas mchims phur zla ba drug bzhugs nas mkhas btsun mang po'i skrub sde btsugs mkhas btsun klong chen rab 'byams pa khrid pa dpon du bskos/ rin po che las bka' bstan 'gyur ro rtsag bzhengs te rab tu gnas par mdzad/ gong ma'i sku tshe 36

bsring ba'i ched du bsam yas phu nas rtsu 'phrul gyes tshe chu spyan drangs gong ma nas gdan 'dren pa yang yang byung nas me byi lo slar yang hor yul du thengs gnyis pa phyag btebs/ phebs lam du 'gro don dpag med mdzad de gong ma'i pho brang du phebs/ mchod yon gnyis dang blon tha'i shri kho na las med sa gong ma la tshe dbang gnang ste tshe chu drangs/ de'i stobs kyis hor gyi rgyal sar mnan pa la rgyal po sku tshe ring shos 'di byung / de nas gyi mi shan du bzhugs kabs sa g.yos 'byung nyen 'dug gsungs pas gong ma mchod yon gzim gur bzhugs/ me glong lor sa g.yos kyis mkhar grong mang po zhigs/ rje la skyabs zhus pa thams cad la skyon ma byung / skabs de rgya dang mdo smad pa'i ban de ngan pa 'ga'i bya spyod la brten nas chos la mi dga' ba dang / mi dpon mang po'i bsgros phyogs kyis dgon pa rnams bshigs/ ban de mi gtsang ba thams cad khral dmag 'ul gsum bskul rgyu'i lung bsgrags pa la sus kyang zhus ma phod/ de'i tshe pho brang gi khrims ra 'u mon gdong gi tshogs chen sa ra rin po che phebs nas khri'u la bzhugs/rgyal blon ldams cad la rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'i bka' bkyon pas jims cad dad cing skrag nas de ma spug dgon gnas lha khang kams gan nas gso ba dang / ban de thams cad gtsang mi gtsang med par dar gan du 'don pa'i 'ja' sa phyogs spums cad du 37

bsgrags/ ta'i tu'u shing kun la kar sde'i dgon pa bzhengs/de nas sa yos lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mor zla dkyil las rgyal blon 'khor bcas la kal bstan pa sogs ya mtshan mtha' yas pa byung ngo / /bzhi pa rje rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ rang byung bas shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams su sprul sku 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ de dang nye ba'i rngod a la rong du yab bsod nams don 'grub dang yum brtson 'grus rgyan las 'brug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la 'khrungs/ sku bltams ma thag ma ṇi dang dpyangs gsal gyi gsung byung bas yab dogs pa skyes pas/ yum gyi nga la rmi lam bzang po byung bas the tshom mi dgos zhe sa rmis ltas gsungs pas dogs pa gsal bar gyur/ ngo mtshar gyi lta sa mngon gsal can mang po byung / dgung lo gsum la myang por byon/ de'i tshe yum la nga karma sha skye ba yin/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir nga'i gdul bya mang po 'ongs/ khyod lhos shig gsungs nas 'chi med 'phrul 'khor mdzad/ bla ma'i gtso bo rgyal ba g.yung ston pa dang / mgon po rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan dar rgyal ba gsum yin/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnyis ka dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen don 'grub dpal las mdzad/ chos spums cad thogs med du mkhyen pas slob gnyer cher ma mdzad kyang / zhwa nag 38

can bdun rgyud kyi nang nas dbu tshad la 'di pas mkhas/ snyan ngag brtsams pa'ang 'di bas legs pa med ces rje 'phrin las pas gsungs/ 'dul ba'i phyag len la thugs rtsol lhag par che zhing /sgar chen gyi gzi brjid dang sde tshugs 'dzin pa'ang 'di nas byung /dgung lo bcu bzhi par sa g.yos shin tu che ba bar ma chad par byung nas bod kyi mi nor sa khang gzhis la 'jig tshabs shin tu che ba byung dus bod kyi lha mi'i mam gtso rnams nas bla lha khag la skyabs zhus pas sus kyang bzlog ma nus/ de nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku karma par skyabs zhus te 'jigs pa rnams nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlabs nas bod kyi mi nor zog gsum mang po srog gi nyen kha las skyabs par mdzad/ 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra mo rnams kyang bsrung zhing / sha spru tsam dang / chang gi dri tsam yang spyan lam du mi 'grim/ sku'i nye 'khor du glegs bam mang po bkod nas bzhag pa mnal lam du gzigs pas de thams cad kyi tshig don thugs su chud cing / yi ge'i rigs mi 'dra ba yang drug cu tsam mkhyen/ hor gyi rgyal po tho gan the mur gyis spyan drangs te byon/ hor rgas las grub pa'i dbu zhwa rin po ches spras pa phul/ lu pan shan du rgyal po rat+na/ btsun rma su dī dha ri ba6sa smin par mdzad nas/ 'phan chen du grags pa dar zab las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dos chen sum cu so gnyis dang /39

ldem gnyis la dos brgyad yod pa de sogs phul/ sprul pa'i dzo gi lnga yi byang chub kyi shing la 'phags pa klu skrub kyis phyag brkos mdzad pa'i rten gan sto la yang phul ba bod du drangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phyag rjes rgya cher mdzad de bod du phebs nas sngon gyi sprul pa'i rgyal po dang skyes chen mang pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang bya 'dabs bdun pa dang dgu pa sogs ngo mtshar can sum stong bdun brgya yod pa de thams cad nyams gso dang / mchod pa'i tshogs rgya chen po dang mar me'i rgyun dpag med btsugs/ lu ban shan du che li ci'i dmag gi 'jigs pa bskyabs/ gcan gzan ma rung zas 'tshe ba'i yu la du bka' shog gnang bas zhi/ de nas rim gyis karma dgon du phebs te chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor/rje gong mas lung bstan pa'i ri shod nying phug steng chen du btsug lag khang bzhengs/ der bsdus don gyi bstan bcos mdzad/dgung lo zhe bzhi par byang phyogs sa mtho sa zhig tu sku gdung bzhu na ma 'ongs pa bod la rgya dmag mi 'ong ba'i zhal bzhes dang bcas mya ngan las 'das/ rje nyid kyi slob ma rgya mtsho lta bu las gu'i gung rin chen dpal dang / sras kyi thu bo dpal mkha' spyod dbang po gnyis bcas so/ /lnga pa rje de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ rje gong ma'i lung bstan bzhin du myang 'dam gyi sar shing pho byi ba'i lo la yab sngags 40

pa gu ru rin chen dang / yu ma lha mo skyid las ya mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas bltams/ bla ma'i gtso bo rje mkha' spyod dbang po yin/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po las rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs rim bzhin mdzad/ mtshan chos dpal bzang por gsol/ gsang phu nas bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal dang / gu yi gung pa rin chen dpal sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas sde sgod kyi gsan sbyong rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhes par tā ming rgyal pos gdan drangs/ nan cing grong khyer gyi lcags ri phyi ma'i nang du gong ma rang nyid phebs bsur bcar te mjal dar dang / gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa zhig phul/ karma pas kyang mjal dar thog dung dkar ga sa 'khyil zhig 'bul gnang mdzad/ de nas rje nyid kyis rgyal po yab yum gyi 'das mchod la ris med kun grol gyi rim grol rgya cher bsgrubs pas tā ming rgyal pos gser gyi byang shing la rgya yig dang bod yig thog de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che/ chos kyi rgyal po/ nub phyogs byams pa chen po/ zhi ba dbang phyug gi sangs rgyas/ zhes pa'i mtshan rgyan dang / shel dam/ 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab bcas phul/ dus des de bzhin gshegs pa dang tā ming g.yung lo rgyal po gnyis me— phag lo'i rgya zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nas bco brgyad bar dang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes 41

gsum nas bco brgyad bar nyen re'i mdzad sgo ji gnang skabs de ri mo mkhas pa dag gis bris rte yin thang la rgya hor bod yu gur tur rde bcas yig sna lnga dang ldan pa'i bris thang de la ngo mtshan 'ja' sa gsi thang mar grags shing / mjal dus gzhog g.yas nas g.yon phyogs su tshur zhal 'byed dgos pa'i phred thang ri mo'i nang nyin mo re bzhin gyi mdzad pa rnams so sor byas pa'i khyon rnam grangs ling rtse bzhi bcu zhe dgur dbye ste bris yod cing /ling rtse re re'i nang du ngo re re bzhen nan cing rgyal sa'i yul bkod dang / g.yas phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs yul ling gu si'i dgon pa gtsug lag khang thogs brtsegs gsum pa la g.yu tsi'i rgya phebs byas pa dang / g.yas phyogs su skrub mchod gnang sa'i gzhal yas khang chen mo thog brtsegs bzhi pa la rgya jibs can/ khang brtsegs bzhi pa de'i rgyab tu da dung 'phar du thogs brtsegs bzhi dang rgya 'ibs bcas mthong rgyu yod pa'i jing bsrel mchod rten du grags pa shin tu mtho ba rnams la 'ja' tshon sna snga'i gur khyim dang g.yas g.yon nas 'ja' glang chen mche ba gyen du zeng ba 'dra ba dang / 'ja'i ka ba zug pa/ nam mkha' 'ja' sprin sna tshogs 'khrigs pa la sogs gong gsal gyi rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa nyid dang gnyis so sor ling tse byas nas mu 'brel ri mor bkod pa bcas mtshar du dngar zhing gson nyams ldan pa'i phred thang gzhi 42

dar shog 'dra ba glang ko'i srab mthug tsam pa/ dkyus la li'i rmid ༄༄dang phred la ring tshad li'i rmid ba⑫༄ra yod pa zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la phul/ (deng dus nor gling rig dngos bdag gnyer khang du gces spras gnang mus/ ) de bzhin gshegs pas rgyal po yab yum gyi 'das mchod mdzad kabs bdun phrag gnyis ring cho ga mdzad pa la nyin ltar gong ma yab yum byon te drung nas dbang bskur re re mdzad/ gzhan rnams kyis sgrol ma'i chog mdzad/ tshes bcu bzhi zhig la 'ja'i kur phub/ gong ma mchod yon la gnas bcu zhal gzigs/ shing sdong gcig gi mgo nas bdud rtsi babs/ shing sdong gcig la gser gyi me tog shar/ spyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nyin cho ga'i dbu tshugs pa nas tshes bco brgyad ma grol gyi ra du 'ja' 'od sna tshogs 'khrig pa dang / me tog gi char nyin gcig ltar babs pa rgyal 'bangs thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong ngo / /tshes bcu dgu'i mtshan mo gong ma'i yum gyi mtshan byang drung gis bzhu bar mdzad/ gzhan bla grwa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon rnams rgya mtshor gshom rgyur 'dren pa'i tshe glang po che la rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang /dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas kyis gdan drangs nas chab la bshams/ de ltar rmad du byung ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par grags/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa 43

rgyal po'i pho brang nas ri bo rtse lngar byon te bzhugs ring 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs te bgro gleng dngos su gnang / rin chen dmar po'i gter kha brdol/ skabs rer mchod rten du 'ja' 'od klongs nas sku gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar du ma byung ba rnams gong mas lung gi zhu yig 'phral 'phral du phul ba snga phyi bcu phrag lhag pa 'dug pa'i nang ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang ba 'dug ces chos 'byung bde ther du gsal1 rgya yul du kar dgon mang du btab/ bod du go ka1 chen shrī/ du dben sha sogs kyi las ka mang po zhus/ karma rgya lha/ karma gan dril/ karma gan shog karma gan gos/ karma gan dkar sogs nor dngos khyad can thams cad rje 'di yi phyag phyir byung / gdan sa mtshur phu bskyangs skabs lha ldan du phebs nas jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi snam spyor sogs mchod sprin dang / dbus gtsang gi sde dgon yongs rdzogs la mchod rdzas mang 'gyed rnam bzhag sogs mchod sbyin rgya cher spel/ mtshur phu zhig gsos dang gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ de nas dbus gtsang gi bdag po sne'u gdong hran ha dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan nas lha sa po tā la bzhugs gnas su phul nas rtse la bzhugs/ twa ming gong ma chen po g.yung lo nas bla na med pa'i 'bul chen thengs gsum 'byor/ mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i rmad byung 44

gi mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba 'ba' zhig sangs rgyas 'jig rten du dngos su byon pa dang mi ga nyis pa'i rgya bod hor gsum gyi gdul bya ris su ma chad pa mji' dag 'di la 'di phyi'i bde legs kyi ska ba bzang po zad mi shes par sbyin par mdzad pa'i bka' drin lha yul las mi shong ba bskyangs/ skabs skabs su ma 'ongs lung bstan yang gsung te1 dper na/ de phyir 'byung 'gyur 'di ltar ste/ /zhwa nag can gyi skye rgyud 'di/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du gnas/ /ka rgyan lung las de skad gsungs/ /bdag la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la / /rtsa gcig mtshams nas karma pa'i1 /zhing 'di'i sku phreng 'gro don rdzogs/ /gzhan don longs sku'i zhib khams ‘nyul/ /'jig rten khams rnams spums nud du/ /rnam 'phrul 'gro don char pa phab/ /ces gsung gang yin yid ches kyis/ /da ni 'di nas ka yi rabs/ /bcu drug gam ni bcu bdun mtshams/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang ke tshang bstan/ /nam gzhug zad pa'i sprung bu 'dra/ /shar phyogs gnam bskos rgyal brgyud chad1 /rgyal sa mtha' mi sus thob byed/ /byang shar gnyis nas mtha' mi brdol/ /bod yul a long bzhin du 'khor/ /dbus kyi rgyal po'i bsod nams zad/ /ji ltar byas kyang phyin ci log/su la smras kyang tshur la rgol/ /bzang spyod nub nas ngan spyod dar/ /mtha' mi 'khrul gyi 'khor lo yis/ /mkha' la 'gro 45

zhing yul la blta/ /dus ngan de 'dra byung ba'i dus/ /blo bde skyid pa'i snang ba med/ /'on kyang sdug bsngal ma byed par/ 1dkan mchog yid dang 'bul mi bya/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gyis/ /sbas yul bzung la skrub pa gyis/ /ces gsungs/ yang gshen ye shes snying pos phyag dang bskor ba mang po byas nas zhus lan du/'o na gson dang ye shes snying / /'di nas bzung ste rdo rje'i mtshan/ /bcu bzhi'am ni bco lnga'i bar/ /gdan sa 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas/ /de nas bstan spyi nyams pa'i dus/ /'di'ang spyi mtshungs de dang 'dra/ /'on kyang thugs bskyed chen mo'i mthus/ 1rgyal bstan brtsad nas ma rdzogs bar/ /gdan sa 'di nyid stong mi 'gyur/ /'di rdzogs bstan mjug thams cad rdzogs/ /dar rgud sna tshogs re mos 'ongs/ /'di nas mdo khams smad kyi char/ /sde bcu dge ba'i yul phyogs na/ /las can rgyal po bstan la sman/ /de yi ring la mdo khams bde/ /de 'das sde dge nyams par 'gyur/ /de yang de yi yul sa na/ /dpal gyi ming can dgon pa 'byung / /'gro mgon ras chen sprul pas 'dzin/ /de dus nyi ma lta bu dang / /zla ba lta bu'i skyes bu gnyis1 /dus mnyam gcig tu zung 'brel 'byung / /ming ni ka dang kha yis 'dog 1de la 'brel tshad phyir mi ldog 1sgom de'i nang du spyan ras gzigs/ /sprul pa'i 'od zer cha shas 46

shig /sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin rgyal po 'ong / /de yis ring la sgom sde bde/ 1de 'das sgom phyogs nyams par 'gyur/ /mdo khams zal mo sgang rgyud la/ /las can skyes bu ston zla'i mdog /chos dbyings 'gyur med gshis la rdzogs/ /'brel thog pad+ma 'od du 'dren/ /de 'das mdo khams nyams par 'gyur/ /sa la spyod pa'i gdan sa 'dir/ /gnas brta na rna ma 'phrul ngur smig 'dzin/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa 'byung / 1de 'das 'i ma'i thugs glong thim/ /rdo rje'i phreng las mi bskyod ces/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /dper dang 'gran pa'i zla ma mchis/ /de yi thugs rje thugs bskyed kyis/ /kar bstan dar rgyas gsum gnyis bsrings/ /ka yi phreng ba bcu drug smad/ /bcu bdun 'go ru dam sri'i sprul/ /nā tha'i ming can bla ma zhig /sa spyod gdan sa 'di ru 'byung / /log smon de yi nus mthu yis/ /kar bstan phung la nye ba'i tshe/ /de dus sngon smon ldan pa yi/ /yo rgyan thugs sprul nub phyogs nas/ /spe ba'i do shal gtum drag thugs/ /zhal nas drag po'i gsung tshig 'byin/ /sprug nag mdog ldan spyan gnyis 'bur/ /dam log sprul pa de yis 'joms/ /de yis bod khams dar cig skyobs/ /de tshe bde ba nyi mthong tsam/ /bod yul 'di la 'byung bar snyam/ /de min las can byon na yang 1 /bstan pa mar la 'grib pa dang / /47

bdud smon log pa'i 'bus bu yis/ /bde ba 'ong bar dka' mo yin/ /dbus nas dbus kyi rgyal po nyams/ /bdud sprul blon po kong nas 'ong / /dbus dkrug dbus kyi chab srid zhig /sngar med mtha' mi mang po yi/ /gar byung med par nyil gyis 'gebs/ /dus ngan mi rnams bdud kyis bslus/ /chos ni mi mos sdug gis khengs/ /stod smad bar gsum gang la yang / /'khrug rtsod khrug gi char pa bab/ 1'thab dang 'khrug dang rtsod pa las/ /mthun cing bde ba'i lung pa med/ /dbul zhing brel ba kho na las/ /phyug cing dal ba'i lung pa med/ /mnar zhing bcings pa kho na las/ /rang dbang sdod pa'i long pa med/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum chos skyong rnams/ /thugs rje med pa ma yin kyang / /sems can las dang bdud smon stobs/ /dus dbang mar la 'grib dang thug /de tshe gsang sngags dam chos rnams/ /nus mthu che zhing byin rlabs myur/ /o rgyan chen po'i zhal snga nas/ /dus ngan me ltar 'bar ba'i dus/ /gsang sngags nus pa me ltar 'bar/ /zhes gsungs skrub blog de la gyis/ /khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs rje phrin las 'dus pa'i bdag snyigs ma'i skyabs gnas thams nud ni/ /gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /gtsug na sgom la gsol ba thob/ /gnyen po de las zab pa med/ /'di dgos mi dgos mang po bskyur/ /48

rang yid ches na de yi chog /mi bslu nges pa mchog gsum yin/ /blo gtad pha waṃ gtan zug gyis/ /ji star byung yang the tshom spangs/ /legs pa'i bya ba gang byed la/ /skar khung nang gi nyi zer bzhin/ /rang rang bde 'bras mngon gyur 'ongs/ khams gsum sems can pha ma soms/ /drin lan 'gro don khyad med gyis/ zhes gsungs so/ de ltar dus dang phyogs la nges pa med pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan kha gsal go bde mang po'ang gsung pa rnam thar dang zhal gdams las gsal/ dgung lo so gnyis pa rab byung bdun pa'i shing lug rgyal ba sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pas rje bdag nyid chen po thog mar mjal ba'i zla ba brgyad par sku 'brum bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ brtan bzhugs phul kyang / mdo khams karma'i nye logs su 'dun pa btang zin gsol ba thob thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin gsungs pa dang / gsol dpon la dpe mchod rten gsum rnams 'thor ra gyis bdag po zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs nas zla ba ra tshes15nyin rje spyan ras gzigs chos skyong ba'i rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba'i pho brang chen po po tā la'i rtse mo'i gzim khang du dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ 1mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po la sogs kyis mchod pa'i bya ba mdzad/ sku gdung rin po che bzhus pas thugs rje chen po dang / bde mchog dgyes rdor yab yum la 49

sogs pa'i sku dang ring bsrel dpag med byon/ lha sa dang mtshur phur zla ba mang po'i ring 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad pa byung / dngul gdung dang snang brnyan rin po che/ nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gser gyi bka' 'gyur mtshur phu'i lha khang bkra shis gsar mar bzhugs so/ /drug pa rje mthong ba don ldan ni/ rje de bzhin gshegs pas mdo khams karma'i nye logs su 'dun pa btad zin gsungs pa bzhin karma dang nye ba ngom gyi sar/ yab sngags 'chang nus pa can zhig dang yum rang bzhin gyi nol 'byor mar sprel lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la bltams/ dgung lo gsum ma lon pa nas khrom khri khag tsam la so so'i mos ba dang mthun pa'i chos gsungs/sku gzhon nu'i dus nas sog dbon rig pa'i ral gri la bsten nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho lta bu la sbyangs pas mkhas pa dang grub pa'i phul du phyin te/ than pas nyen pa'i dus chu rtsed mdzad pa dang / bka' bsgo tsam gyis kyang char gyi rgyun chen po babs par grags/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la dge 'dun sgang mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po shin tu bgres pa las rab tu byung /mtshan chos grags dpal bzang por gsol1 chos rje rong ston/zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes/ zha lu ba/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra sogs las kyang dbang lung mang du gsan/ rgya nag gi rgyal pos 50

ching has hra las grub pa rin po che du mas spras pa'i dbu zhwa 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag du grags pa zhig phul/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis gzhan la phan bde dpag tu med pa byung bas/ gsol ba 'de bas pa po rnams kyis sprul sku mthong ba don ldan la gsol ba 'debs so zhes brjod pas mtshan de ltar du grags/ mthar rtse lha sgang nas dpen gnas gsang phur phebs te rten kam rnams phyag dam mdzad sham bha la dang ma kha gnyis rtsod pa yod pas kho bo rigs ldan gyi grogs su 'gro dgos yod gsungs nas sku chos dang / dbu zhwa zhwa nag bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams la sogs pa'i phyag dpe rnams go shrī la gnang ste lung bstan shal chems bka' rgya yang mdzad/ de nas dgung grangs sum cu rtsa brgyad pa dgongs pa chos dbyings su thims so/ /bdun pa rje chos grags rgya mtsho ni/ rngod spyi mdor yab grub thob grags pa dpal grub dang yum lha mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su shing pho khyi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lngar 'khrungs/ chos thams cad mkhyen mkhyen par byon pas 'khrungs nas zhag bdun pa nas gsung chos gsungs pa nas bzung chos gsung tshad la thogs rdugs med/ zla ngo gnyis tsam nas khri la bzhugs khrom lha sde mi sde thams cad la phyag dbang mdzad/ zla ngo bzhi lnga tsam nas snye bor spyan drangs/ bla ma dbang brgya pa zhes ban rgan 'jam dpal 51

bzang po dang / go shrī dpal 'byor don 'grub gnyis las rab byung dang rim bzhin bsnyen rdzogs gsan nas bzung bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag 'dzam gling tsam la bzhugs tshad ma gsan pa med/'chad rtsod rtsom pa ci mdzad kyang sku drang por bsrang nas sha ra rar gsung pa ma gtogs thugs bsam skad cig kyang mi dgos par grags/gdul bya yang rgya dkar nag bal bod sogs 'dzam gling thams cad du khyab pa byung / rje 'di'i dag snang dang grub rtags sngon gnas dang ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur mkhyen tshul sogs ni 'dzam gli gi skye bo thams cad kyis kyang brjod pa mi nus/ rgya gar gyi pa rtse sna ta yi da kyi shing rta dang / sgra can 'dzin gzhon nu/ ma ga ka'i rgyal po sogs kyis gdan drangs kyang phebs par ma mdzad/ zhal slob kyi ga rtsa bo ni rgyal tshab pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa/ karma phrin las pa/ zha lu lo chen sigs mkhas shing grub pa thob pas ni sa chen yongs su khyab par gyur to/ /bstan bcos tshad ma rig gzhung rgya mtsho sogs mang ngo / /ma bar snga gong nas drung si tu pa la ngom gyi gnas dang bcas pa lung bstan chab shog bstsal zin pa pa dang / gsol rtsag steng du zhal chems phyag bris mi gsal tsam zhig 'jog gnang mdzad de/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum par chos kyi dbyings nyid bsdus so/ / brgyad pa mi skyod rdo rje ni/ rje gong mas sprul sku ngom du 52

'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ ngom chu rgyud pa gtam gyi grong du yab ma byams dang yum bla ma sgron las me yos zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bzhi yi snga dror sku bltams/ 'khrungs ma spug nas gsung byon/ zhag bcu gsum nas bzhengs te gar mdzad/ rgyal tshab bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan chos kyi grags pa dpal bzang por gsol/ drung 'khor ba rnams rang 'dod kyis bla ma gzhan bsten par tsam pa na sku chung ngu'i dus nas nga yi bla ma 'dan ma grub chen yin gsungs pa ltar/ de nyid las dge tshul sogs rgyud pa 'di yi dbang lung man ngag ma lus pa gsan1 dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen chos grub seng ge las bsnyen par rdzogs/ chos rje karma phrin las pa dang dud mo bka shis 'od zer sogs bsten nas gsan bsam bsgom pa cher mdzad pas lung rtogs kyi yon tan yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang mtshungs/ 'phags pa chen po rnams kyis kyang rnam par thar pa gting dpag dka' ba mnga'/ 'jang rgyal pos spyan drangs te 'jang yul du phebs/ gong ma cing des pho nya btang nas spyan drangs kyang rgyal po myur du grongs pa mkhyen nas phebs pa ma gnang /hor yul du tshig ma'i char babs pa dang / sog yul rgyal po ra ba ṣa pa mdzer bsnyun pa dang / yu gur rgyal khams dug sprul gyis gtses pa sogs bka' shog tsam kyis zhi zhing zlog par mdzad/ rje 53

'di'i lta ba thal 'gyur gtso bor mdzad pa dang / sngags rnying mar dogs dpyad gnang ba'i tshig zur re gnyis la phyis su chos la zhen pa che ba'i gang zag mchog dman 'gas sgro kyir zhu ba thos kyang 1 de skabs rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i slob ma'i tshogs nam mkha'i skar ma tsam dang / jo nang rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog sogs dang /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan slob ma dang bcas pa'ang de bzhin la dbu ma gzhan stong gtso bor ston pas gangs can yongs su khyab pa'i dus yin mkhas pas shing thub pa phal cher lam de nyid la brten nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dgongs don brnyed pa gdon mi za yang / dbang po 'bring dman gyi rtog ge ba 'gas lta ba de la mchog 'dzin gyi thal rang gi gzhung sogs dor ba dang / gnyis med kyi ye shes la bden par 'dzin pa bkag pa'i phyir spubs mkhas kyi mdzad pa yin pas/ mthar thugs na bka' brgyud rin po che'i rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i lta bsgom dpyis phyin par nyams su bzhes shing dgongs don bkal mdzad rje 'di lta bu mi srid pa tsam mo/ /'on kyang mkhas shing grub pa'i go sa mthon por bzhugs pa rnams la lta grub gcig kho na phyogs ris su 'dzin rgyu yod par ma nges te/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi mnga' bdag jo bo rje dpal ldan a dī sha la/ mkhas pa mang pos lta ba gang bzhed zhus pas/khyed rang gang 'dod gsungs te dbu sems sogs gtam rnying ltar 54

'di 'dod zhus pa na/ kho bo yang de lhar 'dod de la lung rigs 'di lta bu bdog gsungs/ mnga' ris pa blo gsal zhes bya ba blo gros zla med pa gcig gis go nas nyid kyi bzhed pa mi gsungs bar kun la mthun 'gyur gnang ba ji ltar lags/ zhus pas/nga yang sangs rgyas kyi rjes su slob pa yin pas gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par lan btab pa yin gsungs/ gzhan zhig gis 'o na nyid ji ltar bzhes zhus pas nga la 'dod pa med gsungs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi sa na ye shes mnga' 'am mi mnga' zhus pas cha med 'tshang rgya ma myong sogs dang / khyed bod la nga'i dbu ma'i sta ba las sems tsam bstan yang mi bzod gsungs nas don la lta ba sbogs ris med par bzhed pa dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzab po la jo bos gnad kyi man ngag gnang bar/ thabs gcig gi steng du thabs ma tshang ba med pa skrub tshul bstan pa phar phyin theg par slob dpon thogs med dang klu skrub gnyis ka'i lta bzhed kyi tha snyad dang / gsang sngags su spu snyad ji ltar gsungs pa kams cad gcig bsdus bskyed rim lta bu chos re re'i steng du'ang thams cad tshang bar bsgom dgos gsungs/ de bzhin du bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad dbu ma gnyis ka zung 'jug tu bzhed pa mang zhing / rje 'dis kyang gzhan stong gi lta grub rang rkang tshugs pa la phyogs zhen ma gnang bar/ gtso bor klu sprub rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lha 55

bzhed kyi khog dbug ste mthar thug bzhan stong bzhed pa'i grub mtha' phra mo tsam yang phyir ma lus pa de'i khungs su bsdu bar mdzad pa gor ma chag go /sngags rnying ma'i phyogs su rje 'di la mtshan g.yar ba'i bstan bcos zhig yod pa'i dogs sel rgyal ba nyid kyi drang po'i sa bon dang / slob ma'i ga rtsa bo dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i chos 'byung las dogs pa gzhi med du sel yod zhing /gzhan slob dpon rje 'bangs dang bcas pas shin tu gsang ba zab mor 'dzin pa'i chos tshul rnams/ deng dus sgod dang ldan mi ldan gyi dbye ba med par thos chog dang mthong chog yin zhes skal ba dang ma bsnan par khyab brdal du bstan tshe shin tu gsang ba zab mo'i gnad ma go ba 'gar lta log tu 'gyur ba'ang srid snyams dogs dpyad dang / gter ma'i phyogs su tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba 'gyur ba'i man ngag zab mo mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa la lta sgom dang thos bsam mi byed par/ mdos chog dang ba spung bzlog tshe sprub nor sgrub bka' spung drag stsal can sogs la gzhan las gces spras su byas nas/ grong chog gis mi tshe phud pa de dag ni lta ba dang 'bras bu khyad par 'phags kyang / spyod phyogs de dang cha mthun pas bon dang rnying ma zhes bka' stsal ba yin la/ deng sang rnying phyogs kho nar ma zad grub mtha' tshang ma'i mtshan nyid yang de ltar gyur pa ni rang re rjes 'jug rnams dus nges par skyes 56

pa'i lag nyes yin pas rgyal ba nyid slob dpon pad+ma dang rnam dbyer med pas pha mas bu tsha la bslab bya byed pa lta bu las rang mtshang la phog pa'i log rtog gtan nas mi rung ngo / /gter ston gu ru chos dbang gi yab rnying ma'i sngags 'chang mkhas pa ston nyi bya bas sras kyi gter ston nas gzigs phul tshe/ zhal ta'i tshul gyi mnga' bdag myang tsam ma gtogs gter ston thams cad kyi go ma chod par gsungs pa dang 'di rigs mtshungs so/ /rje 'di la gnu nga 'bum po ti nyi shu skor tsam bzhugs/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa stag lo khrums zla ba'i tshes nyer gsum la yang srid kre shod du 'byung ba lung bstan bka' rgya bstsal te mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /dgu pa rje dbang phyug rdo rje ni/ mi bskyod zhabs dgung lo nyer brgyad pa'i dus su nga skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i stod sogs lung gas la bar bstan pa bzhin1 tre shod du yab a rdor zhes bya ba dang yum gling bza' a lod gnyis kyi gras spu me pho 'brug lo gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bdun la bltams/sku bltams ma thag nas nga karma pa yin gsungs/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa skyes bu'i gzugs kyis sgar la skor ba byed pa kun gyis mthong / si tu chos kyi go cha dang rje zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag gis gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi 57

dbang phyug tu gsol/ rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba las kung gsung chos 'ga' gsan/ gtso bor rje dkon mchog yan lag sa bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs dang bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi bklag lung sogs bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag spums cad gsan/gdan sa mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum gsar bzhengs rnying gso rgya cher gnang zhing / khams dbus gtsang gsum du dgon sde gsar btab nyams gso'i cha rkyen dang bkas bkod mang du gnang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang bshad skrub dang gar thig dbyangs sogs kyi phyag len zhib mo la bkod pas dad ldan dngas ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan du gyur pa zhig rje 'di kho na'i skabs su byung ba snang zhing / phyogs ma spu'i skye bo spums cad kyang chos dang zang zing gnyis kas bskyangs ba'i phrin las kyi rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / bstan brtsas mang du mdzad/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa yos lo zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer brgyad la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings su bsdus so/ /zhal slob kyi ga rtsa bo zhwa dmar drug pa/ rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho sogs mang ngo / /bcu pa rje chos dbyings rdo rje ni/ rje dgu pas khams phyogs su phebs pa'i thugs 'dun yod tshul gar dbang drug par zhal chems stsal ba bzhin/ mdo khams rmad stod deng sang lcang 58

mo 'gu log tu grags pa'i gi zi thang zhes bya bar yab khye'u thar dang / yum a 'cho bya ba'i sras su shing 'brug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag nas yi ge drug pa dang rdo rje gcod pa'i snying po zhal nas gsungs/ snga phyir phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs rdzu 'phrul grangs kyis mi chod/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gis seng ge'i khrir gsol zhing dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtshos gtsug phud bzhes pa dang / bka' mdo rgyud kyi dbang lung mang du phul/ slar tshigs gsum rim nod kyi sdom pa phul ba nas bzung bka' brgyud kyi rtogs pa don brgyud 'dzin pa gar dbang drug pa rang yin/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dngos su byon pa ltar 'gro ba rnams la byang chub sems kyi phrin las mkha' dang mnyam par bzhugs pa las/ dus dbang gis kar bstan kyang bsdu ba'i dus la babs pa dang / karma pa'i yon bdag gtsang pa rgyal po dang / dge lugs phyogs kyi yon bdag sog po'i rgyal phran 'ga' ma mthun par 'khrugs pa la/ kar lugs pa'i grwa rigs karma par bla mar mi 'dzin pa'i bdud rigs can 'gas sngar nas dkrugs pa dang gzhan phyogs la'ang jo bo rjes bsam gtan chags sdang dag la byed/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar sog dmag gis kar bstan la shin tu sdang ba'i skyon gyis/ yul dbus su bzhugs pa'i skal ba ma grub nas tsa ri dang spo pe brgyud mdo khams smad du 59

thugs rje chen po'i phrin las spel ched bya bral gyi tshul kho nas 'gro ba 'dren par mdzad/ 'di dag la karma pas mtha' dmag khrid rtsis sogs kyi bshad pa ni/ rang gi mdzad pa lam du btang ba'i tshig tsam rma / /spyir bod yul gyi bstan 'dzin chen po 'ga'i bstan pa skyong tshul dang / rgyal dbang karma pa na rim 'di dag gis bstan pa'i 'gro don mdzad tshul cung zhig mi mtshungs pa snyams te/ gzhan bag rang phyogs kyi dgon sde grwa rigs mi ser sogs la gnod pa phra mo tsam byung yang / dmag dang go cha chos skyong sbad pa sogs kyis de dag gtan brlag tu song yang thugs mi tshim pa'i tshul dang dpa' gtam rnam thar yan chad du thebs par mdzad la/ rgyal dbang karma pa na rim 'di dag gi thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba 'dul ba'i skabs su 'tshe ba sogs cung zhig byung tshe thugs zhum pa'i tshul gyis byed pa po rang rgyal du 'jug pa las/ de dag gi lan po spang ba'i tshul rje 'di'i nom thar 'dis kung shes so/ /'phags pa rmo'u 'gal gyi bu mu stegs pas 'dam bu'i tshul ltar bcom nas bkrong skabs ston pa sangs rgyas nyan thos dang bcas pas dmag mdzad dam/ grwa ma 'grig pa'am/ kha stabs zhen nas ma pher ba gang yin soms shig ston pas bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bstan pa ni lung dang rtogs pa cam yin la deng sang ni don mang ba bya ba mang ba zhig la bstan par 'dzin no/ /de lta bu'i 60

sangs rgyas dngos snang de nyid sa spum rgyal po'i mchod gnas su lo du mar bzhugs/ rgyal thang du ri bo po ta la dang mtshungs par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gnas ri la 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rags lnga'i sku brnyan sogs rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag bstar du gnang zhing byin rlabs kyi mtshan ka che'i lha khang deng sang skye bo'i mchod gnas gcig pur bzhugs so/ /rje 'dis yul khams re rer yang rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes kyis 'dul ba dang bden tshig gi smon lam mdzad pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar 'byung ba sogs deng sang shā bar skye bo chos ldan dag gi ngag lam du byung ba'i rnam par spur pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab/ kho bo 'dzam gling na ri mo 'bri ba dang snyan ngag ba rtsam pa la 'ong gsungs nas/ sku rten lugs su blug pa/ shing rdo la brkos pa/ lder tsho phyag bris sogs bzo khyad du mas 'phags pa grangs med cing nyin re sku brnyan re mi chags par grags/ gsung rtsom yang snyan ngag gi lam las drangs pa'i bstan brtsas mang zhig bzhugs 'dra yang / rtogs brjod 'dod 'jo sogs yig cha khungs mi btsan zhes gser phreng nas phud 'dug mod/ yab sras la lung rgyun ma chad pa bzhugs pa dang /kun mkhyen bla ma'i dngos slob bka' bsdu ba'i byed po bla ma kun khyab sogs kyis dgos pa ma mdzad pas cung zhig the tshom mo/ /zhar 61

byung jim gro pa kun tu bzang po de nyid kyang phyis su mtshan ldan min par mchog da/na 'ga'i gsung las thos kyang / rje bcu pa nyid kyis ched brjod che bar mdzad pa'i gsung mang po mthong bas/rgyal ba yab sras kyi ye shes kyi dgongs nga sa gzigs pa'i gsang lung gtan tshig pher nges 'dra yod na ma gtogs ri bong cal sgrog de 'dra phyis su kar lugs pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams la mang du gsung rgyu 'dug kyang mkhas pa rnams rang gis dpyad pa las gang zer kha la nyan gang byed bya ba la bstos shig gal srid de 'dra yin du chug kyang / rim gro pas rgyal ba'i zhabs phyi yongs su grub nas dpon slob gnyis ka'i mdzad pa bsdu tshar ba de 'dra'i gtam gsar snyan rgyud du 'dzin pa gal mi che ba'i las su 'dug go /de ltar rje bcu pa 'di'i sku tshe smad la bod yul dbus su phebs/ bstan pa'i me ro slar yang gso bar mdzad/ dgung lo don gcig pa shing stag dbo zla ba'i tshes brtsa lngar zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs so/ /zhal slob kyi gtso bo ni zhwa dmar ye shes snying po dang /rgyal tshab nor bu bzang po'o/ /bcu gcig pa rje ye shes rdo rje ni/ mdo smad 'gu log gi yul grur me 'brug lor 'khrungs/ dpal ldan ye shes snying pos ngos 'dzid mdzad nas dgung lo dgu par seng khrir mnga' gsol/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zhwa dmar ye shes snying po yin/ dag ba'i 62

gzigs snang 'jam klas shing chos thams cad thugs la rang shar du byung / dus gsum thogs med du gzigs pas ma 'ongs lung bstan rgya cher bstsal/ gzim chung re rer sku re bzhugs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas/ chibs chen bya dkar sogs zhabs 'og tu tshud pa'i dud 'gro rnams kyang shes rig mi las bka ba yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ba byung / mi ring bar nyid kyi sku thang zhig sa skyo nga sde dge'i phyag tu gnang nas sku skye ba phyi ma'i lung bstan/ chu pho rta lor dgung lo nyer bdun la sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdus so/ /de tshe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'ja' sprin sna tshogs pas skor ba'i dbus su ston 'khor gsum byon pa skal ldan 'gas mjal lo1 /bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje ni/ rje gong ma'i zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar mdo smad sde dge'i mnga' 'og dbon stod dkyil le zhes pa sngon rin po che sha dbon brgyud du yab srung lu dang yum dkar mo skyid kyi sras su chu mo glang lor ngo mtshar du ma dang bcas 'khrungs/ zla ngo gnyis nas nga karma pa yin gsung byon/sgar gyi mgron gnyer phan bde ngos 'dzin du 'ong ba la tshe/nga ma'i phyag mdud dang / sku 'dra/ phyag phreng sogs ngos 'dzin yang dag pa mdzad/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gar dbang brgyad pa dpal chen chos kyi don 'grub sogs las bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas par gsan bsam sgom pa mtha' yas dbus gtsang ru bzhi 63

stod gnas lho mon bal yul rtswa mchog grong sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ yid can skye dgu grangs med pa rnams thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon la yang dag par bkod pa sogs grol ba bzhi ldan gyi mdzad pa bla na med pa bstan/ bal po'i rgyal po rnams kyis bsnyen bkur phul/ skye bo mchog dman bar ma kun gyis sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i snyan grags kyi 'dzam gling yongs su khyab pas rgya yu la du gdan drangs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i bzhed don lhun gyis grub cing 'brel tshad don dang ldan par mdzad nas si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas la snying po'i don gtad/ rang lugs kyi bstan pa dri ma med par skyong dgos tshul sogs zhal bkod na na cher bstsal te dgung lo sum cu pa chu pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bcu par rgya nag tu mya ngan las 'das so/ /bcu gsum pa rje bdud 'dul rdo rje ni/ byang chub rdo rjes sprul sku phyi ma 'byung ba'i phyogs mtshungs kyi bkod pa gu ru bye rmeṇ+ḍa la gnang ba ltar/ yul gnyal zhes bya bar rigs rus rnam par dag pa'i yab yum las glang lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar ches la bltams/ grub pa'i rgyan gcig rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la o rgyan rdo rje'i bkas gsal bar lung bstan pa bzhin mi ring ba gdan sa mtshur phu'i khrir 'khod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis gtsug phud bzhes ba nas bzung sdom pa gsum 64
