sogs dbang lung man ngag rgya mtsho sta bu phul/ de dag gi skabs su dag pa'i snang ba 'jam klas khams dbus gtsang gsum du zhabs kyi 'khor lo ris med bskyod de gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ skye bo mchog dman sus kyang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / rje gong ma rnams kyi skabs su dus cung bzang ba'i dbang gis gdul bya yang 'dul sla/ 'di skor dus cher snyigs pas gdul bya shin tu mi bsrun zhing / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yang phal cher gyis log par mthong ba'i skabs 'di 'drar rje 'dis thugs byams pa chen po'i stobs shugs rgyal sras gzhan las che bar bstan pas phyogs ris kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa kun gyis kyang sangs rgyas dngos su mthong zhing rnam par thar pa la log rtog gtan nas mi mnga'/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar bas spyan gyis gzigs tshad dang snyan gyis gsan tshad la yon tan sgrog cing ched brjod mdzad pa ma gtogs grub mtha' yin khul dang brtag dpyad bgyid pa sogs kyis slob ma rnams mgo bo rmongs su 'jug pa/ rtsod dus kyi rang mdangs ngoms pa de 'dra thugs la 'dzin pa mi mdzad/ khyad par mu to ba 'byor pas shin tu dbon pa dag gis mjal ba na thugs brtse zhing / lugs gnyis ka'i gsung gsang sog rgyas par bstsal ba dang / chen po'i go sar bzhugs pa'am 'byor pa che ba dag gi rnam dpyod kyis mchod 65

tshul bgyis pa na de dang mthun pa'i zhe sa tsam las dgyes tshul gtan nas mi gnang / dus kyi dbang gis zhu ba po dang bskul ba po ma byung ba ma gtogs chos tshul gyi rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor/'phrin las kyi sgo che ba gcig ni lha ldan du chu rang rdol byung nas jo bo nom gnyis klus gdan 'dren pa nye ba na/ gzhung sa nas rim gro mang pos ma blog byang chub sems dpa' karma pas/ bden tshig brjod na bzlog pa nus/ zhes lung bstan thob nas rje bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba btab pas phyag nas tsam gyis gdengs can ka sun ma bzlog pa dang / bal po'i dmag gtsang du sleb te bod khams 'joms par nye tshe rje nyid bde chen yang ri'i rtser phebs nas rten 'brel 'ga' mdzad pas de nyin bal dmag phyir log pa ste/ 'di gnyis ni slob dpon chen pos dngos su lung bstan pa'i 'khrin las dus las ma g.yel ba'o1 /de ltar gdulaX bya bgrang ba las 'das pa'i don mdzad nas snying po don gyi bstan pa'i rgyal tshab si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la gnang zhing mchog gi sprul sku phyi ma gang du 'byon pa'i yul dang yab yum sogs zung du bstan pa'i phyag bris phyag rtags kyis btab pa bstsal/ dgung lo re lnga bzhes pa me sbrul lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /bstan brtsas pod gsum sngon dpal spungs dgon pa'i par khang du bkad/ /66

bcu bzhi pa theg mchog rdo rje ni/ rje gong mas sku brnya na bzhengs shing de la mtshan bcas gsol bar mdzad nas sprul pa'i sku mdo khams su 'byung bar lung bstan pa ltar khams karma dgon pa'i nye sar me sbrul lor 'khrungs/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dang zhwa dmar bcu pa sogs las gsan bsam sgom pa dang dbang lung man ngag rdzogs par gsan/ gzhung sa chen mos rje btsun karma pa zhes gus bkur mdzad/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che dbus su phebs skabs gzhung sa chen mo dang bka' gros kyis dbus gtsang gi gnas so sor skrub chen dang gtor bzlog sogs grangs mang rtags thon mdzad pas dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan srid yun ring brtan par mdzad/ mtshur phu dgon pa la sngon rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i skabs dge 'dun nyung du song zhing / sgrig lam slod pas zhabs 'bring pa tshos rgyal ba'i dbang por sgar gzhung gis sgrig lam dam po zhig 'dzugs dgos zhus par nged rang sdom brtson sde snad 'dzin pa pos dal bsngad chog ma 'ongs pa na khams phrug klad sgag gis sgrig dang bca' ba legs po bzo 'ong rgyu red ces zer nas phebs pa ltar mtshur sgar grwa tshang la/ grwa pa 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi 'gros sta bus sgrig lam ha cang dam po mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang dbus gtsang khams gsum la theg pa chog gi rdo rjes phrin las kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byed 67

cing dgung grangs bdun cu don gcig par zhing gzhan du gshegs dka/ /bco lnga pa rje mkha' khyab rdo rje ni/ gtsang ri nang phyogs su lcags lug lor 'khrungs/ mdo khams su byon nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang kang sprul yon tan rgya mtsho gnyis las bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad/ jo nang 1 sa ngor tshar gsum sogs sprub rgyud shing rta brgyad kyi dbang gdams ngag ma lus pa gsan/ khyad par kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdun ka tshang gi smin grol rgyab rten ba6sa tshang ma gsan/ mkhas pa mi pham dang / lhag bsam bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ karma tshe dpal sogs las rig gnas che phra mang po dang / si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i mdun nas dgongs 'dus dbang lung gsan/khams dbus gtsang gsum du 'gro don rgya cher dang / mtshur phu'i rin chen gtir mdzod sogs par du bskrun par mdzad/ bstan 'dzin grags pa zer ba'i rgya rong ba rdzogs chen chos lugs yen pa zhig gis rin chen gter mdzod la dgag yig snga rjes byung ba rje nyid dang / ka:thog si tu pas tshar bcad bden spang lta bus gter mdzod bod tsam du ma zad rgya dkar nag la'ang cher 'phel/snga phyir mdzod chen lnga'i dbang lung dang / lhag par gter mdzod kyi dbang lung lan drug gnang bas slob tshogs grangs las 'das pa 68

bskyangs/ yang khrod skrub khang du lha khang gsar bzhengs dang kar rabs bco lnga ga rtsa bo thog tshad/ gzhan kams mi tshad re bcas gser zangs las bzhengs pa la mthun rkyen mdzad/ mchog gling lung don mkha' 'gro bzhes pa'ang don dang ldan par nges te/sras kong sprul gnyis pa dam pa tshul dgu dang ldan/ sras byam pa rin po che'ang mtshur sga ra la zhabs 'degs che zhing / rten dge slong rnam par dag pa bcas yon tan ldan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i mdzad phrin mthar phyin nas/ 'byung 'gyur sprul sku lung bstan phyag bris lab / 'di nas shar phyogs gser ldan 'bab pa'i 'gram/mna' bsnun dpa' bos bzung ba'i yul gyi char/ rje rigs khyim bdag a dang thub kyis brgyan/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i lhums su gnas yu la mthong / 1rang byung ye shes rig pa'i rdo rje 'bod/ces sogs gsal bar lung bstan nas dgung grangs nga gnyis par zhing brjes so/ /gsung tshogs dge slong 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis phyogs bsgrigs byas pa pu snyi bcu dpal spungs par khang du bzhugs myong ngo / /bcu drug pa rje rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje ni/ rje gong ma'i lung ltar mdo khams shar phyogs sde dge'i char gtogs 'dan khog bye brag seng ge'i gnam rdzong du yab a thub tshe dbang phun tshogs dang yu ma rgya mkhar skal bzang chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su 69

shing pho byi ba'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin 'khrungs/lcags lug zla ba brgyad pa'i ches lngar dpal mtshur phu mdo bo lung gi gtsug ga khang chen por tā yi si tu pad+ma dbang chog rgyal po mchog dbus ris med skyes chen du ma dang / rgya gar/ bal po/ 'brug 'bras ljongs la dwags sogs phyogs du ma nas 'dus pa'i bla sprul gyi ga rtsas skye bo grangs las 'das pa'i dbus su dga' ston legs 'bul dang bcas chos kyi seng ge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol/spyir phyi nang rig pa'i gnas du ma dang / ris med mdo sngags kyi chos sgo mtha' yas pa gsan sbyong dpyis phyin par mdzad/ lhag par byams mgon tā yi si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po dang /'jam mgon kong sprul dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer zung gi zhal snga nas zab don gyi gdams ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byos gsan zhing / don brgyud kyi dgongs pa 'phos te nges don gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur te mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon chen por dbang bskur zhing skrub brgyud gser ri'i phreng bar bzhugs su gsol/tā yi si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i drung du dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ gzhan phan spyi mdzad pa la gdan sa mtshur phu zhig gsos rgya bskyed rgya cher mdzad pa ma zad/ shing sprel lor sman ljongs 'brug tu zhabs sor 'khod 'brel/ 'brug rgya gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang phyug gis rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par 70

mngon par bskur zhing rgyal khams chos kyis mtshings par mdzad/de nas bzung / rgya gar/ bal yul/ 'brug 'bras ljongs bcas su chibs bsgyur gyis phyogs de dag gi skye bo mtha' dag smin grol mdzad/ lhag par zad gangs can ljongs stod smad kun tu dus snga phyir zhabs sor gyi re kha 'khod de smin grol spyi dang / khyad par dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang ba ni rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng gi gral nas mang shos kyi gras zhig yin/ de 'brel bshad sprub kye sde dngos brgyud gnyis nas gsar 'dzugs gnang ba mang dag cig mchis/ shing rta lor gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbus bod kyi bla chen mi dpon che drag gnyis brgya tsam dang lhan du rgya nag tu gzigs skor la chibs bsgyur gyis bad spyi'i bstan srid la srun pa'i phyag 'gan rgya cher bzhes/ sa pha ga lor 'brug brgyud rgya gar du phebs/ rgya gar gzhung la 'bod bskur gyis btsan sbyor du 'byor ba'i bod mi rnams la skyabs gso dbu 'dren don smin mdzad/ bstan pa nyams gso'i thugs bzhed kyis 'bras ljongs rum btegs kyi sa gnas su gdan sa bshad sprub chos 'khor gling gsar bzhengs/ bal yu dang la dwags gnyis su'ang dgon sde gsar bskrun gnang / yu rob dang a gling / shar lho e shi ya bcas su chos lugs mi rigs ris su ma chad pa'i skye bo mchog dman 'bum tsho brgal bar 71

dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel ba mdzad pa ma zad/ bstan gzhi chos tshogs kyang brgya phrag gsum tsam gsar 'dzugs gan nga / lhag par skyabs rje tā yi si tu rin po che/ rgyal tshab rin po che/ zhwa dmar rin po che/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che gtsos bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu grangs las 'das par nyid nas gsan bzhes gnang ba'i chos mtha' dag khyab spel mdzad/ /ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa ni sku 'khrungs pa'i snga bong du nyin gcig lhums su ma bzhugs shing / 'khrungs tshes nyin sngar ltar lhungs su snang / khams li spung spang phug tu rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag khams 'brong stod mtsho 'bur du chu la zhabs rjes gnang / rum btegs su sman sprub gnang smin mdzad de khams phyogs su sman 'gyed zangs spul du gnang ba'i rtags su/ lo de'i bdud rtsi chos sman dam 'byar zhal byang 'khod pa ri stong rnams su thogs med du thob kyi yod pa'i lo rgyus grags/ snga phyir sprul sku ngos 'dzin stong phrag brgal ba mdzad pas mtshon ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang / rgya ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar lnga brgya tham pa par bskrun gnang ba dang 'brel/ ris med kyi dgon sde kun la chos sbyin du bstsal bas mtshon gsung rab nyams gso yang rgya cher mdzad/ dgung grangs nga brgyad pa lcags mo bya lor sprul sku'i 'khrungs yul sogs gsal kha 'khod pa'i zhal chems lung bstan dang don rgyud kyi bstan 72

pa si tu rin po che la gtad de re zhig dag pa'i zhing du gshigs so/ /bcu bdun pa rje yo rgyan 'khrin las rdo rje ni/ rgyal mchog sku gong ma rig pa'i rdo rje mcheg sku gshegs rgyu'i lo lnga'i sngon ngol dgung grangs lnga bcu rtsa gsum par rgya gar grong khyer ka li ka ta nas rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen po mchog nas gos chen ser po'i thum can gyi spung 'khor zhig sras kyi thu bo tā yi si tu rin po che la gnang ste 'di khyed kyi spung ba yin pas thu dang bral med 'chang zhes mgul spung gi tshul du gnang / de nas skyabs rje si tu rin po che nas mgul spung gi rgyab skog zhal dbye gnang bar sku gong ma'i 'da' kha'i zhal chems phyag bris phyag bstar ma ngo ma mgul spung nang nas byon par rgyal ba yab sras lhan rgyas nas zhal mjal lhod zhu dang 'brel 'jim mgon kong sprul rin po che nas brnyan par thog zhal bshus kha shas zhu gnang mdzad pa sogs rgyal ba yab sras thams cad dad gus spro gsum gyi dgyes 'tshor brjod kyis mi lang ba thob pa dang / de mjug spyi lo1⑫⑫da ba ri pa'i tshes 14nyin rum btegs gdan sar kun mkhyen tā yi si tu rin po che dang / rgyal tshab go shrī rin po che rnam gnyis kyis bka' brgyud bla sprul che phra rnams dang rum btegs bshad skrub chos gling karma'i yig tshang gi dbu las 'dus sde/ 'bras ljongs lha sde mi 73

sde yongs rdzogs kyi dbus su kun mkhyen tā yi si tu rin po che mchog nas rgyal mchog sku gong ma'i bka' 'chems zhal gdams phyag bris phyag bstar ma'i dgongs don rnam gsal bsgrags gnang ste thams cad blo bde bag phebs yong ba'i bka' drin bskyangs gnang ba dang / zhal gdams gyi nang don du/ ye ma ho/ rang rigs pa ni kun tu bde/ /chos kyi dbyings la mtha' dbus bral/ /'di nas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi shar/ /lha yi gnam lcags rang byung 'bar ba'i yul/ /'dod 'jos mtshan pa'i yid 'ong 'brog sde mdzes/ /thabs ni don grub shes rab blo la dga'1 /sa la spyod pa'i lo khams pa/ /dkar mo rgyang grags ngo mtshar can/ /rje don yod grub pas rjes su bzung / /phyogs ris med pas phyogs kun khyab/ /nye ring med par kun la bde/ /karma pa zhes yongs su grags/ /rgyal bstan gsal ba'i nyi ma rtag tu 'bar/ /zhes pa'i zhal gdams phyag bris phyag bstar ma la yon rgyal rabs kyis phul ba'i 'a gser tham gru bzhi 'ja' zer ma'i bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya phab pa de dag gsang rgya yongs brtol te dngos su gsal bsgrags gnang bar der 'dus ser skya mchog dman yongs rdzogs dad gus spro gsum gyi dga' spro'i mchi ma dbang med du shor/ de nas gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po la skyabs mgon sku gong ma'i zhal chems 74

phyag bris ngo ma der yod thog nas snyan seng dang sbrags bka'i slob ston bcas 'phra la myur zhu gnang yong ba'i zhu 'phrin yang yang phul smog byams mgon tā yi si tu pad+ma don yod grub pa rin po che mchog dang / mtshur phu rgyal tshab go shri karma grags pa bstan pa yar 'phel 'phrin las kun khyab rnam gnyis nas rgyal ba yab sras kyi dad dam lar rgya dang brtsas min mos gus drag po nam yang mi lhod pa'i thugs brtson chen pos rda ram sa theg chen chos gling gi pho brang du ngo bcar dang 'brel ba'i zhal gad mas phyag bris ngo ma dang sbrags gnas lugs snyan du gsol bar/ gong sa mchog nas thugs dgyes pa chen pos bka' bzang phyir phebs dgongs don du/gsham gsal zhal chems don mthun/ skyed byed karma don grub dang / ma yum blo dga' gnyis kyi bu shing glang lo pa de bzhin gshegs pa sku phreng bcu drug pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel byed/ sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i smon 'dun bcas/tā la'i bla mas/ bod chu sprel zla4tshes riXspyi lo1⑫⑫pa zla ba༄pa'i tshes riXl/ zhes mgul spung dang / mgul dar bcas/ spug tham bka' bzang rin po che'i phyir phebs bstsal ba ma zad1 go nga sa chen po'i thugs dam gyi gzigs snang du'ang / lung pa kha lho la bstan pa/ spang ri dang shing nags kyi tshal yod pa'i sa la yang srid rin po che 'khrungs yod tshul sogs kung bka' bzang spyi 75

phebs bcas bka' bskyangs/ de 'brel kun mkhyen si tu rin po che mchog nas kyang rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i ngo mtshar thugs kyi mchod rten rin po che'i drung du thugs dam brtags pa'i dbras bu yang / 'bras ljongs karma'i gdan sa'i byang phyogs gangs can bod yul gyi shar phyogs lha thog gis gnas1 'dod 'jo ba'i ming rtags kyis mtshan pa'i 'brog sder yab ming don grub dang yum ming blo dga' can la phag byi glang gsum gang rung gi lo par 'khrungs shing / sku bltams pa'i skabs su dung dkar dang 'brel ba'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma 'byung bar snang thes dang / rgyal ba sras bcas gzhan bde kho nas dgyes/ /lha rna mas mkha' las bden pa'i thu dbyangs len/ /dbyangs kyi rang bzhin srid gsum zhi bas bltams/ /dam pa'i don ni sgro bkur g.yul las rgyal/ /zhes brgyal ba rdo rje 'chang rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i ngo mtshar thugs kyi mchod rten rin po che'i mdun du/ 1 na ting tā yi si tu pad+ma don yod grub pas bla ma la mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa'i ngang nas yi ger bkod pa'o/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bde legs stsol cig chos skyong dam can rgya mtshos 'phrin las skrubs shig ces gsubs/ gzhan yang gu ru'i sprul pa gter chen yo rgyan mchog gyur gling pa mchog gis gter lung du bstan pa 'di lta ste/ theg mchog mya ngan 'das 'og 76

'god pa'i mtshan : bde ba'i bdag nyid jig pa'i rdo rje dang: o rgyan phrin las bsam gtan la sogs 'byung: zhes dang / mchog gyur gling pa'i rnam thar bkra shis dbyangs kyi yan lag nang du/ de yi phyogs brag ri dang ljon shing gi drungaXdu sku phreng bcu bdun pa dang kwan stang tā yi si tu lhan rgyas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas rgyal bstan gyi lo 'dab rgyas shing dwags rgyud snying po'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i brda/ zhes gsal ba ltar don la mi 'gal ba dus gsum rjen gcer du gzigs pa'i ris med skyes chen dam pa du ma'i ye shes kyi gzigs snang gcig tu mthun pa dang bstan spung dam can rnams kyi bden nus 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas kyi mthu las yang srid rin po che nges brnyes 'khrul bral rtsad gcod zhu phyogs skor krung go srid gzhung gis kyang yang srid sa gnas gar 'khrungs rtsad ga rtsad chog ces pa'i chog mchan 'phral mar bstsal ba ltar/ ke tshang gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa dkar legs dgon pa dang nye ba'i lha thog ba sgor zhes pa'i 'brog sder yab don grub dang yum blo dga' gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang lo zla ba 5pa'i tshes 1la 'khrungs/ spyi lo1⑫ba'i lo zla ba༄tshes ba nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun du mkhan chen kan ting tā yi si tu rin po che chos kyi don 'grub mchog nas gtsug phud bsil te rang byung khyab bdag 77

o rgyan rgyal ba'i myu gu 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ de nas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i ad ra zhes pa chu sprel hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig res gza' rta bdun dbang po dar ba dang / rgyu skar dbo ste snga dro me rlung dang / phyed yol rgyu skar me bzhi 'phrad pas 'chi med grub pa'i sbyor ba bcas gza' skar tshes gsum 'phros sbyor bzang ba'i nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa'i yang srid rin po che gser khrir mnga' gsol rten 'brel legs 'bul bstar ba'i mdzad sgor zhugs mkhan skye bo rna mas dgon pa'i phyi nang gling yongs su khengs shing / rgyal khab phyi nang gi ris med dgon sde khag dang / tshogs pa khag dang / mi sger bcas dad ldan 'bul ba po so sos bka shis pa'i rdzas dang / zhing khams rab 'byams kyi bkod pa maṇ+ḍal rten 'brel rten gsum dang / rten 'brel khri 'bul gyi 'bul dngos mdzad pa dang / yang srid rin po ches kyang der 'dus skye bo ser skya thams 6da la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ngan song dong sprug gi sgom bzlas dang gzungs sngags yi ge drug pa'i rjes gnang sogs thams cad 'khor ba mtha' can gyi thar pa'i sa bon rgyud las skye bar byed pa'i ched de nyin grol ba bzhi ldan gyi gsung mjal yang bstsal/ de ltar gser khrir mnga' gsol nas bzung yang srid rin po che dam pa'i mdzad pa stur bzhes kyis 78

'bri klog chos spyod sogs thugs 'dzin sogs rmang gzhi'i sku yon sgron 'bul gsan bzhes sogs dus thog so so'i thugs dam lhod med bzhugs la/ gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che'i yang srid 'khrul med ngos 'dzin gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi rdzu 'phrul yang skabs skabs byung ba nye 'khor kun gyis mjal ba bcas so/ /de ltar dpal rgyal dbang karma pa rim byon 'di dag gi sku dngos kyi 'gro ba 'dren pa ma zad sprul pa dang yang sprul gyi tshogs grangs med pas sems can la thabs du mas phan pa mdzad pa ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad tshul mdo sde za ma tog las rgyal bas gsal bar bstan pa dang / sku'i dri ma tsam mam na bza' sogs nyer spyad phu mo res kung sems can la gnas skabs nad gdon me chu mtshon sogs kyi 'jigs pa las skyabs shing mthar thug bla med rdzogs byang la 'god pa sogs—mngon sum du grub bo/ /gsol 'debs dang mtshan dang sku brnyan byin can re res kung rgyal ba dngos kyi sbon las tsam grub pa ni blo dman bdag lta bu la'ang brjod pa'i mtha' mi zad pa yod do/ /de ltar nges bzhin phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skye 'gro spums cad kyi mos gus phul byung gis gsol 'debs la brtson pa'i rgyun sngon nas da lta'i bar du rgyun mar byung ba ltar1 da dung rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab cing / karma pa mkhyen no zhes mtshan tsam 'dzin pas 79

kyang skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /khyad par rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rjes bstsal ba'i thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor de ni bla sprub khyad par du 'phags pa ste rgyud sam stu tri'i rdo rje slob dpon bsgrubs pa'i le'u las 'di dang mthun pa'i bsgom tshul gsal bar byung zhing / gzhung de nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i glu yin par gsungs zhing gsol 'debs kyi tshig de phal che rgyal ba spums cad kyi rang bzhin mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsang tshig la nyid kyi slob ma grub thob rna mas kyi dag snang la shar ba'i tshig tshogs rnams sgrig pa dang /gsol 'debs rjes ma de nyid kyi phan yon dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i dbugs 'byin pa yin pas snyan dngags sogs kyis brgyan pa'i gsol 'debs gzhan las kyang 'di nyin byin rlabs che ba yin no/ /de'ang karma pa'i yang srid la sku phreng mang po zhig ni 'khrungs ma spug tu nga karma pa yin zhes gsungs pa sogs dmigs bsal gyi rtags mang po zhig la brten nas ma nor bar ngos 'dzin thub kyi yod/ sku phreng 'ga' zhig gis sku skye'i 'khrungs yul sogs gsal kha 'khod pa'i zhal chems lung bstan 'jog srol yod/ lung bstan de'ang 'da' ka kho nar gnang ba sha stag ma yin par dus nges med spyi dang lhag par mtshams skrub lta bu'i skabs su'ang gnang srid/ skabs 'ga' zhal slob dmigs bsal zhig la zhal chems 80

yin min gyi gsal cha med par dus btab ste shog dril dam 'byar du gnang srol yang mchis/ yang kha shas nas zhal chems kyi cha shas 'chal thos la brten so so'i bu yi lo rtags tsam phyogs mthun byung na der khungs byas te yang srid yin rgyu byed mkhan rnams la lus srog 'tsher ba'i ltas ngan drag po 'byung gi yod pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan la brten 'di'i skor ha cang gsang rgya dam po mdzad srol yod/ de ltar rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bdun pa o rgyan 'phrin las rdo rje'i bar bcas kyi mdzad pa rags rim tsam bkod nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sku che ba'i yon tan dang sku tshe'i mdzad 'phrin rnams rnam spur rgyas par gzigs pa zhu/tā yi si tu na rim gyi mdzad rnam/da ni bska la bzang gi sangs rgyas lnga pa byams mgon thub pa'i bstan pa la dgongs nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rim pa byon pa ni si tu na rim ste/ rgyal dbang karma pa thub pa'i drung / chos rgyal gzugs can snying por gyur tshe de'i bangs stobs chen zhig dang /de'i rjes su rig pa'i gnas dang brtul zhugs grub pa ku sa li ye she snying po/ mtshungs bral dpa' bo chen po ṭam bhi te ru ka/ pad+ma sam bha was rjes bzung sngags 'chang gyim shang zhabs/ theg mchog 'khor los bsgyur ba mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ zla 'od gzhon nus thugs sras dben sgom shes rab byang chub dus mkhyen rgyud 'dzin 'gro ba'i mgon po ras chen sangs rgyas grags/ grub 81

mchog —hūṃri sku rim 'gro pa ye shes dbang phyug rang byung ba'i slob ma re mgo ba rin chen 'byung gnas/ rol rdor rjes bzung tā ming rgyal po'i mnga' 'og rgyal bstan gyi sgor 'dul mkhas ba'i zhing chen po sogs rim par byon nas si tu'i mtshan gso ba ste/dang po si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ karma dman dang nye bar grub chen sha gdung rigs su 'khrungs/ ston pa mchog gis gsungs pa'i chos tshul 'chad pa la 'jigs pa mi mnga' zhing /ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa kun gyi tog tu gyur pas chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes su gsol/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i slob mar gyur/ me phag lo gong ma'i pho brang du phebs nas yung lo gong mas si tu'i las ka dang zhwa nag gnang / 'u gas gnyis ka'i jin las spel bar mdzang/ me sbrul lor gong mas kan ting na ya thang mya'u tsi gi shir te tā yi si tu pa spyo bo nas dbang bskur ba'i bla ma brtse ldan 'jig rten 'dren pa zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ bod du phebs te dgung lo bdun cu don gcig par dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /gnyis pa si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal ni/ lcags rta lor 'khrungs rje mthong ba don ldan gyis si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid du rngas 'dzin te dbang lung man ngag gnang ste rje nyid kyi slob mar gyur te de'i phrin las spel bar mdzad/ dgung lo 82

zhe bdun me sprul lor zhing gzhan du brjes so/ /gsum pa si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor ni/ sa rta lor bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud du rje chos grags rgya mtshos si tu gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang ste gser khrir mnga' gsol/rje nyid kyi drung nas mdo sngags kyi chos ma tshang ba med pa gsan mdzad de kar lugs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ mi tu'i las ka dang dbu zhwa dmar po gnang / gdan sa bar pa karma'i bdag por gyur/ rje brgyad pa khrir bkod pa sogs phyag rjes che/ rgya nag gong mas gser yig gzengs bstod gnang ba ste gos chen tshon mdog sna tshogs can la/ yig rigs mi 'dra ba lnga yod pa'i bod yig tu/ bla ma bkra shis dpal 'byor 'di chung nas rab tu byung / khrims gtsang yon chen po mnga' bas nge da gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur yod pa/ zhes bkod 'dug dgung zhe gsum lcags glang lor karma dgon du zhing gzhan du gshegs so/ /bzhi pa si tu mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha ni/ zur mang rtsi brgyud du chu stag lor 'khrungs/ rje mi bskyod rdo rjes si tu gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin te mnga' gsol khri ston mdzad/si tu'i las ka dang bcas karma'i gdan sa bkod/ rje nyid kyi ga rtsas mkhas grub mang du bsten nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag mtha' yas thos pas mkhas grub chen por gyur/ rje dbang 83

phyug rdo rje khrir bkod pa sogs phyag rjes che/ dgung zhe gsum shing bya lor zhing 'di'i mdzad pa bsdus so/ /lnga pa si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyi ma ni/ mtshan gzhan si tu chos kyi dge legs dpal bzang po'ang gsol/ rje 'di me khyi lor 'khrungs/ rje dgu pas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/go shrī'i las ka dang shel spum/ zhwa dmar sogs gnang / sa smad du byon nas ke po gnas zhig gsos mdzad/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos gdan drangs bsnyen bkur rgya cher byung / de nas gdan sa karma dgon gyi 'du khang g.yer mo che gsar bskrun mdzad/da gung zhe bdun chu sprel lor gshegs so/ /dgung lo don gcig me bya lor gshegs so'ang grags/drug pa si tu phrin las rab brtan ni/ sde dge'i bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs dang ma spun du sde dge sman shod du sa khyi lor 'khrungs/ rje chos dbyings rdo rjes ngos 'dzin/ chos sgo lung rig nyi ma la kar lugs kyi dbang lung man ngag kams cad gsan/ a lo dpal 'byor sogs kyi skor du ma 'ongs par sprul sku phyi ma rnams kyis phrin las mdzad pa lung bstan/ rje chos dbyings rdo rjes dbu zhwa dmar po gsar du gnang / rje 'di la rgyal mchog bcu pa'am yi dam gyi lha gang rung zhig gis gnang ba'i lu bstan rje chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi skabs su 'byung ba'i chig 84

gsal ba phyag bris ngo ma yin pa zhig kyang yod par grags so/ /gtsang sogs dus zin longs skabs rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku rjes bsnyegs te 'jang yul du phebs/ ri bo bya rkang nas sto phyogs zhag bcu bgrod pa'i chu sho ho zer bar dgung nyer lnga par mya ngan las 'das1 sa gnas der sku gdung mchod rten zhig kyang bzhengs so1 /de rjes legs bshad smra ba zhes bzhugs kyang / de skabs kar lugs nyams dma' bas gling dpon gyis rang 'dod kyis sa ngor grwa pa bzhag dgung bco lnga bzhes par 'das so/ /si tu'i kyo spums cad bgrang na na rim bdun pa yin/ si tu'i mtshan gsol ba kho nar bgrang na 'di mi brtsi'o/ /bdun pa si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas ni/ rje mi bskyod rdo rjes rgya gab chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / rje dgu pas chos kyi rgyal mtshan la bstod par/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos tshul ji snyed pa/ sogs kyang rje 'di lung gi bstan cing / gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ stag sham pa mi 'gyur rdo rje rnams kyis lung bstan ltar/ a ta rong du yab ngag dbang tshe jing dang yum khru 'gu ma'i sras su sa yos lor 'khrungs/ zhwa dmar brgyad pa chos kyi 85

don 'grub dang rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje gnyis rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten cing / zab cing rgya rge ba'i chos tshul ma lus pa gsan/ mdor na rje 'di'i rnam par thar pa ni 'phags yul gyi slob dpon klu sgrub sogs kyi mdzad pa sta bu ste bsam pa dang brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das zhing / deng sang phyi'i rnam thar rgyas tsam bzhugs pa 'dis ni rje 'di nyid kyi mdzad tshul cha tsam las rtogs par mi 'gyur na nang dang gsang ba'i rnam thar lta ga la zhig gnas skabs su si tu'i mtshan gsol ba tsam las don la 'phags mchog mi pham mgon po mngon sum mi yi gzugs su byon pa yin pas rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs rkye mnga' bdag dam pa rig pa'i gnas lnga sogs la sngar gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes las 'gran pa mi bzod pa dang / dgon sde gsar btab rnying gso sogs dus snyigs ma 'di ltar bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad dus gcig tu byon yang 'di tsam phyag len du theb pa dka' 'o/ /rje 'di sngar gyi sgyung bstan de dag gis dngos su gsal ba ma tshad/ rgang ma si tu phrin las rab brtan zhangs kyi phyag bris yin nam snyam pa'i lung bstan mdzad byang mi gsal ba byang gcig can zhig las 'di ltar/ yang gcig dad dang mthong ba yi/ /sa thob bla ma'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ka ra'i ming can bshad pa 86

yi/ /lo bcur yongs su bskor nas kyang / /lnga yi yongs su 'khor bar 'gyur/ /grub pa'i ming can de la ni/ /ā tsar+ya yis rjes 'dzin 'gyur/ /de ni rim gyis mthong bgrod de/ /sangs rgyas pa ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de yis skye bo mang po la/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin 'bog par 'gyur/ 1khyod kyi ming ni 'di yin te/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma smra ba'i dbang / /chos kyi snang ba can zhes bya/ khyod kyi yid bzhin nor bu de/ /myur ba gcig gis thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bstod pa'i tshig de dag gis rgyu mtshan yab sras sogs ye shes spyan ldan rna mas kyis gzigs par zhu/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma sogs rje 'di nyid yin nges la/gong gi 'phror/ yang gcig ma dul dul ba'i gnas/ /'a dang nga yi thog mtha' can/ /de yang ma 'ongs gnas pa'i tshe/ /khyod kyis 'dul ba nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes 'jang yu la du rje 'di yi ring dgon pa gsar btab pa sogs mang ba de yin no/ /yang 'di sta'i nges par brjod par bya/ /phu ni gnas kyis rab brgyan cing / /glang smyon ze ba lta bu'i ri/ /de na mchod pa byed pa'i mi/ /brag thor bu 'dus pa'i skyid sbug der/ /la yi thog mar ldan pa'i mi/ /de sgod ldan gdul bya'i rgyal por go/ /ri rtsa rtse sbom phra med pa'i sa/ /yid rtog pa ldan na rtsa ba phra/ /de yod pa'i lung pa sang nge ba/ /sngar mi yod kyiXgyong rol skam po la/ /87

mi khyod kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes dpal spungs dgon pa'i sa gzhi bcas bstan pa 'dra zhing / da dung gzhan 'ga' zhig 'dug kung 'dir ma bris/ de ltar rje 'di'i bstan 'gro'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad ste/ dgung lo don drug pa shing rta zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la chos dbyings su bzhugs so/ /brgyad pa si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po ni/ rje gong ma de nyid zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshe sprul pa'i sku zhus pas karma pa yab sras dang khyad par du dpa' bo rin po ches gang gsung pa de yin zhes bka' phebs pa ltar rje dpa' bo la gu ru pad+mas lung gsal bar bstan pa'i sprul sku 'khrul med du shing rta yor mdo khams sde dge yid lhung du smar khang tshang zhes pa 'tsho mdzad mkhas pa'i rigs las 'khrungs/ dgung lnga par rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar chos grub rgya mtsho/ 'dzing sgar rdo rje grags pa sogs mkhas grub du ma bsten nas chos gsan/ sku btsun pa'i tshul 'dzin/ lugs gnyis ka nas gzi brjid che/dpal spungs rgyud sde lha khang rten dang brten pa bcas gsar bzhengs/ ris med dgon khag mang po la dngul 'gyed lan gsum mdzad pa mtshon phrin las rgya che/ dgung grangs drug cu nas brgyad cu'i bar skrub sde bsam gtan gling du them sgang bcad rgya mdzad nas sprub rgyud gong ma rnams kyi sbob tshugs dang mnyam 88

par mdzad/ 'bri 'brug sa rnying rna mas kyi gdams pas thugs rgyud yongs su gang / phyag nas zangs thal du 'gro ba dang rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag pa so gas grub pa chen po'i rnam spur mnga'/ shing yos lor zhi bar gshegs te zhag gnyis bar thugs kar drod ma yal ba dang mkha' la 'ja' tshon dang me tog 'dab ma lnga pa'i char 'bebs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lhas dang bcas so/ rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum pod gsum sngon dpal spungs dgon pa'i spar khang du bzhugs so/ /dgu pa si tu pad+ma kun bzang ni/ rje gong mas/ thang gi lha dang gnam gyi mtsho: nga yi sprul pa maṇ+ḍal bha dra: shing stag lo pa 'gro ba'i mgon po 'byung: zhes pa sogs zab gter rdo rje'i lung gis ston cing grub thob chen po 'di nyid shing stag lor byang thang lha'i mdun gnam mtsho khar 'khrungs/ rje bcu bzhi pas ngos 'dzin zhing 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho dbus phebs mdzad nas gzhung sa dang se ra dgon par gnang ba zhus nas dpal spungs su gdan drangs/ mkhan chen bku shis 'od zer sogs mkhas grub mang po bsten nas gzhung man ngag dang bcas gsan sbyong / sku gzhon nu'i dus nas rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes rang byung du mnga'/ grub pa'i spyod pas 'bri chu rgyas par chibs bcibs nas gshegs pa dang / yang khrod gnam skas brag nas 89

rta chibs te thur du phebs pa/ sde dge nas rta rgod cig chibs nas dpal spungs bar chu tshod gnyis cam gyis phebs pa/ 'dan khog tu mi zhig gis glang rgod gcig khrid nas 'ong ba dang lam bar thug par khyod kyis glang de nyar tshags ma byed gsungs pa la/ khos ban rgod kyis mi zer ba ci yod snyam ste ma nya na/ rjes su glang des mi de bsad/ bod ljongs su phebs skabs shig lam bar chu po chen po dbyar chu rgyas sgang la thug pas/ kun gyis chu las brgal mi thub zer nas sgar tshugs chags byed brtsis ska sa/ tshang ma la bka' brkun drag pos sgar pa yongs rdzogs chu la rgyab kung nyes skyon cung zad med pa chu phar khar thon pa sogs grub rtags mang po bstan pa'i lo rgyus yod/ tshang mas si rgod ma zhes skur pa 'debs kyang rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos si tu rin po che 'di ni yo rgyan rin po che'i sku sha rlon pa yin zhes bstod bsngags yang yang mdzad/ rgyun tu phal cher 'ba' chas mdzad nas chang gsol/ rta rgyugs bcas cho rol gyi spyod pa mdzad kyang / si tu sku rabs thams cad tshangs spyod 'dul ba 'dzin pa sha stag byon pa'i bag chags lta bus bud med la shin tu 'dzem pa zhig go/ /mthar dgung grags so gnyis shing bya lor rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i mdun rdzong sar du byon/ tshur lam shan pa 'bum chung rtag rgyal zhes pa la nga'i rta kha khrid nas 'gro 90

gsungs/ pho brang sgo chibs babs nas chibs 'brang nag ces pa rta mchog 'gran zla med pa de gnang nas/ da phan chad srog gcod spongs shig gsungs/ khos kyang bka' bzhin bskrubs pas ngan song skye sgo chod par nges so/ /de nas mi ring bar sprul pa'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /bcu pa si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po ni/ me khyi lor mdo smad li thang du sku 'khrungs/ rgyal ba bco lnga pa dang mkhyen kong rnam gnyis bcas dgongs mthun gyis si tu gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin/ dpal sprungs su gdan drangs nas gsan sbyong mdzad pa la mkhan chen bka shis 'od zer las rab tu byung / khyung po karma 'od zer las 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ btsad po lha rgyal las bka' 'gyur lung / 'jam mgon kong sprul las bka' brgyud sngags mdzod bcas gsan/ dgung lo nyer lnga'i dus mkhan chen bkra rtsis 'od zer las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'jam dbyangs chos rgyal las sum rtags dag gsum/ sgra tsan+d+ra pa/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan dngags bcas rig gnas skor gsan/ mkhan po skal bzang las tshad ma gsan/ mkhan chen gzhan dga' rin po che las ka ri ka che chung / mdo rtsa/ sor mdo/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ rigs tshogs phyi ma rnams dang / spyod 'jug byams chos sde lnga/ rgyud gsang snying / klong chen mdzod bdun sogs 91

mdo rgyud bstan bcos grangs las 'das pa gsan/ rje nyid kyis zhal nas gzhan tshos ci zer yang 'dra/ kho bo ni rang rgyud smin pa/ gzhan rgyud grol nus pa bla ma gzhan dga'i bka' drin yin zhes gsungs par grags/ dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang brtsa lnga pa las ka tshang rang lugs rku dbang lung khrid gsum bcas mdor na dgung grangs so gnyis bar thos bsam mdzad/ de nas gsol ngan du rdag pa'i bsnyun gzhi tshabs chen byung bas sgrub khang bsam gtan gling du lo gsum ring sku mtshams bcad rgya mdzad/ sgrol dkar bsnyen pa dung phyur grub/ zhabs brtan du bla ma rnams kyi dgongs babs yig brgya dung 'khoraXphyi nang bzhengs/ mkhan gzhan dga' rgya bo ri khrod du bzhugs skabs zha sa spru dang gsol chas dgos 'dong dgongs pa ma rdzogs bar gnang / zhing brjes skabs kyang rje nyid kyis dgongs rdzogs dang / dpal spungs tshom chen du gser gdung thog tshad skrub pa mdzad/ de nas dpal spungs 'du khang rnying skyon dang chung skyon che bas gzhi nas gsar bzhengs mdzad/ gser zangs kyi byams chen thog tshad gnyis/ston pa dang / jo bo/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'od dpag med/spyan ras gzigs/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ sogs gser zangs las thog tshad re can/ sgrol dkar dngul sku thog tshad/ logs bris 'grad bral dang / spyan gzigs yo byad 92

mchod rdzas grwa gdan bcas gsar bzhengs rgya cher bsgrubs/ 'du khang steng gser g.yab rgya bskyed dang / rgyal mtshan brgyad/ rten thug drug bcas gser zangs dang / span rgyan thog tshad chung ngu re yod pa nyi shus skor/ gzhan yang dung 'khor khang du tshe lha rnam gsum dang / o rgyan rin po che bcas gser zangs mi tshad che tsam re dang / steng du gañdzir dang / span rgyan bcu gnyis bcas bzhengs/ sgrub khang dang bshad grwa gnyis rtsa ba nas bshigs te gsar bzhengs/ de dag la gañdzir dang / span rgyan logs bris sogs dang / gzhan sku rten grangs mang / gsung rten la bka' bstan 'gyur tshar mang / bris sku dpag bsam 'khri shing / byams pa'i skyes rabs/ phur pa khro bcu bka' srung bcas zhal thang nyis brgya lhag bskrun/ par gsar brkos la/gzhung chen bcu gsum rtsa 'grel dang / rje brgyad pa'i gsung skor las/ mdo rtsa pod gsum/ sor mdo pod gcig dbu ma 'jug pa pod gcig sher phyin pod gnyis bcas/ gzhan yang tshad ma rig gzhung rgya mtsho pod gnyis/ rlung sems dbyer med/gzhan dga'i gsung skor sogs pu sti che chung brgya skor gyi spar shing ngo / de min tshes bcu'i 'cham chas skor sogs brjod du mi lang pa'i bzhengs pa gnang / mthar chu 'brug lor zhing gzhan du brjes so/ /zhal slob kyi thu bo ni rgyal dbang bcu drug pa dang /93

be ri mkhyen brtse/ rgyal sras mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer bcas/bcu gcig pa si tu pad+ma don yod ni/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes si tu gong ma'i sprul sku 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin/shing rta lo mdo smad sde dge'i cha gtogs dpal yul du 'khrungs—dgung lo drug par lha sa dang mtshur phu/ 'brug yul bcas brgyud rgya gar du phebs te risaXmed kyi skyes chen dam pa du ma bsten nas spru na gi rig gnas spyi dang mdo sngags chos sgo mtha' yas pa rnams la rim pas gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ lhag par dpal rgyal dbang bcu drug pa dang / kar lu rin po che rnam gnyis las ke chang dang shangs chos kyi zab don gyi gzhung dang gdams ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan nas mchog rdo rje slob dpon chen por dbang bskur/ sprub rgyud gser ri'i phreng bar mngon du phyogs pa'i don gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur/ dgung lo so gnyis bzhes pa la gdan sa dpal spungs su zhabs 'khod de gdan sa chen mo theg gsos dang byams chen gsar bzhengs/ bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs/ dgon pa'i bca' sgrig sngon srol ldar dgos pa'i bka' 'grel/ dbang lung sprub chen/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa sogs bstsal ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ mdo dbus gang sar dgon gnas lha khang sogs dngos rgyud kyi rten dang brten pa nyams gso gsar bzhengs la mthun rkyen 94

gnang ste pe cing brgyud de rgya gar du phebs/ de nas phyi rgyal yu rob dang / a gling / shar sto e shi la bcas par chos lugs mi rigs ris su ma chad pa'i skye bo mchog dman bgrang las 'das pa rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel ba rgya cher mdzad pa las brtsas min dad ldan gyi slob ma ji snyed cig byung ba ma zad/ yul gru mang po la bstan gzhi chos tshogs kyang brgya phrag tsam gsar 'dzugs gnang / spyi lo1⑫ku1lor slar thengs gnyis pa rang dgon dpal spungs su phebs te bod sbongs dang / mtsho sngon/ mdo khams stod smad/ 'jang / rgya yul sogs nas 'dus pa'i bla sprul dang dge 'dun nyidas stong brgal ba la gdams ngag mdzod dang bka' brgyud sngags mdzod kyi dbang lung man ngag sogs gdams ngag zab mo mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du lhag ma ma lus par rgyud spel gnang / gzhan yang bstan 'dzin kyi skyes chen dam pa du mar thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang lung khrid dang dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ de nas 'du khang rnying skyon che bas zhig gso dang bshad grwa gsar bzhengs bcas kyi 'char bkod legs po gnang nas rgya gar du phebs/ de nas mi ring bar 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs la bka' drin gzhal med du che ba dpal rgyal dbang karma pa bcu drug rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i yang srid 'khrul bral btsal 'tshol nas gser khrir mnga' 95

gsol rten 'brel legs 'bul bstar ba'i mdzad sgor zhugs te gtso skyong gnang / de'ang rang byung rig pa'i rdo rjes 'byung 'gyur gyi snying po don rgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che'i srog 'dzin du bzhed de thugs kyi sras tā yi si tu pad+ma don yod grub pa ga rtsas rgyal ba yab sras rnams skyong bkur res mos mdzad srol yod pa ltar byis pa'i spu dus nas thugs brtse chen pos dbang lung khrid sogs smin grol rgyab gsum cha tshang ba'i bka' drin bskyangs ba dang / sngon gyi dad pa dang thugs rje zung du 'brel ba'i stobs kyis cung zad kyang btang mi bra bar sku thog mang por rjes su 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed dam bca' brtan po khur du bzhes pa/ dper na/ mchog gyur gling pa'i (1'ji⑫nga 184༷) rnam spur las/ g.yas nas rim pa na/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dang / karma pa'i/ rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho bcas/ g.yon nas rim pa la/ mi bskyod rdo rje dang / dbang phyug rdo rje/ chos dbyings rdo rje1 ye shes rdo rje/ byang chub rdo rje/ bdud 'dul rdo rje/ theg mchog rdo rje rna sa zhal gzigs pa kams yongs grags ltar ro/ /gsham du ma 'ongs par sku phreng bdun gyi gzigs snang yin par gsung ste/ g.yon gyi gangs ri dang brag ri ke'u tshang du karma pa sku phreng brtsa lnga pa/ spyan snga ba dang bu slob bcas rlung 96

dang 'phrul 'khor la brtson pa ni/ zab lam nā ro chos drug gi rtogs pa mngon du mdzad pas phrin las gangs can ljongs su khyab pa'i brda/ g.yas su gtsug lag khang gser gyi ga rje ra g.yu yi rgya phibs yod pa karma pa sku preng bcu drug pa yongs 'dzin rin chen dang lhan rgyas chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa'i stong khang du ston pa shākya'i dbang po bzhugs pa ni/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag po rtsod med yongs su grags pa'i brda/ de'i phyogs kyi brag ri dang ljon shing gi drung du sku phreng bcu bdun pa dang kan ting tā yi si tu lhan rgyas ni1 thugs la yid gcig tu 'dres pas rgyal bstan lo 'dab rgyas shing dwags brgyud snying po'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i brda/ mdun du gur sgar chen du karma pa yab sras ston 'khor zhal 'dzoms pa ni/ sku phreng brtsa brgyad pa gdul bya phrin las shin tu rgyas pa'i brda ste/ de'i skabs su gter chen nyid chibs rta mchog tu skye ba bzhes zhes gsungs/ g.yon du rgya mtsho chen po'i khar gru gzeng du karma pa bzhugs pa karma pa sku phreng bcu dgu pa ni/ phrin las shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i khar khyab/ de dus rgya mtsho'i chu srin khra bo zhes mtha' dmag yin la de bzlog pa'i thabs gu ru rin po che bdud kyi gshen chen dgongs pa'i brda/ yang ljon shing gi bsil grib tu karma pa bzhugs pa ni sku phreng nyi shu ste/de ni sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas shing sgong ba bsam 97

gtan kho na la gzhol ba'i brda/ g.yon zur phebs gyol du bzhugs pa'i karma pa dge slong rna mas kyis gdan 'dren pa ni/ sku phreng nyer gcig pa sgar chen/ cing phyogs gar yang btegs pas che rgu rna mas kyis spyi bor 'degs pa'i brda/ g.yas su gser phibs g.yu gyo ldan pa ni gtsug lag khang du ljon pas brgyan pa'i kun dga' ra bar/ mkhan po paṇa zhwa rna ring dang chos gos rna ma gsum gsol ba la/ 'khor dge slong tshogs glegs bam thogs pa kams chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa dang / mdun du lhung bzed bkod pa ni/ 'byung 'gyur gyi char 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar zhing thos bsam gyi bya ba la 'bad pas/ dbyar gsar du 'dzugs pa sogs lhun bzed dang mkhar sil 'chang ba/ 'dul ba'i sde sgod la mkhas shing 'dzin pa phyogs gang yang mang du 'byung bar 'dug pas/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis/ dus kyis 'phel da ltar byar yod yen/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'gro ba'i sdu ga bsngal sel ba'i sman gcig pu ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yin pas da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rna mas kyis bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba dang / khyad par du dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa rin po che yal bar mi dor zhing gces sprad kyis 'dzin skyong gyis dang / rtags dang cha lugs tsam gyis kyang thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba'i sa bon theb par ngas pas dngos 98

kyi phan yon ni bsam brjod las 'das so/ /zhes gsung pa ltar dpal rgyal dbang karma pa na rim dang kan ting tsā yi si tu na rim gyi bar thun mong ma yin pa'i bla slob kyi 'brel ba yod cing / phan tshun skyong bkur res mos kyis sgo nas spyir mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa/ khyad par du bka' bzhin brgyud pa'i ring lugs kyi chu klung chen po brgya phrag mang po'i mgo bor gyur te/ ris su ma chad pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag la gzigs rtog dang zhabs 'degs bla na med pa zhus pa las/ gangs can ser skya yongs nas brtsir bkur dang bsngags brjod shin tu che ba ni lo rgyus dngos kyis grub la/ rje mkha' khyab rdo rje'i 'da' ka'i zhal chems sogs lhang dang zhal gdams du ma las kyang gsal ba ltar tā yi si tu pad+ma don yod grub pas kyang gangs can ser skya yongs kyis yang srid rin po che myur du gtan 'khel yong ba'i smon zhus pa dang rje gong mas don rgyud kyi snying po gtad pa dang 'brel/ yang srid rin po che ngos 'dzin bya ba'i 'os 'gan khur tu blangs te yang srid nges brnyes 'khrul bral byung ste bka' brgyud yongs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por chos kyi khri 'phangs mthon por zhabs sen bka shis pa'i re kha bkod grub pa byung ba 'di ni rang cag bod kha ba can gyi sems can rnams dang 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs la bka pa drin zhal med du che bar brten mdo khams stod smad sogs bod 99

ljongs gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi nang rgyal khab khag la yod pa'i dgon sde dang / chos tshogs khag dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs tshos dad gus spro gsum gyi sgo nas me tog 'thor ba dang throgs/ deng sang 'chi med pad+ma kā ra'i ngo bor 'tsho zhing gzhes pa 'di bzhin zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa snying nas gsol lo/ /kaḥthog pas si tur ngos 'dzin pa ni rje gong ma rig 'dzin chen mo'i slob ma yin pas yang sprul tsam du 'dzin rung mod sprul sku ngo mar 'dzin pa'i srol med/'jam mgon kong sprul na rim gyi mdzad rnam/dang po 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho ni/mdo khams sprul pa'i gnas brgyad kyi ya gyal pad+ma lha rtse'i mdu na rol/ yab bsod nams 'phel dang yum bka shis mtsho gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu bya spyi lo18riXlor sku 'khrungs te thun mong dang thun mong ma yen pa'i shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas shing / mdzod chen rna ma lnga la sogs gsar rnying bka' gter dag snang gi chos sgo rab 'byams la 'chad rtsom gyi bka' babs te/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas ris su ma mchis pa'i rgyal bstan yongs la ston pa gnyis pa lta bu'i 'phrin las bskyangs te/ mthar dgung grangs brgyad cu rtsa bdun rab byung 100

bco lnga pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1ra mi⑫ lor dgong pa zhi bar gshegs so/ khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa/ tā yi si tu sku phreng bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams dang / 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po dang / chos rje kun dga' 'jam dbyangs sogs sa ngor gyi bstan 'dzin rnams dang / mi pom 'jam dbyangs rna ma rgyal rgya mtsho dang / gter ston las rab gling pa sogs snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin rnams/ rgyud smad mkha na po ye shes gong 'phel/ brag g.yab gdong sprul mkhas mchog ngag dbang dam chos rgya mtsho sogs ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin du ma/ sman dpyad 'gro don shin tu che ba ku se gser ljang zhabs drung sprul sku sogs te/ mdor na skabs der dbus gtsang nas mdo khams stod smad bar gsum du khong gi zhal slob tu gyur pa shin tu mang bar snang ngo / /dam pa 'di nyid kyis rtsom bsgrigs gnang ba'i mdzod chen rna ma lnga ste/shes bya mdzod ni/ thog mar dge ba klad kyi don bstan bcos kyi ming dang mchod brjod dam bca' sngon du 'gro bas/bar du dge ba gzhung gi don la gdul zhing 'jig rten khams/'dul byed ston pa sangs rgyas/ 'dul thabs chos kyi 'khor lo/101

de nyid 'phags bod rnams su dar tshul/ gzhi rten tshul khrims rna ma gsum/ dang po thos pa/ bar du bsam pa/ tha ma sgom pa'i rna ma bzhag de la brten nas sa lam bgrod pa/ mthar 'bras bu la sbyor tshul bcas gnas chen po bcu/ de re re la nang gses kyi dbye bas rkang pa bzhi bzhir yod pas theg pa che chung /snga 'gyur 'od gab la rdo rje rtse mo'i dgongs pa khyad par ba rnams kyang zhar la rtogs par byas shing / de dag bsdu na gnas lnga pas lhag pa tshul khrims/ drug pa dang bdun pas shes rab/ brgyad pas ting 'dzin gyi bslab ba gtsor bton zhing gzhan rnams ni 'di dag gi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i yan lag tu gyur/ tha mar dge ba mjug gi don la bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin dgos pa rtsom tshul smon 'a ma shis brjod kyis rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i rtsa ba'i skor/mdor bstan don bsdu/ tshig 'brel bcas pod gsum la ldeb gcig stong brgya med bdun cu don brgyad do/ /'di mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis snga phyir par thengs gnyis brgyab cing / deng phyis kyi mkhas dbang gzan dkar sprul sku thub bstan nyi mas sa bcad tshigs su cad pa zhig bsgrigs gnang ste/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun yod/ de'i mgo brjod du rje nyid kyis/ dam pa gang gi gsung mdzod las/ /nye bar blangs pa'i bsnyen bcos 'di/ /mdo sngags rig gnas 'dir 102

'dus shing 1 /shes bya kun la 'di khyab pas/ /gsung mchog yid bzhin rgyal po la/ /mos gus drag pos nye drangs te/ /lhag bsam dag pas sbyar ba lags/ zhes gsungs so/ /bka' brgyud sngags mdzod ni/ mnga' bdag mar pa las brgyud pa'i bka' srol rtsa ba rngog dkyil bdun la byas/ de steng gzhan las gang rnyed 'thor ba bsdus pa ste/ dgyes rdor lha dgu/ 'di mtsho skyes lugs dang rnam pa 'dra'ang brgyud khungs klu sprub la mdzad par snang / bsre 'pho'i khrid 1 ro mi tri'i lugs so so/ bdag med lha mo brtsa lnga1 gur rigs bsdus/ bde mchog dang phag mo ke tshang lugs kyi lha lnga1 chos drug gi khrid/'khor ba sgyur drug sam bu ṭi rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyer dku/ ma hā mā yā lha lnga/ dbyibs sngags chos gsum gyi khrid/rdo rje gdan bzhi rnal 'byor nam mkha' lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/yum bka' ye shes dbang phyug lha bcu gsum ma/ gdan bzhi'i khrid/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga pa/ khrid zhi sbas bka' srol bcas ma rgyud skor/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus 'phags lugs/rim lnga'i khrid/ 'jam dpal gas nga ldan/ gshed dmar lha lnga dang mal lugs 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor 'di gnyis mar pa las brgyud pa min yang rje brgyad pa dang zhwa dmar bzhi pa rna mas kyi yig cha dang dbang lung gi rgyun bzhugs shing / pha rgyud 103

rigs gsum tshang ba'i phyir du bkod/ ras chung pa'i gtum mo lha lnga bcas/ de dag rnams kyi byi ba thabs/ dkyil 'khor chogazur 'debs sbyin sreg sogs gsar bsgrigs bgyis/ thor bu'i rigs lam bzang bla skrub/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ rgyal po dza:las brgyud pa'i rdor sems/ rnam rgyal ma/ sgrol ljang /phyag rdor rnams kyi dbang dang rjes gnang / bka' spung rgyud mgon/ dud sol ma/ tshe ring ma bcas kyi yig cha rnying pa rtsa ba gal chen rigs dang / gsar byed gang 'os gsar spel bgyis/de dag gi rgyab chos lta bur theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa/dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtags pa gnyis pa'i spyi don 'byu 'grel/ rje rang byung ba'i zab mo nang don 'grel pa/ zhem ye 'byed pa dang snying po bstan pa bcas kyi 'grel pa de dag go sla gtsor ston du dmigs nas gsar spel bgyis/ rnying ma bka' ma las 'khon lugs phur pa rje btsun tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i phrin las dang stod las dbang chog la kha skong ci nas dkas zhes dpal ldan rja spung gi bla grwa rnams kyis nan bskur ltar drag po sgrol dbang dang gtor zlog gtso bor gyur pa'i yig cha pod gcig 'khon lugs yang dag gi skrub dkyil rgyun khyer bcas tshan gsum/ so lugs yang dag skrub khog dang bsnyen yig gshin rje gdong drug gi sgrub dkyil dang dbang chog rnam 'joms khro dkar nag gi 104

las byang dbang chog rnams kyang bka' mdzod du gtogs pa pod gsum la ldeb gcib stong lnga brgya bcu gcig go /rin che na gter mdzod ni/ sdom la/ sa gter dbu brnyes sangs rgyas bla ma dang / /rgya ban rdor 'od gu ru hūṃ 'bar ma/ /rgya lo rdor bzang lha btsun byang chub 'od/ /zhang btsun dar rin rong zom chos kyi bzang / /grwa pa mngon shes rdor 'bum chos grags pa/ /sna nam thub rgyal zhang khrom rdo rje 'bar/ /khyung po dbal gyi dge ba rgya phur bu/ /lha rje gnubs chung lha btsun sngon mo dang / /ra shag chos 'bar dbu ru shākya 'od/ /grub thob dngos grub nyang ral nyi ma 'od/ /ra mo shes sman gru gu yang dbang gter/ /chu pho dge 'du na ba mkhal sprug po gdong /kun spang zla 'od mnga' bdag mol mi 'khyil/ /sum pa rkyang po 'bri ban sum tshogs dang / /sangs rgyas dbon po gnyal ba nyi she'i mtshan/ /g.yag phyar sngon mo sbur bu bya'u mgon/ /bal po a hūṃ a jo dpal bo pa/ /lcang sman don grub rong sman nyi ma'i 'od/ /dam pa dmar po skal ldan byis pa dang 1 /khams pa me zor kha la me 'bar ba/ khams pa phra mo brang ti mkhar bu ba/ /du gu rin seng gtsang ring shes rab mtshan/ /bla ma grum dang yon bdag mkhar nag pa/ /gu ru chos dbang gter slob kal 'byor bzhi/ /jo mo sman mo dung mtsho ras pa che/ /rgya 105

ston pad dbang khams pa nyi ma grags/ /gu ru jo rtse mkha' 'gro kun dga' 'bum/ /tshe brtan rgyal mtshan badz+ra ma ti dang / /phyag rdor pa dang sngags pa dbang chen gsum/ /zangs gling dbang phyug g.yas ban ya bon la/ /pad+ma las 'brel rgyal sras legs pa'i mtshan/ /dri med 'od zer me ban rin chen gling / /bon po lha 'bum yang bon ri khrod pa/ /gra sgom chos rdor yar rje yo rgyan gling / /nyi zla sangs rgyas shes rab me 'bar ba/ /bram pa kun bzang rgyal sras rdo rje gling / /bzang po grags pa yo rgyan sangs rgyas gling / /dri med lhun po dri med kun dga'i zhabs/ /dpal gyi rgyal mtshan rgod kyi ldem 'phru can/ /spung stong rgyal po grub thob karma gling / /'jam dbyangs bla ma bsam gtan bde chen gling / /'gro 'dul rat+na gling dang pad+ma gling / /mchog ldan rdo rje 'gro 'dul las 'phro gling 1 /kun skyong gling pa mchog ldan mgon po dang / /tshe dbang rgyal po paṇa chen pad+ma dbang / /tshe ring rdo rje mi 'gyur las 'phro gling / /rin chen phun tshogs ma ti rat+na ba/ /gar dbang zhig po gling dang legs ldan rje/ /shes rab 'od zer mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang / /bkra shis stobs rgyal gar dbang las 'phro gling / /pad+ma rig 'dzin bkra shis tshe brtan dang / /'ja' tshon snying po bdud 'dul nus ldan pa/ /zla ba rgyal mtshan yo rgyan gter bdag gling / /klong gsal snying 106

po stag sham bsam gtan gling / /mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal/ /ngag gi rdo rje dbon gsas khyung thog dang / /chos rje gling pa kun grol g.yung drung gling 1 /stobs ldan rdo rje kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / 1thugs mchog rdo rje kun bzang bde chen rgyal/ /rol pa'i rdo rje pad+ma bde chen gling / /tshe dbang nor bu rtsa gsum gter bdag mtshan/ /dri med gling dang ta'u rog rje gling / /'chi med rdo rje bstan 'dzin zla ba'i 'od/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po chos rgyal rdo rje dang / /pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i zhabs/ /mchog gyur bde chen gling pa yan chad do/ /dgongs gter snyan brgyud dag snang chos skor ni/ 1byang sems zla rgyal dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ /dam pa bde gshegs g.yu thog yon tan mgon/ /dge bshes brtson grags kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje grub dbang zla ba pa/ /ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po sangs rgyas mgon/ /grub thob tshul khrims bzang po pad+ma dkar/ /dbur smyon chos grags nam mkha' 'jigs med rtsal/ /rgyal mchog lnga pa nyi zla glong gsal ba/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal/ /karma chags med kun bzang chos rdo rje/ /ngag dbang mtshan 6na rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /'jigs med gling pa chos 'byor rgya mtsho dang / /pad+ma dgyes pa pad+ma nyin byed dbang / /bstan 'dzin phrin las gtsug lag chos 107

rgyal lo/ /de ltar sa gter dgongs gter dag snang snyan brgyud kyi chos skor rgya che ba rnams kyi dbang gi snying po dang / khrid rgyun yod rigs rtsa bar bzung / /sgrub spubs phrin las dbab chog bsnyen yig dang khrid yig sogs gang dgos gsar du sbyar/ /chos tshan nyung ngu dang rgyun dkon pa'i rigs/ gter phran rnams kyi gzhung dang yig rnying rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus/ de dag la'ang gas byed dgos pa la zur 'debs sogs zhib par bkod pa'i pu sti 'bring tshad drug cu longs pa bzhugs/ gter gsar lam rim ye shes snying po'i 'grel ba sogs kyang 'di'i khongs su sdud dgos pa yin no/ /de'ang thog mar mdo khams gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du dbon sprul gsum pa karma skrub brgyud bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dang sde dge chos rgyal dpal ldan 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje1 sde dge gnyer chen pad+ma legs grub bcas kyis ga rtsar bzung thog gzhan yang rnam dkar gyi 'byor ldan mang tsam gyis sbyin bdag gnang ste/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me bya spyi lo 1ra kyi༄ lor par du bskrubs pa dang /de nas rgyal dbang karma pa'i gdan sa stod lung mtshur phur karma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rjes rab byung brtsa lnga pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1⑫༷kyi lor dbu brtsams te lo jo bzhis yongs su rdzogs pa par du bskrun zhing / 1rgyal dbang nyid kyis zhu dag mdzad pa 108

dang dkar chag sogs kyang brtsams/ 'on kyang par gzhi de gnyis ka brlags zin/ sde dge par khang gis gong zhus par gzhi de gnyis go bsdur bgyis te rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1⑫pa'i lo nas spyi lo 1⑫nya'i lo'i bar par gsar du brkos nas/ deng sdo dge par khang du rin chen gter mdzod pod bdun cu la sdeb sum khri stong med lnga brgya don brgyad dang / de'i tsag li sum stong nyis brgya zhe bzhi bcas bzhugs so/ /gdams ngag mdzod ni/ skrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad la rab tu dad pa'i yid kyis so so'i ring lugs las byung ba'i smin grol gyi rgyun 'bad pa chen pos btsal/ de dag nyams su lon pa'i skal ba med kung bla ma'i gdams ngag chud mi za ba'i phyir dang / lugs srol yongs grags rnams ni so so la dar rgyas che rung shin tu dkan pa kha gcig rgyun chad la nye bas tshig brgyud ma chad tsam byung na snyam pa dang / mdo sngogs bstan pa'i snying po 'di dag tshar re thos kyang mi lus thob pa don ldan 'gyur ro snyam du lhag pa'i bsam pas/ shing rta brgyad kyi rtsa ba'i snying po rnams dang / smin grol bcud kyi yang zab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i smog ma snga 'byur snying ma la yo ga gsum gyi dang po ma hā yo ga la/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam chung / slob dpon rin po che'i man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bcas ma mo las kyi thig le/ kun 109

mkhyen chos rje'i sgyu 'phrul don khrid bcas/ a nu yo ga la bde ba gsal mdzad kyi rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ 'dus mdo'i ngang sgom zur bkol/ /a ti yo ga phyi nang gsang skor gsum gyi sems sde'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang lung / a don bco brgyad kyi dbang /khams lugs nyang lugs a ro lugs rnams kyi khrid/ nang blong sde'i rtsa brgyud dang lung / sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs dang khrid/snyeng thig bla ma mchod chog bka' spung sde bdun/ gsang ba man ngag sde'i rtsa brgyud dang lung / bla ma yang tig gi dbang dang khrid/ kun mkhyenaXchos rje'i gsang skor/ sems nyid ngal gso dang rang grol skor gsum gyi khrid/ dong sprugs khrid/ snying thig bla ma mchod chog bka' spung sde bdun bcas/gnyis pa bka' gdams skor la gzhung gdams man ngag gsum las/ gzhung rtsa ba byang chub lam sgron 'grel pa dang bcas pa lam rim khrid sogs/ gdams ngag blo sbyong rdan bdun ma'i rtsa ba/ khrid yig blo sbyong brgya rtsa'i be bum sogs man ngag rtsa ba byang sems nor phreng / thig le bcu drug gi dbang / khrid yigazhar byung lha bzhi'i rjes gnang khrid/ bka' gdams gsar ma'i mtshan gzhi rje rin po che'i lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum/ phyag chen rgyal ba'i gzhung lam/ dmar khrid/ de'i cha lag sems bskyed lugs gnyis kyi cho ga/ rjes 'brel dbu ma'i lta khrid/110

bka' gdams bla ma mchod chog bka' spung mgon po gri gugajo bo rje'i dzo dkar bcas/gsum pa gdams ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i skor/gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje tshig kang dang rnam 'grel/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsa ba/ khrid yig gzhung bshad/ kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang / lam 'bras ring brgyud nye brgyud shin tu nye brgyud rnams dang / gur gyi dag pa gsum gyi khrid/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad/ sgo drug chos 'bre' / zhar byung zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid/ lam 'bras bla mchod/ bstan spung gur mgon lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bcas/bzhi pa mnga' bdag mar pa bka' brgyud kyi skor la/ thun mong phyag chen gyi gzhung rtsa ba dpal rnyags pa med pa'i rgyud/ sa ra ha/ sha ba ri te lo/ nā ro/ rme tri pa1 mar mi dwags gsum gyi gsung 'grel pa dang bcas/ thun min chos drug gi rtsa ba bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i chig rkang / ka dpe che chung / te yo nā ro mi la'i snyan brgyud gsang ba skor gsum bcas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum snyan brgyud lugs kyi dbang / gdams khrid kyi rtsa ba snyan brgyud rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ ras chung pa'i lus med mkha' 'gro chos dgu/ mtshur ston snyan gyi shog dril bzhi/ dwags po bka' 111

brgyud so so'i bka' srol las byung ba rtsa ba dwags po gdan sa'i lugs/ zhang tshal pa/ karma ke tshang / de'i nang tshan zur mang dang gnas mdo/ phag gru bka' brgyud rtsa ba dang / zur bzhi ya brgyad las/ 'bri gung / stag lung / 'khro phu/ gling ras bka' brgyud dpal ldan 'brug pa stod smad bar gsum/ yang dgon pa/ 'ba' ra ba bcas kyi phyag chen chos drug ga rtsa bor gyur pa'i khrid kyi rigs/ bka' brgyud spyi'i bla mchod/ bka' spung phyag bzhi pa dang dud sol ma bcas/lnga pa shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi skor la/ rtsa ba chos drugasdong po phyag chen/ yal ga lam khyer gsum/ 'bras bu 'chi med rnams kyi rdo rje'i tshig kang 'grel pa dang bcas/ me tog mkha' spyod rtsa bar byas/ byin rla sa sgo 'byed kyi bka' gnyis byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis/ byin rlabs gzhung shing gi bka' drug gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi byin rlabs/ nye brgyud spung rgyal lugs kyi khrid cha tshang / ring brgyud rje btsun tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i khrid/ su kha sirnyi dang lha bzhi dril sbob skor1 shangs lugs bla ma mchod chog mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang / mgon po'i bka' chen bcu gsum/ snying zhugs dang ka du pa la bcas1drug pa dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed skor/ rtsa ba rgyud 112

sde'i dum bu/ dam pa'i gsung thor bu/ bka' babs snga phyi bar gsum bka' spung dang bcas pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs yongs rdzogs/ de dag gi khrid yig lo chen dha rma kas mdzad pa/ snye mdo bsod nams dpal ba'i zhi byed khrid bcas/ de'i yan lag dam chos bdud kyi gcod yul gyi skor la/ gzhung rtsa ba bram ze lhan de ba dang ma gcig gi gsung bka' tshoms yang tshoms nying tshoms le lag shes rab skra rtse/ zab don thugs snying rna mas/ smin byed dbang zur mang / 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ rgyal thang pa'i lugs gsum/ gdams ngag khrid yig bka' babs snga phyi bar gsum/ tshogs las/ zhi byed bla ma mchod pa bcas/bdu na pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las/ gzhung rtsa ba dus 'khor rgyud snyi nga / dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ sha ba ri pa'i gzhung chung rna mas/ lha dgu'i sprub thabs mchod chog mchog dbang thun mong ma yin pa khrid yig cha lag dang bcas pa jo nang rje btsun rin po che'i gsung / lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le/sbyor drug 'bring po dpe med 'tsho lugs bsdus pa lce rtse rkan spyar/ sbyor drug bla mchod/ lhan skyes dang rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang bcas/brgyad pa rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sprub la/ grub chen o rgyan pa la rdo rje phag mo dang rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros gnang ba'i gzhung 113

rtsa ba/ 'grel bshad/ khrid yig bsnyen sprub gdan rdzogs su sgom pa rnams so/ / de min brgyud srol sna tshogs las byon pa'i gdams ngag khrid thor bu'i skor la / grub chen brgyad tsu'i byin rlabs dang khrid/mi du khrid drug dbang dang khrid so so/ sems nyid ngal gso dang snying po don gsum skor zha lu nas brgyud pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dmar khrid rigs lnga/ thang rgyal yig drug nyams len/ bo dong lugs kyi phyag chen dang thub pa mdo gcod/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po'i gtum mo dang 'pho khrid/ rong ston ma 'pho/jo nang gsar 'gyur bka' babs bdun gyi khrid/ bcud len gyi rigs mthar dge tshe lha rnam gsum gyi rjes gnang / nye brgyud tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma dang sgrol dkar ba ri 'ugs kyi tshe khrid/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi mchod chog bcas bzhugs pa pod bcu la ldeb bzhi stong bdun brgya bdun cu don gcig go/rgya chen bka'i mdzod ni/ shog ser dam rdzas sogs zab gter gsang ba'i khyad nor thun mong ma yin pa dang / dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen gling gi rten dang brten pa bcas pa'i dkar chag yang khrod kun bzang bde chen gleng gi sprub pa rnams kyi kun spyod bca' khrims/ skad gnyis shan sbyar la nye bar mkho ba'i zin tig gces par btus pa/ rtsis kyi bstan 114

bcos nyer mkho bum bzang las skar rtsis 'jig bde/ rtsis kyi sngon 'gro me long / gtsug lag rtsis kyi sngon 'gro rab gsal me long / mi na'i sa dpyad gsar 'gyur lugs kyi sgo 'byed/ rje nyid kyi rnam spur sogs gsung rtsom thor bu'i rigs phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa bcas pod bcu la ldeb bzhi stong brgyad brgya bcu dgu bzhugs so/ /de ltar rnam thar dang dkar chag las bsdu so/ /gong zhus de dag gi par shing sngon mdo khams dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du cha tshang bzhugs kung / rig gsar sgabs rin chen gter mdzod dang gdams ngag mdzod pod drug gi par shing brlags zin/ gzhan rnams da lta'ang dpal spungs dgon du bzhugs/ de bzhin du rje 'di nyid kyi ngo mtshar gsung rab glegs bam dgu bcur longs pa'i rnam thar la gzhig na sku tshe de nyid du rtsom pa rkyang pa mdzad pa lta bu dang / mdo sngags bka' gter gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa'i dbang khrid man ngag bklag lung sogs kyi 'chad spel la bsam na sku tshe kho nar 'chad spel sha stag mdzad pa lta bu/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyong gi rnal 'byor nas brtsams dkyil 'khor rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams bzhes mdzad tshul la brtag na sku tshe'i ring sgom khang 'dag sbyar gyis bzhugs pa lta bu/ tsā 'dra rin chen brag dang rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub gnas su 115

dgon sde gsar spel dang rten rnying mang po'i nyams gso/ sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsar bzhengs/ tshom bu tshogs kyi sprub chen brgya phrag phyed gnyis mdor na chos spyod rnam pa bcu'i phyag rjes la gzhal na sku tshe de nyid la bya ba las kyi 'khor lor brtson nas bzhugs pa lta bu ste/ nges par 'phags pa'i spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig go/ lhag par zab gter gyi bka' babs tshul ni/ ngo mtshar zhing brjod kyis mi langs ba yin pas 'dir mi smos/ zhes bdud 'joms chos 'byung las gsal/de'ang rje nyid kyi gsung rab glegs bam dgu bcu tsam bzhugs pa de dag spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan rgyun dang / bye brag bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas gong 'phel yong ba la dge mtshan rlabs po che yod pa/ gso rig gcig pu la mtshon na1 shes bya mdzod〉kyi nang tshan bzhi pa rig gnas zhar byung dang bcas pa'i byung ba brjod pa'i nang gso rig gi skor la/ thog mar su zhig gis dran gyi gang las brgyud pa dang / bar du ston pas ji ltar gsung tshul/ tha mar rgya bod du ji ltar dar tshul gsum la bsdus nas khog phub par mdzad/ lhag par rgyud bzhi'i byung tshul las rgyud bzhi g.yu thog rang gis mdzad par bzhed/ yang rin chen gter mdzod〉 sa gnyan rims sna tshogs sngon 'gog dang /bcos thabs rnam grangs mang zhing phan pa che ba mang po dang / dmu 116

chu'i bcos thabs/ — mdze nad brtsas thabs sogs kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan pa'i sman dpyad skor shin tu rgya che ba yod pa de dag da bar dar khyab cher byung / yang rgya che bka'i mdzod〉las/ zin tig gces bsdus bdud rtsi thig pa〉zhes pa rje nyid kyis rang gi myong byang man ngag phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa de khyab spel dang 'brel/ rig pa dpe thog lus pas lag len dka'/ /ma sbyangs sman rkyal thogs pas nad pa bslu/ /zang zing don gnyer sman pa'i ming 'dzin la/ /'di 'dras don du 'gyur snyams 'bad pas 'god/ ces pa'i zhal gdams snying gi nor bu dang ba gsungs nas bzung kong sprul zin teg ces pa 'di ni khams phyogs tsam du ma zad/ bod ljongs/ mtsho sngon/ kan su'u/ yun nan 6sa pa'i bod rigs sman pa zhems kyis bed spyod shugs chen byed pa dang / rang cag sman pa rnams la rgyas bsdus 'tshams shing 'a ga len bde ba'i sman dpe yag shos shig yin stabs sngon chad sde dge dang / lha sa sman rtsis khang gnyis la shing par brkos pa ༷ dang / spyi lo1⑫ba5lor mtsho sngon sa khul nas lcags par brgyab te 'gro phan ha cang che ba byung zhes bod sbongs sman rtsis khang gi yon krang byams pa 'phrin las mchog nas gsungs so/ /mdor na/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba dang /117

skye 'gror sman pa'i mdzad da phrin mtha' klas pa phyag bzhes mdzad pas mtshan snyan yangs pa'i rgyal ba/ mas kun tu khyab/ lhag par du dam pa 'di nyid la grub mtha' phyogs ris med pa dang yul lung 'then khyer sogs med pa shes bya'i gnas kun la thugs brtson drag po skad cig kyang mi lhod pa dang / de thams cad gsan lo tsam du mi 'jog par re re bzhin nan tan mdzad de bod da kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i rig gnas so so dpyid dpal bzhad pa ltar gong 'phel yong ba dang / lhag tu thos bsam mdzad 'dod yod khan rnams la dpyad gzhi'i gsung rab yig rigs rnyed dka' ba pod dgu bcu longs pa brtsams pa 'di 'dra ni blo gsal rnams kyis mig stos su bzung nas shes rig yon tan don gnyer hur bskyed bya dgos so/ /'jam mgon gnyis pa dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer ni/ (1⑫04nga 1⑫54) bod dbus gtsang ru bzhi las dbu ru stod lung dpal gyi mtshur phu zhes bya ba'i yul du/ yab rgyal dbang karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje dang / yum rig ldan dka'i bde skyid dbang mo zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing pho 'brug gi lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te 'khrungs/ byis pa'i gnas skabs nyid nas kung byis pa'i rgud pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das shing / bag 118

med par rtse ba mtha' dag las ngang gis log nyes spyod rnams ni rang bzhin gyis ba sdams/ blo gros dpag pa dka' zhing dam pa'i chos 'tshol ba la ngang gi zhugs pa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che rnams las nam yang nyams pa med cing / ma 'ongs mngon shes mnga' tshul yang dge rgan dang sku 'khor rnams kyis dngos su mthong thos byung tshul du ma yod/dgung lo lnga pa'i dus su yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang pos dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes te/ mtshan karma dpal ldan chos kyi dbang phyug blo gros dri med pad+ma'i myu gu mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sde zhes gsol/ de nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug par bzhed de/ rab byung gi rtags bstsal nas bla mar mnga' gsol te yon tan kams cad kyi rtsa ba glog yig sbyong ba'i tshul bstan pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen na—sa/ chos spyod mang po zhal ton du mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes par shing yos sa gar zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum la gdan sa chen mo 'og min mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang chen du 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i sprul skur rje bco lnga pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng du mnga' gsol nas rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbu zhwa dang sku chos gsol te bka' brgyud gong ma'i thugs dam rtsa ba rgya rgyam yin pas 'di dus dang rgyun par dgongs bzhes mdzad dkas pa'i bka' slob yang bstsal/119

de nas lha ldan du phebs te jo shāka sogs rten khyad 'phags can rnams mjal te mchod 'bul mdzad/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho mjal te da ni sngar nas yid la yang dang yang du yod pa bzhin dam pa'i chos 'tshol ba sogs thus nas rgyal ba rin po ches gtsug phud bzhed de thugs shin tu dgyes par byung ste shel bam dang thang ka gnang nas gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung bstsal zhing mtshan thub bstan chos sku bde chen dbang phyug ces gsol/ lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes kar rje gong ma'i gdan sa dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen gling la phyag phebs/ me 'brug lor gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs kyi gtsug lag khang du khri ston mnga' gsol/ rgya bod dang / 'jang / rgyal rong mdo khams sto( smad kyi rgyal blon sku drag sku tshab mang pos khri 'bul bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad/de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su rab tu byung ba dag gi las su bya ba ni gnyis te/ 'di ltar klog pa thos bsam dang /skrub pa bsam gtan gyi rim pa'o dgongs nas/ de bas na bdag gis kyang klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa rang gi rgyud la 'dzin cing gzhan la'ang rgya cher spel ba bya'o snyam du dgongs nas1 de dus dpal spungs dgon du bzhugs pa'i mkhas dbang grong gnyis tshe dbang 120

dang / bkra 'phel/ gser kha chos grags/ gzhan yang rgyal tshab rin po che dang / zhe chen kong sprul sogs bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung yang mang rab gsan pa dang / bshes gnyen dam pa gzhan mang po las gzhung chen bcu gsum dang / mdzod chen rnam lnga/ rje dus gsu ma mkhyen pa nas mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bar gyi bka' 'bum/ si tu chos 'byung dang pad+ma nyin byed kyi bka' 'bum/ ke tshang chos skor dang 1shangs chos skor/ nā ro chos drug phyag chen rgya gzhung / blo sbyor thugs rje chen po bcas kyi dbang lung khrid man ngag bcas gsan/ de thams cad gsan lo tsam du ma mdzad par re re bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes nas lam rtags kyi yon tan gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin ma grub kyi bar thugs brtson drag pos bskrubs/khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i don la gzhan mkhan chen rnams kyis kyang gting dpag par dka' ba'i sgom byung gi shes rab 'gra na zla bral/ gzhan la'ang rang gi thob tshad 'a na re ma chad pa cher med cing dbang lung gnang ba'i skabs kyang zang zing tsam gyis don du gnyer ba ma yin par bstan 'gro'i don du kho nar sku ngal ma stos pa gsal dag dal lhod go ba chags nges mdzad de 'jam mgon gong ma'i rnam spur 'phren las skyong thub nges byung ngo / /de dag gi tshe yang yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi dang rtsa ba tshul khrims 121

su dgongs nas lha ga pa'i tshul khrims nyes lhung gi dri ma spums cad dang bral ba zheg mnga' bas gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa gser ri 'i phreng ba lha bu'i dbus na lhun po ltar mngon par 'phags shing /bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtsos min thugs rgyud la rgyun chags par mnga' bas 'gro ba kun la bu gcigaXpa ltar dgongs te/ rje nyi da kyi gsung las kho bo la so thar gyi stung ba sde lnga las/ pham pa bzhi gtan nas gos pa med ces yang yang gsungs/ mdor na bsgab pa phra mo yan chad la mig ltar gces spras mdzad/de nas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig las mi g.yel ba'i spung ma khyad par can dang bka' phyogs skyong ba'i lha dag gis dngos su bsnyen bkur zhing legs so gso ba'i tshig gis mngon pa bsngags shing / gzhan la chos ston pa'i 'phrin las lhur mdzad la dgongs pa mngon du phyogs pa ni/ snga phyir du zur mang dang /lha thog dkar legs/ karma dgon/ ja ma dgon/ khru mgu dgon/ 'dam dkar dgon/ zhang 'gu dgon/ dre thang dgon/ ban chen dgon/ ri ba dgon/ tshang gsar gnam dgon/ mgon po dgon/ byang rta rna dgon/ khyung po gru ya ba dgon/ go lcags dgon/ skyo brag dgon/ rab 'byor dgon/ dad pa dgon/ go che dgon/ dil yag dgon/122

rnam rgyal gling dgon/ tsha ba sgrol ma lha khang/ dpal de dgon sogs chos sde mang por phyag phebs te dad ldan mang po'i zhus ngor skrub chen lan mang ka dbu bzhugs mdzad pa dang / skal ba dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa la 'chad nyan mdzad cing dkan pa de dag gi grwa tshogs kyang je che la song ste rim gyis dbang lung khrid dang dge tshul slong gi sdom pa stong phrag brgal ba gnang / kun mi phyed pa'i dad pa g.yos te tshogs kyi kun spyod rnam pa dag cing /chos 'chad nya na sogs ches phul du byung bar gyur te rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'i dad pa rnams dad pa byas/ dad pa rnams phyir zhing dad pa 'phel bar byas te 'jam mgon bstan pa phyogs kun 'phel bar mdzad/de nas rang gi bsti gnas dam par rjes 'jug rnams sgrub pa nyams len la sbyar te sprub pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las spel ba 'di mchog dang gtso bor gsungs pas gdul bya rnams rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du skrub pa nyams len la 'god pa bya'o dgongs te rje nyid kyis kyang bstan pa'i bya ba de ltar mdzad pa'i skabs kun tu thugs dam gyi rim pa rna mas chags med du mdzad de 'jam mam/na gong ma'i rnam thar phrin las skyong thub nges byung /rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu lug zla ba gnyis pa'i ches gnyis la dbu btsugs te dpal spungs su rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang 121

lung gnang ste/ skyabs mgon dpa' bo rin po che dang / zur mang drung pa sprul sku sogs gzhi byes ris med sprul sku bla ma drug cu skor la khrid lung gnang ba yang gsal dag go brda 'phrod nges dang de bzhin mchod pa spyi bye brag gzab rgyas dbang chen sogs tshogs 'khor bcas shin tu rgyas pa mdzad de yongs rdzogs zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum la legs par grub/mdor na rje nyid kyis 'chad pa'i tshe sku ngal ma stos par thog mar nas sbyong rtsal dpe gzigs zhib cha dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su thogs pa med par mdzad/ rtsod pa dngos mdzad pa sku tshe 'dir med kyang / bka' 'dri zhu ba po spobs pa can 'ga' res brgal brtags ji tsam byas kung lung rigs kyi sprub byed bcas the tshom sel nus/ rtsom pa na zhal gdams rna mas ni snya na ngag sog kyi rab rtog ma yin par rang bzhin brjod pa go bde ba rgyal bas mdo rgyud las gsung pa lta bu snyan 'jebs don ldan kho na dang / 'bul yig chab shog sogs skabs su bab na snyan ngag rab rtog bston dor gzugs ca na sogs ches ya mtshan pa ste bka' rtsom pu sti che gras gnyis tsam bzhugs/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi chos thams cad gnas zugs ji lta ba gzigs pas gcig shes kun grol du gyur/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes bstan 'gro la phyogs lhung med pa'i phan pa 'ba' zhig dang / nus pas dam sri gdug pa can 124

rna mas kyang brlag par mdzad na gzhan lta ci smos so/ /rab byung bco lnga pa'i me stag zla baXganyis pa'i mjug la sna sel rim gro rigs rje nyid dang / gter sras 'od gsal rdo rje gnyis nas tshad ldan grub pa mdzad de zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer lnga gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge zhing shis pa'i nyi na rmang bteng nas yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dgongs rdzogs su kar rabs lha khang gsar bzhengs kyi dbu brtsams pa dang zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug la dbu tshugs te ga rtsa bo rgyal dbang bco lnga pa chen po sku thog tshad gser zangs rgyab yol rgyan drug bcas gser dngul spel ma 'khor kar rabs bcu bzhu kyi chad mtho brgyad re bcas tshad ma zangs dang gser shas mthug cing gser mdangs legs pa bcas bzhengs te lo jo gsum tsam gyis rten dang brten pa legs par grub1rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sbrul zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la sngon 'jam mgon gong ma'i dus kyi sprub khang yo grangs mang bas rnying skyon dang / 'di nas skrub khang 'phar ma bas ha cang chung skyon bcas gang thad gzhig nas gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i rnying ma bshigs shing zla ba bcu pa'i nang lha khang khag dang mtshams khang phyi khog sdod lo tsam grub pas sgrub pa sngon dpon g.yog bcu yod steng gsar du bco lnga bsnan nas sgrub pa po nyer lnga yod pa'i thugs bzhes mdzad/ mgon khang dngos bang khang 125

tshon rtsi bcas grub nas mthar rdor slob bla ma kar lu rin po ches kung 'phrin las kyi rogs ram phul du phyin pa bcas kyis mthar phyin par gyur to/ /gzhan sngon rjes su 'jam mgon gong ma dang / byams mgon pad+ma dbang mchog gi snang brnyan byin ldan can dang / ke tshang zung 'jug bla brgyud zhal thang sogs zhal thang stong phrag la nye ba gsar bzhengs/ gdan sa karma dgon nyams gso'i thebs rgya chen dang dus mkhyen sku zangs gser mtho brgyad can gsar bzhengs sogs la mthun rkyen dang / zur mang rnam rgyal rtse'i gar dbang sprul skus karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum pu sti bcu skor srur du bzhengs par zhal 'degs rgya cher gnang / mdor na bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i 'gro don rgya chen por mdzad/ ma thar rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sbrul lo khra legs kyi ri khrod du dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus te sku gdung zhal chems ltar ri khrod de ga'i dbus nas gdung khang mchod 'bul gzab rgyas bcas bzhugs su phul/ de nyin 'ja' tshon sogs mtshan ltas dpag tu med pa kun gyis mthong snang mthun pa dang / khyad par smad phyogs nas 'grul pa zhig gis de ring nam mkha' la khang khyim yul bkod lta bu mang po'i dkyil du bla ma na bza' ser po mnabs pa zhig je mthor phebs pa song ba mthong bas ci red ces dris pa sogs ngo 126

mtshar 6na du ma byung bar grags so/ /de ltar rje 'di pas rang nyid kyi sku dang srog la'ang ma gzigs par bstan pa'i srog shing bzung bas na rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag la bka' drin shin tu che'o/ /'jam mgon sku phreng gsum pa karma blo gros chos kyi seng ge (1⑫54nga 1brtse lda) ni/ rje gong ma dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis 'da' kha'i zhal chems su/ sprul sku yul dbus su yong / yul khyim/ lo dus/ pha ma sogs karma pa bcu drug pa chen po mchog gis lung ston par 'grur/ zhes bka' bstsal pa ltar/ gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang /rgyal dbang karma pa'i sgrib bral ye shes kyis gzigs pas/ dgung grangs gcig dang zla ba lnga bzhes skabs na bza' dang mtshan gsol/dgung grangs drug bzhes par karma pa bcu drug pa mchog gis 'bras ljongs rum bteg sprul pa'i pho brang du mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas bzung rgyal dbang mchog dang 'bral med rgyal ba yab sras lhan bzhugs kyis rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu'i bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag skrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po cher bskyangs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1khyar4 lor dpal spungs gdan sar phebs te ser skya mi dmangs rnams la bka' dbang dang gsung chos/ lhag par dge 'dun grangs lnga brgya tsam la dge tshul slong 127

gi sdom pa gnang / de nas lha ldan du phebs nas 'og min mtshur phu gdan sa bskyar bzhengs kyi chog mchan zhus bskul dang 'brel 'bul dngos ji byung gdan sa de nyid gsar bzhengs kyi ched du gnang / spyi lo 1⑫khu1lor slar dpal spungs su phebs te sde dge par khang chos mdzod chen mo zhig gsos byas pa la rab gnas zhabs 'degs rten rtsa bcas gnang / dpal spungs su dgon de'i bla sprul dge 'dun dang / mtsho sngon/ bod ljongs sogs nas phebs pa'i bla sprul dge 'dun grangs lnga brgya lhag dang 'dus tshogs pho mo khri tshogs brgal ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang chen dang /dge tshul slong grangs lnga brgya bcas gnang / de nas skye dgu 'dam dkar dgon du phebs nas nang chen dgon sde khag la bla sprul dge 'dun mi dmangs khri tshogs brgal ba la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen bstsal/ ma thar dgung grangs so dgu spyi lo 1khya⑫ji lo zla ba ba tshes lda༄nyin bka' gling phug nas 'bras ljongs rum btegs gdan sar phyir phebs kyi phebs lam zhig tu phebs gru 'bar 'thor byas pa'i rkyen gyis bsam yul las 'das par re zhig zhing du gshegs so//zhwa dman na rim gyi mdzad rnam/da ni rgyal dbang karma pa dang thugs rgyud gcig pa gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam rol zhwa dmar ba na rim kyi rnam thar de mtshungs gleng bar bya ste/ de yang bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i 128
