sngon rol du de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag ces bya ba 'jig rten du byon te des mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i tshe/brtsam ldan 'das shākya thub pa tshong dpon shes rab bzang po zhes par gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa de la bsod stoms thog mar phul lo/ /zhes mdo bskal bzang las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag de nyid sems can gyi don du pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs kyis mdzes pa'i rtsad pan can du sprul pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rje mkha' spyod pas skye ba snga 'brel zhes par sku skye ba brgya'i bar du rje ro la pa'i rdo rje 'di nyid rjes su bzung ba'i tshul 'di bzhin mdzad do/ /zhes mtha' dag 'bri bar mi nus/ nyung bsdus tsam ni/ te lo pa'i slob ma khol po dga'/ nā ro'i slob ma bram ze kun rig mi ka'i slob ma bal por 'khrungs pa'i gzhon nu gsang 'tshol/ sgam po pa'i slob ma tshul khrims dpal/dus mkhyen gyi slob ma dge slong nam mkha' 'od/ bsna'i slob ma bkra shis grags pa rnams so/ /yang karma bka'i sha rnam thar dgongs pa lung bstan las/ /lung bstan skyes bu rnam gnyis dang //dbyer med rang byung rdo rje nga 1zhes rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang kha' spyod dbang po gnyis so/ /yang rje karma bkar sha kho bo skye ba nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byams pa'i bstan pa rgyas par byed do/ /zhes dpal mkha' spyod pa nyid kyi zhwa'i brda don du zhwa dmar rtsad pan 129

'dzin pa nyi shu rtsa gcig tu ston pa yin no/ /dang po zhwa dmar grags pa seng ge ni/ mdo smad spom 'bor gyi sa yi char/ deng sang phyag phreng du grags pa'i yul stod/shis zhes bya bar yab stag chung dang yum dbra rgod bza' las chu lug la bltams/ sku chung ngu'i dus yum gyis zhing gi lo thog la byi'u bkag bcol ba na byi'u ma dkrog pas yum gyis rgol tshe rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ byi'u la nyin re zas lan re las zar mi 'ong ba'i bka' sgos pas deng sang yul grong der byi'u bkag mi dgos pa'i ngo mtshar yod/ stag lung ba'i chos sde rdza khol ba blo gros grags la dge bsnyen zhus/ dus mkhyen dngos slob rgya pho ba lung pa'i slob ma ye shes seng ge las rab tu byung / nyer drug la mtshur phur phebs/slob dpon tshul rin dang / slob dpon shu ku rgyal sogs bsten nas sde snad mdo rgyud sogs la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad pas mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ gzhon du byang chub las bsnyen par rdzogs/nyer brgyad la rje rang byung ba mjal nas bka' brgyud rin po che'i gdams pa ma lus pa gsan nas bstan pa'i dag por gyur/ rda sngo mdor 'khrungs shing jo nang pa'i gong ma byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la sbyor drug dang / rig 'dzin ku ma ra dza la rdzogs chen gsan/ rje rang byung bas ka po gnas nang du 'byon dgos zhes lung bstan yang 'byon ma grub/ phyis zhwa dmar ba'i skye phreng la 130

'di'i rten 'brel gyi cung zhig gnod par sems/ mtshur gnas nang du bla ma'i bka' mi bcag phyir gnas nang zhes ming btags nas dgon pa btab/ /rje rang byung bas rgya yul nas bka' shog dang zhwa dmar gnang / dgung lo re bdun pa glang lor mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /gnyis pa zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po ni/ byang gnam gzhung gi bye ma lu nga na yab lha rgyal dang / yum 'brog mo'i sras su lcags pho stag lo la bltams/ byis pa'i dus nas dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas/ dgung lo bdun pa la rje rol pa'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos pa nas bzung bka' chos ma zus pa gsan/ dbu zhwa dmar po gnang / gzhan yang bla ma mang du bsten/ mkhyen rtogs phul du byung / bka' 'bum gyi ngo mtshar grub pa'i rnam thar sogs mtha' klas/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla mar gyur rjes 'dis ma 'ongs sprul rgyud sogs kyi lung bstan gang bstsal thog tu babs pa sogs ya mtshan du ma mnga'/dgung lo nga drug pa shing mo bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer dgu la gshegs so/ /rje mkha' spyod dbang po la sprul sku gnyis 'byung bar lung bstan pa ni/ shar gyi phyogs su chu klung chen po dang /glang po sna zhag rkyang pa lta bu'i ri dang nye bar bsam gtan 131

byed do/ /zhes zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos dpal ye shes dang /sngon gyi phan pa'i lha ga mas byang phyogs kyi bla ma'i gnas su spyod cing de'i phrin las sgrub par byed do/ /zhes stag lung rje byang chub rgya mtshos lung bstan/gsum pa zhwa dmar chos dpal ye she sa ni/ nyang po'i yul gyi khe brag mdor yab bsam 'grub dang yum ra bza' las/me khyi dbyar ra'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'khrungs/ ya mtshan gyi ltas mang / brgyad pa la rje de bzhin gshegs pas dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gnang nas mtshan chos kyi dpal ye shes su gsol/gzhan yang chos gdams ngag thams cad gnang / tā ming rgyal pos lā ta hung las bzos pa'i dbu zhwa dmar po mu tig sogs kyis brgyan rnga/ phul/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sog dbon rig ral sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ rje mthong ba don ldan la bka' chos phul/ bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa chu pho sprel lo'i ston ra la gshegs so/ /bzhi pa zhwa dmar spyan ma chos grags ni/ mkha' spyod dbang pos shar nas shar gyi phyogs su skye ba 'dzin par lung bstan pa ltar mdo smad kre shod khang dmar du yab dgon pa skyabs dang /yum dbra bza' bsod nams sgrol ma'i sras su chu mo bya lo 'brug zla ba'i tshes gsum la bltams/ dgung lo brgyad pa la rje chos 132

grags rgya mtsho'i drung gtsug phud phul/ dpal 'byor don 'grub las rab tu byung / karma pas dbu zhwa dmar po gnang nas chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i mtshan gsol/ gzhon nu dpal las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhan yang bla ma mang du bsten pas zab cing rgya che ba'i mkhyen rab phul du byung bas phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur/dpal mkha' spyo da pas rje btsun badz+ra rā dza'i dgongs pa sprub par dga' bas de'i gnas dang nye bar kun tu rgyu'i spyod pas 'jug go/zhes lung bstan pa ltar gdan sa thel gyi spyan snga mdzad pas lugs gnyis ka'i bstan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung / de dus rgyal ba zhwa dmar nag gnyis ka'i bstan pa chen po khyab pas phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu phrin las la/ drung skor rna mas kyis ma bzod pas rgyal ba yab sras kyi bar du snya na phra zhu ba sogs dkrug gzhi mang po zhig byung tshul rnam thar rgyas bsdus rnams las ma gsal yang /rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung lkog gyur thams cad gsal bar bstan pa'i zur pa zhig mchis pa las zhib pa 'dug dgung lo nga gcig pa la yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par mdzad pa sogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa'ang bgrang las 'das/dgung lo don gnyis pa sprel lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la chos dbyings su bzhugs so/ /133

lnga pa zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag ni/ rje mkha' spyod dbang pos mthar spyod pa nor 'dzin skyong ba'i bu gzhon nur byas te rdzas kyi nus pa mi zad pa'i gsang tshol bar byed do/ /zhes lung bstan pa bzhin kong po'i stod rkyen bya bar yab rgyal po mtshan ldan dang / yum bsod nams sgrol ma'i sus su shing mo bya lo'i 'khrums zlar 'khrungs/ rje mi bskyod rdo rjes zhwa dmar ba'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin/ de skabs sprul sku gzhan zhig kyang byung yod 'dug par rtsod gzhi cung zad byung yang mi bskyod rdo rjes/ zhwa dmar pa yi char pa babs gyur kyang / nga yi zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag yin/ zhes thag gcig chod mdzad/ phyis su grub mtha' gzhan gyi mkhas pa dag gis sprul sku ni gcig shos yin zhing dkon mchog yan lag nor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs kung mkhas pa ni rang gis dpyad shes pa yin pas mdzad pa dang / phrin las la gzigs shig rje mi bskyod rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten/ gtsug phud phul ba nas bzung bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa gsan/ rje karma pas nyid kyi rgyal tshab du dbang bskur/ dpa' bo gtsug ga phreng ba sogs la kyang bka' chos mang du gsan/rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i rigs bdag tu gyur/ mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas phrin las kyi sgo mtha' yas pa zhig mja da nas dgung lo nga dgu pa chu mo lug gi lo gro bzhin can gyi nyer 134

gsum la gshegs so/ /drug pa zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug ni/ dkon mchog yan lag gis sku 'khrungs pa'i yul phyag bris gnang ba ltar/ 'bri gung gzho'i lung par yab 'bri gung chos rgyal phun tshogs dang yum long mo bza'i sras su shing sprel hor zla dgu pa'i gnam gang la bltams/ rje dbang phyug rdo rjes seng khrir mnga' gsol te/gtsug phud bzhes pa nas bka' lung man ngag thams cad gnang /gzhung mang po thugs la 'dzin pa dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs 'jam dpal dang mtshungs/ rje chos dbyings rdo rje ngos 'dzin pa la khams su phebs nas chos dbyings rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i bla mar gyur yang / lcags mo go shrī dang yang drung sogs drung skor 'gar dam sri zhugs pas yab sras re zhig byol dgos pa byung / dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos gnas dang nye ba'i gnas bgrod cing bdud rtsi 'thung bar dga' bas lan bzhir rgyud mar kho nar brtse zhing phyogs thams cad du 'gro'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ ke po gnas nang du bzhugs mdzad cing gtsug lag khang gsar rgyab/ri bo bya rkang yan dang rgya bal gyi bar zhabs kyis bcags/ slar rje chos dbyings rdo rje la zab chos ma lus pa phul/ dgung lo zhe bdun pa lcags rta dbo zla ba'i tshes bzhir mya ngan las 'das so/ /bdun pa zhwa dmar ye shes snying po ni/ rje chos dbyings 135

rdo rje la gar dbang drug pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ smar smad 'gu log tu yab tshe rgyal 'bum dang / yum lug ku sgron gyi sras su lcags mo lug lor sku 'khrungs/ rje chos dbyings rdo rjes ngos 'dzin/ rdzogs chen ka dag thod brgal gyi lam rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyiXrdzogs lung sogs gsan pa rgya che/ 'jang yul sogs su phebs/ rgyal dbang ye shes rdo rje ngos 'dzin dang bla ma mdzad/ thugs dam nyams bzhes kho nar mdzad pas dus 'da' zhing / dgung lo re bzhi pa shing khyi dbo zla'i nyer bdun la gshegs so /brgyad pa zhwa dmar dpal chen po chos kyi don 'grub ni/yul yol mo gangs rar lha gzigs glang gi gdung sngags 'chang karma gu ru dang / yum sbyin pa bzang mo'i sras su shing phag tha skar zla ba'i tshes bcur 'khrungs/ rje ye shes rdo rjes ngos 'dzin te gtsug phud bzhes pa sogs bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ tre ho bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang / go shrī don yod snying po sogs las bka' brgyud kyi zab chos ma lus pa gsan/ zab cing rgya che'i chos tshul rgya mtsho la mnga' brnyes/ rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje dang si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog bgrang las 'das pa'i bla mar gyur/ rje 'di la blob dpon chen po'i 136

gter kha mang por lung bstan ched brjod mnga' bas ma 'ongs par bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur zhes sngags rnyeng ma 'i bstan 'dzin dag gis gsungs1 bal yul man chad du 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad nas rje 'di dang byang chub rdo rje gnyis ka rgya yul du gong mas gdan drangs pa lhar phobs pas dgung lo ma brgyad pa chu byi mgo zla ba'i tshes gnyis la zhing dbyings su bzhugs so/ /dgu pa zhwa dmar chos kyi nyi ma ni/ lho stogs su sku 'khrungs kung sku tshe cher ma bzhugs pas rna ma thar zhib par ma nges shing / sku gong ma gshegs pa'i phyi lo 'khrungs pa lha na dgung lo bdun par khrir mnga' gsol te brgyad par gshegs pa 'dra snyam mo/ /bcu pa zhwa dmar chos grub rgya mtsho ni/ gtsang bkra shis rtser yab sde pa thang lha dang yum nyi zla dbang mor pan chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi sku'i ga byung du chu khyi la 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang karma pa dang / rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ si tu rin po che rnams kyis ngos 'dzin khrir bkod par mdzad/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas lo du ma'i bar bsten nas dbang lung man ngag rgya tsho tsam gsan/ rig 'dzin chen po dang dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' bar yang dbang lung 'ga' nod/ si tu rin po che'i yang srid khri khar mnga' gsol ba sogs gdan sa'i mgo 'dzin mdzad/ gar 137

dbang drug pa dang brgyad pa'i gdul bya lhag mar dgongs nas bal yul du phebs/ de skabs rgyu mtshan che phra sna tshogs pa zhig gis rkyen te bal bod gnyis cung ma mthun pa yod pa la/ gzhung sas sku tshab 'ga' bal yul du btang ba bal pos brtsan du bzung /rje 'di byon 'phral bka' bstsal te brtsan las ston/ bal po rgyal po'i snying nad zhi phyir bod la bka' brkun pa'i tshul mdzad de slar sdum yang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bkas bkod dang ba cas bod du rdzong / 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ skye bo ngan pa srang mda' bzhin/ /cung zad tsam gyis mtho dman byed/ ces pa ltar bka' khyon gyi tshig de rnams dgra ji bzhin par bzung ste gzhung sar zhus nas rgya yu la du snyan phra phul/ rgya dmag lhag pa na bal pos kyang dmag gtsang du spros pa sogs 'khrugs gzhi chen po de byung ba yin la/ bar gyi bang mi ngan pa de dag bdud rigs kyi cho 'phrul dngos su yin zhes go ka brgyad pas gsungs so/ /slar bal po rgya 'og tu babs tshe sku gdung yin rgyu ba'i tshul zhig spras pa de gas 'khrugs pa bde 'jags su song / spyir rgyal sras rnams kyi mja da pa ni sems can kun la phan spubs kho na ste/ rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rjes thugs rje'i stobs kyi bal dmag phyir brlog pa dang / rje 'di'i sku gdung yin rgyu ba des rgya dmag bzlog cing 'khrugs pa gtan zhir byung ba sogs ni phrin las kyi sgo gcig go/138

de dag ni rje 'dis 'khrugs pa mdzad pa'i log rtog bsal phyir/go shrī brgyad pa'i gsung 'phros dang / de skabs bal yul du dmag mir yod pa'i skye bo shes ldan dag gi ngag rgyun khungs thub bris pa yin no/ /'das lo ni me 'brug tsa ma yin nam nges pa can zhig ma nges so/ /spyir rje 'di zhwa dmar ba'i sprul pa 'khrul med yin pa ni/rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa/ si tu rin po che/ dpa' bo/ rig 'dzin chen po sogs kyi lung bstan 'khrul pa bral ba ma zad/ phyis rgyal tshab mchog sprul nas kyang / the tshom mi mnga' zhing / 'on kyang go shrī dkon mchog 'od zer gyis sprul sku gcig shos ngos 'dzin pa yang ma 'ongs par mchog sprul 'dir gdul bya'i bsod nams kyis ma thub pa'i rkyen ngan phra mo 'byung ba mngon du mkhyen pa dang /si tu rin po che dang rig 'dzin chen pos de ltar mkhyen kyang de dag ni gdul bya'i bsam tshad tsam ste rgyal ba zhwa dmar ba'i skyon du mi 'gyur bas sprul sku dngos su byon pa khrir ma 'khod na rgyal ba de snyed la drin du bzo bar mi 'gyur ba dkangs pas rtsod gzhi'i tshul gnang ba yang phyogs gnyis kas ma mkhyen pa ni ma yin pas/ rang re so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan rnams yab sras de dag gi grwa slob tsam yin pa'i phyogs zhen gyi kha na ma thob smra ba dang / sems la log lta skad cig tsam skye ba ni nyes pa'i g.yang sa chen po ste/ rgyal dang rgyal sras kams kyi rnam par thar pa ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs 139

pas/ de ltar phyogs gcig tu zhen par byas na ston pa shākya thub pas theg pa gsum brton pa yang gang zag gcig gi rgyud thog tu nyams su blang ba'i gzhi med par dgyur ro/ /rnam gling pa'i sprul sku de yang skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan du mas phyug pa zhig yin par grags pas zhwa dmar ba nyid kyi yang sprul tsam ni min pa'i nges pa med pas ma dad pa dang skur ba 'debs pa sogs nam yang mi bya'o//de ltar rgyal ba zhwa dmar ba de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yang dpal karma pa'i phren las kyi rgyun bzhin chad pa mi 'gyur la lhag par skyes rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig po de ni gsal ba 'byung bas de dag gi tshul dpal mkha' spyod pa'i rnam thar gsang sgron gyi bsdus don tshigs ba cad kyi 'grel pa nyung ngu zhig yod pas rang dang skal ma nyam rmongs dad can rnams kyis der bsta bar bya'o/ /rgyal tshab na rim gyi mdzad rnam/rgyal ba zhwa dmar nag de dag gi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba ni/ deng sang yang sprul pa'i sku rgyun mar byon pa yod de/ sprul gzhi ni longs sku'i zhing du phyag rdor ram kun tu bzang po/ thub pa'i 'khor du 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus su chos blon 'gar/ slob dpon pad+ma'i drung du 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug mi la'i skabs su ras pa zhi ba 'od sogs skyes rabs gzhan yang mang zhing khyad par rje 'di 'brom ston pa'i sprul bsgyur du bzung ba'ang yod pas/ de lta slob dpon chen po dang 140

jo bo rje thugs rgyud gcig par grags pas rgyal dbab karma pa na rim jo bo rje dang / rgyal tshab rim par byon pa 'di dag bshes gnyen ston pa'i spru la pa bzung ba don la mi 'gal lo/ /ci 'brom ston spyan ras gzigs yin na khyod kyi rgyal tshab gsang bdag gi skye phreng du 'dzin pa 'gal snyam na/ dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs tsam dbye ba las rigs gsum ngo bo gcig pas sku'i mdzad phrin gang bsgyur ba der gsung dang thugs kyi yon tan yang rnam rtog mi dgos so/ / rgyal tshab dang po go ka'i dpal 'byor don 'grub ni/snye bor 'khrungs/ rje mthong ba don ldan gyi sku skye phyi ma'i 'dren par dgongs nas skyes chen mang po la dam pa'i chos gsan mngag pas bka' bstan 'gyur gnyis ka'i lung gi thog drangs bod gangs can gyi chos la ma gsan ba med/ rgya nag rgyal pos kan ting ha'i go shrī'i las ka gser gyi tham kha lha nyag drug yod pa gcig gnang nas las ka mdzad/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba'i bla mar gyur1mtshur phur mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe me tog gi char cher babs pa'i me tog dkar sngo yu ba nun zhig ya mtshan gyi rten du phyis su'ang phyag sgam nang du yod par grags so/ /rgyal tshab gnyis pa bkra shis rnam rgyal dpal bzang po ni/snye bor 'khrungs/ rje chos grags rgya mtshos dmar ser gyi rtsad pan 141

gnang / kar bstan gyi bdag por mnga' gsol— rje mi bskyod rdo rje seng ge'i khrir spyan drangs/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa dang gsung chos du ma phul/ 'di skabs kyang sgar pa'i drag rim rnams kyi snying la bdud zhugs nas rje chos grags rgya mtsho gshegs rjes sgar gyi chos khrims sogs gtan nas bshig sprul sku min pa zhig ngos 'dzen par brtsam tshe rje 'dis mcho sha sprul ngo ma khrir bkod/de mtshams rje 'di pas gdan sa bar pa'i drung bkra shis don 'grub pa la dug blud pa yin zer nas rje 'di 'khrul phud kyis 'jang yul du rdzong / sangs rgyas gnyan paraXsgar du phebs pa'i tshe sgar pas mi ngan dang khrum par 'dzin/ dul mo bkra shis 'od zer la nyams chung tsam du 'dzin/ chos rje karma phrin las pa lugs gnyis ka'i mkhyen rgya che bas sgar par cung zad dad kyang chos khrims gtsug pa'i thabs ma rnyed/ zhwa dmar ba spyan snga chos grags rje gong ma'i dam log yin pas grib ma phog kyang dmyal bar 'gro zer nas/sprul sku gdan drangs kyang 'byon par bkag sgar pa rnams gros byas nas sprul sku'i bla mar drung bkra shis pa 'os de mar pa lo tsā ba dngos yin zer de phyogs su spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ ma phebs tsam du dam can pa'i phrag dog gis kho rang khrag skyug ste shi/ chos rje gong ma'i phyag rdzas thams 6da bkra shis don 'grub pa'i skye dman dbang phyug skyid mo zer ba'i bud med zhig dang kho rang gi drung skor rnams 143

kyis lhag snar du chos khrims phar zhog sham thabs 'ching mkhan cher ma byung / dus rtag tu sprang mo sgar nyi shu las mi nyung ba re khrid/ sems can phul tshad bsad nas sha ston byed/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs rten bzhengs gang yang ma grub par gnas tshe rje 'di 'jang yul nas yar phebs/ rten gsum bzhengs pa dang sprul sku bdag 'dzid sogs mdzad pas blo bur snyung gzhi zhig byung nas mya ngan las 'das/ sku gdung bye mar sbas pa'i gseb rnams su yungs 'bru lta bus ring bsrel mang du byung / snyung gzhi de yi rkyen yang nang nas byung ba yin zhes/ gong gi tshig de dag nom thar gsar rnying gang na'ang med kyang / rgyal dbang mi skyod rdo rjes phyis su sgar pa la bka' brkun pa'i tshul gyis gnang ba'i zur pa zhig las shin tu rgyas pa gsungs yod/ ngan pa 'di 'dra 'dir bri ba'i dgos pa ci zhe na/ sngon yang de 'dra byung 'dug cing / deng sang yang de 'dra 'byung nye ba dang / ma 'ongs par de 'dra yong bar dogs pa mdzod/ zhes so/ /rgyal chab na jim 'di dag kar bstan shin tu nyag phra ba'i skabs su bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur kyang / skur 'debs mi 'os pa re ni snga nas da lta'i bar du zhu dgos pa'i sri ngan pa zhig yod par mngon la phyis go ka brgyad pa'i skabs su dug spyod tshul sogs kyi gtam sna tshogs byung ba dang 'di rnams cha 'dra bas/ deng nas 143

bzung ste log rtog la rnam dpyod dab ma na ngag tu 'dzin pa'i tshig mchog dman su yi ngag las thos kung ltas nga na yin pas bzlog bsgyur bya ba 'os so/ /rgyal tshab gsum pa go ka grags pa dpal 'byor ni/lho rgyud seng ge sgang du yab sngags 'chong bzang po dang / yum dkon mchog bzang mo gnyis kyi sras su me pho byi ba'i lor 'khrungs/mi bskyod zhabs dang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba sogs las zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsan/ sgar chen gyi gu'i gung par mnga' gsol/ dgung so gcig par pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su gdul bya rnams 'dren par zhal gyis bzhes nas gshegs so/ /rgyal tshab bzhi pa grags pa don 'grub ni/ snye mo stod dbu skor du yab tshe dbang nor bu dang / yum legs mdzes sgron ma'i sras su me lug lo la 'khrungs/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi go shrī'i khrir mnga' gsol/ zhwa dmar lnga pa dang bcas khams phyogs su phebs/ mi bskyod zhabs dang zhwa dmar lnga pa rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ chos kyi dbang phyug la bka' chos phul/ bka' gdams glegs bam du gzhan yang grags pa'i mtshan rab can mang pos 'gro ba'i bde skyid bskrun/ zhes lung bstan pa bzhin rje 'dis lam sgron 'grel pa sogs bstsal shing bka' gdams pa'i chos kyi sgo rnams lhag par 'dzin pas grags pa'i mtshan can ni na rim 'di gsum 14 4

yin par 'dug ces skyes chen 'ga'i gsung las thos so/ /dgung lo re bdun la gshegs so/ /rgyal ldob lnga pa grags pa mchog dbyangs ni/ gtsang gi gting skyes mkhar chen du yab mi dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / yum rigs ldan dbang mo'i sras su me sprul la 'khrungs/ tā ra na ba las dus 'khor sogs zhus/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug dang dba' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho sogs la zab chos ma lus pa gsan/sog dmag gis kar bstan la 'che skabs/ gong sa nas mtshur phu sogs ke tshang go chos sde nyer gcig tsam gnang ba sogs karma pa'i phrin las rgyun ma chad tsam byung / dgung zhe gnyis pa sa khyir lha ngan las 'das so/ /rgyal tshab drug pa nor bu bzang po ni/ rgyal thang du sku 'khrungs/ rje chos dbyings rdo rjes rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga'/ rje bcu pa zhing du gshegs tshe brta na bzhugs bcas bstsal/ go shrī don 'grub snying po sogs bstan 'dzin skyes mchog mang po'i bla mar gyur/ de skabs su kar bstan nyag phra bas yab sras thams cad kyi rnam thar sa bon tsam las bzhugs mi 'dug pas sku tshe ji ltar bzhugs pa sogs kyang ma nges so/ /rje 'di la 'jam mcho/na chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i sku bstod ngo mtshar du ma can yod pas rjes 'jug 'gas 145

sna tshogs smra b.rang nyid col chung ba yin no/ /rgyal tshab bdun pa go shrī dkon mchog 'od zer ni/snye mor 'khrungs1 'di skabs smin gling phyogs nas rgyal tshab kyi sprul sku yin rgyu zhig khrir 'khod pa la/ phyis zhwa dmar nag gis ngos 'dzin 3khrul med gnang nas 'di pa dgung lo bco lnga'i skabs su gdan sar phebs/ zhwa dmar nag dang si tu rin po che las bka' chos ma lus pa gsan/ 'on kyang thugs shin tu gtum zhing sus kyang ngo mi 'dzin pa zhig bzhugs pas/ rig 'dzin chen po dang dpa' bo rin po cher zhwa dmar mchog sprul gyis don skor zhu phod che tsam gnang bas phyis rgyal tshab yab sras kyi gral nas bud pa yang de nas yin mod/ de 'dra la skyon du bzung bar mi bya ste bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas bdun pa mir 'dzin pa kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī lta bus kyang byang chub kyi sems la rgyun chad med de tshig rtsub re zhor du shor 'dug pa 'di sngon las zhig yin zhes gsungs pa dang 1yab sras thugs cung mi mthun pa'i tshul bstan pa yang sangs rgyas dngos su zhal bzhugs pa'i nyan thos 'od spung chen po dang kun dga' bo rgyun tu mi mthun pa'i tshul bstan pa'ang las 'bras mi bslu bar bstan phyir dang / 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung skyes rabs mang por mi mthun tshul bka' gdams glegs bam las 'byung ba sogs 'di lta bu ches mang ngo //146

'di 'dra la skyes chen thugs rje'i stobs che ba dang / drung skor thugs mos gus dang ldan zhing bstan par phan thabs kyi mdzad phrin thub pa byung na mthun sbyor sogs gnang ba dge ba'i rlabs che ste1kar 'brug gnyis sngar shin tu ma mthun pa yod pa la/ 'jam mgon rig 'dzin chen pos/ rgyal ba bcu gsum pa dang / rje chos kyi 'byung gnas/ 'brug pa bka' brgyud khrin las shing rta sogs thugs yid gcig 'dres mdzad nas deng sang kar 'brug bstan srid gcig pa mdzad pa dang / a lo bla ma kun mkhyen gyis rje chos kyi 'byung gnas sku chung ngu'i dus nas ris med pa'i bla ma dang chos tshul rgya mtsho la bsten par bskul bas rje de nyid kyi mdzad phrin mkha' dang mnyam pa byung zhing dpa' bo dang si tu gong ma rnams thugs nang de tsam med pa la skrub dkar grub mchog kun dga' bstan 'dzin pa gnas nang phyag mdzod kyi go sar bzhugs skabs thugs yig gcig 'dres byung ba sogs bstan don gzhan las kung mdzad pa rlabs su che ba 'dug dpal rig pa 'dzin pas pob sras rnams thugs mthun sbyor gnang skabs rje 'dis ma gsan song ba dbu thod thug pas lan zhes rgyal ba bcu gsum pas go shrī brgyad par bka' bstsal to1 /'on kyang rgyal ba bcu gsum pa ni sku chung dus ni rje 'dis 'dzin skyong bslab sbyong sogs zhus pas drin can dkan mchog 'od zer zhes sgar gong 'og gi bla brgyud gsol 'debs su 147

'dzud pa sogs dngos su thong / dgung lo re bzhi la zhi bar gshegs so/ /rgyal tshab brgyad pa chos dpal bzang po ni/ 'jang yul sa spum rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar sa glang lor 'khrungs/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjes ngos 'dzin te dgung lo bcug cig par dpal spungs su gdan drangs/si tu rin po ches zab chos dpag med bstsal/ bcu bzhi la mtshur phur phebs rjes karma pa dang dpon slob thun mong ma yin par gyur/ bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa gsan/ mchod khang gong ma zhig gso dang grwa khang gsar rgyag sogs khams dbus kun tu kar bstan kho nar dmigs pa'i mdzad phrin mtha' klagazhing dngos gtsang / si tu rin po che'i slob ma phyis 'byung nang kar lugs phyogs su mkhyen rab rje 'di pa che/ rgyal ba bcu gsum pas nyid kyi rgyal tshab yin na yen bzhin pa'i lugs gnyis ka'i thugs kyi gtad so thun mong ma yin pa gnang ba la drung skor rnams rang phyogs kyi chags sdang mkhan 'gas ma bzod nas mjon sum rjes dpag gang gi yang mtshan ma med bzhin du grong gseb bud med ngag 'khyal can rnams kyi gtam lta bu 'ga' zhig gi rje 'dis phrin las 'gog par byed kyang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba la lag pas bkab pas rang nyid kyi bzhin ras tsam las gzhan ga la babs/148

lar ni ma 'ongs pa na yang rgyal ba yab sras kyi drung skor du 'khod pa'i skye bo shes ldan 'dra srid tshe khe nyen che bar 'dug pas las 'bras tsam la ni thugs gzhi bcun dgos par 'dug rje 'di nyin mdo khams 'jang yul bar du zhabs kyis bcags nas yar chibs bsgyur gnang skabs gsung gi 'phros pa gnang lugs sogs yun ring mi bzhugs par zhal bzhes pa ltar rgyal ba'i dbang po gdan sar mnga' gsol te dgung lo nga bzhi pa rta lor zhing gzhan du gshegs so/ /rje 'dis lung rtogs kyi yon tan/ byang chub kyi thugs bskyed/ bla ma rnam gnyis sogs la chos sku'i mos gus/ bstan 'gror phan pa'i mdzad phrin/ phyogs med kyi dag snang / sdom gsum gyi phyag len sogs gang nas bltas kyang sngon byon grags pa don 'grub zhabs kyi rnam par kar pa dang mtshungs la/ bdag gi zhabs drung du lo gcig tsam bcar bar rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa dang / rgyal ba nyid kyi rnam thar thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' yang mthong zhing thos mod/ rjed par 'phang yang phyis su kar lugs pa la zang zing dang rnam dpyod ma gtogs de 'dra dgos rigs su mi 'dug pas 'di de tsam du bsdus so1 /zhes karma yon tan rgya mtshos gsung /de nas rgyal tshab dgu pa ye shes bzang po nas/ rgyal tshab go shi sprul sku grags pa 'phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po'i bar rgyal 149

tshab na rim gyis rje karma pa la dad gus tshad med pa'i dbang gis tham sa cad mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam bzang por bkris pa'i 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad pa sogs skabs 'dir karma bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la phyag rjes bsam yas las 'das/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta lor sog po go shir han gyi dpung chen bod du btegs nas bod kyi sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang po gson bzung byas nas bkum pa dang chabs cig karma dge bsgyur shugs chen mdzad/ 'on kyang bka' rgyud rgyal ba yab sras kyi thugs bskyed dam tshig dbang gis rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs la skabs der gong sa lnga pa'i spyan mthong che bas dgongs sel zhu sne gang 'drong gnang ba'i thog nas mtshur phu'i gdan sar rgyal tshab mdzad de bla ma'i gdan sa bskyangs par mtshur phu'i rgyal tshab tu grags shing rgyal dbang karma pa'i rgyal tshab mdzad pa las mtshan du thogaganas nang dpa' bo na rim gyi mdzad rnam/da ni rgyal dbang karma pa'i phrin las 'dzin pa dpa' bo na jim gyi tshul cung zhig ni/ sprul gzhi 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yin te/ de'i sprul pa rgya gar du ngag gi dbang phyug grub ste mu stegs pham par mdzad pa'i paṇa chen shes rab 'byung gnas te dpal chos kyi grags pa dang slob dpon pad+ma sogs kyi slob ma yin/ jo bo rje dang 1 ro pa'i slob ma dge slong ma bde skyong bzang mo 'jam dpal dang gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor rol pa'i ye shes/ de'i sprul pa 150

lngar 'gyed pa'i sangs rgyas rong pa dang / gter ston rin chen gling pa/ de'i sku skye gzhon nu lhun grub bya ba'i gter ston gcig byon kyang sku gzhon nur gshegs/ de'i sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dgu lo nyer gcig la gshegs so/ /de'i sprul pa dpa' bo'i mtshan 'dzin pa ste/dang po dpa' bo chos dbang lhun 'grub ni/ yar lung stod du 'khrungs/ lhun bde rab 'byams sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas zab chos gsan/ grub pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar mdzad pas bla ma dpa' bor grags/ chos grags rgya mtsho rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin zhing rje des sto dro bo lung gi bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs la thogs pa med/ dgung lo zhe dgu par ya ma tshan gyi stas bcas gshegs so/ /gnyis pa dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba ni/ dbu ru snye thang du yab bla ma dang yum lam bsnyed sgrol ma'i sras su shing pho byi ba'i lor 'khrungs/ dro bo lung gi seng khrir phebs/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa sogs mkhas grub mang po las zab cing rgya che'i chos grangs med gsan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ni mi bskyod na zhabs yin/ zhwa dmar lnga pa sogs yab sras kyi bla mar gyur1 mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing bka' 'bum sogs kyang mang / dgung lo re gsum la gshegs so/ /151

gsum pa dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho ni/ mchu ra phu'i gnas sgor yab bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / yum nor 'dzin dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su sa pho 'brug lor 'khrungs/ rje dgu pa dang zhwa dmar lnga pas ngos 'dzin nas dro bo lung gi khrir 'don mdzad/ rje bla ma de gnyis sogs las zab chos mang du gsan/ gar dbang drug pa dang rje chos dbyings rdoXrje sogs mkhas grub mang po'i bla mar gyur/dgung lo re gsum par gshegs so/ /bzhi pa dpa' bo phrin las rgya mtsho 'am kun bzang snying po ni/ mdo khams ta'u shal khog dang nye bar yab rdu zog dang / yum ra yon bza'i sras su lcags stag lor 'khrungs/ rje chos dbyings rdo rje dang zhwa dmar ye shes snying por bka' chos thams cad gsan/ gong sa lnga pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gnas nang dang sngags grwa sogs la phebs gnang / dgung lo lnga bcu par gshegs so/ /lnga pa dpa' bo gtsug lag don 'grub ni/ chu shul rtse lngar nang so tshe brtan gyi sras su 'khrungs/ ye shes rdo rjes ngos 'dzin/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gar dbang brgyad pa yin/ bye ho rin po che sogs las bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bco brgyad par gshegs so/ 1drug pa dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba ni/ mdo khams 152

sde dger pho khyi lor 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang yab sras kyis dpa' bo'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin nas/ dgung lo bcu bzhi par gong ma'i khrir mnga' gsol/ zhwa dmar nag dang rig 'dzin chen po/ si tu rin po che sogs rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ gter gyi kha byang babs pa sogs phyis sngags kyi spyod pa gnang / tsa ri'i gnas kyi 'ja' tshon phug sogs su thugs dam kho nar mdzad/ rje 'di ni grub pa'i go sa mthon por bzhugs pa zhig ste 'ja' tshon du sku gshegs so/ /bdun pa dpa' bo gtsug lag chos kyi rgyal po nas/ da bar mchog sprul rgyun ma chad pa'o/ /tre ho na rim gyi mdzan rnam/zhabs drung tre ho rin po che yi skyes rabs ni/ sprul gzhi rgyal mchog tshe dpag med yin te 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal po iṇ+ḍa sto bha/ nā ga dzu na ste 'phags pa klu skrub/ te lo pa shes rab bzang po/ paṇa chen phyogs kyi glang po/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar sogs dang / khyad par 'phags pa klu sprub dngos yin par paṇa chen shākya kas lung bstan pa'i 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ spom brag pa bsod nams rdo rje/ grub chen da shrī/ khyad par mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum mdzad pa rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs chen po don 'grub 'od zer gyi bar ro/ /tre ho'i mtshan 'dzin pa ste/dang po tre ho mkhas grub chos kyi rgya mtsho ni/ khams shar 153

zla'i rgyud yab dpon bro skyabs/ yum bsod nams sgon gyi sras su 'khrungs/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ skyabs che 'jam dpal rgya mtsho1 rje chos grags rgya mtsho rna mas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/mi bskyod zhabs la'ang bka' chos mang du gsan/ gsung rtsom yang mang du bzhugs/ me lug lor gshegs so1 /tre ho zhes pa ni mtshur phur bye ho'i las tshan zhig yod pa der bzhugs pas de ltar grags/ zhes dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas gsung / bye ho dang kre 'o sogs don gcig yin pa 'dra la tre che chung gnyis byung ba 'di nyid tre chung gi brgyud pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bye ho dpag bsam dbang po ni/ la stod lhor 'khrungs/ zhwa dmar lnga pas gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan karma bslab gsum rgya mtshor gsol/ rje dgu pa dang rgyal tshab grags pa don 'grub/ gar dbang drug pa rna mas mjal/ bka' chos kyang mang du gsan/ bstan bcos mdzad pa'ang mang / rje dgu pas bshad sgrub gling gi bla mar bsko bzhag gnang / khams phyogs su phebs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don cher mdzad do/ /gsum pa tre ho bstan 'dzin dar rgyas ni/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / gar dbang drug pa las bsnyen rdzogs dang bka' chos mang du gsan/ grags pa mchog dbyangs kyi byang 154

chub gling gi 'dren par bskos/ sa yos lor gshegs so/ /bzhi pa tre ho byang chub chos kyi snying po ni/ yar 'brog tu yab rta mgrin dang / yum bka' brgyud yar 'phel gyi sras su chu sprul lor yum gyi rtsi ma'i go bar nas sku 'khrungs/ rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs kyis ngos 'dzin1 rgyal ba gong sa lnga par gtsug phud phul/ mtshan blo bzang chos kyi dbang por gsol/smin gling gter chen la chos bka' mang du gsan/ ye shes snying po dang / ye shes rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ gar dbang brgyad pa sogs yab sras rnams kyis sgar chen gyi go shrī'i las ka gnang / chos rje gling pa dang mjal nas gter chos gsan/rje 'di'i thugs dam gyi ga rtsa bo dang gzhan la ston pa phal cher rdzogs chen gnang bas kar rnying gnyis ka'i rdo rje slob dpon yin la/ rgyal ba yab sras sogs de skabs kyi skye bo mchog dman kun gyi gtsug nor du gyur/ dgung lo don brgyad par gshegs so/ /lnga pa tre ho chos kyi dbang po ni/ rje chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis ngos 'dzin gnang / khrir ston dang bka' chos kyang gnang / rje karma pa bcu gsum pa dang zhwa dmar bcu pa sogs kyi slob ma yin/ chuXbya lor gshegs so/ /blor yang mchog sprul rgyun ma chad pa deng sang gi bar du byon no/ /mjug bsdus pa'i gtam/de ltar 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyis rtsod dus kyi sangs 155

rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / spel ba/ skyong ba mdzad phyir gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mtshungs mi mtshungs sna tshogs pa'i phrin las bsgyur ba la/ log rtog dang sgro skur gyi dri mas nam yang gos pa mi bya ste/ rgyal ba'i phrin las skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan la yang / so skye'i snang ngor thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang 1 bskal pa mchog gis 'dzin rgyu sogs sna tshogs yod la/rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rnams nas kyang so so'i lta bzhed gnas ska bas mi mthun pa lta bu du ma bstan pas/ deng sang bod kho nar yang chos lugs dang grub mtha' sna tshogs pa byung ba 'di bzhin la/ grub mtha' so sos rang gi mi mthun phyogs dgag pa dang / mthun phyogs sprub par byed pa'ang ga rtsa cher rgyal ba'i bka' dang mdzad phrin la bstun dgos/ de dag la phyogs zhen gyi chags ldang phar zhog rang gi sta grub 'di ni mchog ste gzhan rnams dman pa'o snyam pa tsam ang lta ba chog 'dzin zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /sprir gang zag mchog dman su la'ang brnyes pa mi bya ste/rang res ni tshe 'di'i ltar snang tsam las tshe rabs snga phyir gang zag des las ji ltar gsog pa ni cha tsam yang mi mngon la/ lhag par rang re'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams yin zhing deng sang sangs rgyas dngos mi bzhugs kyang / de'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams ni rgyal sras rnams kyi sprul pa kho nar 156

rngos pas/ de dag gi rnam par thar pa la the tshom tsam skye rung 'khor ba mtha' med kyi las yin/ phyis su log lta'i gzhi phal cher dam log yin min dang lung bstan bzang ngan 'byung tshul sogs las 'byung bar 'dug kyang / dam log ni mdo phyogs kyi mkhan po dang slob dpon/ sngags kyi skabs su dbang lung man ngag bstsal ba'i rdo rje slob dpon de la/ phyis skyon phu mo tsam gyis dad pa gting nas log cing / de'i chos tshul la mi spyod cing /rjes 'jug sigs la gnod pa de ni dam log yin zhing / spyir sngags rnying ma sogs la dam tshig sa ya 'bum sder bshad pas dam log su yin gyi dbye ba shi na tu 'byed dka'o/ /dam log tu gyur yang phyis 'dul ste drang po'i lam du tshud pa'ang rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi rnam thar las shin tu mang ngo / /deng sang ni chags sdang dbang gis gang zag phal che bar dam log gter log bdud sprul sogs khungs dang gtan chig med kung yod 'dra'i log lta re dgon sde rnams su dar mod/ bdud kyi mthar thugs rang gi sems las byung ba 'di la dog pa cung zhig ma bcug na kho yang thabs mkhas shing rtsa ba che ba zhig 'dug go/ /de bzhin du lung bstan rnams kung phal cher sgro btags pa so gas kyis rla da pa dang / drang po yin du chug kyang 'das ma 'ongs gang la'ang rtags dang mtshan ma mi 'gyur ba zheg gdul bya'i bsod nams shugs kyis mi srid pa dang / rgyal 157

bas chos tshul mi 'dra ba bstan pa bzhin sgra ji bzhin du so so skye bos 'dzin mi rung ba du ma yod 'dra bas 'dir dper brjod na/lung bstan gyi 'byung khungs ni lo rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gdung tshab gter ston rna mas las byung bar rdo rje'i gsung la bslu ba med kyang 1 sangs rgyas gling pas jig 'dzan god ldem la lung bstan 'bri tsam dang / smin gling gter chen gyis stag shams pa la tang stoms tsam dang / gter ston bdud 'dul rdo rjes sku tshe stod smad du kar dge gnyis la lung bstan mi 'dra ba gnyis mdzad pa dang / rje rtsang kha pa sogs la 'ga' zhig gis bstod cing 'gas smad pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan par gnod pa'i rgyal po sogs la byang sems skyes 'phags kyi rna ma 'phrul yin tshul sogs du ma snang zhing / gangs can spyi'i bde sdug gi lung bstan dang de dag gi skabs su bde thabs kyi bka' drin bstsal ba rna mas ni bslu med bden 'bras can kho na ste/ gang zag gi lung bstan sogs la rang re so skyes dpyad pas skyon can rnams la'ang dag snang tsam du bzhag go/ /de ltar rgyal bstan spyi dang gang zag su la'ang smad mi rung ba bstan nas lhag par rang re ka tshang gi yab sras 'di rnams rgyal dbang karma pa'i phrin las spel ba'i byed por mnga' gso la yin pas dgon sde so so'i bla ma yin rgyu sogs kyi khyad par che bar mi sta ste/ rgyal dbang karma pa nyid nas kyang yab sras 'di dag la 158

khyad par med pa'i gus zhabs sogs kyi mdzad pa gnang ba 'jig rten pa'i mthun 'jug tsam ga la yin te/ skyes rabs gong ma rnams su yab sras de dag yongs 'dzin du bzhes shing ma 'ongs par yang res slob ma dang res 'gar bla ma'i tshul du dpon slob mi 'brel bas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa'i dgongs pa dang / yab sras rnams kyi gsol 'debs spyi bye brag dang bcas sngar nas mang mod/ lhag par rgyal dbang btsu gsum pa'i bka' 'bum du gzhan gyis bskul ba sogs ma yin pa'i ke tshang bla ma yab sras rnams kyi gsol 'debs so sor mtshan byang btab cing / 'dod gsol la so sos bstan pa spel ba'i smon lam dang bcas mdzad 'dug pa de ni dgos pa khyad par can zhig ste/ rje nyid la zhu ba'i zham ring tshul mthun yod na yab sras de dag la khyad par dbyer med pa'i bka' bstsal log lta'i smag rum ma lus dpyis 'byin pa yang dag pa'i lam gsal ba zhig gnang rgyur 'dug pa la de ltar ma byung zhing so so'i phyogs zhen la shor ba dag 'di ltar gsol ba thob cig ces don gyi bka' bstsa ba'o/ /gsol 'debs 'di ni gzhan gyis bskul nas de mtshungs gnang ba'i phyogs dang mi 'dra bas ke tshang bstan pa 'dzin tshad kyi rgyal dbang nyid kyi gsung ci lha ba'i tshig don ltar dad mos kyis bton na dgos pa che ba zhig yod 'dra'o/ /da ni nyams len chos tshul gyi cha la spyir bka' brgyud par 159

thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad nyams su len par nus na tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'am 'di'i go sar sa bon 'jog par nus pa'i gdams pa bla na med pa yod pas na 'dzam gling na yongs su grags mod/ de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos gdul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun pa rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa'i glegs bam zhal phye ba tsam gyis 'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma'i gzhir gyur pa rnams ni glegs thag chad chad kyis bsdams te mun nag gi mdzod du bzhugs su gsol/ snyigs dus kye mkhas pa dang grub pa 'ga' yi phugs kyi dgongs phyogs ji ltar rung gnas skabs cung zhig dpyad tshe so so'i rang 'dod kyi dri mas cung zad ma gos pa ni cher mi 'byung ba snyam ste/ bstan bcos sogs thams cad dang mi 'gal zhing thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig dgos mod de las gzhan du gyur par blo phug gtad na mthar chos dang bla ma thams cad gzhan gyis bsgyur nas bka' brgyud pa'ang sprang 'chal du 'gro/ 'di la lung yang mang du mchis te/ gar dbang drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis thar pa don gnyer gyi slob ma ri khrod pa rnams la bstsal ba'i bca' yig tu/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang nas bzung rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud 'di mang yang rung nyung yang rung 'di yi zab chos ma spyad pa ma gtogs/ rgya gar ba'i 160

lug rgya nag pa'i lugs sogs mang po mi dgos pa'i gsung rgyas pa 'dug khyad par rang phyogs kyi bla ma chos dang bcas par skur ba 'debs pa sogs nam yang mi bya ste/ jo bo rjes/ rtsa ba'i chos lugs dor byas nas/ /chos gzhan dag la mtho 'grogs byed//rang gi chos grwa smad byed cing / /gdan sa'i zhabs tog zhabs nas 'dren/ /rang lugs shor tsam gzhan ma lon/ /zhes gsungs pa dang sa paṇa gyis/ pha bsad pa la rgya rnga brdungs/ gsungs pa rna mas lung bstan lta bur 'byung nye bar 'dug dngos su rtags kyi mtshan mas kyang grub ste/ rang re bka' brgyud par ma zad rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhas grub karma chags med kyi slob ma'i gtso bo rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin de nyid rang don spang rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin yang / gzhan don gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi shugs lta bus chos dang bla ma thams cad gzhan du 'gyur zhing rang phyogs la sdang tshul gnang bas deng sang lugs gnyis ka'i 'brel ba tsam nga dka' ba 'di byung ba yin/jo bo rje la dpal ldan a ti shas kyang / chos lugs mang yang rang lugs bzung lugs la ma zhen kun la slobs/ zhes gsungs pa lhar/ rab tu phyogs ris med pa'i dpe ltas sogs grub na rang nyid blo gros kyi rtsal rgyas zhing / gzhan la'ang dag snang sogs 'byung / min yang bka' brgyud gong ma'i zab chos thun mong ma 161

yin pa rnams la tshig re re'i bo ba tsam rnyed dam/ gdams ngag sogs mkho mi mkho gang rung dbang lung khrid phran bu re ci thob kyis thos bsam sgom pa re rdus na rang la babs pa'i las dang bstan pa ngo thog kyang de yin1 de bas gzhan cho ga re gnyis kyi gar thig tsam la sbyong ba chol le ba re byas/ rtsis sman sogs rig pa phran bur bslabs kung lag len gyi thog tu ma 'khel zhing rang bang gzhen la phan pa gting ma tshugs/ phyogs ris chags sdang can gyi rleb dpon dang grwa rigs 'gas rang lugs rgyal ba yab sras sogs skyes chen rnams kyi yon tan rgya mtsho tsam re sus bor nas skyon gyi chu thig la 'bad 'bungs byed pa la gsung gi bdud rtsir bzung /nyams len dang bstan pa'i mthar thug zang zing gang mang la 'dzin pa ni shin tu dman no/ /de ltar smra ba 'di yang phyis su gdul bya'i bsod nams dman zhing rtsod pa'i dus mthar song ba'i dbang gis rgyal ba yab sras 'di dag rnam thar la sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi gtam sna tshogs rna bar thos pa yid kyi ma bzod pas 'di lhar bris na rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la phan par srid dam snyam pa tsam yod thog rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po kan ting tā yi si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs kyi phyag bris rtsa gsum thang sku sum char yab sras drug gi sku bzhugs pa zhig mjal ba de la dad mos spro gsum gyis bskul ma lta bur gyur te 'bad nas bris so/ /162

— pyo tsu pyo tsha shā tsha she shā— snye sdi —bye— snye pyo smo pyichi 4 shā ma shā mi rte she bye 2 ) pe pe pelnga 4 zo 4 4 4 4 4 4 4 ba ༷ 4 4—༵ mi mi ka 0 ka 2 / mi tsu shā nu rdo pyo mapa 4 shā sgo ba tsa 0 tsa shā 2 pe pyoyo 4 4 byu tshe ma ji yi 5 4 4 4kun tsa—— 4 4 4 di 4 4 4 4 — — ‘shā1 — ṭā — ba bal cho ‘ṭā pa sbyo ‘ za ḍā pyo ‘ba rtsorga za ‘ba ྾ ba ba nga / ba ngo ba ngo rtsamib mnya ༅ ༅ lda1 ngo ‘ za ‘ba ba ༵ ‘ba ma‘shā shā glu ca za / sbyo ma ṭā ca ⑪2 hā rgyu ba rgyu dzi ba tsho ba ༵ dz+wa1 ba tsa 4 r+yā ba mi ba ba tsho ji 4 tshi da za ༵ ma —yu zo za ḍā ma ma lnga ༵ ba phya rā ṭā ba po sgro ‘ba ‘za ‘ lorlo dzi sgyul sgyul ‘pyo ༵ ༵ ‘6 ༵ zo sgyul ‘ za ༵ ⑪ ༅ ca — ba tsho ba po ༅ tsho ba pa tsho tsho po1rtsa shā tsho 5tsa pa ‘pyo cho ba cho bka tsho ༅ ba mi tsacho ༅ tsho la7 ma po ༅ ༅ ba phya ༅ ‘ba pa cho’7 —po1 ba lho 7 ‘ngo ca tsho lo 1 tsho ‘za ba ba—‘༵1 4 byu tshe spyo 5 2 6 tsa 4 ku chi tsho rngo163
‘jakhya1swā ༵ 19zlo14164
༄/ /rje btsun bla ma si tu chos kyi 'byur gnas kyi rnam thar dad pa'i sa rgon skyed ba'i bdud rtsi'i zim char zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

/sarba glen ka ru'i shā ram hā gu ru ra sna na mo/thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug chen po tā ye si tu rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde 'byung ral pa'i zla gzhon lang tsho yis/ rab btud zhabs sen nyin byed 'od dmar gyis/ /'gro kun mun pa'i g.yang las srung brtson pa/ /gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba dam par 'dud/1ma 'ongs rgyal ba byams pa mgon po yi/ /sprul pa'i byang sems chos kyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /'khrungs yul sku tshe'i mdzad 'phrin sa bon tsam/ /rang snang dag pa'i dad pa skyed kar bri1/'khrungs sa mdo smad stag dgongs ring mo'i cha1 /ming 'dus lung las a ta rong zhes pa'i/ /a lo deng ring sgang zhes yul de nyid/ /o rgyan pad+mas rog mo ljongs zhes btags/ /sa yi thig le yo rgyan lu nga bstan pa'i/ /gsang bdag sprul pa sde dge bla ma ni/ /byams pa phun tshogs yongs su grags pa dang //rgyal bas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud lung bstan pa'i/ /chu bo gser ldan zhes pa ru/ /rgyal po byis pa'i ming can 'byung / /zhes pa'i rgyal bu bstan pa tshe ring dang / /mu ne btsad po'i spru la pa thes kung grags/ /dpal brtsegs sprul pa chos rgyal blo gros sogs//169

de nas sa yos mgo zla'i tshes bcu nyid/ /yum nyid bde ldan lhanganger 'khrungs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas gling sogs 'khrul med lung bstan pa'i/ a ta rong du 'brug sgras nam mkha' khyab: mdo khams shar phyogs zhwa khra can gyis gang: ka' brgyud bstan pa nyi zhur tsam zhig 'byung: a ta rong du rdo rje zangs gri mkha' la 'phyo: sa rin chen gdugs chung 'phub 'dra'i 'og: 'bu sdig pa ra dza'i rā co can: shrī sing ha'i sprul pa snying stobs can:kaḥthog nye ba'i sa char dgon pa 'debs: do khams shar phyogs a zhes bya ba'i lung mda' ru: ḍi bhi he ru'i dngos sprul chos gyi ming can zhig: 'byung nas bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshanaphyogs mthar tshugs: chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya shar nas 'byung: a rong lha mi'i mchod sdong 'phrul po che: mdo khams 'gro 'dren re rten skyabs gcig po: mthong bas dad pa'i blo bskyed kun yid 'phreg: gang zhig dad blo drag po'i lho sprin gtibs: phyag rdor sprul pa sa snyeng 'gran med pa'i: rdarma'i mtshan can grub mchog dam pa 'byung: don ldan mi yi dge spyod 'di /don du skrub na mi rabs gsum/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas dag tu gyur/ /sprub po'ang lo gsum tshe ring 'gyur/ /rgya gar chos kyi 'byung khams de/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i sprul pa ste/ /bod yul dbus su bstan chags na/ /rbad yul 171

bkra shos g.yang du len/ /zhes sogs tshad ma'i lung bstan brjod las 'das/ /lcags 'brug gter chen klong gsal sprul sku 'khrungs/ /rje yi dgung lnga 'bri glog tshad med mkhyen1 /'di skabs yul 'brog phebs skabs lngags nags gong / /chibs brdab rkyen gyis skye ba snga phyi dang / /yab rje lha yi dge bsnyen gsal po mjal/ /shing mo bya la tshab tsha sprul pa'i sku/ /mkhas grub karma nges legs bstan 'dzin 'khrungs/ /bod du lha bzang dmag slebs bde srid mtshan/ /dgung lo nga gsum sku tshe bar chad btang 1/rje yi 'don chog thogs pa med pa mkhyen/ /me khyi karma pa yi mgron gnyer dang / /zhwa dmar brgyad pa'i mgron gnyer dge legs slebs/ /mi tu chos gyi 'byung gnas kun khyab ye shes dpal bzang po/ /zhes pa'i mtshan dang rgyal mchog zhabs brtan phebs//me phag lo la tshe dbang sogs dang bcas/ /jo pho gnas su byang chub rdo rje mjal /kun mkhyen zur mang gdan drangs lhan cig phebs/ /mdor gzhung rin chen mi 'gyur rdo rje mjal//khu dbon sgar sar stag chen zor gdong btags/ /gsol chas dug btab 'gro zhes yang nga gsungs/ /'di skabs gang gsung thams cad lung bstan mdzad1 1kun mkhyen slob tshags mdzad 172

rung ma mdzad rung / /nyer lnga'i dgung lir kams cad mkhyen zhes gsungs/ /zur mang drung pa bstan pa rnam rgyal dang / /che tshang gsung rab rgya mtsho'i zhal snga dang / /rig 'dzin chen po rol pa'i rdo rje yis/ /smin grol gsang sngags chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol//lha steng rten mjal phyag rdor zhal gzigs byung //sa byir karma pa nas che tshang mjal/ /'di lo rje dbon sman rgyal bstan 'dzin 'khrungs/ /rje yis phyag bzhi'i grub 'cham thugs nges mdzad/ /bdud sprul zas ngan shoms rkyen dpal 'byor gyi//dpe mdzod nyid tu bsnyung chabs cher byung dus/ /sde dge sungs rgyas bstan par snyan gsol pab—/ /nga yi sprul sku med du mi chog cing / /gang yin long ba thang gang bzo zhes bkyon/ /rin chen ril bu mang po 'phral du gnang / /dpe mdzod kun gzigs gsung rab go don khrol/ /'brug pa chos rje kun mkhyen sku mched nas/ /dbang chos lung rigs phal cher thugs brtson mdzad//de skabs dus mkhyen gri thod 'dzin pa la/ /rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mang pos bskor ba dang / /mthing dmar zhwa can 'ja' 'od dbus bzhugs mjal/ /nam mkhar tshe dpag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mjal/ /dbang po brgya byi na zla ba 'dzin pa'ang gzigs//chu 'brug rma pa nyid spyan drangs nas/ /dgyes spro'i dga' ston 'bul nga spam cher bgyis/ /gong nas lhag lha rta mgrin jing 173

skyeng yin/ /gsungs shing rgyab rir bsang mchod phyir phebs dus/ /rje nyid ku/na dga' zhes pas rgyab gad na drangs/ /brdab phog kho yis a na na byas par/ 1rje yis da lan drag gi rjes nas ni/ /brdab che phog gsung de bzhin tshul khrims nyams/ /rgyal dbang yar phebs chos dbang gshegs brdzangs skrub/ spom brag gnas gzigs mkhar mdor drung phun tshogs/ /'phrad pas spyo la shin tu mkhas zhes smra/ /dpal 'byor phebs nas ka: thog rgyal sras kyis/ /klong gsal tshe dbang mja da pa'i tshe chang snad//dkar yol cung zad gas pas thugs rtogs kyis/ /khang 'og skyur yang ma chag ngo mtshar gsung 1 /rje nyid sku tshe ring ba'i ltas su bzhed/ /de nas dbus phebs dang po lha lung khud/ /sde dge bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis/ /karma pa dang rje nyid gdan 'dren gnang / /gdul bya'i tshogs ni gnam skar sa drog bzhin//mtshan mo 'i me tshom nyin mo bzhi na du gsal/ /gsol ston 'bul bkur bsam mi khyab pa mdzad/ /de nas gro bzhin tshes dgur dbus su phebs/ /smin zla'i bcu gnyis 'bab phrom gzhung nyid du/ /gar dbang brgyad pa chos kyi don grub mjal/ /lha rdzas dung dkar gser gyi rdo rje phul/ /mdzod pa skyes mchog 'bel gtam sha ra ra/ /bla ma kun ma khyen chos bro khrig se khrig /rim gyis bye ho dpa' bo mchog rnams mjal/ /mgo zla'i tshes bcur 'og 174

min mtshur phur phebs/ /lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gcig thog mar mjal1 /gar dbang mchog gis rgyud sde'i thog ma yi/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod lung dang ni/ /bka' brgyud gser phreng lung rnams thog mar bstsal//chu sbrul cho 'phrul zla ba'i bco lnga la/ /klu sprub phug bzo ston pa'i sku brnyan mdun/ /gar gyi dbang phyug chos kyi don grub kyis/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen sdom pa gnang ba'i mtshan/ /karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snab ba gsol/ /nab zla'i brtsa lngar yab sras ming ge'i khrir/ mnga' gsol mthing dmar cod pan sgro na par mdzad1 /gong ma'i gser spum la sogs phyag tu phul /smin grol nges zab nam mkha'i sgo 'phar phyes/ 1de nas lha sar jo shag gnas rnams mjal/ /nyi 'od sprul sku'i lung rnams phal cher gsan/ /gar dbang mchog las sa ris tshogs rnams bslab/ /rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang ni/ /dwags po bka' brgyud 'don chos che phra yi/ /dbang lung phyag len thig tshon dbyangs gdangs bcas/ /ma lus chos mdzod bum pa gang byo'i tshul/ /thugs su bzhes te lo mjug mgon 'cham mdzad//lo sar bka' 'gyur grub pa'i gtong rags phul/ /kong po lha bris pa las ri mo bslab/ /rgya dpe dper bzhag lan war byang chub mdzad1 khams su phebs khar rje btsun gar dbang nas//175

smon lam legs gnang nges don bstan pa gtad/ /yangs can mdzod nas lha khang li ma'i rigs/ /mgon khang gri khrab so so'i ngo spyod bslab/ /de nas khams phebs karma'i mtsho kha ru/1sku mtshams bsdams te grol nas bka' chos gnang / /de nas sde dge lhun grub steng du phebs/ /chos kyi rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring dang / /yab sras kun dang dgyes sbo'i zhal 'dzom mdzad/ /dga' ston bsnyen bkur dbu thon rgya cher phul//me sprel lo gsar sgrol dkar bsgom bzlas bzhugs/ /de nas khams pas gdan drangs sga nyag phebs/ /smin grol rgya chen phar tshur res mos mdzad/ 1de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs nas/ /dbyangs char ri mo bod rgyun gzhung bzhin bslab/ /slar yang tshur phebs dgun kar dbos phyogs kyi/ /me tog bsod sto ma sdud pa sgar btegs phebs/ khyor sor gsum gyis nyams bzhes mi 'bral zhing / /'od gsal 'khor yug nyid du zin par gnas/ /me byar 'jam da pal ril bu skrul pa'i rtags/ /ril lu zhu zhing zhag bdun gzims spangs nas/ /thar mdo'i dgongs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams bzhes mdzad/ /'di dus stong gar dmag byung lha bzang ni/ /lha sar bskos nas la phug bzhin gtsang zer//'di skabs ston pa shākya'i rgyal po nyi da/ /'khor bcas mjal spros 176

zhu mol phul ba la/ 1bka' stsal pa/ /gang gis rlabs chen spyod pa gang / /rgyal sras rnams kyis spyod pa ste/ /de yi rjes su slob pha'i blo/ /de dag de ni tha bas chen mchog /zhes gsungs so//jo bo a dī sha yi zhal mjal te/ /gdung shugs gsol btab dogs sel mang zhus par/ /kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin can//gzhi yi chos su gang gsungs pa/ /lam gyi chos su de dag ste/1'bus bu'i sgabs su rnam bzhag med/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /sngags kyi ga nga ba gang bshad pa/ /'bras bu'i theg pa'ang mtshon par byas/ /rnal 'byor chen po de'i rang nying/ /la sogs gsungs gnang bde don 'byed pa byung / /sngon 'gro bzhi yang 'bum ther grangs re them/ /'di skabs rmi lam nam mkha' dngas pa la/ /'ja' tshon gzi 'bar tshe ring bya dang 'brug /'od zer phog pa'i sa gzhi'i 'bras can shing / /du ma'i 'bras bu smin zhing rgyas pa rmis/ spom brag skyabs che mdo stod gser phug mjal/ /tsa ri nas yin zer ba'i shar po ni/ /rbad 'go snum zhing nya sul hrang nge ba/ /dar sna stag gzig phul 'jal mdun 'khod gzigs/ /zhing skyong ga ya rda ra'i zhal gzigs yin/ /dpal 'byor phebs bzhugs bla ma kun mkhyen nas/ /ye shes rab 'bar dbang lung nyams su bzhes/ /karma dpal grub nyid las sgra mtshams sbyor/ /gsan pas sgra gzhung spums cad mkhyen par gyur/ /177

sa khyi lo sar yi dam bsnyen bsgrub mdzad/ /de nas tshab tsha'i zhus ngor rdza rgyud kyi/ /yang 'dzom glong thil bstan 'phel dgon sogs phebs/ /sku brnyan chos 'khor bsam mi khyab pa dang / /sa phag rgyas pa 'bum gyi lung sogs gnang / /tshur phebs lha mdor sde dge mjal sbod mdzad1 /dpal 'byor dgon phebs skyabs cher 'dren ston phebs/ /sog po mang 'phrad rje yi sog skad mdzad1 /nyer 'tshe med par sog po dga' nas log /g.yu ri khud du gter chen rol rdor mjal1 /stag sham gter gyi kha byang gnang ba bzhin/ /gtsang gshis rdo rje gro lod gnas mchog tu//spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor bzhugs ces dang / /rab byung 'brug gi mgo bo can/ /de'i 'gro don sna khrid byed/ /la sogs zhu 'bul bcas te dpa 'byor phabs/ /lcags byi lo la zi ling sku 'bum nas/ /rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho dbus 'byon par/ /mjal dgos zhing skyong nyid kyis lung ston bzhin/ /khu khyim 'il mgo'i tho gol tho lo ger//zhu mjal 'phros mo phyis su legs pa byung / /de nas gnyan dgon dgu gtor dbu bzhugs mdzad/ /'di dus snye mo bstan 'phel mthong snang su/ /rje nyid mche ba ring por rngams pa mjal/ /de nas gnyan sprul gyis gdan bka' 'gyur gyi/ /bklag lung ched du zhus pas rje nyid kyis/ /ba/ra dbang brgyad par bklag lung lan 178

gsum gyis/ /zhal bzhes phul lhar skya ka sum mdor bzhub/sa//mgo zla'i bcu gsum gza' skar dar ba la/ /bla ma che dgu grwa mang yongs bskor dbus/ /chos kyi khri mthor chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis/ /gangs can skad du rgyal bka' 'gyur ro rtsag /nyin zhin shog grangs mang rnams pod gsum re/ /khrom tshogs rnams la rjes gnang rgyas pa re/ /thun bar rnams su che tshang gsung rab nas//dbang lung khrid sgor bsam mi khyab pa ga na/ /lcags glang bzhi pa'i 'go la ljags lung grub/ 1gtong rags legs 'bul dpangs bstod brjod las 'das/ /sde dger dbus phebs gnyis pa'i dgongs khrol zhus/ /sku brdzangs cher stsal chu stod zla bar phebs/ /'bab rom gzhung du thang lha'i phebs bsu mjal/ /gtsang dbus rten dang gang zag ma 'u sa mjal/ /kun nas dge ba'i ltas mtshan gsal bar gzigs/ /'di dus sde dges ma zur brlag ces gleng / /chu stag lo la 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi/ /rtog ge pa rnams yid ches skye bar mdzad/ /nag zlar sto kha'i gnas noms thams cad mjal/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan sku gdung phyag la bab/ /mtshur phu'i gos sku chen mo bkram pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' 'ja' 'od cha mtshan shin tu mang / /de nas rgyal ba gar dbang brgyad pa dang //tre ho la sogs lnga dbus chig rdzogs su/ /bsnyen rdzogs so so thar 179

pa'i bslab pa bzhes/ /gnyer chen 'bar lug lnga pa'i lam du thim/ /chu yos tre ho'i drung nas rnying lugs kyi/ /pad gling chos rje gling pa'i chos skor zhus/ /rang gi rang skra 'bal ba'i 'a spyod byas kyang //de dus rnying mar thugs gting ma rang skabs/ /mnal nyams mi 'gyur rdo rje o rgyan nyid/ 1bcu drug mkha' 'gro'i 'khor los ḍā dril 'khrol/ 1badz+ra gu ru'i dzab dbyangs gar sta sa kyis/ /mdun bsus nam mkhar 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /yo rgyan pad+ma dngos su phebs zhes gzigs/ /gzhan yang ya mtshan mthong snang sna tshogs byung / /rnying lugs chos la thugs dad lhag par skyes//bstan 'gror thugs bskyed bka' dang bstan 'gyur bcas/ /bzhengs grabs mdzad nas stod kyi gnas skor phebs/ /stag rnar sha stong gzugs grangs med mjal/ /sog po 'dzul khul gnas gsar mang du lces/ /chu bar phebs nyi na 'ja' tshon lnga sgreng zhig /phebs bsu mkhan gyi mi dang 'grogs nas byung / /nam mkha'i dbyings nas me tog char yang 'bab/ /spo mthon dbang phyug mi la'i skru brnyan la/ /phyag nas phul ba zhal sgros 'dzin par mdzad/ /phyag na'i bshags bzhugs zhing skyong mi bzhin lab/ /lha sman chen mo'i dam sgrib khrus kyis gsal1 /mda' dar 'dzin pa'i bud med lam dbye gzigs/ /gangs rir 'ja' tshon re kha kun gyis mthong / /sa 180

la'i yu la pa sad kyi ga—nod las skyabs/ /'di nas dmar nag gze 'od stabs su rgyas/ /yi bu rgyal pos sri zhu bsti stong 'bul/ /bya rung kha shor bya rgod spungs ri dang / /'phags pa shing kun shan ta pu ri mjal/ /yi bu rgyal po chos kyi grol bar mdzad/ /jo bo dza lir gser gdugs gsol nas phebs/ /ye rang rgyal pos zhabs 'gyur zhu bzhin du/ /rgya gar paṃ thing zhes grags yangs le shod//a su ra yi brag phug jo bo mchog / ka stu rga rdo rje gdan bkod mjal/ /de nas kho ka rgyal pos zhabs 'bring zhus/ /stag mo lus sbyin mchod rten sku dkar gsol/ /de nas kho khaṃ dbon chen yum bcas sleb1 /bstan 'gyur grub bo zhes pa'i tshul bcas gsan//shing 'brug kho ka rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzad/ /lha chen dbang phyug ha lu'i zlos gar gzigs/ skyed grong phebs ste 'phags pa wa ti mjal/ /nag zla'i bcu bdun byams sprin lha khang phebs/ /lnga ba'i nyer gcig sra dun tse ru phebs/ /chu stod tshes gcig gangs ri'i lho sgor phebs/ /dgra brtsam lnga brgya sangs rgyas zhabs rjes mjal/ /bdun pa'i tshes gcig la dwags rgyal pos mjal/ /sre ta pu rir chu tshan khrus sogs mdzad/ /khrums zla'i tshes gsum gangs ri ti se 'khor1 /spu skar tshes dgur zang zang lho brag dang //ji bo bka bzang jo mo gangs sogs phebs/ /de nas yangs pa nun dang mtshur phur phebs/ /rmi lam sku lus bya rgod mang por 181

byin/ /zhwa nag gser mdangs dbu la mnabs pa dang / /dgra bcom mang po mjal ba'i snang ba gzigs/ /shing sbrul lha sar phebs nas jo shāka mjal/ /rmo rang zhabs drung drung nas mkha' spyod dang / /dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'i dbang yang zhus/ /de nas rgya yi me tog spung du phebs/ /dmag zor bla mtshor de nyid mngon sum gzig / /dwags lha mjal te chos zam gdong du phebs/ /phag mo'i sku dang la ba phug sogs dang //la brtsegs khri bzhi shā ro bzhi sogs mjal/ /pho brang g.yu mtshor zhal khob dar zhu nas/ /mgon po ber nag can gyi zhal dngos gzigs//dbang chus khrus mdzad stag tshang dom tshang phebs/ /rdo rje ra bar mkha' 'gro 'bum dil dang / /kol tshang baṃ ro mjal nas mtsho dkar phebs/ /mtsho skor gnang ste pu ri phug med cher/ /sha za kha mo mjal nas yo rong dang / /sga chags brgyud de bu chu lha khang mjal/ /pho thang shol rdzong phu lung chos sbyin mdzad/ /me rtar bde mchog phag mo'i bsnyen mtshams mdzad/ /nyi shu lnga la sho ba mdo ru bsleb/ /nga phod pa la rtag zhus lung bstan du1/zil non me pho rta lo / /byang phyogs bdag po bro bas 'dzin//spre'u la ni 'tsho ba brtang / /phyis nas pra waṃ ga yi lor/ /g.yul chen 'jigs pas 'joms shes bstan/ /zhes gsung phyi dus pho lha sa gnyer tshor mdzad/ /bdud rtsi'i del du dbon po karma phebs//182

go yi chab tshan sde gnyer ser skyas mjal/ /dngul mda' lhun grub steng du sa ye dbang / /bstan pa tshe ring yab sras mjal sprod dang / /dpal spungs dgon pa 'debs dgos gsung bzang gnang /me lug nag zla tshes gnyis sa slong dang / /tshes bdun gnyer chen chos spyong blo gros kyis/ las dpon mdzad nas lha khang rmang 'dings so/ /rje nyi da lho zla'i gdul bya rjes su gzung / /sa sprel ri khrod dgon pa'i bsnyen mtshams mdzad/ khang bzo rags pa grub nas sde dge phebs/ /dngos rnams cher stsal gsol ston rgyas pa phul/ /sa bya lha ris lder bzo tshon grub cing / /pad+ma'i dpon khag a lo se cha dang / 1lha ru dpe khag bzhi yi mtho btsun rnams//chos rgyal yab sras bka' yis bcad de gnang / /rgya dpon kyu ta lo yes chos khrir mjal/ /de nas dgu pa'i tshes gcig 'jang la phebs/ /gdul bya rim drangs skya bka dgon dang ni/ /lcags khyi sgam po gnas dang kho tse gnas/ /rgya nag ri bo bya rkang gnas su phebs/ 1rnam snang lha khang sogs mngal zla brgyad bar/ /'ja' tshon gur khyim ngo mtshar skye bar 'char/ /dgra brtsam 'od spung sku gdung bzhugs pa yi/ /brag sgo ra mchod 'bul smon lam yang dag phul1 /'di dus 'ja' 'od dkar po kun gyis mjal/ /tā la'i pho brang rgya dpon this tug mjal/ /gsol 183

ston sna tshogs bsnyen bkur rgya chen bstab/ /dpon slob kun la rgya rag mang po drangs/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis bzi dang ra ro med/ /gsol dkar khri mdun lhung ba'ang yod tsam las/ /gas chag med pas rgya dpon ya mtshan skyes/ 1rgya rnams chang shi 'khrab pas ltas mo che/ /rgya dpon 'khor los dar re phyogs cig bsres//phyag mdud zhus pa so sor ma nor gnang / /sa tham sgrol bstod rgya yig bod skad bsgyur /'og min gling du grwa brgya bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ /dpal spungs phebs 'phral sde dger mjal sprod phebs/1lcags phag chos rgyal sde dge'i bkas bskul te/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog ni bka' bstan 'gyur/ /de la mos pas rgya dbus li spung sogs/ /phyi mo par du bsgrubs zin 'dug na yang //brda chad rga rim 'khrul pas yin lo tsam/ /ma gtogs mkhas kun yid rton mi nus kyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan du/ /bka' 'gyur par zhig bzhengs par spro ba na/ /khyod ni rgya bod mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan te/ /bka' bstan kun la thogs med mkhyen pa rgyas/ /de phyir bka' 'gyur rin chen phyi mo rnams//'gyur nyes brda log go rim 'khrul pa rnams/ /chos spyan ldan pas dag par gsal bar mdzod/ /dbu 'dzugs dga' ston maṇ+ḍal cher 'bul zhus/ /de nas rim gyis zhus dag mdzad pa dang //zhar byung gdul bya'i re ba skong bzhin du/ /184

chu bya sa ga'i tshes 'gor zhu dag grub/ 1dpal spungs phebs nas karma pa yab sus/ /rgya nag phebs pa mjal phyir byang du byon//dgu pa'i tshes gsum cha gar nor bur mjal/ /cod pan sgron dang 'bul ston smin grol zhus/ /bdag kyang zhabs phyir phebs dgos zhus na'ang / /rang lugs bstan pa'i bshad skrub 'dzin skyong phyir/ /snying po'i bstan pa gtad kyi bzhugs shig gsungs/1zhabs pad spyi bor blangs nas smon lams bcas/ /thugs bkral che yang yab sras so sor phebs/ /chu glang chos spyod par zhus skyes rabs kyi/ /zhal thang sum cu sko ra gyi phyag bris bstar/ /rdza phyogs dger bkod grwa brgya lhag bsnyen rdzogs/ /shing stag lhun grub steng gi chos grwar phebs/ /bka' 'gyur par la bde mchog rab gnas mdzad/ /dpal spungs sman sku zung 'jug brgyud rim bzhengs/ /de nas mthing dmar dngul gyi mchod rten la/ /rab gnas phyir du dbus phebs gsum pa la//sde dger dgongs khrol sku brdzangs lnga brgya tshan/ /'bul bzhes spom brag gnas rtser karma pa/ /spom brag pa dang seng dpal mgon po ber/ /zhing skyong yab yum rnams kyi zhal gzigs byung / /skya kar mdor phebs chos mgon chos bro gzigs/ /smin zla'i tshes bcur 'og min mtshur phu nas/ /dngul gdung rab gnas snyan shal 185

mchong 'bul spyos/ /shing yos jo shāka gnas mjal rgya bod kyi/ /che rgu gnyan bcu dag pa'i lam sner gtad/ /bshes gnyen byams pas chos kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ /mi dbang chen pos bod du bzhugs pa zhus//jo mo gangs su u rgyan sku brnyan bzhengs/ /stag rnar rigs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu mjal/ /'di nas smin grol chos gsan phyogs phebs mdzad/ /rab tu byung ba nyi shu skor yang bskrubs/ /shang gi gnas mjal zab phur bcad rgya bzhugs/ /lha sa rgya 'bri mtshal yer gnas mchod mjal/ /me 'brug rgyal tshab dpa' bor bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ /de nas lha sar mi dbang thon phyag zhus/ /khams phebs karma ra bsnyen rdzogs brgya lhag bskrubs/ /lhun grub steng phebs sde dger mjal sprod gzab/ /dpa spungs phebs tshe legs skyes tshogs rnams bzhes/ /bkra rdzong bu mo tshang gi 'das chos mdzad/ /me sbrul drung par chos gnang rig 'dzin che'i/ /bka' phebs karma pa yi ngos 'dzin mcha na/ /dpal ldan 'jigs med bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje mi shig snying po'i dbang phyug nges don bstan pa'i rtsa lag phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ /zhes gsol dbal spungs bca' khrims thog mar tshugs/ /sa rta sgrol bsnyen mdzad nas lhun sting phebs/ /chu stod tshes 186

gsu ma chos rgyal dgung du gshegs1 /gshegs chos mdzad nas dbal spungs phebs pa dang / /kaḥ thog sprul skur phyag chos phag dbang nos/ 'jang du phebs skabs bsod nams mgon pos skyel/ /sa lug khra 'bur 'dus sder chos lung gnang / /'og min la gshis brgya skor re bsnyen rdzogs/ /'jang gnas kun gzigs dmar mchod mang bcad/ 'bam gyi rnam snang gtsang gshis mtshams 'bru drug /mjal nas rja thog rje mo dge tshul bsgrubs//mchod yon yu ma sras rgya sman me tog btsug 1 lcags sprel sgrol bsnyen gling chos 'das chos mdzad/ 1dpal yul karma nor bus spran drangs phebs/ /bum sprub dbur bzhugs nam mkha' dngas pa'i dkyil/ /'ja' tshon hor yig ma ṇi rang byon 'char/ /dpal yul nya khyi bla ma byin rlabs zhus/ /mgo bo zla ba'i bar du na ba byung / /phyis tshod slob dpon gyur nas gshegs rjes su/ /ka pa la ru phyag rjes khrig ger byon/ /brda gor slob dpon brgyad kyi rtogs pa phul/ /kun bzang ye shes dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul mdzad/ /dpal sprungs phebs nas sde dger dga' ston zhus/ /tshes bcu sprub mchod 'cham tshugs mchod theb gnang / /dpal grwa brgya dang lnga bcu bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ /lcags bya karma lha steng bsnyen mtshams bzhugs/ /de nas 187

tshur phebs dzo thog yum sras nas/ /bsnyen bkur mdzad cing dus 'khor zhabs drung mjal/ /dpal spungs phebs nas mchod rten chen po bzhengs/ /chu khyir rja thog yum sras zhabs drung bcas/ /phyag chen khrid mdzad dpon tshang dbus phebs rdzong / /lha rje rnams la sdum khrid sman thu mdzad/ hor dang stong skor mgo log sogs la phebs//dgon par grwa bca' bstan don bsam las yas/ /'brang ri sprug por bsang dang gtor chen mdzad/ /chu phag rgya mo rong gi dpon nang po/ /sog mo cog rtse dam pa 'khor bcas kyi/ /mjal bsu dga' ston seng tsed la sogs gzigs//'bul nod gling bzhi'i tshul te nub rta drel/ /'bul yig gser zhun kho nas bris pa 'dug /yar lam hor brgyud dpal spungs nyid du phebs/ 1dzi thog yum sras mi du brgya rtsa mdzad/ /me ling sde dger sman dpyad gcod sogs gnang / /shing byir zhwa dmar sprul sku'i rten bzhugs 'bul/ /nyi grags sprul skur 'dzam dkar dbang sogs mdzad/ /tshe dbang dpal spungs gshegs pa'i pur sbyangs mdzad/ /pad+ma nor bur dgongs 'dus dbang rnams gsan/ /'dan phebs phyir lam mkhan chen dgongs pa bzhin/ /rdo khams lha khang rab gnas rgyas par gnang / /188

shing glang kaḥ thog zheng skyong sa dmar gyi/ /bla ma dang ni tshe dbang phrin las rnams/ /bsnyen par rdzogs sheng phyag chen khrid kyang bstsal/ /zhwa dmar sku don dbus phebs bzhin pa ka/ /sde dge bla dpon lcam dral rdzong bskyel bcas/ /gle mda' thang nas mgon po'i gser 'bag mjal/ /kong po brag gsum mtsho la sangs gling gi1 /phyag bzo gur drag bong rir sgyur 'a tshon pa'i//gzim khang nyid du tshe dbang nor bu mjal/ /ljon pa lung phebs yig bdun sprub thabs bsgyur/ rje des rig 'dzin chen nas smin grol lam/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bum pa gang byo mdzad/ /khyung po'i ring bsrel re lnga lhag par gnang / /smin zla'i tshes gcig lhag par jo shāka mjal/ /mtshur phur bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje mjal/ /zhabs brtan rtsad pan sgron nas maṇ+ḍal phul//karma pa nas rje de'i zhal gzigs mdzad/ /smin grol rgya chen karma pa la phul/ /me stag rgyal ba rgya mtsho dbang dang ni/ /brgya rtsa rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang rdzogs pa phul/ /brtsa lnga lha sa mthil du zhal rgyas phebs//bka shis rtse sras gling gi sras/ /zhwa dmar gang yin shor rgyag mang du byas/ /ma 'byed jo bo'i mdun du bka' blon phebs/ /rtags bsgril dang po si tus gsung bzhin bab1 /rang phyogs pa rnams lha gso di ri ri/ /dga' ldan khang sar dar chen ya la la1/189

phyogs kun lha bas nga da ra po me re re/ /mnga' jis ku/na shī dril bsgrags bsnyan lhong ste nga / rtsed shod kun nas lo gas ra dga' ston phul/ /phas rgol kun kyang rjes su bzung bar mjad/ 1rta rgyug skabs gzigs rig pa 'dzin pa mes/ /rta gang mgyogs pa khyod kyi mkhyen yang gsung / mi shes zhus kyang dmar zag thugs la yod/ /de ga nyid do da rung 'dzi 'dug gsung / /rjes nas zag 'dzi zhig gi mgyogs dar blangs/ /lan gcig mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma ru/ /skye ba bzhes pa khyed kyes mkhyen no gsungs//mi shes zhus kyang dgongs pas gzigs gsungs par/ /bka' bzhin dpyad pa bla ma dbu ther gzigs/ /de ga gsungs 'ing rig 'dzin chen mo dgyes/ /gsang phu sde pas sgar 'og rtsis sped gnang / /zhwa dmar mchog sprul seng khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/ /me yos lo la slar mang bal yul phebs/ /dpal ldan sa skya bla brang lhan rgyas dang / sgo rum bse 'bag la sogs rten rnams mjal/ /de nas sku zhabs rig 'dzin chen mo dang 1 1rje nyid bya rung kha shor zhal 'dzom mdzad/ /thi ma snying thig ring bsrel mang bar gnang / /bya rung kha shor nyams gsos rab gnas mdzad/ /ha ri rdong phebs 'brum pa spung ba'i phyir/ /gzhung gi sku tshab bsleb pas phyir log tu /sna dkar rtse ru dbang dang mjal sprod mdzad/ /de nas mtshur yangs rten dang gang zag 190

mjal/ /pad+ma khyung rdzong can du gcod rgya mdzad/ /tha skor zla bar rmang lam nyi ma shar/ /lha mtshan bzhi ldan dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / /rig 'dzin che mjal sbyin bsreg mdzad pa dang / /rtar khyer rir 'jigs nyams dga'i gur du bzhugs/ /de 'dra ya mtshan rmi lam 'ga' yang gzigs/ /de nas bka' brgyad ma ru bcad rgya'i skabs/ /mchod rten nyer brgyad gsos dang sāts+tsha ni//nyer brgyad mchod rten gcig la gse ra phye 'thul/ /thub pa gangs dang tsa ri'i mchod rten gsos/ /spus bzhes la sogs ltas kyis gshog dus gzigs/ /sa sbrul tshes brgyad bcad rgya grol nas ni/ /lha sar dpon po dbang dang che dgus mjal/ /dbang skabs dpon pos bla ma mgon por gzigs/ /sde dge lcam dral phebs mjal dbang sogs gnang / /khrums zlar yab sras khams btegs dzo thog phebs/ / lcags rtar yab sras sde dge lhun steng phebs/ /skyes 'bul bsnyen bkur stobs dang dpal spungs phebs/ /drin chen yum gyi rjes sgrub rgya cher mdzad/ /de nas karma lha steng 'gro don phebs//khams smyon bde chen thod par yig brgya mjal/ /rje stod lha bzos rgyud sde'i zhal spung bris/ /rdis tu lha bzos gser phreb zhal spung zhengs/ /'ja' tshan lha bzos gu ru mtshan brgyad bkod/ /191

lcags lug sde dge bla chen lcam tshe ming / /'das pas bcad rgya grol te sde dge phebs1 /dgongs rdzogs sku rim lcam dral yab sras bcas/ /mnyes par mdzad nas dpal spungs nyid du phebs/ /rje dbon bsam 'phel 'jang yul 'gro don brdzangs//tshogs par phyag chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /chu sprel mkhar dbon kun dga' sangs rgyas sogs/ /bsdus grwa bslab dang khams pa sprul sku sogs/ /chos drug khrid nas rdza rgyud gdul byar phebs/ /rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' bzhin kaḥthog phebs/ /ka mgo yo yang zhing skyong thugs ma g.yos/ /rdo smad phebs par sde srid phyag tu phul1 /chu byar rdo smad grwa mang bsnyen par rdzogs/ /rdo snyi gser gsum mgu log chos la bkod/ /de nas dpal spungs mchog sprul nyid dang mjal/ /rig 'dzin bkas bskul sgro la mtshan gsal 'gyur mdzad/ /sga zur go bug gdul bya rjes su bzung / /rja thog a spung byang chub lam du khrid/ /shing khyir mchog spru la khams par dbang lung phul/ /gser 'gyur dbu brtsam mkhan chen sku brdzangs bstab/ /shing phag hor du rgyal rong dmag lhag nas/ /rim gror bgyis dang mdo stod chab srid phul/ /ob chi rnams la sdum khrid zhib mor gnang / /sde dge'i las gnyer blo stobs phul byung ba /192

khyab 'jug 'jug pa bcu yi rdzu 'phrul bzhin/ /dmag dpung dpa' skyes snying khams ldan rnams kyis/ /rgyal rong dmag sde sha khrag tha nga mar brdal/ /ba mda' zam par dgra mad phreng ba bstar/ /rbab kyis grong nas dgra bo rjes med byas/ /ma zur rdzong du dgra nor gnang du blang / /chos skyong bka' spung dmag dang mnyam du brgyug /mgon khang noms su mtshon la khrug ris 'khyug/dus dang dus med gnam par 'ur rdir sgrogs/ /de tshe gnam sa'i bdag po sde dge rgyal/ /rgya dbus bar du gnas tshad snying rtsa 'dar/ /rjes su rgya khrims byung bar chos spung gi/ /lung bstan bzhin du bdag rkyen gzengs bstod las/ /'tshe dang nyams nyes phra mos ma gos so/ /hor dpon rnams kyi legs 'bul gus phyag gis/ /sde dge'i gzhung sgar mtha' mar kyi li li/ /zhes pa'i skad cha yul kun rlung ltar grags/ /sa smad phyogs kyi gdul bya rjes su bzung / /brag dmar gsal stong kham yung bum skrub mdzad/ /me byir nor bu bla mas tshe snying dung / /zhabs brtan phul dang sde dge lcam dral nas/ /skyes bu mchog gi spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /tshar bcad tshogs rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /rja thog nor bu rtse yi pho brang du/ /byang sems rnam bzhi dge 'dun rgya mtsho yi/ /ra ta gling gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor zhal lces nas//193

sde dge grub thob skrub pa'i ril bu dang / /skye bdun sku sha a rgya hri dam sogs/ /'dzam gling rten 'dus yongs su rdzogs pa yi//ril bu bsam gyis mi khyab bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' bar snang 'ja' tshon dra ba 'brel/ /bum nang ril bu 'phel phyur phyi ru 'phur/ /sku gsung thugs rten ril lu dpag med 'tshobs/ /rlung gi grangs la zhag po bco brgyad thogs1 /de nas dpon 'khor mnga' ris yul sde kun/ /smin grol ril lus 'khor ba mtha' can mdzad/ /bsti stongs cher rtsal drung yig lha 'phel gzhi/ /yab sras kun phebs so sos dbang chos mdzad/ /bsnyen bkur rgya bskyed dpal spungs chos grags phebs/ /klu 'bas tshe skrub bskrubs pa'i dbang chen phul/ /ye na rdzong du hor mo thar lam bstan/ /me glang lho byang gdu bya'i re ba bskangs/ /sgrogs chen gdong ra bsang dang mchod pas brnga na/ /kang yul bka shis dar lce sde dger btags/ /sa stag gser gyi bka' 'gyur rab gnas mdzad/ /gro bzhin gnam stong lhan rgyas 'jang yul phebs/ /mchams kyi 'bru drug gtsang gshis gro lod mchod/ /'jis kyi rna ma snang brgyud de phebs pa la/ /bstan 'phel gling du mchog sprul sku 'brum thar/ /sa yos snyu chag mo kar rgya yis mchod/ /rgya zas rgya zog rgya yi rtsed mo gzigs/ /dam pa gnas nas 'jang ri sprug por 194

phebs/ 1yid bzhin 'khor lo zla ba'i bar du gzigs/ /de nas yar phebs ba 'a lam ra su brgyud/ /ko shod sding dpon sar phebs sna bzang ba'i/ /bkag ma dge 'dun go mtshon thogs pa byung / /dmag log byas nas log tu song na'ang / /dge 'dun nang 'khrugs pa yi dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun me yi 'khrul 'khor la sogs pas/ /mtshon 'dzin dpung chen khyim pa dad pa ldog /rgyal bstan ye mi 'dug dgongs thugs mugs mdzad/ /ngos legs bstan 'dzin chos dbyings klong du bzhugs/ 1ke 'bur nas brgyud dpal spungs gdan sar phebs/ /mkhas grub dam pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bskrubs/ /kaḥthog zhing skyong phebs nas thugs dag pa'i/ /dbu rtsi bzhes 'dug gang ltar nged la ni//bsam ngan yod bsam rmi lam na med gsungs/ /'jigs mdzad bsnyen skabs nyi ma shar ba dang / /gur gum me tog gzigs rmis spyan 'byed skabs/ 1bdud rtsi 'thung zhing shing 'bras zos pa dang /1skas mdzes tre dbang bskur la sogs mthong / 1lcags 'brug zhwa dmar mchog sprul dbus la phebs/ /sde dge bla dpon tsha thang bar du phebs/ /karma mchog gi sprul skur bsnyen rdzogs phul/ /oṃ gyi yi ge rdo la rang byon rnyed/ /dge rgyas bar du mchog sprul chibs bskyel zhus/ /rin chen spungs par bskyel dar 'bul res mdzad/ /'bral mi phod ltar chibs kha yas 195

byir gyes/ /sman rgyal bsam gtan bod du skru bskyel mdzad//gdul bya'i re skong dpal spungs gdan sar phebs/ /ngor rje shar chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sku skyes gnang zhing khri 'bul rgya cher phul/ /rmang lam rgyal ba zhwa dmar brgyad pa mjal/ /sku tshe jing ba'i legs mtshan gnang ba'ang gzigs/ /lcags sbrul bka shis stem phebs dpon rgan la/ /dbang chos sman rten sogs phul dgongs rdzogs skrub/ /thar lam nyid bkod lcam dral dpon lcam la/ /'di phyis bslab gdam rjes su rang bar mdzad/ /khrom gzhung 'phel tsha nyag rong stod smad phebs/ /rku jag bsdom dang sha 'khon sbyang ba sogs/ /'gro ba de kun skal pa bzang bor mdzad/ /chu rtar sde dge bsnyun pa'i rim gro bskrub/ /dbus phebs lnga pa dgos pa'i ltas kyang gzigs/ /sde dge gsar rnying smin grol lam yang phyes/ /maṇ+ḍal skyel dang sku brdzangs bsam mi khyab//slar yang dgon phebs 'phral yun dge shis kyi/ /phrin las spel nas rlung ltas bzang skabs btegs/ /rim gyes mtshur phu yangs pa can du phebs/ /mthing dmar cod pan 'dzin dang mjal sprod kyi/ /dgyes spro rgya chen rdzogs ldan dus la 'gran/ /lha sa'i rten rnams mjal zhing stong mchod phul/ /smon lam rgya chen yang dang yang du btab/ /rtse shod che dgu'i mjal 'dzom phun sum 196

tshogs/ /zhi ba lha ni dogs sel je— nga du phebs/ /mnga' ris bal po lho 'brug sog stod smad/ /dwags kong nyang dang gtsags dbus che dgus gtsos/ /nyin mtshan kun la chos 'khor rgyun chad med/ /dad gus ldan pa'i 'bul nod rgyun chad med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i dogs sel rgyun chad med/ /thugs bskyed smon lam brtan po rgyun chad med/ /'bri gung spro lung 'brong ngur bcad rgya bzhugs/ /mar me 'dzin sogs ltas la ngo mtshar che/ /gzhu stod gter sgrom tshogs khang steng 'og phebs/ /tshogs 'khor gang mdzad ya mtshan rten 'brel du/ /sku nyid rdo rje gro lod gyur pa dang / /phyir pheb sgrol ma'i sbyin bsreg mdzad ba'i skabs/ /gur steng ut+pal sngon pos gang ba byung / /'bri gung rdzong du mjal spro zhib rgyas dang / /lha sa gnas nang mtshur bar chos zang zing //re ba cher bkangs rgyal ba yab sras la/ /bka' 'gyur rin po che yi lung gi 'phros/ /ye shes rgyal ba'i mdo las dbu 'dzugs dang //phyag chen zab khrid phul ba'i dbu yang 'dzugs/ /'du khang karma pa la zhabs rten phul/ /mdzod nag sngon gyi sman rag ma skam 'dug /chu lug thub sku 'dzam gling rgyan cig mdun/ /dpal ldan karma pa la bsnyen rdzogs phul1 /bka' 'gyur la sogs lung dang smin byed dbang / /grol byed khrid rigs bgrangs kyi mi lang mdzad//phyogs kyi dad 'dus bla sde che rigs la/ /'bul nod 'dus mang 197

chos dang zang zing yis/ tshims par mdzad nas rgyal ba yab sras gtsos/ /ru bzhi bod kyi skal ldan thams cad kyis/ /che chung ma bltos 'brel pa sna re yis/ 1bsnyen bkur sku brdzangs nam mkha'i mdzod sgo phyes /sngo smon bkra shis rgyas 'debs yang yang phul//zhwa dmar dpa' bo yongs 'dzin rin po ches/ /chibs bskyel mdzad par mongs 'dzin dam pas ni1 /phyi nang chos kyi sgro 'dogs ma chod nas/ /dad pa'i ngos nas khams su mnyam phebs gyur//sde dge lhun steng khu dbon lhan rgyas mjal/ /rgya bod mang por dbang bka' rjes skyong nas/ /dga' ston gnang skyes res mos dgyes pa'i ngang / /gdan sa chen po dpal spungs chos gling phebs//kaḥdapal la sogs nye ring legs 'bul mkhan/ /nam mkha'i skar ma tshogs pa'i rjes su 'gran/ /shing sprel 'bri gung sprul skur zhabs 'degs dang / /gnyer pa bsod nams thar pa'i 'a ma la bkad/ /byang brgyud 'gro 'dren gdan sar phebs pa'i dus/ /shel mig mchod brgya gcig bsdus 'od 'bar ba/ —rmang nyams gzigs dang mdzod 'grel dbu tshugs dka /shing byar zur mang la phebs bstan 'gro skyong / /me khyir sde dge bsnyun par thabs kyis sel/ /phur pa lha khang bzhengs pa'i sa thig bris/ /re mtsho kha sogs sngo sman thugs 198

rtsol mdzad/ /'di dus sku nyid mgon po ber du gyur/ /nam mkhar 'phyo snyam rmang lam sta bur gsungs/ /rdor brag bla ma gshegs pa'i gdung dbur phebs/ /sde dger srid spel bum pa srung 'khor bskyal/ /rje nyid tshe dpag med du gyur pa dang //sgrol ma gyur pa'i nyams shar srid spel phul/ / me phag bcad rgyar sku nyid mgon por gyur/ /ber dkar gsol ba'i rming nyams dag kyang byub / /sde dge rja thog dngul chu brtsa bkru sbyangs/ /thal sman la sogs lung dang mthun par mdzad/ /dbang chos la sogs dpon 'khor mnyes par mdzad//lcam la khrus dang srid spel spung ba btags/ /sa ga'i bco lngar seng chen gnam brag phebs/ /gsang khrus gtor chen bum pa gter du sbas/ /'di dus lha sras srid du 'dzin pa'i ltas/ 1lcam la rmi lam legs ltas dag kyang 'dug /phyis dus gur mgon ga rdos sgra che ba/ /byung zhes de nas gdan sa nyid du phebs//'jang nas dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rje nyid/ /'jang grwa mang po'i zhabs 'bring bcas te phebs/ /sde dge lha lung byang brgyud sga nyag phebs /chos mgon sprul sku rab tu byung bar gsol//dpal spungs phebs nas slar yang dbon stod du/ /dpon po chos skyong gshegs pa'i spur sbyang phebs/ /sku mched bsnyun pa sman dang rim gros sel/ /bsnyen bkur bzhes nas slar yang gdan sa 199
