dang / /sa byir dzo thog phebs pa lha sras 'khrungs/ /srid spung gos thabs 'ga' yis nyer 'tshe skyob1 /lcam nyid sngon dus sgyu 'phrul lha mo bzhin/ /chos nyid thim pa'i dge ba'i mtshams sbyor sogs//thar pa'i lam du bgri ba'i phyag na len gzab/ /gdan sar phebs nas yongs 'dzin rin po cher/ /dbang chos sogs mdzad sku brdzangs rgya cher spel/ /phur khang ting nge 'dzin gyi rab gnas mdzad/ /rmang nyams karma pas bzhengs rdor 'chang dang / /grub brgya bkag mdangs ldan pa zhig kyang gzigs/ /sde dge'i sku rim yas zor gtor 'bul tshe/ /mgon po ber gyi dar chen bslang ba rmis/ sde dge bsnyun par sman ga rtsad dbang gi skabs/ /dril bus sgra las bsnyun gzhi bde zhes gsan/ —ji na bzhin du bsnyun dwangs legs 'bul phul/ /chu glang sde dge'i sman yig par 'god pa'i/ /bye ba ring bsrel la sogs zhus 'go tshugs/ /dpal 'byor la phebs rten gsum mgon khang mchod/ /dpe deb tshogs 'gyed dbang dang bca' bsgrigs mdzad/ /lcags stag bal po sa ma dha bha dras/ /rin chen sna lnga yig tshogs sman rna mas 'byor/ /chags med sprul sku byams tsha'i de rgyu 'dzin/ /rmang lam rig ldan rgyal ka rgyal po'i chas/ /zhal 200

mdangs dkar ba mjal bas thugs spro mdzad/ /rtsis dang dus 'khor 'grel chen don zhus rmis/ dzo thog phebs nas sras la skyabs spung mdzad/ /lcags rar phe sa nas sde dge sku ngo la//dbang bka' gcod thun mdzad nas 'gro phan gyi/ /rin chen ril bu yang zab mang sbyor dang / /nyi zla 'khor lo gsal byed zla shel sogs/ /sbyor ba'i dbu tshugs sman lha longs sku yi/ /cho ga mthun gsum re gnang yang grub nas/ /rin chen ril lu dkar yol bcad so dgu/ /yang zab bzhi lhag dril grub sbyang khrus dang //sman lha'i rab gnas bsngo smon mtha' rgyas btab/ /de nas klu sdings mkhan chen rab gnas mdzad/ /'bul bkur bzhes nas dpal spungs gdan sar phebs/ /rgyal tshab dbus phebs sku brdzangs rgya cher btab/ /sde dge tshe yag kong lcam gnyen ston gzigs/ /lcags yos rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa/ phebs bsu rgyam gzhung mjal 'dzom grub par mdzad/ /de nas yab sras zur mong dgon du phebs/ /phyogs kyi gdul bya'i re ba gang bar mdzad//deXnas gdan sa dpal spungs phebs pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha'i khams la 'ja' tshon bla bre bres/ /phyogs kun 'ja' sprin dkar po'i yol bas khyab/ /dge 'dun 'phen gdugs yo byad rol cha yis//sa gzhi khyon lam mtshams sprin bzhin du dmar/ /lha dbang sman 201

dris du da pas bar snang khyab/ /lha rna mas me tog char pa si li li//skye bo'i tshogs rna mas phyag bskor tshubs se tshubs/ /don gyi rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /rgyal ba rgyal dbang 'di las gzhan du kyi/ /rje nyid gtsug 'a ga khang phyir mdun bsu phebs/ /nang nas maṇ+ḍal rje nyid phyag bstar mdzad/ /maṇ+ḍal tshig dbyangs brtan bzhugs gsol ston 'bul/ /dam chos dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i lung sogs dang / /rang byung bka' 'bum dbang lung khrid rnams phul/ /chu 'brug lhan rgyas sde dge lhun steng phebs/ /sde dger bde mchog phag mo'i bka' dbang bstsal/ /rje nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho ber nun dbang / /la sogs phul nas mkhan chen gsol ston dang / /mchod yon zung nas bsnyen bkur gya nom pa/ /bzhes te slar yang dpal spungs nyid du phebs/ /zla ba lnga par tshes bcu lo dar bzhin/ /sde dges dbus kyi phyogs med lha mi'i khrom//nyin re'ang stong re phar 'gro tshur 'ong bzhin/ /mthing dmar dbu zhwa mang gsol mthong thos dang / /dran reg skye ba gcig gi don ldan mdzad/ /gnyer pa bod rgyal las mtha' chos la bkod//karma pa la sku gsung thugs rten dang / /rin chen gser dngul 'jig rten nom pa'i rigs/ /dbus su phebs pa'i sku brdzangs maṇ+ḍal phul/ /slar yang brtan bzhugs 'bul bkur rgya chen bstsal//202

de nas lha steng bar du sku skyel mdzad/ /rang byung zhabs rjes mtshal zhal smon lam gnang / /'bral mi phod lhar yab sras yas phyir gyes/ /lha steng grwa pa drug cu bsnyen par rdzogs/1lha mi 'dre gsum re ba so sor bskangs/ /karma sogs brgyud gdan sa dpal spungs phebs/ /sde dge'i gso rigs par phud pod lnga 'byor/ /rnyags chu che bar chibs kyis phar brgal rmis//mgo zla'i brgyad kyi tho rongs phyag rtsa tshubs/ /chur sprul gser 'gyur dkar chag smon lam mdzad/ /rje btsun sgrol ma mi mo'i rna ma pa can/ /shin tu mdzes shing rgyan dang na bzas spras/ 1mjal 'phral phyag rtsa 'khrugs pa'i— rgyu ci zhus//sgod chung chu dkar gang ba gnang nas 'dis/ /khrus kyis gsung par phar la zhal ngor gtor/ /slar yang sgrol mas gnang ba'i chu de yis/ /rang la khrus ma byas pa ma legs snyams/ /de nyid zhal nas ci yang mi skyon te/ /nga dang khyod nyid ngo bo gcig yin pas/ /khrus chu nged la gtor ba legs pa yin/ /da ni mi sdod po ṭa la ru 'gro/ /gsung pa rje yang der 'gro zhus ma thag /da dung cung mi rdol bas re zhig bzhugs/ /gsungs te 'phur byon na bza' 'jus pheb snyam / /sgrol chog khrus byas phyag rtsa cung zad bde/ /tshe sprub da kyil 'khor 'od zer bdun gyi mtha'/ /'khor yug cung zad ma rdzogs pa'ang rmis/ /mdzod nas sku rim bsam mi 203

khyab pa mdzad— /rgyal rong steng du gong ma chen po yi/ /dpung chen btegs pa'i dmag dpon gtsang kyun gyis/ /skyabs mgon re ba chen po'i gdan zhus slebs/ /zhu dbon dge legs lhun grub dbus 'khor gyi/ /zhal mjal phebs dang khams pa'i zhabs brtan 'byor/ /rmang nyams lung pa chen po zhig tu phebs/ /mchod rten gser gdung nun du phebs pa dang / /mdzod 'grel kun khyab mtha' bsdu'i ltas byung gsungs/ /'di skabs phyag rtsa'i rgyu ba med pa dang / /tshab tshub res 'byung rlung lhas kyang ma legs/1rmang nyams brtan pas g.yo ba brtsam zhis byung / /rgya yi spyan 'dren gnyis pa zhig kyang 'byor/ /yab sras gsung brtag rtsub pa'i bka' rgya phebs/ /'dis bar lo gsar ras chos tshes bcu yi/ /'cham dang sde dger sri zhus bkur ba dang / /lo mjug dgu gtor 'cham dang yas zor rnams/ /spyi dger bstan lar dmigs pa'i nan tan mdzad/ /shing rtar min gtsang kyun gyi yig rten 'byor/ /sku mtshams rim gror mang po zhabs brtan phul/ /sku nyid mi bzhugs rtags mtshan gsal che yang / /gong ma'i bka' la ldog tu med zer yang //gdul bya'i zhu ngo mi sbog byang sems tshul/ /gcig phan gcig gnod jus don mi bzhed kung / /spyi bod kun phan 'byung res chib kha bskyod/ /sde dge mchod yon lhun steng zhal rgyas mdzad//204

dbang bka' byin rlabs du mas rjes su bzung / /bkra shis chos rdzong lha sras dam pa la/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang dang tshe dbang brgya/ /slar yang yab rje chos kyi rgyal po la/ /gur drag dbang dang gsung bsgros nyin 'ga' mdzad/ /kaḥthog pa dang mjal 'phrad zhib par mdzad/ /'khyam tshe gong mar gsol ston sku bdangs phul/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i bku shis la// sngo ba smon la rnam dag yun ring mdzad/ /mkhan chen zhu chen bla chen kun gyis bkur/ /bla ma grwa tshogs zhabs brtan ngang nas bskyel/ /sde pa che dgus dpon chen nor gyis bskyel/ /mnga' ris kun gyis 'bru nor mtshams pas bskyel/ /rnal 'byor po mos gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bskyel/ /dmag dpon mgon po bsam 'grub dpung brgya tshos/ /lam ring zhabs 'bring dang bcas dgon chen nas/ /brda ma mdo bar sde dge 'khor bcas phebs/ /de nas ma ṇi gal ba zhes pa ru/ /mchod yon khams bde res phul rje de yis/ 1sde dger tshe skrub ril lu grangs med phul/ /bkra shis dar gyi skyel lan g.yab g.yug bcas1 /thugs 'phros chen po'i ngang nas ring sar phebs/ /ba 'jo mcher yag sman rgyal bsam gtan dang / /sde dge dbon po chos skyong blo gros dang / /rje drung rna mas la rig gtad mdzad nas ni/ /smar khams bla mar sku rim sprubs shig gsungs/ /ngag dbang mgon 205

por 'phral du 'phrad do gsungs/ /rdzong 'bul mkhan ni sa gzhir mi shong tsam/ /rag stag sku 'bum phyag smon yun ring gnang //sde yi mgon khang phyag mjal snyan shal phul/ /rim phebs mchog dman bar gyi yid re skong / khrom mang bka' phog byin rlabs 'gog pa med/ /dzar yar ti ri bo rta rna'i mdun/ /hor yul kre shel gnyis kyi sa mtshams su/ /brag ri khyung tshang phub pa'i g.yas ngos kyi/ /kre yi maṇ+ḍal thang zhes bya ba ru/ /sngon dus dgas po bku shis rnam rgyal dang / /dpal ldan sa skya mya ngan 'da' ba'i gnas/ /phal cher la zang zhes su grags par bzhugs//rgya nag bsnyun 'dri mkhan gyi lo yes 'byor/ /sde dge'i bsnyun 'dri gu ru 'phel slebs par/ /byi na rlabs gnang dang bka' 'dri nyin dus bzhin/ /sku 'khor rnams nas sku rim le stod med//rje nyid thugs dam bsgrigs mar chags 'dri med/ /shing rta don drug khru zla'i nyer bzhi yi/ /nam gung sku lus drang por bsrang bzhin par/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung phyag gnyis ni/ /mnyam bzhag phyag phreng 'dzin bzhin rje nyid kyis//lus la nad med snang ba shin tu dngas/ /gsungs nas tshes kyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag /ston pa bzhin du mya ngan 'da' tshul mdzad/ /zhag bdun bar du thugs khar drod dang ldan/ /de skabs mkha' la sgyur 'a tshon dra bas 'brel/ /me tog char dang 206

bdud rtsi'i zar pa 'beb/ /g.yu 'brug sgrar yang bstan pa 'khyag go sgrogs/ /dad pa can gyi gdung mchod bsam mi khyab/ /rgya bod kun gyi 'gyod pa bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gyang sgo bsam mi khyab/ /'dzam gling gsal ba'i nyi ma de ru stor//de nas sku 'bum dpal sprungs gdan sar drangs/ /za ma tog tu sman sna'i mchod pas sbran/ /sde dge la sogs gdung mchod mtha' yas mchod/ /gtsang dbus bod dang bod chen gnas gang zag /ris dang grub ma ba'i rgya yis ma dgag par/ /dgongs rdzogs mched sbyin nam mkha'i mtha' klas so/ /sde dge sku phebs dbon sprul rgyal tshab bskos/ /sprul dbon rim shār bsla ba don rgyas pa dang / /dpal spungs mchod gzhis yul 'brog gang la'ang //mchog dman kun gyi gnod 'gal mi chog par/ /sde dge nyid dang da bye ba med ces pa'i/ /bka' dang bka' shog bka' drin che bar mdzad/ /rjes su sde dge mchod yon thun mongaXgis/ /sku 'bum mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang ni/ /chos rgyal phyag 'dom gsum du bzhed na yang / /las sne ma mgu phyag 'dom phyed gsum bzhengs/ /sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu hril po dang / ring bsrel rnam lnga 'dzam gling rten 3dus kyis/ /phyur bur bkang ba'i mchod rten rin po che/ /bod chen bstan pa bde ba'i dab—la du che/ /skye dgu bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing du che/ /dad ldan 207

dwangs ba 'dren pa'i yul du che/ /grwa slob mos gus 'phel ba'i rgyan du che/ /gar dbang bcu pas rab gnas byin rlabs che/ /mdo khams mchod rten gzhan dang 'gran med che/ /rje des zhal nas gsung chos gang zhe na/ /nyin re la'ang thun bzhi chab gter dang / /sāts+tsha phyag gdab bsnyen bzlas gsol kha gcod/ /bar gseng phyi nang chos khrid smin grol ston/ /rtse gcig ma gtogs g.yeng ba skad cig med/ /bka' 'gyur ljags klog lan ma gsum la'ang / /ljags zhus 'gyur brtsas 'bum sogs yang klog mang / /g.yer 'gyur bzhengs dang bka' bstan gnyis char bzhengs/ /bka' 'gyur yon gyis bslu ba'ang mang tsam yod/ /ljags brtsam bka' 'bum ji ltar bzhugs ce na/ /ka lā tsan+d+ra 'chi med mdzod gzhung dang / /mdzod 'grel cha lag sum rtags snyan dngags kyi/ /'gyur bcos bcas te po dī drug dang ni/ /'chi bslu'i gzhung dang mgon po mngon 'byung bstod//gshed dmar rgyud dang gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog rgyud/ /gsar 'gyur 'phags pa shing kun dkar chag dang / /skar rtsis ra sna ma la myur rtogs 'gyur/ /rje yi myur rtogs gsal byed mdzad pa dang 1/gsal 'gyur sred med bu'i gzungs sgrol mtshan gzungs/ /klu dga'i gzungs dang nag po che'i bstod pa/ /sa tham rgyal po'i sgrol bstod rgya nag 'gyur/ /spen pa'i bstod pa bde mchog bstod pa dang / /nag po che bstod ni na sna bden mo/ /dbyangs mo rta gzungs sdeb sbyor rtsa 'grel dang / /dbyangs can sgra mdo sogs la po ti gcig /phyag chen smon 'grel mi du'i dbang chings dang //208

bstod 'grel dkyil chog mgon po'i bskang bstod dang / /byang chub rdo rje'i dngul gdung dkar chag dang / —'ja' sprul yongs 'dzin khams sprul dpa' bo yi/ /dris lan sogs dang smon lam zhal gdams skor/ /zhabs brtan bla ma'i rnal 'byor skrub spubs skor//mgon po'i spung 'khor skrub thabs sogs pod gcig sde dge'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag pod gcig dang / /rol rdor rnam thar gser 'grur dkar chag dang / /chab gtor bsang tshogs sngags klog tshe ring ljongs/ /'brum bcos brda dag pa ṇi tsaka'i skor//pu sti gcig dang 4ka' brgyud rnam thar gnyis/ /rje btsun rang chu la brjod dang dkar chag bcas/ /rgya rtsis rgya bod sman dang man ngag skor/ khams pa'i snyan 'grel kun khyab sgra 'grel dang 1yongs 'dzin sgra skor zin bris mdzad pa rnams/ /rje 'di'i gsung las skyes phyir gsung 'bum gras/ /pu sti bcu drug bcas kyi phyag rjes dang /dpal sprungs la sogs dgon sde gsar 'debs ni/ /shin tu mang zhing rje 'di'i bu slob ni/ nam mkha'i skar ma tsam du mchis lags sheng / /snying po'i bstan pa gtad pa'i 'gran med gnyis/ /bla slob zung 'brel 'phags chen sprul sku bdun/ /thugs sras bu gsum mchog sprul chen po brgyad/ /zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i mkhas btsun brgyad/ /gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug bzhi/ /lnga rig smra ba lnga dang bstan 'dzin lnga/ /don gyi ye shes thob pa'i sprub chen drug /sga 'dan lho rdza kaḥdapal bla ma dang / /sprul sku che chung bgrangs las 'das pa dang / /gso 209

rig lha bris bshar gzab yi ge'i rigs/ /rje 'di'i bka' drin ma khyab yul 'ga' med/ /dge tshul dge slong gnang grangs khri ru nye/ /rags rtsis 'dus pa'i 'khor ni sum stong dang / /drug brgya lnga bcu rgyal ba'i rjes su bkod/ 1gzhan gyis dag pa'i snang bas 'ja' lus kyang / /chab mdo mgon rjes byams chen rje 'dir mjal/ /'bri gung sprul zung rdo rje gro lod mjal/ /sga rje bla mas tshe dpag med par mjal/ /sde bza' gur mtshos spyan ras gzigs su mjal/ /dpon po wang gis zu bo/na po ber du mjal/ /sman cha 'dzin ngas sman gyi rgyal po mjal/ /rgyud bzhi cha lag bco brgyad lung rnams kun/ /dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas gnang ba rmis/ /zhes pa'o/ / kun bzang rdor 'chang rigs lnga sangs rgyas stong / /rgya bod grub chen pad 'byung karma pa/ /ngo bo dbyer med chos kyi 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/1rig 'dzin chen pos bstod pa phul ba lhar/ /srid pa'i mkha' la 'dren pa'i nyi ma shar/ /ma rig mun sel rnam grol snang ba rgyas//mtha' gnyis g.yang bkag 'khor 'das dbyings gcig pa'i//sangs rgyas lag gtod mkhan de'i rnam spur gyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /mchod pas thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /re ba yongs su 'gongs pa mi bslu'i chos/ /de phyir snying 210

la 'dzin phyir nyung ngur byas/ /de la khungs med sgro btags 'di ru med/ —yod na dam pa rna mas kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /de yi dge/ tshogs bdud rtsi'i char pa yis/ /sa gsum byang chub myu gu rgyas gyur cig /du ga gsum rgyas pa'i sems bur sku gsum gyi/ /ri mo myur du bkra ba'i bkra shis shog /chos dang chos can chos dbyings dag pa'i glong / /phyag rgya chen por gtan srid zin par bsngo/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa mchog gi sprul sku si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar dad pa'i sa bon bskyed pa'i bdud rtsi'i zim char zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni/ las ngan bdag lta bu tshe rabs kyi tshogs ma bsags pas blo rmongs shing blun ches pas/ bslu med bla ma rna mas kyis mdzad tshul nyams mgur zhal gdams rna ma thar zhig nga yang blta ba'i mos brtson bgyis kyang / /dug gsum dug lngas nang nas 'bar/mi dbos pa'i gang zag gi phyogs ris bzang ngan yag rtsog la mno bsam gyis khyad 'phags rnams kyi mdzad spyod rna ma par dag pa rnams kyang yid la mi nges 'dug pas byang chub bar du 'di sna re yid la 'jags na ci ma rung / /gzhan phyi thos pa/nang myong ba spungs rtogs ni til 'bru tsam med par mtha' ba glang mug ges 'chi ba ltar ci byed a tsa ma bsam zhing bla ma yongs kyi dgongs rdzogs/ 'gro drug drin chen yongs kyi sgrib sbyong du dmigs nas sman pa gu ru 'phel gyis 'dzom thog nor bu rtse nas bris pa la kho bos chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi rna ma thar rgyas pa dang bsdus te go bde kha gsal bgyis khul byas so/ /211
ba / /mdo khams gdan sa chen mo dbal spungs zub bstan chos 'khor gleng gi ngo sprod bsdus tsam zhu ba bku shis g.yang 'khyel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

da / /'dir karma bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen mo mdo khams sde dge'i shar dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi lo rgyus ngo sprod rags bsdus tsam zhig bya ba la/ gdan sa'i 'phel 'grib dang / sprul sku khag gi sku phreng rim byon/ spar khang dang rten ga rtsa bo/ bshad skrub kyi bstan pa bskyangs tshul/ tshes dus sgrub mchod/ dgon lag dang sde 'khor pa/ dgon pa'i bca' yig deng gi gnas tshul bcas khag brgyad du dbye nas bstan par bya ba ste/dang po/ gdan sa'i 'phel 'grib kyi skor/dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling ni bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir stod mnga' ris skor gsum1 bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug tu grags pa'i 'bri klung dang /zla klung gnyis gyi bar du tshud pa'i 'bri zla zal mo sgang dang / sngon gling gi dus gling dpon du si dang / bar sde dge rgyal rabs/phyis sde dge rdzong sman shod chus dpal spungs shang zhes pa'i mnga' khongs su gtogs/ gnas de'i khyad par ni thun mong so skye no mas kyi mthun snang du ji lhar grub pa ni/ 'phags yul dang rgya nag gi gzhung las ji ltar gsungs pa'i sa dpyad legs rnyed dka' ba thams cad ma tshang ba med pa dang / sa gzhi spums cad 'jam zhing ngam grogs dang g.yang sa med cing rdo dang tsher ma nyung ba/ mi ma yin gdug pa can dang gcan gzan gtum po'i 'tshe ba med cing 215

khyad par du sbyi la la rngogs mi bsrun pa'i srog chags nye ba'i phyogs su'ang mi gnas pa/ sa gzhi mtho dma' kad stom pa/ gnam gshis kung ha 6nga tsha ba dang grang ba'i gnod pa med pa/ dbyar dgun kun tu skye bo rnams khams dwangs shing rig pa bka ba/ shin tu mdzes pa'i brag ri da /ra dmar sngon po'i phreng ba dang / bzang shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang zhe'u gseng yid du 'ong ba bcas kyis brgyan pa/ ro nus khyad par 'phags pa'i sma na gyi rigs du ma skyes pa/ 'u nga pa phu ma shor mda' ma ral ba/ dwangs shing bsil ba'i 'bab chu'i sgra snyan dag g.ya sa g.yon nas rgyu cong mdu na du 'dus pa/ ri rgyud gangs dang 'brel zhing chu rgyud gca nga por zug pa/ rgyun du skad rigs mi gcig pa'i skye bo dum 'dus shing sde bzhi dge bcu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa phyi ltar bsngags pa 'os pa'i yon tan du ma'i dpal gyis spungs pa/ nang lhar mkhas grub skyes chen du ma'i gdan sa/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan bkra ba/ lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis spungs pa/ gsang ltar o rgyan pad+mas mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga'i nang yon tan thugs kyi gnas de bī ka glu tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi mdun zhol sngon dus rje mar pas bstan pa rgyas pa lung bstan pa'i khyad par 'phags pa'i dpal gyis mngon pa sprungs pa'i gnas khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /de'ang / rgyal po bka' chems las/ bod yul gnas kyi bye brag gsal bar gsungs shing / 'dzam 216

gling gi rgyan gcig kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i tsa ri'i lam yig las/ smad rong btsan kha ba dkar po la thug cing / stod bal po'i yul grub pa'i gnas chen po la thug gi bar dang / lho phyogs kā ma rū pa'i mthar thug gi gnas tshun chad la/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa'i gnas phran stong phrag yod ces tsa ri kho na'i gnas kyi grangs su gsungs pas/ gzhan la'ang rigs mtshon pa na/ gnas mchog 'di kun kyang shin tu tshad mar grub pa yin la/ 'phags pa klu skrub kyi rnam par rol pa skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i thugs sras dpal ldan byang chub gling pa'i zhal nas/ spyir mdo khams sgang 1 ri mtho la sa gtsang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa/ sa gzhi phun sum tshogs pa/ bsod nams bsags pa can rnams kyi 'byung khungs/khyad par 'bri klung dam pa chos phyug gi shar phyogs/ tre ka brag dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi nub phyogs/ ldan glong thang chos kyi sgron ma'i shar phyogs/ byang phu tshur dz+wa lo'i gnas kyi lho phyogs/'or rdu'i byams skyong gi bka' bsgo'i byang phyogs/ bla ma rin po ches rjes su gnang ba'i dgon pa/ rje btsun ma pa'i sha ba ris byin gyis brlabs pa'i ming yig dang po mthun snang du shar ba pa pang dgon/ don gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms pa'i tshogs su gyur pa'i phyir dpa' dpung sgang / mos gus rin po che me tog gi char 'bebs pa'i yul/ sgos dri sna tshogs kyi ngad ldangs ba/ rol 217

so sna tshogs pa'i sgra 'byung ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal te ru ka mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i bla ma dam pa/ dpal chen po dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bas byin gyis brlabs pa/ sngon gyi chos rgyal rigs bsum mgon po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dge bsnyen/rang rtags srog gi snying po phul ba/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dge bsnyen/ rang rtags srog gi snying po phul ba/ slob ga pon chen po pad+mas dbang bskur/ lag tu rdo rje byin/ gsang ba'i mtshan btags/ bstan pa spung ba'i gnyer gtad pa'i dge bsnyen chen po nga 'dra dang / sgo bo rdo rje phur bu dang / gnyan ldang rdo rje blo gros dang / 'khro zil khrom rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa'i gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba/ 'bri gung byang chub gling las byung bas bdag gi ming yang dpal byang chub gling par brjod pa de'i phyir bdag gi dgon pa'i mib yang dpal byang chub gling dngos grub brtan par gzigs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas chal/ bka shis pa'i mdzod/ces bya ba yin no zhes gnas kyi mtshan nyid gsal bar gsungs/de ltar 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi thugs sras dpal ldan byang chub gling pa dpal spungs su 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis btang ba ltar phyag phebs te/ res mtshor gnas pa'i nag phyogs klu ma rung pa phyag mkhar gyis bsnun nas bsgral te mtsho phal cher bskam par mdzad/ de nas bon gyi tha tshig la gnas pa'i btsan dmar rtsad ka pa zhes pa da lta dgon pa'i nub phyogs kyi brag ri la 218

gnas pa de dang / bon po rnga khur/ nga 'dra che brgyad/ spu khyim stag slags/ spa ra/ gdong ra sogs phyogs thams cad kyi gzugs can gzugs med dz+wa mas dam la btags shing deng sang dgon gzhung rdo gcal yod pa de la mtsho zhig yod par klu nag phyogs gnas pa de'ang btul te mtsho chos gos kyis 'gebs par mdzad1 phyag phreng gtor bar mdzad pas shug spos dri zhim can byung ba yin pas deng sang gi bar du'ang phyag phreng sgang zhes grags/sa phyogs thams cad byin gyis brlabs te rdzu 'phrul gyis zhabs rjes stod smad bar gsum bzhag pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ de nas gdan sa'i mthil dpal spungs su mdzad cing de las gyes pa'i brag nag dgon klog pa ga rtsa che'i grwa sde dang / dbu che ri mgul sgom grwa chen mo bcas dgon khag gsum gyi gtsos dge 'dun khri tsho du ma 'dus par grags/ gdan sa de dag dang nye ba'i thang zhig la chos khri brtsigs nas rgyu 'bras kyi chos du ma gsungs/ da lta'ang thang de la chos khri thang zhes zer/ dpal ldan byang chub gling pas thog ma'i dgon pa btab pas dgon ming la byang chub gling zhes brjod par/ khams pa'i ngag rgyun du spe'u byang chub gling dgon yang zer/ dbu che mgul sogs la spong ba po'i khang mal mang po deng yang mthong rgyu yod/ de ltar bshad skrub gnyis kyis 'bri gung bstan pa lo grangs bcu phrag mang por bskyangs/ deng sang dpe thar dgon pa dang lcags ra dgon sogs kyang de dus 'bri gung 219

bka' brgyud yin par gdon mi za'o/ 1rab byung lnga pa'i lcags stag spyi lo1'i⑫0lor 'bri gung gdan sar sa skya'i dpon chen ag len gyis dpung chen drangs nas 'bri gung lha khang mer bsregs/ skya ser khri phrag lhag bsad pas 'bri gung gling log ces pa de byung / de skabs khams dbus kyi 'bri gung dgon sde mang po sa skya la bsgyur/ dgon 'di'i ma lag dang bcas pa de dus sa lugs su bsgyur ro/ /dpal ldan byang chub gling pa ni/ yul khams kyi 'bri rgyud gsang dbang grong mtha' che gnas khang ma khar skya ru yab sna a gro cha ston pa la sa zhes pa rta mgrin la yi dam mdzad pa de dang /yum nyag bro za dge ma thar mo bya lor lhums su zhugs pa'i dus/yi ge drug pa'i sgra drung du nye ba rnams kyis thos kyang yid ma ches pa byung / sku 'khrungs nas zhag bsum song ba na dbul ba'i stabs kyis ma zas btsal du song yang ma rnyed na sprur 'khor ba la/ a ma khyod gar song zer/ khyod la sbyin rgyu'i zas 'tshol ba song yang ma rnyed zer ba la/ khyod kyis ma rnyed pa nga khur la 'gro dang rnyed gsungs pas phyi nangs yum gyis khur nas mkhar ba zhig gi sgor bzhugs su bcug tshe/ mgron su byung la yon bdag tsho/ 'chi ba yin/ 'chi ba yin/ yig drug thon gsungs nas khong rang nas ma ṇi gsungs pas kha cig the tshom du gyur/ 'ga' zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' yin nges zer nas zas mang po phul/ de nas dgung lo bdun bzhes pa nas yab kyis rta mgrin thugs dril 220

gnang / de nas dgung lo bcu gsum pa la sba sgom so po'i slob ma1 gnam mtsho so mo de pa'i grub thob bku shis rin chen pa dbus su byon pa dang 'grogs nas byon pa'i dus mgron tshan thams cad la lam du dge mi dge la sogs rnams khong la 'dri chog pa byung bas/ so mo do pa'i zhal nas 'dis ci gsungs bden par 'dug pas tha mal pa zhig mi 'dug ces gsungs nas khong rang gi rta bskyon nas byo) pas thams cad mgo thon pa 'bri gung mthil du slebs cing / chos rje 'jig rten mgon po dang mjal nas dpon slob thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ chos khrid dang gdams ngag jogs pa gnang zhing / thugs nyams su bzhes pas yun ring ma lon par grub pa brnyes zhing / bla ma bde mchog tu gzigs shing bla mas kyang slob ma phyag rdor du gzigs pa'i lo rgyus mang du yod pa 'dug 'bri gung mthil du nad yams chen po zhig byung ba la 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis sbyin sreg gyis gsung pa ltar sbyin sreg mdzad pas nad yams chad pa byung / skabs shig ti rtser byon nas sprub pa mdzad pa'i tshe rna ma rgyal bum pa la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs zhal gzigs/ las kyi bum pa la brten nas bde mchog gi lha tshogs zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis ga rtsa bo shākya thub pas mdzad nas re res kupa 'khor mi 'dra ba re bstan pa gzigs so/ /de nas bal po'i rgyal pos spyan drangs nas sangs rgyas kyi tshems dang / byang chub shing ras kyi na bza' dang 221

'jig rten pa'i dngos po mang po phul/ de skor byang gi 'phrul gtsug tu dgon par mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mdo smad dbu skyel sogs kyis bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa byung nas 'bri gung mthil gyi gdan sa la gnod kyi dog nas khams su 'byon par bzhed pa'i tshe khams kyi gzhi bdag dbu che brag dkar gyis gdan drangs nas/ khams su 'byon pa'i tshe ri dwags rnams kyis kyang rang rang gnas pa'i sa la rim bzhin du skyel ma byas nas/ 'dor du mdo na yang dmar shi byas pa'i sar bden tshig brjod cing byon pa'i tshe rdo che chung thams cad mchod rten du gyur/ de la da lta'ang rdo mchod nang zer/ de nas mdo khams su pa pang gi dgon pa btab cing / gzhan yang rab sgang dang / li thang / a ldan/'ga' thag mgo rod/ 'ba' thang / rgod lung / dra 'bos pa/ rog mo / 'phel gnye ba rna mas su byon nas/dgon pa mang du btab cing sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba mdzad do/ /slob tshogs kyang mang du byung ste/ khyad par bu chen dpal bzhi ni 'od zer dpal dang / rgyal mtshan dpal gnyis ni dbon rgyud do/ /gzhon nu dpal dang / tsardon dpal gnyis ni grwa rgyud bcas bzhi'o/ /dgung lo zhe bdu na la 'gro don du gshegs pa'i rjes su dbon rgyud rim pa ltar bzhugs pa ni/ 'od zer dpal dang rdo rje dpal/ rin chen rdo rje/ rdo rje rin chen/shākya rdo rje/ dbang phyug rdo rje/ bsod nams rin chen/ rdo rje rin chen sogs mang du byon no/ /bla rgyud kyang shin tu mang 222

zhing khyad par 'od zer nas rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyi bar yin pa snang / tsha ba sgang gi ka na brag kung 'di'i dgon lag yin cing / dgon pa rna mas kyang so sor cheb yod par 'dugaces yig rnying dag las gsal lo/ 1de nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po mnga' ris rab 'byams tshul khrims 'od zer gyis dpal spungs shad na sa bzung nas gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zab rgyas bskor/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dpal sa skya'i bstan pa rgya cher rgyas par mdzad de/ mkhan slob gzi brjid can du ma zhugs stabs mdo khams phyogs kyi sa ngor rna mas dgon 'dir chos zhus pa las sa ngor du chos zhu grwa rgyun 'gro mkhan rgyun chad song pas/ shar dpal spungs la ngor pas mthu mdzad de ngor gyi gtor zor zer ba'i dkan de'i g.yon ri'i brag gru gsum dmar gtor 'dra ba zhig dang / mdun gyi nags tshal dbus mi lngags thang zhes spang ri g.yang bzhi'i dbyibs 'dra ba zhig yod/ de ltar dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa sa skya'i mkhan po dpal ldan lhun grub kyi bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs/ de skor spe'u byang chub gling pa'i bstan pa a ras bshig ces lung bstan yod skad kyis grwa pa tshos srog chags a ra la sdang ba byas kyang / rjes su shing mkhan ab ra zhes pa zhig gi dgon pa mer shor sa dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs brlags song ba red ces bshad srol 221

yod pa tsam ma zad rī sa su zhing rmo dang / sa rko/ rdo slog byas kabs khang pa'i ka ba dang / gdung ma sogs mes tshig 'phro can dang / rgya bzos gyo ban dzir pa ṭa dang 'brug sogs srog chags kyi gzugs can chag dum dang sku 'dra/ mchod chas sogs rnyed rgyu yod pa dang / si tu chos 'byung skabs me dgra'i sri gnon la phur khang bdud dpung zin gnon rten mchod sprub rgyun ma chad pa 'jog par gnang ba sogs kyi lo rgyus gtan tshig gis dkan pa mer shor yod par grub cing / de lhar dgon snga ma de'i shul kyā khang dmar gdung ma zer ba zhig dang / dpa' 'og smyung gnas lha khang zhes pa las med par gyur/ smyung gnas lha khang de ni phyis su mkhan chen zla bzang thes pa des 'a 'bum phrag gzungs ldan gyis bskangs kyi deng sang dbyings su bshig par gyur to/ /de ltar sa 'bri gnyis rkyen 'gas stong du gyur nas1 si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis dgung lo nyer brgyad bzhes pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug spyi lo1ba'i4lor dbu brtsams te dpal spungs thub bstan ches 'khor gling bya ba yongs su grags pa 'di phyag btab1 de'ang si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang a lo bla ma kun mkhyen gnyis dpal spungs su dpal 'byor dgon nas btegs te dgon pa 'debs sa'i sa dpyad gzigs skabs/ da lta'i 'du khang bzhugs pa'i sa der rdo zhig gi thog tu nas bzang po khyor gang tsam yod pa de bye'u zhig gis bsrungs nas 'dug pa mthong bas der 224

dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grig stabs si tu chos 'byung dpon slob gnyis kyis thugs thag bcad/ chos 'byung skabs nas de dpal spungs dgon pa'i rten sgam du yod pa chos 'byung rna ma thar du gsal/ zlaXb gsum pa'i tshes kar sa slong mdza da de sde dge'i gnyer chen chos skyong bkra shis las dpon mdzad nas rmang bting /sde dge rgyal pos 'u lag gnang ste lo gnyis tsam gyis gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang nyer lnga tsam bzhengs grub/ de skabs rje nyid sbyo 'dra rin chin brag tu sku mtshams bcad rgya mdzad/ de nas sa bya'i lo spri lo1blda⑫lor sde dge rgyal po chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring ston 'khor dang bcas pa shar dpal spungs su byon nas dgon pa btab pa'i legs skyes dngos po gya nom pa gnang ba dang chabs cig sde dge'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i phyi 'brog pad+ma'i dpon khag rnams dang / a lo/ se tsha/ dpe war/ lha ru bcas nas btsun khral lnga brgya lhag bkas bcad/ don de ni sngon chos 'byung dgung grangs gnyis la bzhes pa sngon srol ltar dus gsum mkhyen pas rab byung gsum pa'i shing sprel spyi lo11༄4lor phyag btab pa'i karma dgon pas sprul skur gdan 'dren zhus kyang / sde dge'i bla mas nga'i sa char 'khrungs pa'i sprul skru nga rang la dbang gsungs nas karma dgon la ma gnang bas so/ /de nas si tu sku phreng na rim sde dge tshang gi dbu blar gyur la sde dge tshang gi chos 225

srid la dpal spungs si tu sku rabs kyi phan bde'i sbon las rgya cher spel ba dang / lhag don rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag dwags rgyud kyi bstan pa sa phyogs de nas rab tu 'bar ba'i skal bzang byung / de nas si tu pad+ma nyi na byed dang 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mcho rna ma gnyis kyis sprub sde gong 'og gnyis gsar du btsugs pa dang /si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos spyi lo1⑫shā4lor dpal spungs 'du khang chen mo rgya bskye da gnang ba dang / sprub sde 'og ma/ bshad grwa khang / spar khang bcas gsar bzhengs dang zhig gsos mdzad pa/ 'jam mgon kong sprul gnyis pa dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis sprub sde gong ma rgya bskyed gnang zhing / kar rabs lha khang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs mdzad pa sogs 'chad 'gyur lhar ro/gnyis pa/ sprul sku khag gi sku phreng rim byon gyi skor/thog ma si tu'i sku phreng ni sa chen por gnas pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam rol du bzhugs pa dang / 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon chen po ba he ru ka dang slob dpon chen po shrī sing ha dang / slob dpon chen po dā ri ka pa ste mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba mang po'i skur bstan nas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rgya cher spel ba dang / 'gro ba mang po smin grol la brkad pa/ bod yul 'di'ang slob dpon chen po 226

pad+mas rjes su bzung ba'i rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'am gyim shang zhabs zhes gyim shang gi man ngag sogs sngags rtsis rnams gsungs shing dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i sa dpyad kyi rten 'byung bsgrigs par mdzad pa dang / skad gnyis smra ba 'dan ma rtse mang zhes rgyal ba'i bka' rnams thog mar bod kyi skad du bsgyur bar mdzad pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros zhes dpal 1 ro dang mi du'i thugs sras gangs ri'i ljongs su snying po'i bstan pa spel bar mdzad pa dang /rje dwags po'i dbon sgom po tshul khrims snying po dang / karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs sras ras chen bsod nams grags pa dang / grub chen karma sha nye gnas ye shes 'od dang / rang byung zhabs kyi thugs sras grub chen ri mgo pa rat+na bha dra dang /gzhan yang 'gro mgon smar tshang bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag spang mkhan chen dri med 'od zer bla ma dang jo nang pa sgrol ma'i mgon po sogs skyes bu dam pa mang por sprul nas bstan da 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad pa dang / karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i skabs su rgya nag tu tā'i zhing rdzu 'phrul 6na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug spyan 'dren pa po de dang / rgyang rtse chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa dang / rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs skye dgu chos bzhin skyong ba'i khams kyi rgyal phran 227

rna mas kyi skru'i skye phreng rem pa brgyud nas chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa las don rgyud kyi byin rlabs dngos su 'phos pa/ sangs gling dgongs 'dus lung bstan las gsungs pa'i chos kyi spyan can drugapad+ma'i ljags ldan drug ba6 sa 'byung bar lung bstan pa ltar 'og ma'i karma'i dbon rabs ba'i si tu na rim dang si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas nas gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du rgya ba byams pa mgon po'i no ma 'phrul du bstan 'gro'i don du byon pa rna mas kyi no ma tha ra ni gong du ke tshang yab sras kyi rna ma tha ra las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi sku rabs ni thog mar 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas ni/ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ /gang gi lag na ting 'dzin mchog yod pa/ /rgyal ba byams par grags pa mtha' yas bzhin//sems ca na rna mas kyi don mang byed 'gyur zhes/ /blo gros mtha' yas de ni ngas lung bstan/ /ces gsungs pa dang / lang kar gshegs pa las/ /de yi 'og tu byas dus la/ 1'dren pa blo gros zhes bya ba/ /shes bya rna ma lnga ston pa po/ /dpa' bo chen po 'a byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mtshan dang mdzad pa cas sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsal bar lung bstan pa dang / o rgyan ches kyi rgyal pos kyang gter kha gsar rnying du ma nas rdo rje lung gis 228

'khrul med gsal bar bza gas pa ltar/ ston pa'i nye gnas kun dga' bo/ rna ma snang sprul pa'i lo chen be+e ro tsa naXsogs 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub shing rta chen po du ma'i rol par bzhes nas rgyal bstan spel/ de'ang rje 'di nyid la mtshan gzhan 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dang / 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa zhu/ dam pa 'di ni gangs can gyi ljongs su mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i skar tshogs rto bu byung ba'i nang nab / rgyal ba'i lung gis zin cing ris med bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi nor bu'o/ /gsum pa dbon sprul gyi sku rabs ni/ 'di dbon sprul zhes pa si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbon po yin pas so//de'ang si tu chos 'byung la dbon gsum byung ba ste dbon bsam 'phel dang / dbon karma nges legs/ dbon bsam gtan bcas si tu chos 'byung dang 'khrungs yul gcig pa mdo khams sde dge'i char gtogs a lo ding ring sgang du 'khrungs/ dbon gsum po de dag dang skye srid bcas pas spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i grub mtha' yongs rdzogs dang / sgos su bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la bka' drin gzhal med du che zhing / lhag don gso rig thad la brtson zhib gnang ba'i mdzad rjes dang grub 'bras ni dus phyes sus kyang 'gran du red pa lta bu zhig yin/229

dbon bsam 'phel ni/ yang gro lo tsā ba dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi yang srid gter chen rat+na gling pa nyid 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i rna ma rol reg 'dzin glong gsal snying po rang gi zhal bzhes dang mthun par grub brgyud bstan pa'i gas la byed du bsam bzhin skye bar bzhes pa yin/ zhang po kun mkhyen si tu rin po che dang /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan la mnga' dbang 'byor zhing / si tu rin po che'i mdzod pa'i khur bzhed nas sprub brgyud bstan pa'i gsos byed chen por gyur kyang / mi ring ba dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes par sku gshegs/ de'i yang srid dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rje ni/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i sras su sku brtoms te/ kun mkhyen si tu rin po che nas dbon bsam 'phel gyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin si tu dgung lo re dgu bzhes par 'jang nas dpal spungs su gdan drangs/ de nas rje si tuXdang / be+e lo tsā ba tshe dbang kun khyab sogs ris su ma mchi sa pa'i dam pa du mar bsten nas tshul gsum dam pa'i dpal gyis mngon par phyug cing gong sa spums cad mkhyen pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i thugs sras kyi 5ngas mar gyur/ snga phyir 'jam dkar dang sa twa dung phyur re zhal nas gsungs/ dam pa de nyid gyis dmigs su zung nas gso ba rig pa ma sbyangs kyang /rnam dpyod kyi blo gros kyis gso ba rig pa'i gnas phal che ba mkhyen 230

pas sde dge'i ril nag chen mo bsdu spyo ra gnang / dpal spungs snyub khang 'og ma bsam gtan chos khring rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs gsar bzhengs/ dbus gtsang phyogs nas phyag 'byor byung ba'i mnga' ris byang chub 'od kyi thugs dam gyi rten thub pa dam tshig gsum bked dang grong khyer ma sogs kyi rten mang po dang 1'a gas pa klu sprub kyi phyag brkos byang chub kyi shing las byas pa'i rten ga rdol/ gzhan yang zung 'jug brgyud rim ma'i zhal thang sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten mdo khams smad 'dir sus kyang 'gran du med pa gsar bzhengs kyis mtshon bstan dgon 'di nyid dang bka' brgyud spyi la'ang bka' drin che/ de lta ra 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba bla lhag tu spel nas zhib gzhan du gshegs so/ /de'i yang srid o rgyan chen mos lung gis zin pa'i karma sprub brgyud bstan 'dzin 'phrin las ni/ yul dbus lha ldan gzhung sa chen mo dga' ldan pho brang pa'i bka' yi mdun na 'don ra shag dpon tshang gi sras su sku bltams/ dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma saṃ bha was rnam 'dren pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob tu bsngags shing ma las btsun grub pa'i bdag nyid si tu pad+ma nyin byed kyis dbon sprul gong ma dbang gi rdo rje'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhing sing khrir mnga' gsol shis brjod rgya chen bstsal zhing / de nas rje nyid dang / kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa/ mkhan chen zla 231

ba bzang po sogs dam pa du mar bsten nas ma khas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla mar mnga' brnyes/ dpal spungs dbon du blob pa nyan bshad dang 'dul ba'i sde dbyar gnas rgyun 'dzugs gsar bskrun gnang ba sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba 'byams klas/slob tshogs kyang si tu pad+ma kun bzang dang / mchog gyur bde chen gling pa/ gzhan yang dam pa'i tshul dgu'i sgo nas bstan 'gro la sma na pa'i phyag rjes bcas mtha' yas/ de nas dam pa de nyid gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'dan dre thang du bsdus so/ /de'i yang srid dbon sprul rin po che ni/ gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che gtsug lag nyin byed kyi chos dang rigs kyi sras su sku bltams/ karma pa theg mchog rdo rje nas dbon sprul ma/nga ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ sku na phra mo'i skabs dpal spungs gdan sar spyan drangs/ rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa dang / si tu pad+ma kun bzang /byang sems bla ma bka shis 'od zer/ mdo sngags gling pa/ dpa' bo rin po che/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub mang por bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas la gsan sbyangs mdzad/ de nas dbus gnas nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod du phebs te sprub brgyud rin po che'i rtogs pa'i don brgyud skyong zhing gnas pa'i gdan tshab mdzad nas phyis rang dgon dpal spungs su phebs ma grub pa sku gshegs/ des na slad nas yang srid dpal spungs dgon pa'i 232

gdan khrir 'khod ma thub pa snang / de'i yang sbod skyabs rje bsod nams dbang po'am deng sang yang grags su dpe war sprul sku 'chi med rdo rje zhes pa 'di ni/ kaḥthog mkhan po ngag dbang dpal bzang ngam mkhan po ngag dga' rin po che zhes pa de nyid kyis/nged rgan bu la ma 'ongs mngon shes med kyang rmi lam gsal snang du 'chi med rdo rje ni skrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing dbon sprul rin po che'i sprul sku yin snyam shar bas dgongs chub zhu/ zhes pa'i bka' shog cig gnang myong ba dang / de mtshungs kyi lo rgyus dang mthun pa dpal spungs dgon pa'i rdor slob bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas sogs bla rgan dag gi zhal nas gsungs par grags/ dam pa nyid kyis skrub brgyud shing rta che brgyad kyi dbang lung man ngag bcas gsan bsam sgom skrub dang yang khrod kun bzang bde chen gling du sku mtshams bcad rgya yun ring mdzad de spyir byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam gnyis la brta na pa thob pa dang sgos su grub mtha' gang la'ang dag snang dang mos gus kyi rtsal rab tu rgyas pa dang /mdo sngags dang bka' gter gsar rnying gi dbang lung 'di las phyug pa ni deng sang shin tu dkon por gyur bas/ phyis dus 'dir bstan pa'i me ro slar gso skabs bstan pa'i snang byed zla ba tshes pa lta bu 'di nyid do/ 1dbon karma nges legs ni/ de yang mkhas grub kyi snang 211

byed blo ldan yid kyi pad+mo kha phye bar gyur pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta sku skye karma nges legs bstan 'dzin zhes grags/ gong zhus ltar ding ring sgang du mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/ kun mkhyen si tu rin che nas sāts+tsha dgon pa'i bla ma sku skye'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang 1chung ngu nas rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ rje si tu rin po che sogs mkhas grub du mar bsten nas mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya tsho'i mnga' bdag chen mor gyur/ khyad par gso rig sman gyi gnas dang dkar nag rtsis la spyangs pa phul du byung bar gyur te1 spyi lo1bka'i lor rtsis gzhung nyer mkho bum bzang brtsams/ de nas sman slob 'gas lan mang bskur ba ster sman bsdus ye waṃ zhes pa'i pod gnyis brtsams/ da lta gso rigs phyogs kyi brtsam chos bzhugs pa las smad dpyad lag len skor la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang po nges pa rnyed yod pa'i sman gzhung yin pa mdo dbus khams su grags/ 'on kyang rgya mtsho chen po chus ngoms pa med pa ltar mu mthud mkhas dbang yongs 'dzin dam pa ches mang ba bsten pa gnang ste/ mdo sngags gsar rnying shes bya spyi bye brag dang bcas pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ gsung tshogs kyang sdom gsum 'grel pa sogs phyi nang kun gyi mkhas dbang dag gis gsung gi legs bshad du 'dzin cing tshad ma'i yul du 'jog zhal slob 234

rdo rje grags pa dang / rta mgrin mam/na po/ sman slob 'tsho byed tshul khrims 'od gas ma sogs mkhas pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan dpyangs pa mtha' klas de ltar bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis kyi 'phrin las rgyas par spel nas dgung sor bzhi par sku mya ngan las 'das par grags so/ /de yi yang srid nges don bstan 'dzin 'phrin las ni/ mtshan gzhan karma rin chen zhu/ rje 'di spyi lo1440lor sku bltams/ rgyal dbang karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rjes karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin/ rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje dang rdo rje grags pa/ rta mgrin mgon po sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dam pa mang por bsten nas phyi nang rig gnas mtha' dag la dpyis phyin pa'i slob gnyer mdzad/ shes bya ji ltar ji snyed la mkhyen pa'i dpal yon rab tu rgyas shing mdo khams kun tu snyan grags shin tu che bar brten skal ldan gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad 'phrin bzang pos smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ spyi lo 1bar⑫lor sman yig 'chi med nor phreng zhes pa 'di nyid dpal spungs su brtsams/de rjes gces bsdus 'chi med nor phreng gi bu yig tshul du lhan thabs snying gi nor bu zhes bya ba sde tshan bco lngar dbye nas gsang sman sbyor tshad zhal shel 'phyug lhad med pa ngo sbod thog da dung gzhung gi sa bcad du med pa'i ter mab 'ga' zhig dang / gces 235

bsdus 'chi med nor phreng gi lhan thabs snying nor yang zab gnad phran zhes pa phyi rabs don gnyer can gyi ched du shul bzhag mdzad/deng sang gi bar du mdo khams stod smad dang bcas pa'i bob lugs sman pa du mas bed spyod bzhin pa'o/ /de ltar sku tshe'ang mthar phyin cing dpal spungs gdan sar 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba rgya che/slob tshogs kyang rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rje dang mkhyen brtsi'i dbang po sogs mang ngo / /de nas yang srid rim byon ni ba sku skye 'di dag gis suts+tshar bstan 'gro'i rgyun mar 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas dang byed bzhin pa'o/ /dbon bsam gtan ni/ de'ang skyabs rje pad+ma don yod kyis/ /dus gsum nad kun sel mdzad sman gyi lha/ 1rmad byung mthu stobs lcags zam pa/ /bdud rtsi'i mdzod 'dzin g.yu thog mgon/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /zhes sogs tshad thub kyi mkhas grub du mas bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor zhing lung gis legs par zin pa'i rje dbon bsam gten rin po che ni/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon dī dang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po sogs dag pa'i skye ba brgyud mar bzhes pa'i mthar kun mkhyen si tu rin po che dang 'khrungs yul gcig pa a lo ding ring sgang du 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rje si tu rin po che dang 1 'brug yongs 'dzin rin po che/236

khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ be+e lo tshe dbang kun khyab/rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu sogs kyi drung du mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bur gsan bzhes gnang ba dang / sgos su gso rig thad bla ma dam pa khyad du 'phags pa rna mas dang / gtso bo slob dpon kun mkhyen si tu rin po che bsten nas dpal ldan rgyud gzhi gtsor gyur gyi gzhung dang 1 man ngag ga len skor rna mas thugs rgyud gcig 'dres kyi gdams pa'i gnad rna mas ma lus pa bka' drin du bstsal te mkhyen rtogs ma nyam par grags shing g.yu thog pa'i sprul pa la'ang nges/ kun mkhyen si tu rin po che gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba mtha' dag bsgrubs la dgung grangs kyang don bzhi'i bar bzhugs pas dbon rgan rin po cher grags/ slob tshogs kyang rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba sogs bka' brgyud yab sras rna mas dang / lhag par gso dpyad thad da phan lo rgyus thog mthong dkon pa de'u da mar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs mchog lha thog rgyal pos yul 'bud btang ska bas dpal spungs su phyag phebs te dam pa 'di nyid zhabs la btug ste sman rtsis la sbyangs pa mtha' 'khyol ba gnang bar grags/de'i yang srid karma theg mchog bstan 'phel lam nges don bstan 'phel ni/ karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rjes dbon rgan jin po 237

che'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin te dpal spungs gdan sar khrir bkod/snga phyir slob dpon rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rje dang / si tu pad+ma nyin byed sogs dam pa mang por bsten nas mkhas btsun grub pa'i go sa mthon por gshegs/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas la thugs brtse chen pos kang po bam sting sprul sku'i skye srid du kong sprul zhes pa'i mtshan gsol nas khrir bkod pa sogs dpal spungs dgon par 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad rjes rmad du byung / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' na'ang me gling rdor brag dbon pas rtswa sa'i 'khon gyis dpal spungs dgon pa la mngon spyod kyi las byas pa'i rkyen gyis dam pa 'di nyid glo bur du sku gshegs/ sku gdung 'jam mgon rin po ches mchod sdong chen mo nang du gzhugs su gsol nas 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i bsod nams kyi rten du dpal spungs rgyud sde lha khang du bzhengs/ de'i yang srid sa dbang sde dge'i mdun na 'don sngo na tshang gi sras su sku bltams/ chung ngu'i dus nas rdor zhabs rjes 'jog pa dang gzan dang sham thabs nyi zer la 'gel ba/gzhan sems shes pa/ ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur sogs ngang gis gsungs pas grub pa'i skyes mchog tu kun yid ches/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed gyis dbon karma nges don bstan 'phel gyi yang srid du rngas 'dzin nas gong ma rim byon gyi seng khrir mnga' gsol shis 238

brjod rgya chen bstsal/ de nas rje de nyid dang / rgyal dbang treg mchog rdo rje/ mkhyen kong rnam gsum sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas tshul gsum dam pa'i yon rtan gyis mngon par phyug cing skrub rgyud rin po che'i rtogs pa'i don rgyud skyong zhing bla ma bya bral ba'i tshul gyis lho pad+ma bkod sogs su gnas mjal du phyin/ spo bo'i phyogs su klang ma shi'i rā mdud pa dang rgyun du ral grir mdud pa'ang mang po brgyag pa —dang /dpal spungs nas spo bo'i phyogs su phyag nas gtor bas zangs thal du 'gro ba dang dpe war chu srib sa rong zhig tu sgar drel gcig glor bur du shi'i ro gshas nas lha 'drer bka' btad lta bu'i brag la drel khrag gis yi ge bris pa ding sang gi bar sub tu med par gnas pa sogs mdor na 'phags pa'i yul gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug dag dang sgo kun nas mtshungs par gyur/ dgung grangs brgyad cu par zhi bar gshegs pas si tu pad+ma dbang mchog nas gdung rten dang dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/ zhal slob 'jam mgon dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer dang / be+e ri mkhyen brtse sogs so/ /de'i yang srid karma bsam gtan blo gros mchog ni/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog gi sku tsha blo bzang rgyal mtshan su sras spu sde dge'i mdun gnas ra tshang rtsar ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog gis dbon sprul gong ma'i 239

yang srid du ngos 'dzin cing thugs brtse bka' drin chen po sa rjes 'dzin bar mdzad/ yang srid mchog la rje gong ma'i gshis ka dang mdzad spyod ji bzhin mnga' bas kun yid ches shing dad gus tshad med bskyed/ snga phyir rgyal dbang rig pa'i rdo rje dang si tu pad+ma dbang mchog dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros/ gangs dkar sprul sku karma bshad sgrub chos kyi se nga ge bla ma kar lu sogs spob dpon du ma'i zhabs la gtugs shing mdo sngags rig gnas dang ke tshang chos skor gsan bsam mthar phyin mdzad/ dus zings skabs si tu pad+ma don yod dang bcas rgya gar la gnas bcas/ spyi lo1⑫ra4lor ar gling du zhing brjes shing gdung bzhu ba'i skabs mkha' la 'ja' gur phub pa dang thugs ljags spyan gsum ma chig par bzhugs pa sigs ya mtshan gyi rnam pa sna tshogs pas phyi gling pa mang po'ang dam chos la yid ches dang dad pa brtan po'i gnas su 'khod par grags/ de'i skye srid karma blo gros rin chen mchog ni mdo khams gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs dgon pa'i nye 'dabs dpal smad ces pa'i 'brog sde zhig la yab bsod nams dang yum bsam sgron gnyis kyi sras su spyi 1⑫ra⑫lor ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas te 'khrungs/ zhal ma 'byed pa'i skabs su dbyangs gsal gsungs pa dang sku rtsed sogs gyi skabs ḍā dril dkrol ba bcas byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra'i spyod 240

pa la kun gyis nges shes brnyes/ spyi lo1⑫⑫'i lor skyabs rje si tu pad+ma don yod grub pas mdo khams gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du chos 'khor bskor ba'i skabs dbon sprul gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang zhing mtshan karma blo gros rin chen mchog gsol/ de nas dpal spungs dgon du bzhugs su gsol nas ding gi dus su sku yon gsan bzhes kyi sgos dam pa'i skyes bu the tshom bral bar bzhugs/de ltar dbon gsum po dang so so'i yang srid rim byon gyi mdzad rnam sa bcad stong min tsam zhig bkod pa 'di sngon byung yig cha dag tu thar thor las kho bos ma mthong yang / dpal spungs dgon pa'i bla ma sku bgres 'ga'i zhal gsungs 'khrul med dang /phyogs 'dir lhag bsam zol med kyis thugs khur gnang mkhan re zung gis 'tshol sdud byas pa la kho bos dpyad bsdur gzab nan bgyis khul byas kyang / sku skye gnyis kyi mtshan dngos dang / la la'i 'khrungs 'das lo chigs/ yab yum bcas gang yin ma shes lus pa sogs nor 'khrul yod rigs la zhe khrel med pa'i thog yo bsrang legs bcos kyi dgongs 'char gnang skyong yod pa zhu'o/gsum pa/ spar khang dang rte na ga rtsa bo'i skor/gcig dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi sgar khang dam chos bang mdzod ces pa ni si tu pad+ma nyi na byed dbang po'i 241

sku ring du gsar bzhengs mdzad/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos rgya bskyed btang / gang der ston pa thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa 'ga' zhig gi dbang du byas te 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir byon pa'i mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis legs par bkral ba'i 'chos skyobs kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i bstan brtsos dang / gzhan yang rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig gcig pu thun mong rig pa'i gnas dang /skabs 'ga' zhig tu nyer mkho'i tshogs ji snyed dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug karma ke tshang chen po dang / byams mgon ba'i si tu yab sras/ 'jam mgon kong sprul sogs kyi ljags rtsom bcas khyon bsdoms pod chen sum brgya tsam la par shar khri bdun tsam bzhugs pa ste/de'ang dang po gsung 'bum dang phyogs bsgrigs skor la/ karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gsung 'bum pod gsum dang / karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i gsung 'bum pod bcu1 si tu chos 'byung gi gsung 'bum pod bcu bzhi/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed kyi gsung 'bum pod gsum/ 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdzod chen rnam lnga ste/ bka' brgyud sngags mdzod pod gsum/ shes bya mdzod pod gsum/ gdams ngag mdzod pod bcu/ rin chen gter mdzod pod drug cu re gnyis/ rgya chen bka'i mdzod pod 242

bcu bcas so/ /gnyis pa gzhung dang gzhung 'grel gyi skor la/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i tshad ma rig gzhung rgya mtsho pod gnyis dang / karma pa mi skyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung ka pod lnga'i 'grel pa cha tshang pod drug mkhan po gzhan dgas mdzad pa'i gzhub chen bcu bsum gyi mchan 'grel cha tshang / tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum gyi 'grel pa pod gcig li thang nges don gyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa pod gcig dbon karma nges legs kyis mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rgyas pa dang / mdzod 'grel bcas pod gsum1 dgas po bkas rnam pa'i 'od zer skor gsum pod gsum/ nang brtag rgyud gsum pod gsum/ do ha skor gsum pod gcig phyag chen rgya gzhung pod gsum/ phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho pod gcigarin 'byung brgya rtsa pod gcig thugs sgrub zhal gdams pod gcig kā ri ka pod gnyis/ gzhung chen bcu gsum gyi rtsa ba cha tshang ldeb thung can bcas so/ /gsum pa thun rmang rig gnas skor la1 khams sprul snyan 'grel dang / mi pam snyan 'grel/ lhag bsam sum rtags/'chi med nor phreng ma bu/ zin tig bu yig rtsa chu 'grel pa/rtsis kyi lag len nyer mkho bum bzang / sman sbyor bdud rtsi'i 243

thig le bcas so sor pod re'o1 1bzhi pa mdo sde'i skor la/ gser 'od dang / grwa lnga/ za ma tog 'od mdo/ rtogs mdo/ thar mdo/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing mdo/ sprum 'bum/ gser chung / de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mdo/ tshe mdo dang de'i 'grel pa/ bzang spyod dang de'i 'grel pa/ sgrol ma dang de'i 'grel pa/ ltung bshags dang de'i 'grel pa/ nor rgyun ma bcas so/ /lnga pa dkyil 'khor dang sprub spubs skor la/ nag rgyal phag gsum dang / bde dgyes gsang gsum/ zhi pad nyis/sgar bsang chen mo/ chags med a chos bcu gsum/ gcod gzhung / gro lod/ phyag drug pa/ nā ro chos drug chos spyod rgyas bsdus/ sman mchog dkon mchog spri 'dus/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ dus 'khor/ bde chen zhing sgrub/dri med rna ma gnyis/ bzungs dang bklag chog sgrol ma'i bal ga chog smyung gnas bklag chog bcas so/ /drug pa sna tshogs skor la/ brgyad stong dang 1 pad+ma bka'i tha nga / dwags po'i thar rgyan/ mi la'i mgur mtsho/ ri chos zhal gdams1 ngal gso skor gsum— rang grol skor gsum/gcig shes kun grol1 zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor spyo khrid/dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas mdzad pa'i phag mo'i ka ma bshad/244

'jam mgon dpal ldan mkhyen brtsi'i 'od zer gyi rnam spur/ pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i rna ma thar/ stag gzigs nor rdzong /gzhad yang gsol 'debs/ zhal gdams/ chab shog kun bzang 'khor lo— lha par/ thar mdo/ sgrol ma/ stung gshags kyi jo par bcas bsdoms pa'i par shar khri bdun tsam yod kyang /rig gsar zhes pa'i skabs rin chen gter mdzod kyi gtsos par shar khri bzhi tsam gtor brlags song / da yod kyi par shing dkar chag zur du bkad pa'o/ /gnyis/ rten gyi ga rtsa bo ni gser gdung khang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i sku gsung thugs rten che long tsam brjod pa las sku rten la spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i ka brnyan li las grub pa mda' tshad can byin rlabs rmad du byung ba dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi snang brnyan rgyu rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa lus tshad can/ si tu chos 'byung gis phyag bzos rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga dang / bde mchog gsang ba dpal ma ha ma ya1dus 'khor/ kye rdor bcas tsan+dan dkar dmar las grub pa bzo spus shin tu legs pa mda' tshad re can/ gzhan yang rgya li dang bod li bal li sogs li ma'i sku rkang gang nas khru gang lhag tsam yod pa sum brgya la nye ba dang / pad spungs mchod rten dang /byang chub mchod rten sogs nyi shu rtsa grangs bcas byin rlabs che la 245

lo rgyus ring ba'i rten ngo mtshar can bzhugs1 rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bkod pa rgya'i si spung ltar gyi ri mo mtshon mdangs bcad rnams rgya'i lugs dang / kha zang cha lugs sogs rgya bal yul gyi nyams can si tus rang blos gsar du spros nas bris pa'i zhal thang nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / rgyud sde'i zhal thang bcu shas/gnas brtan skya ra ma zhes pa'i gnas brtan gyi zha thang / grub chen brgyad cu/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis bcas tshud yul du sngon chad sman mkhyen bye'u sogs ri mo mkhan gang gis kyang bskrun du med pa mig gi dpyid du gyur pa'i zhal spung si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi phyag bris zhal thang brgya las brgal ba dang sangs rgyas stong sku'i ldebs bris bcas dang / thugs rten la karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje la rgya gar gyi a tsa ras phul ba'i rdo rje gdan gyi blos bslangs dang / kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i thugs dam gyi rten gser dngul las grub pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i blos bslangs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / karma pa byang chub rdo rje'i thugs dam gyi rten rin po che gnyis pa las grub pa'i dus 'khor gyi blos bslangs gyi dkyil 'khor/sman 'jim las grub pa'i mkhyen rkang rnam gnyis kyi gdung rten/si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi gdung rten te bka shis sgo mang /dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten/ rten gan sto la bcas rin chen dang po gnyis las grub pa mu tig gis bstar ba'i thub dbang 246

gi sku dang bang rim rnams su rin chen du mas phra bkod pa ba6sa dang / gsung rten la si tu chos 'byung gi phyag bris mthil shog tu gser gyi zhu mas bris pa'i dbu ldeb rna mas su ston pa'i mdzad pa btsu gnyis kyi ga rtsas pa'i dbu lha rna mas phra ltar bstar ba'i rgyal ba'iXbaka' 'gyur rin po che tshar gcig dang / gzhan bka' bstan par ma dang bka' brgyud gong ma rna mas kyi gsung 'bum sogs skya pod brjod las 'das pa bcas bzhugs so/ /gyen rtse lha khang du bzhugs pa'i rten ga rtsa bo ni gter chen klong gsar snying po'i phyag bzos gu ru'i snang brnyan rje nyid kyis gter nas bton pa'i pad zhwa mnabs la/ phyag tu gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa ngo mtshar can zhig bsnams pa rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa zhig dang / tsa ldan dkar po las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po lo gi shā ra'i snang brnyan ngo mtshar byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha rab tu 'bar ba mda' tshad can/ de'ang dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rjes rtse po ta la nas sngon srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dam gyi rten de gdan drangs pa red ces bshad srol 'dug tsa ldan dmar po las grub pa'i phur pa'i lha tshogs brtsa lnga'i sku stod kal gsum phyag drug can la sku smad phur pa can gru gang re tsam/ mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer dang mkhan gzhan dga' rna ma gnyis kyi sku gdung gser dngul gnyis las bsgrubs pa mthong ba don ldan lus 247

tshad tsam re dang 1 gra sa zhes pa'i bla ma zhig gi sku gdung dngul las grub pa'i byang chub mchod rte na bang sgo'i sāts+tsha las jing bsrel rgyun 'bab byung ba byin ldan nun/ gzhan yang gong gas la rten de dag gi sku rgyab tu dra mig mtho tshad rkang gang las lhag pa'i nang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi snang brnyan rgyu sna tshogs las grub pa brgya phrag las brgal ba sogs dang bka' brgyud kyi rten rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs cing / de nyi da srung zhing bya ra mdzad po ni dam can rdo rje legs par grags so/ /chos 'byung khang du rgya nag li ma las grub pa'i sangs rgyas sman bla mched brgyad dang / sangs rgyas rab bdun/ dpal ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i snang brnyan ye shes dngos bzhugs su yod pa1 gzhan yang skru rgyu sna tshogs las grub pa'i snang brnyan brgya phrag dang 'bri thang yang de bzhin mchis/ gsung rten las rje phag mo gru pa'i phyag dpe dang / karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i phyag dpe mdo mang / sher phyin sogs gser dngul gyis bris pa'i za da du ma dang 1 mtshal dang snag tshas bris pa'i glegs bam gyi ra bas bskor/ /lha gsar khang du phyag mdzod mda' bla tshe ring gis bzhengs pa'i dbon rgan rin po che'i sku gdung dang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i sku gdung bang sgor 'phags pa klu skrub kyis phyag 248

bzos rdo ka ma ru pa las grub pa'i thub pa'i sku khru gang can bzhugs pa dang / si tu pad+ma nyi na byed dbang po'i gdung rten bang sgor sku rgyu li ma las grub pa'i bde mchog gi sku brnya na khru gang can bzhugs pa dang / dpal rgyal dbang karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa nas theg mchog rdo rje'i bar gyi 'dra sku rin po che dad rten bso da mams kyi go skal du bzhugs pa'i nang du bka' brgyud gong ma rna mas kyi dbu lo na za' spyan ljags skye bdun gye sku sha sogs nang bzhugs bsam gyis mi khya pa yod pa thog tshad re bcas bzhugs—'du khang chen mo'i nang bzhugs su gsol ba'i rten gtso bo 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi mchod sdong du skrun pa gser zangs kyi rgyal ba byams pa'i sku/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spud pa thog brtsegs bdun ma dang / mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba gnyis pa slob dpon rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ jo bo sogs gser zangs las grub pa thog tshad re/ dngul las grub pa'i sgrol dkar thog tshad ma/ ris su bris pa'i ldebs ris dang zhal spung bgrong las 'das pa bzhugs so/ /ba byar gnas khang du bzhugs pa'i rten spyo ga rtsa bo ni/ gser zangs las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi snang brnyan thog tshad gcig yod pa dang / rje phag mo gru pa dang / paṇa chen shākya 249

shrī'i 'dra sku rgyu min tu legs pa lus tshad can dang / dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i smra thang skya bris dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi bris thang brgya phrag du ma bzhugs/ gzhan yang sku rgyu sna tshogs las gru pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang — mas yi dam mkha' 'gro'i snang brnyan bcas dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro rtsag glegs bam bcas bzhugs/sprub sde bsam gtan mchog gling du bzhugs su gsol ba'i rten gtso bo ni/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog gis bzhengs pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa dang / mnyam med mar mi dwags gsum gyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i mar mi dwags gsum gyi snang brnyan ring bsrel gyi snying po can thog tshad re tsam dang / sku rgyu li las grub pa dam tshig gsum bkod rab gnas mdzad che thugs kar nas 'od zer 'phro ba can dang / gzhan yang bris thang dang kyil 'khor sogs bsam brjod las 'das pa dang /bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang zab mo nā ro chos drug gi sprub mchod kyi phyag dpe dang / lag len gyi dpe'u ris dang bcas bzhugs/kun rig sprub sder rten gtso bo sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad dang / rdor sems dang / mi 'khrugs pa bcas sku rgyu 250

rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa dang / mkhyen brtse'i gdung rten bcas thog tshad re can dang / de min li ma dang / gser dngul/ zangs sogs rgyu ma nges pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam sogs kyi snang brnyan ji snyed mchis pa —dang 1 sde dge mtshal par gyi bka' bstan dang bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum sogs bzhugs so/ /dus 'khor lha khang du tshe lha rna ma gsum dang / tsa ldan dkar dmar las brgos pa'i bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi dkyil 'khor 'dod lhas bskor ba dang / rdor sems stong sku gser bris/bka' bstan cha gcig snying po so so dung phyur re 'gro nges kyi 'khor chen bcas so/ /gzhan yang 'du khang sgo khang 'gram du lhung bshags 'khor chen dang / yig brgya'i 'khor chen/ ma ṇi'i 'khor chen/ badz+ra'i 'bor chen/ bde mchog 'khor chen bcas mchis so/ /sprub sde gong ma yang khrod kun bzang bde chen gling du bzhugs su gsol ba'i rten gtso bo/ dpal chen lha khang nang rdo rje sems dpa' dang / yang dag bde mchog sogs kyi snang brnyan thog tshad re/ thub dbang dang / o rgyan za ho ma sogs sku che gras lnga/ lhung bshags sogs sku 'bring gras brgya dang bdun1tshe dpag med sogs sku chung gras brgya dang lnga bcas sku rgyu li dang 251

zangs gser zhe cig go/ /mthong grol lha khang du rten ga rtsa bo 'phags ma sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma dang bcas li sku che gras gnyi sa dang / 'bring gras gnyis/ chung gras brgyad/ tsa na dan dkar po'i sangs rgyas rab bdun/ tsan da na dmar po'i nye sras brgyad bcas1 sgrol ma lha khang du sgrol dkar thog tshad dang / gu ru de ba che na po sogs che gras bzhi/ ga nas brtan gtso 'khor sogs 'bring tshad nyer lnga bcas/ gnas bcu lha khang du thub dbang 'bring tshad gnyis dang / tsan na dkar po'i thub dbang gnas brtan ga rtsa 'khor/ gser zangs kyi gnas brtan ga rtsa 'khor/skru thor sna tshogs bcu dgu bcas/ thugs dam lha khang du gter byon sku tshab rna ma gsum bzhu gas khri bcas dang / thugs chen phyag bzhi pa kha che'i li ma dang / bla ma yi dam skor che gras nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / 'bring gras brgya da cu gya drug chung gras brgyad cu bcas so/ /phyi khyams su sgrol dkar gtsor gyur sku 'bring tshad nyer lnga/ mgon khang du mgon po dang gsar rnying ches skyong skor gser sku bcu gcig kar rabs lha khang du kar rabs bcu bzhi'i skru tshad mtho brgyad re bcas gser zangs las grub pa bzhugs/gzhan zhal tha nga skor rgyud sde dang sangs rgyas stong sku gra tshar bcas gser spung so bzhi dang / dgong 'dus zhal tha nga dang bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs zhal tha nga sum brgya tsam dang rin ched 252

gter mdzod sprub dkyil dang tsaka li sogs grangs mang bzhugs/gsung rten skor rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum/ ya bzhi1 mdzod bdun/ bka' brgyad/ bla ma dgong 'dus/ rgyud sde kun btus/ sprub thabs kun btus/mdzod lnga/ bka' rgya sogs skrub rgyud shing rta brgyad kyi gsung chos par ma dang bris ma glegs bam chig stong lhag bzhugs so/ /bzhi pa/ bshad sprub kyi bstan pa bskyangs tshul skor/gcig bshad grwa'i skor la si tu chos 'byung skabs rje nyid dkung lo nga lnga bzhes par shar dpal spungs pa'i gnas lnga rig pa'i slob gling zhes pa btsugs/ rje nyi da kyis bsdus grwa nas bzung /sgra dang / tshad ma/ gzhan yang reg gnas dang mdo srugs kyi bshad pa rgyun chad med pa mdzad pa rnam thar yongs grags dang /rje dbon karma nges legs dang 'ab lo tshe dbang kun khyab gnyis kyis kung bshad pa rgya cher mdzad pa 'brel yod yig cha las kyang gsal ba ste dper na/ karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i ‘sman bsdus e 〉zhes pa'i nang rnam thar mdor bsdus skabs/ sngar chung dus su sman thog mar bslabs pa'i nub mo zhig rmi lam bzang bar gleng ba zhig byung ba dang / sku zhabs spums cad mkhyen gzigs chen po ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bka' drin la brten nas rig pa 'di la phyogs sgor mo nas mthong 253

thos ci rigs kyis 'gro phyogs dkyus ma min tsam ni yod do/ /thes bris 'dug pas gso rig skor si tu rin po che'i drung nas gsan bzhes gnang ba som nyi bral ba dang / rjes su karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyi sman slob sde dge yid lhung 'jam dbyangs sam tshul khrims 'od gsal zhes pas thengs mang nan bskul zhus pa ltar e waṃ〉zhes pa'i pod gnyis rtsom 'bri legs par mdzad ces pa la gzhigs na rje nyid kyis 'chad nyan byas te sman slob bskyangs yod pa'ang gor ma chag yang karma nges don bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rab rgyas gyis mdzad pa'i 'chi meb nor phreng〉gi mjug byang du/deng dus rgyal bstan dri ma med pa nyi da/ /ming gi cha tsam sgra 'dzin rgyan gyur pa/ /de dang mnyam du 'chi med spyor ba yang / /shin tu lhod pa nyams phra'i skabs su gyur/ /'on kyang rgyal noms sras gyur kun mkhyen rje/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i paṇa chen mchog /'dzam gling mkhas gang skye tshogs gtsug gi rgyan/ /'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed dus 'dir gsal /gang gi bka' drin nyi 'od 'bar ba'i gzi/ /mkhas dbang rgya mtsho'i slob tshogs me tog gi/ legs bshad ge sar dri bsung mdzes 'dzin pas/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i go skabs dog por byas/ /zhes gang nyid 'tsho gzhes dus rgyal bstan nyams chag byung ba dang chabs cig sman dpyad kyang nyams rgud du gyur pa'i skabs su 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed 254

kyi thugs rjes slar yang gong 'phel ches cher byung ba dang 'brel brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma mang dag smon zhing / khong tsho'i snyan grags yu la gru kun tu khyab pa zhig byung ba'i nang karma nges don bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rab rgyas ni zhal slob phul tu byung ba'i gras shig yin/ de bas skabs der gso rig dar rgyas byung tshul mtshon/de nas skyabs mgon pad+ma nyin byed dang pad+ma kun bzang skabs mkhan chen zla ba bzang po dang 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi sku tshe'i stod la mkhan chen bka shis 'od zer dang / li thang mkhan po nges don/ yo sgang dbang phyug lhag bsam bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bcas kyis gzhung rig gnas rgyu cher bshad pas gzhi byes kyi mkhas pa mang po byung zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gsung rtsom yang ci rigs spel/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog gi sku dus su sngon sgrub khang bsam gtan chos gling ge rgyab tu yod pa'i bshad grwa dbyar gnas khang du sgos nas gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / bshad grwa'i bca' yig sogs gsar du bkod nas rab byung brtsa lnga pa'i lcags khyi spyi lo 7kyi7༷lor rdzogs chen mkhan po gzhan dga' rin po che gdan drangs nas lo brgyad ring dgon der mkhan por mdzad1de skor bshad grwa der sa dge bka' rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi bshad grwa ba brgya phrag las brgal ba 'dus pa las/ mkhan mkhyen rab dang / zur mang pad rnam/ tshwa tsha thub bstan/ tshe dbang 255

dpal 'byor/ stobs bcu rab rgyas/ mkhan bsod nams/ra hor mkhan po1 li tha nga mkhan po/ gser thar mkhan po/brag ga ba mkhan po/ zur mang mkhan po sogs mkhas btsun mang po byung de dag las rang dgon du mkhan po mdzad myong ba ni gser kha chos grags lo bzhi dang / stobs bcu rab rgyas lo gsum/ dbon stod mkhyen rab lo gsum mo/ gzhan yang mkhas dbang mi pham rna ma rgyal rgya mtsho ched du gdan zhus te sman gyi grwa tshang btsugs nas rgyun ring la sman gzhung 'chad nyan dang lag len bcas mdzad pas/ sman pa ma sa pa mang sdo byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod la/ rang dgon dpal spungs su mkhan po ja ra tshul khrims bzang po dang / sgo ru 'jam dpal/ gro spu tshe dbang rab brta na sogs byung ngo / /bshad grwa ba rna mas kyis kyang thog mar sum rtags dag gsum nas bzung / dge tshul kā ri ka rgyas bsdus dang / sdom gsum/yid bzhin mdzod bcas dang / gzhung chen bcu gsum du grags pa ste 'dul gzhung gnyis dang mngon pa'i gzhung gnyis/ lta ba'i gzhung bzhi/ spyod pa'i gzhung lnga sogs mchan 'grel rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa brtsas slad med pa dang / slob dpon ka ma la shi la'i sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum/ nang rtag rgyud gsum1dwags po thar rgyan sogs gsan sbyong byed srol yod/256

bshad grwa'i sgrig srol ni bshad grwa 'dir bzhugs tshad kyis thog mar bshad grwa dang bla brang la snyan sgron zhus thog dge 'dun la mang ja dang / mkhan chos la mjal dar phu nas gzhug dgos/zhugs rjes dmigs bsal med na lo gcig yan ma song bar dgongs pa zhu mi chog dmigs bsal byung tshe bla brang dang de ga'i mkhan chos bcas las dgongs pa thob dgos/ de min rgyun ja la zhugs nas brla ba sbyong zhe cig sgyu dzad pa las rang bab gu yangs nas drag zhan sus kyang gang mos bya mi chog dgongs pa mi zhu ba sogs byung tshe phyag dang mchod me sogs kyi chad par sbyar/ tshogs brda rdzogs ma thag thams cad da tshogs thub pa dgos shing de las phyi byung na brkya phyag sogs kyi chad pa gang 'tsham spur/ mkhan chos so gas la brtsi med kyis kha lan dang lag lan byed pa dang /tshogs thog dang gleng nang nas 'dzing rtsod rgyag res byed mkhan drag zhan su'i tha da nas byung na ma nga mang ja dang brgya mchod ma phul bar du dar chen la bcings pa'i chad pa sbyar/ nangs dus bshad grwa'i rgyab sgo ma phyes gong dang nub dus rgyab sgo brgyag rjes gling phyi nang du 'grim 'grul bya mi chog gzhan yang gzhi byes su yin rung rgyun du dgon gzhung gi bca' bkod rna mas tshul bzhin bsrung dgos pa dang / mkhan chen dang bslab rgan rna mas kyis zha bkod ji ltar gnang ba dang / mgo 'og lus tshud dang / dpo na zhabs 257

g.yog 'dus kyi lugs ka'i zhe sems bsam pa gcig bsgril gyis bya ba tshul bzhin skrub dgos pa las mi mthun pa'i log spyod/bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren du su'i tha da nas bya mi chog pa yin/ rgyun pa nangs kyi cha stod dang nub kyi cha smad sogs la brtson 'grus kyis slob spyong dang / dgong thun grol ba dang rang shag tu so sos dpe cha skyor ba las gzhan du 'gro ba sogs bya mi chog gzhung tshan rdzogs pa rnams kyi rtsa ba blo rgyugs 'bul dgos la gzhung de'i 'grel pa tshogs bshad kyi rgyugs 'bul dgos so/ /gnyis sgrub grwa'i skor la thog ma yang khrod kun bzang bde chen gling ni rje chos kyi 'byung gnas skabs sprub khang dang sgrub grwa yod kyang / phyis dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rjes sprub sde 'og ma bsam gtan chos gling gsar bzhengs mdzad rjes gong ma bdag med lta bus 'thor zhig song nas khang pa hral rgyal tsam las med par kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho nyin gcig gzigs skor dang lha bsang gtong bar phebs skabs— 'gro lam gsal po med kung sgrub khang 'og ma'i ltag tu phebs pa na bya rgod gcig 'dug pa de gyen du song ba'i rjes snyegs nas byon par ri'i stong kha zhig nas shar du kha gtad 'phur song ba de nas byon te ri khrod yod sa'i sa de gzigs pas de rten 'brel bzang po 'grig de rjes byes grwa re zung gis grogs byas nas sngon gyi khang shul der khang chung mtshon 258

byed tsam bzos/ de skor rje nyid kyi gzim lam du lha khang bag dro zhig tu rgyal dbang bcu bzhiXpa'i sku'i g.yas phyogs su skyes rabasalha bu'i tha nga sku 'ga' zhig bkram zhing / rgyal dbang sku'am thang sku gang gi gsung yin ma 'byed kyang lung bstan pa'i sgra shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ba dang / mchog gyur gling pas yang khro da 'dir lha khang dgos tshul lung bstan pa ltar dpal spungs bla brang nas gzhi bstang / de nas kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho mchog la gang byung gi dngos po thams cad lha khang dang skrub sde'i grwa 'di nyid kyi thebs su btang nas rim par 'du ba bgyis nas rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags sprel spyi lo1ra༄༷lo'i lha babs dus chen gyi tshes bcu la skrub pa gsar du 'jog pa'i dbu tshugs/ thog mar sgrub pa dpon g.yog drug dang mgon bla bcas bdun yod pa rnams la khang pa bdag bzung dang skar 'dzin byas/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis sna sel nas brtsam ste lo gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub nyams len zla re bzhin dus mchod/ nyi na re bzhin du thun bzhi bcas bca' yig bzhin zhib par lag bstar bgyis/ bka' yig kung deng kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du bzhugs/ skyabs rje pad+ma nyin byed kyis yang khrod kyi mtshan kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling zhes gsol/rje 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho'i sku dus su skrub thengs dgu grol bar grags/ sngon rjes yang khrod kyi rdor slob bla ma 'jam mgon 259

nyid dang / hor pad+ma nor bu/ a ti bla ma kar bstan/ bla ma mgo lu/ bla ma nor bu don grub/ ja g.yog bstan 'phel/bla ma rang byung kun khyab bam bla ma kar lu/ bla ma shes rab sogs rim bzhin byung ba las 'gro don phrin las khyad du 'phags pa can ni bla ma kar lu yin te/ de yang rgyal ba'i lung gis zin cing gangs ljongs mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan ris med bstan pa'i snang byed 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi phrin las kyi rnam par rol par mchog gzigs skyes chen du ma sa zhal gyi bzhes pa/ skyabs rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang kar lu rin po che gang nyid bod mdo khams tre shod kyi rwa ba/ yab ra btags dpal bzang sprul sku sku phreng bcu gsum pa sngags 'chang legs bshad sgra dbyangs dang yum sgrol dkar zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo1⑫༷4lor ngo mtshar gyi mtshan ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas kyang sngon sbyangs skyes bu dam pa'i rang rtags 'a—khor ba la nges 'byung / sems can la snying rje/ chos dang bla ma la dad gus sogs lhan skyes su mnga' zhing / yi ge 'bri glog dang / chos kyi go don sogs bstan pa tsam gyis rdogs med du mkhyen pa zhig byung / dgung grangs bcu gsum bzhes — par do khams bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dpal spungs dgon du byams mgon tā yi si tu pad+ma dbang mchog gi mdun rab tu byung 260

zhing mchan karma rang byung kun khyab tu gsol/ dgung grangs bcu drug steng 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi gdan sa tsā 'dra rin chen kug gi sgrub khang chen mor lo gsum phyogs gsum sprub par bzhugs/ skabs der nyams rtogs mthar phyin— skrub dpon bla ma nor bu don 'grub kyi zhal snga kas gsar rnying gi smin grol gdams pa spyi dang khyad par grub chen khyung po'i gser chos rnam pa lnga'i gdams ngag lag len dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du zhus te de dag gi bsnyen sgrub nyams bzhes kyi gnas la dad brtson 3dang nyams rtogs sogs kun gyi phul du byung / sprub khang bzhugs pa'i sngon rjes su 'jam mgon gyi zhal slob mkhas dbang bkra shim chos 'phel dang / si tu pad+ma dbang ma chog mkhyen brtse gzhan phan 'od zer/ dpal ldan mkhyen rtse'i 'od zer/ dpa' bo gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang phyug sāts+tsha sprub brgyud/ rdzogs chen rin po che/ zhe chen rgyal tshab/ zhe chen kong sprul1 mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros sogs ris med kyi skyes chen du ma'i zhal snga kas mdo sngags gsar rnying gi smin grol gdams skor dpag tu med pa gsun bsam sgom sprub mdzad cing tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor longs spyod spums —cad blos btang nas gang byung des chog gis dben pa'i ri sul zhig tu nyams len kho na skyong ba'i thugs 'dun shugs byung du mnga' bas/ dgung grangs nyer lnga'i steng 'khor 261

'bangs nye 'brel longs spyod sogs/ phyi nang gi dngos po mtha' dag spangs te sde dge lha phu sogs rngos med dben pa'i ji khrod rnams su 'tsho ba bya 'tshol tsam gyis dka' spyad snying rus drag pos lo grangs bcu gnyis tsam gyis ring skrub pa zhe cig mdzad/ de rjes si tu pad+ma dbang mchog gi bka' bzhin dpal spungs gdan sa'i nā ro dang ni gu'i sbob sde rgang 'og gnyis kyi skrub dpon bla ma lo mang ring gnangaXste skrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i slob tshogs mang du byung ba las da sta'ang mdo khams dang dbus gtsang phyogs su du ma bzhugs/ dgung grangs bzhi bcu steng lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis kyi gtsos dbus gtsang gi gnas chen khag dang ris med kyi gdan sa rnams la gnas gzigs mchod 'bul du phebs shing /de skabs se ra mkhan rdo rje dang / lha btsun rin po che/ thogs med jin po che/ 'bras spungs rmog ltog rje sogs skyes chen du ma la dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa gtad/ khyegs gnyis dpal gyis brgyan pa'i jo nang rtag brtan phun tshogs gling dang / zhang zhung rdo rje gdan/ lha phu rmog ltog snye thab rmog lhog la sogs pa la jo shangs kyi bstan pa slar gsos shing bstan 'gro'i bya ba rlabs chen mdzad/ de rjes mdo khams phyogs su phebs te dpal spungs dang / hor khog sogs su bzhugs nas gsan bsam sgom sgrub dbang lung 'chad spel sogs 'brel tshad don 262

ldan gyi bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing mo lug spyi lo1⑫(pa5lor mdo khams su dus kyi dgyur bas slar dbus su phebs/ lho ljongs 'brug rgyal mchog gi sras mo a she dbang mo nas sngon smon bag chags bzang po'i mthu dang / rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi snyan pa gsan pas shin tu mos te/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa bcu drug pa chen po mchog dang / 'byug yul du phebs te der lo mang ring bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum dang / ke tshang dang shangs chos kyi sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs/ mchod rten gsar bzhengs sogs phyogs de'i bdul bya'i skye bo rnams thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bku bar mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me rta spyi lo1lu༄༄lor rdor gling bsod nams dar bsam 'grub dar rgyas gling du thog ma'i lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi sgrub sde gsar pa 'dzugs gnang / de rjes rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu glang spyi lo1⑫ba'i lor rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen po'i bka' bzhin/ rum bteg gdan sar bka' brgyud bstan pa'i snang byed skyabs mgon si tu rin po che dang / 'jam mgon rin po che/zhwa dmar rin po che/ rgyal tshab rin po che bcas rnam pa bzhi la bka' bzhin brgyud srol las byung ba'i skrub brgyud karma ka tshang gi thabs lam nā ro chos drug dab grol lam phyag rgya chen po/ shangs pa'i gser cho sa rnam lnga sogs chos skor yongs rdzogs bum pa gang 263

byo'i bka' dgos bzhin/ rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang / rgyud grwa stod smad kyi mkhan bla so gas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma la shangs pa'i gser chos rnam lnga dang / mgon dkar bcu gsum/ gter gsar phur pa sogs kyi dbang lung gnang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags phag spyi lo 1⑫41lo nas rab byung bcu bdu na pa'i sa mo sbrul spyi lo1⑫ra⑫lo'i bar a me ri ka dang / khe na rnga ḍa/ yu rob rgyal khab khag lho shar ye sha ya'i rgyal khab khag sogs 'dzam gling yul gru ches ma nga por lan grangs du ma phebs te/ gdul bya'i skye bo rnams thog mar mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa nas bzung / dge sdig spang blang rgyu 'bras kyi ga rtsas theg pa che chung gi chos spyi dang / bye brag rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol rjes gnang /lhag par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'i dbang chen lan grangs du ma/gtso bo gdul bya yongs la yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas rjes su bzung ste yul gru de rnams chos tshogs grangs bdun cu lhag tsam dang / sgrub sde grangs nyi shu dang / mchod rten grangs nyi shu skor bcas gsar bzhengs dang dbu khrid gnang zhing / chos tshogs de rnams la chos kyi slob ston mdzad mkhan lo gsum phyogs gsum mthar phyin pa'i zhal slob bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sum cu lhag ched du bsko stsal gnang ba sogs 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs la bka' drin dang chos kyi mdzad rjes shin tu che/ rab byung 264
