bcu drug pa'i chu phag spyi lo1⑫ba'i lor bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras dbus bla sprul dge 'dun dang /rgya bod 'brug 'bras sogs 'dzam gling shar nub kyi dad slob stong phrag brgal ba la rin chen gter mdzod kyi smin grol bka' drin bskyangs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me stag spyi lo1⑫8༄lor 'dzam gling skye bo yongs kyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa gsum gyi dam pa'i chos kyi go don dang nyams len bde blag tu thub pa'i ched thugs bskyed rgya chen po'i sgo nas/ mdo sngags rig gzhung rgyu mtsho'i bcud bsdus bstan brtsas chen po shes bya kun khyab kyi sgra sgyur 'dzam gling kun khyab ces pa'i sgra sgyur tshogs pa zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang ste ris med bod kyi mkhas dbang rnams kyi slob ston dang 'brel/ phyi rgyal gyi lo tsā ba rnams nas da lta sgra sgyur gyi phyag las gnang bzhin pa dang / rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1bar ra lor rgya gar shar phyogs bha ga la'i mnga' khu sī li gu ri/ sā lu sgar zhes skye bo'i tshogs rgyu 'grul gyi lam po cher/ring bsrel rnam lnga'i snying po can mthong grol mchod rten mtho tshad spyi khri brgya skor can gsar bzhengs su gnang / rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sprul spyi lo1⑫ra⑫lo spyi zla'i pa'i nang shes rab gling gdan sar skyabs mgon si tu ren po che dbus sku mchod lhan 'dzom gyis dgu gtor 'chams gzigs dang / dgung gsar 265

dgyes ston zab rgyas gnang / de rjes bzhugs sgar dha ram sa la gong sa skyabs ma bo/na chen po mchog mjal bcar ska bas rje nyid kyi bstan 'gro'i mdzad rjes la skyabs ma gon mchog nas thugs dgyes mnyes chen pos legs gso'i dbugs dbyung gnang / spyi zla'i pa'i tshes15skor rang gdan bsam gtan dar dgon par phebs/ de nas rim pas sku khams cung zad bde min gyi tshul bstan pas nye gnas sku tsha rgyal mtshan 'gas nas thugs 'ban bzod bral gyis lji li'am pha ran si sogs shar nub kyi phyi rgyal gang rung zhig tu sku'i sman bcos la phebs gal che tshul zhus skabs/ da ni gang du phyi na kyang phan dpyad mi 'byung bas 'di gar rang du bsdad pa bzang zhes zhal bzhes ma gnang / de rjes sku khams kyi babs dang sman pa'i ngag bzhin si li gu ri da nar sing hom zhes pa'i sman khang du gdan zhus kyis dun phrag gsum ring sma na bcos gnang bas sku khams ya ra dwangs kyi rnam pa bstan te/ spyi zla5pa'i tshes 5nyi na bsod nams dar dkan par phebs/ slar yang nyi na shas nas sku khams cung zad lci ba'i tshul gyis/ rje nyid dgung grangs brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sbrul spyi lo1⑫ra kyi lo'i zla ba 5pa'i tshes 1༷la gdul bya gzhan don du dgongs pas re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshul bstan te zag med 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su stoms par bzhugs so/ /mdor na rje 266

bla ma 'di nyid sku chung ngu'i dus rnas 'khor ba la nges par 'byung ba'i skyo shas kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ so byang sngags kyi gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ dam pa'i tshul dgu'i sgo nas ris su ma mchis pa'i rgyal bstan spyi dang / bye brag karma bka' brgyud dang shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'chad spel 'dzin skyong thugs bskyed bka' drin rmad du byung bas bod dang bod chen po'i ljongs/ rgya dkar nag 'brug 'bras ljongs/ 'dzam gling shar nub rnams su bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'du na gyi sde/ chos tshogs gsar 'dzugs sogs bstan pa slar spel zhing gdams pa'i srog mthud par mdzad pa la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ rgyud 'dzin gyi slob tshogs kyang bka' brgyud skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab bras dbus ris med kyi bla sprul dge ba'i bshes gnye na bzang la mang ba bzhugs shing / 'dzam gling kun tu skal ldan gyi slob ma skye bo pho mo dpag tu med pa dang / gzhan yang skye 'gro grangs med pa 'brel tshad don ldan thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang la sbyor bar mdzad do/ /de ltar bstan pa dang sems ca na gyi don du thugs bskyed dang smon lam 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin pas rje nyid kyi gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan nas ring po ma lon par/ rgyal dbang karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs grub 267

brnyes kyi skyes chen bzang la mang bar sku 'khrungs pa'i gdung rigs ra btags tshang rje gong ma'i nye gnas dang sku tsha yin pa yab rgyal mtshan lags dang / yum lho ljongs 'brug skur stod pa skal bzang sgrol dkar gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i rmi lam gyi ltas kyi mtshan ma du ma dang bcas bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar bzung ba'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku lhums su bzhugs/ rab byung bcu bdu na pa'i lcags rta spyi lo 1⑫60lo'i zla bar tshes lda⑫nyi na rgya gar rdo rje gling du yum la gnod pa med par mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/de nas rim pa skyabs rje byams mgon mi tu rin po ches 'di nyid skyabs rje kar lu rin po che gong ma'i yang srid mchog gi sprul sku yin pa'i ngos shes mtshan ma gsal por gzigs 'dug cing / 'on kung rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po la bka' brtags/ snyan gseng zhu dgos phebs pas de bzhin skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas kung ye shes pa'i gzigs ngor rje gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral du nges ba'i bka' lung spyi bor phebs don ltar dgung grangs gcig dang zla ba drug bzhes pa'i steng gong ma'i gdan sa rdo rje gling bsod nams dar bsam 'grub dar rgyas chos gling du gza' tshes 'phrod sbyong dge ba'i nyin mkhan slob chos grwa thun mong nas spyang khrus sngon du 'gro 268

bas na bza' dang mtshan gsol zhus te ma sgrol sku gsung thugs rten 'degs 'bul dang 'brel grwa tshang las sne gtsos ser skya yongs nas mjal kha zhus/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu bya spyi lo1kyi⑫re lo zla ba'i tshes lda5nyin/ rdo rje gling bsod nams dar bsam grub dar rgyas chos gling gdan sar gong sa skyabs mgon chen rma mchog chibs sgyur bka' drin bskyangs te yang srid mchog sprul rin po che'i dbu skra gtsug phud 'bul bzhes dang 'brel mtshan gsol thugs smon skyabs 'jug thog ris med dgon sde khag gi bla sprul dge 'dun bcas mnga' gsol khri 'don gyi mdzad sgor bzhugs so/ /sprub sde 'og ma bsam gtan chos gling ni dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rjes gsar bzhengs mdzad/ de nas rgyun mi chad par dar rgyas byung / si tu pad+ma nyin byed skabs nas bzung rdor slob bla ma ni li thang nges don dang / 'jam mgon bla ma bcas sprub thengs kha shas dang / de nas bla rgan don 'grub sprub thengs gnyis/khyung po kar tshul skrub thengs gnyis/ rta mgrin sgrub thengs gnyis/ye shes 'byung gnas snga phyir sgrub thengs bzhi bcas so/ /sgrub sde'i bca' yig sogs zhib cha gdan sa chen po dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gyi skrub sde bsam gtan chos gling gi skrub pa po rnams kyi nyams bzhes ji ltar bgyid pa'i tshul snying bor dril ba don brgyud dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba las shes par bya'o/ /269

skrub dre gong 'og gnyis ka'i skrub pa po'i rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi ni skrub pa la zhugs mab na rna mas la sdom pa gsum yid ches su lngan theng dbyar gnas 3 sdugs te mdo rgyud kyi thos bsam bag re yod dbo/sa za/ khyad par tshe phyi ma dang spur pa byang chub sprub pa'i 'dun pa yod nges las ma brtag pa gang byung gzhag na phog yon chud zos ma gtogs gang yang mi 'byung bas legs par da sprud nas bzhag dgos pa dang / sprub par 'jog pa po la thog mar 'du na pa phyi na cig log tu ma song bas gzhi legs pa/ bar du bsgrub bya'i lta sgom spyod gsum nyams su len pas rang gzha na mgu ba/ mthar bskrubs pa'i 'bus bu chud zos su ma shor bas rang blo bde ba zhig dgod / sgrub pa 'jug la nye ba'i sa thog mar bar chad med cing mthar phyi na pa'i ched du sāts+tsha gzungs ldan dang bskor ba gang mang /dge 'dun spyi la mang ja/ gzhi sde la chos ston drangs/ 'grub tu rung na lam 'phrang bcos/ srog bslu tshe thar/ sbyi na gtong sogs dge ba'i rang dpung bskyed pas 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i gnad dang rten 'brel che/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i thog mar lag len gtsang dag dang tshad ldan gyi chab gtor nyi na ji grub bya/ thog mar dge ba gser gdung khang du sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal nyin gsum/ lha khang khag dang 1 mgon khang rnams su snyan sha mchod 'bul dang 'brel ba'i sprub pa'i bar chad med pa dang sems brgyud chos 270

dang 'brel ba'i smon lam gso la 'debs bya/ de nas zla ba bcu pa'i yar ngo gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i snga dro'i char/ snar bsang rgyas pa btang / phyi dro sgo rtsar cha gsum dang 'byung bzhi btang / mar lu gas rgyud sde'i bsnyen yig las 'byung ba ltar rgyal chen sde bzhi la bskyed bstim rab gnas kyi mtshams tho 'jog spung 'khor bsgom mo1 /skrub khang du thog ma ra mtshams tho bzhag nas bzung tho ma blangs kyi bar ser skya bud med rigs dang drag zhan che chung su'ang mtshams tho nang btsud mi chog pa dang / ja khang du grwa pa btsud na mang ja dang brgya phyag mi skya btsud na snyan shar dang mar me/ ja bag gi chad pa/ bud med btsud na spu mched rnams kyi mdun snyan zhu phul ba'i rgyu lus gnyis kar nyes chad dang / tshabs chen byung ba rnams gnas nas dbyung ba/ sprub pa po rnams kyi grwa shag so sor bye dor dang / maṇ+ḍal/ gtor ma sogs gang 'byor dngos gtsang byas nas rang rang gi rgyud dag cing tshogs rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel bya dbo/sa la/ grwa shag tu sgos me tsam las me bzhag len mi chog cing sgos mes kyang lha khang dang yo byad bsregs pa'i lo rgyus mang bas me la dogs gzab bya dgos/ gter sprub dang tshogs 'khor la chang phran bu ma gtogs chang rag rigs skrub khang nang du khyer mi chog cing / khyer 'thung byed mkhan byung na che ba la dar dang ja bag dang / chung ba la mang ja dang brgya phyag gi chad pa 271

ba cad srol yod pa/ sprub pa po rnams spyir phan tshud thog mar 'jag che ba mi byed cing/ tha mar 'khon pa'i rgyur 'ong / de bas 'khon rgyu bya don med pa/ rdo rje spun mched kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba/phan tshun rtsed mo kha mtshar mi rtse/ rtsed sna byur gyis khrid pa yin zhes dang / phyogs ris chags sdang mi gleng / chos pa'i mtshang rtags ngoms pa 'ong zhes dang / ngan pa'i don la gcig rgyab gcig 'dug mi byed/ grogs ngan gyi byur chags don med la 'khor ba yin zhes dang / thams cad bla ma'i bka' dang dgongs la — brjin dgos/ sgo phyi nang byon bzhugs skabs tha mas cad la gzan chen dang mi 'bral/ tshogs la sham thabs mi gyon pa mi 'gro/phan tshun kha 'thab byas na kha sngon nas phyag brgya dang / lag 'dzing mkhan la phyag lnga bcu 'tshal bcug lag snga ba la ber ka brtsa lnga dang ja bag gi chad pa/ lan zlog mab/ na byung na ber ka cu dngaXja dum gyi chad pa bcas so/ /ngan pa'i rgyab 'tsho mi dpung gra bsdebs/ rdor slob bla mar 'thab 'dzing byed mkhan byung na sku mched la snyan shar phul nas cha da pa bab 'os bcad pa/ tshabs chen byung na sprub grwa nas phud pa/ rdor slob bla ma la kha len slong mkhan dang 1 bkas bkod mi nyan mkhan byung na brgya phyag 'tshal ba sogs ba ca' yig 'os shing 'tshams la zhib phra yod/ skrub pa po rnams lo gsum phyogs gsum dang / bye brag gi nyams len sprub 272

sde gong 'og gnyis kyi khyad par ni na 1 ro dang ni gu'o/ /lo dus dang zla dus kyi skrub mchod dang / sku mchod/ 'don bya 'phar ma/ zhag re bzhin gyi thun bzhi sogs zhib pa so so'i bca' yig gong zhus ltar lag bstar bya'o/ /kun rig sprub sde ni be ri mkhyen brtse'i sku dus su gsar du btsugs/ sprub pa po rnams ni sdub sde gong 'og gnyis gang rung du bzhugs myong ba'i sgrub bla 'ba' zhig yin la/ der lo gcig bzhugs tshe kun jig dang / mi 'khrugs pa/ spe brtsegs/rdor sems bcas bsnyen skrub mdzad pa'o1 /rdor slob bla ma rang da gon gyi dbu chen bsod nams nor bu sogs so/ /lnga pa/ tshes dus sprub mchod skor/bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas tshes bco lnga'i bar dam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub pa'i cho 'phrul dus chen la1 ches bzhi nas bcu bzhi bar bla brang dang bla ma 'gas yon bdag bgyis te smon lam 'tshogs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i dgong mor rje bcun mi la ras pa'i 'don mchod du sgrub brtson bla ma yongs nas mi la'i mgur mcho gsungs/ tshes bco lnga'i tho rengs ras gzan dkar rkyang re mnabs te seng spreng dang bcas te 'du khang bskor/ dge 'dun mang bas zhwa khra dang chos gos bzhes dgos/ de nyin mar pa lo tsā ba'i 'don mchod du phag mo gsungs/ tshes nyer gcig 273

dang nyer bzhi gnyis dpal rgyal dbang karma pa theg mchog rdo rje dang bdud 'dul rdo rje rnam gnyis kyi 'don mchod du rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyin lnga re 'tshogs so/ /bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nas tshes brtsa lnga'i bar rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i chos skor smin gling rdor sems bsgrub mchod nyin bcu 'tshobs/ de skabs phur pa dang / tho gso/ bu gtor ba cas 'don tshogs khag gsum zur du 'tshogs/ tshes nyer lngar si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi 'don mchod du 'du khang chen mor rgyal 'joms nyin lnga dang / gser gdung khang du dus kyi 'khor lo tshogs khag gcig lha sar khang du bstod 'brel bde mchog tshogs khag gcig bcas nyin bdun re chabs cig tu 'tshogs so/ /bod zla gsum pa'i yar ngor sgrol dkar zla ba 'dod 'jo nyin bdun dang / yang dgongs mi 'gyur rnam chos rmed ma badz+ra nyin bdun ba cas 'tshogs/ tshes bco lnga nyin kun rig rgya gzhi rgyas 'debs rgyas pa nyin gcig la phung dung ba nud/ tshes bco brgyad nas brtsams te nyin bdun la zhi khro 'tshogs so/ / bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar ma nyam med shākya thub pa sku 'khrungs pa dang / sangs rgyas pa/ gzhan ngor mya ngan 'das pa ste ston pa'i dus chen la/ tshes bzhi nas brtsams te gsang ba 'dus pa'i bum sprub nyin bcu gnyis 'tshogs/ de'i cha 274

lag ste gzhung gsang tshogs khag gcig dang / ra ta gling tshogs khag gcig ra ta gling tshe sprub tshogs khag gcig rdor sems tshogs khagacig tsā bsgrub tshogs khag gcig chu gtor tho gso1 bcas tshogs khag drug zur du bkar te 'tshob/sa/ tshes bcu drug nas '-i du khang chen mor phag mo nyin bdun dang / lha sar khang rtadu kun rig bskrub mchod nyin bcu gcig bcas chabs cig 'tshogs/ tshes nyer lnga nas kar lugs bde mchog nyin bdun bcas so/ /bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun la si tu pad+ma nyin byed kyi 'don mchod shu 'du khang chen mor dgyes rdor nyin bdun dang / gser gdung lha khang du mā yā nyin bdun/ gsang 'dus nyin bdun bcas tshogs khag gsum chab sa cig tu 'tshogs/ zla ba 'di'i nang bka' brgyud chos spyod rab gsal nyin lnga dang 1 rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsgrub chod nyin bdun/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bskrub mchod nyin bdun bcas 'tshogs dgos pa dang dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi rdul tshon chu gshegs bcas mdzad dgos/ gzhan yang tshe sa bcu bzhi nas tshes brtsa lnga'i bar dbu che mgul sogs su la bstod dang gzhi bdag gso ba sogs mdzad srol lo/ /bod che drug par o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas sku 'khrungs pa'i dus chen dang / bdag cag gi ston pas 275

bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor skor ba'i dus chen la tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sprub mchod gsang 'dus le'u brgyad pa 'tshogs das lo shas mtshams su tshes dgu dang bcu la tshes bcu chen mo'i gar 'cham srol yod/skabs de'i gar 'cham gyi gzigs mor sde dge yab sras dang chab mdo sa dbang khongs gtogs kyi dpon rigs rnams phebs srol yod/ tshes bcu chen mo'i gar 'cham ste gter ston gu ru chos dbang gi gter byon gsang 'dus bla ma'i las byang le'u brgyad pa dang 'brel ba'i tshul ji ltar bgyi ba'i rim pa rnams mag len ma 'khrul ba mthong rgyun rgyal ba gong ma jim byon gyis gtan 'bebs mdzad pa ltar thog mtha' bar gsum gyi cho ga'i gzhung bgrangs te las mthar rdo rje gar 'cham dang / rgya rol/ rgya seng phyogs sgrig bcas mdzad dgos/ de nas dgon pa'i bca' yig star dbyar gseng grub pa dang / pha yul dang zhing 'brog mi ser khul du 'khor zhag tu phebs mkhan dge 'dun rnams dge bskos kyi mdun nas dgongs 'dzin zhu nas rang rang 'khor zhag tu phebs chogasku mdun pa dang / dbu chos las sne dkor gnyer che khagamagon bskang pa sogs rang rang gi khyim du dmigs bsal can gyis dgongs zhu zhu dgos rigs dge bskos nas dus bkag dgongs 'dzin zhus te phebs chog pa las/ de min gdan sa rang du gzhi 276

bzhugs mdzad rgyu las/ rang gzhan gang byung du phebs mi chogabod zla brgyad par dpal spungs su sngon sa 'bri gnyis brlag shul gyi sri rkyen glog par tshes nyi shu nas bzung dgon nang gi bla brang khag gis ra sna gling pa'i phur pa'i bskrub mchod nyin bcu gnyis 'tshogs shing / tshes nyer dgu la phur pa gdab dang blog pa bor/gnam stong nyin dngos grub len pa'o/ /bod zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis ni bcom ldan 'das lha las babs pa'i dus chen yin la1 tshes bco lnga nyin dgon du rgyun bzhugs kyi bla grwa rnams kyis 'du khang chen mo nas so so'i grwa shag bar dkar tsag byug pa dang / tshes gnyis nas bzung ste rgyun bzhugs bla ma rnams kyis mgon po be+e can gyi spar bu nyin gsum 'tshogs so/ / phad zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung byes grwa rnams dgon du 'dzoms te tshes brgyad nyin dgun bca' bsnams/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin grwa mang gis 'chi bslu tshe dpag med gsungs/ tshes nyi shu nas sgrub ba rtson bla ma yongs kyis yong ge mu 'gyur rdo rje'i gter byung gi gro lod dang / dgun nyi log khar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bdag bskyed bsrangs te tshogs 'khor thog dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i sgo nas nyi ldog gi gtor rgyag la tshad ma dang /dngos gzhi/ gtang rags bcas bsdoms nyin bdun 'tshogs/277

'di skor dus la nges med kyang yas zor nyin bcu gcig 'tshogs dgos/ tshes nyer bdun nyin 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi bsgrub mchod du sgrol ma rnal 'byor dang / dgongs 'dus/ shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga bcas tshogs khag gsum du dbye ste nyin bdun re 'tshogs dgosakabod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes drug ni si tu pad+ma kun bzang gi 'don mchod du rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyin gsum dang / si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i 'don mchod du rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyin bdun 'tshogs/'di bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga la yin yang de skabs phur pa'i sprub mchod skabs yin pas so/ /de nas mchod rdzas dang spyan gzigs dmas shin tu rgyas pa bshams te/ tshes nyer gnyis nas mgon po be+e can dgu gtor chen mo'i bsgrub mchod nyin bcu 'tshogs/ tshes nyer brgyad dang nyer dgu gnyis la dgu gtor chen mo'i gar 'cham/ tshes nyer dgu'i phyi dror dgu gtor gyi gtor rgyag dgos/ de stor yo ga gi bsgrub mchod che shos rnams mdor tsam bstan pa'o/ /gzhan yang zla re'i nyin 'tshogs dgos rigs ni/ tshes brgyad kyi snga dror rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / phyi dror kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung sgrol ma me rgan dang / tshes bcu'i snga dror gsang ba le'u brgyad pa dang / phyi dro la phag mo/ tshes 278

bcu bzhi la tshe dpag med lha dgu1 tshes bco lnga'i snga dror kun ribatshes nyer lnga la 'khor lo bde mchog dang phyag bzhi pa/ tshes nyer brgyad la tshe ring ma dang zhing skyong / tshes nyer dgu la mgon po'i gso bskang dang phag mo'i tshogs1 ches sum bcur mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga dang smon lam rnam lnga cha tshang bcas kyi rgyun tshogs rnams chad lus med pa 'don dgos so/ /zhib cha bca' bkab/ ba sa ba/sab /drag pa/ dgon lag dang sde 'khor gyi skor/dpal spungs dgon pa la grwa tshang shog bzhi ste se tsha a lo gnyis kyi grwa pa la se lo shog dang / phyi 'brog pad+ma ru pa dang 'dzin gshin gnyis kyi grwa pa la phyi 'brog kag dpe war chu nyin srib dang dpe kha dang kaḥthog bcas kyi grwa pa la dpe war shog sman shod dang 'dzing gter lhung dang tsam mdo dang hor po sogs kyi grwa pa la lha ru shog bcas so/ /'dus pa'i sde gang yod mtha' gcig tu ma nges kung mang skabs bdun brgya tsam dang nyung mtha' lnga brgya las mi nyung ba yod ra grags/ dgon lag ni bod rang skyong smongs las chab mdo sa khul dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen las skye dku rang skyong khul dang / pad+ma rdzong / yun nan zhing chen las bde chen 279

bod rigs rang skyong byul dang / li cang sa khul/ si khron zhing chen las dkar ma dzes bod rigs rang sprung khul dang / dzam thang rdzong bcas su gnas la/ dpal spungs rang nas bla bskos gtong sa ni spo bo dgon khag gnyis dang rdo stod smad gnyis kyi dgon khag gsum bcas la bla grwa gsum re dang sgar gzhis bcas dang /'dan dre spung o dar rgyas dgon dang / rna ma rgyal gling / rjang shod/ si mda' ro dbu ma bde chen dgon bcas la bla ma re gtong dgos so/ /sde 'khor du da ni sde dge rang zhabs nas a lo dang / se cha/ hor rab tsam mdo/ 'dzing gter lhung /rna ma rgyal gling / mdor rgyud/ dpe war/ sman shod ba6sa la sku tshab gcig nas gsum bar btang / 'dan dre thang la sku tshab gcig dang gnye ra pa rtag 'dug go/ /'brog khul go che la she dpon dpon g.yog gsum dang / phyi 'brog nor khag gsum la she dpon re/ rta dpon gcig rdza chu kha nor ma la sku tshab gcib dang / ri mda' 'a sku tshab gcig dbon stod la sku tshab gcig bcas btang zhing sku tshab rnams lo gsum re la gtan sdod dang /thog sdud dang she sdud rnams lo re la zla ba drug re bsdad dgos/dgon lag dang sde 'khor pa'i mang nyung ma nges kyas sngon chos khrims sogs kyis gtam bshad skabs/ shar dpal spungs dgon pa ni bka' dgon brgya dang brgyad cu'i brten sa/ sa dgon sto nga dang 280

rtsa gnyis kyi smon sa/ rgya bod hor gsum 'du sa/ rgya nag po'i yul du ja zhing / 'jang khra mo'i mthil du 'bras zhing / byang rdo re mdo ru tshwa zhing / sde dge'i yul gyi gnam sa byed bgos kyi ba dag po/ rdzong khag dgu nas sa bogs dang 'bru khrul dgos pa yin zer srol yod pas sde dang dgon lag mang po yod pa ni gor ma chag 'brel yod yib char dmangs brtsa'i brtsas sprur gong dpal spungs dgon pa la zhing mar 'debs mu'u sum stong lhag dang /phyugs rigs mgo grangs bzhi khri sum stong gcig brgya dang / rtswa ra dang bkag nags spyi le gru bzhi ma khri bzhi dang / 'khor pa dud tshang gcig stong lhag ba cas yod ces dang / gzhan yang lo rer 'bru rigs sna tshogs yong sgo spyi rgya khri lnga bcu lhag dang / de min tshong khe skyed sogs kyi yong sgo rgya che na yod pa/ dper na lo re la ja dod rgyab gcig brgya las mi nyung ba dar rtse mdo nas skyel 'dren byas pa/ sa zhing dang phyugs zog shi med 'bor chen yod la 'bri shi med re la lo rer mar bod rgya bcu re sprod dgos pa dang /zhing las thon babs las 'bru rigs brgya cha drug cu re sprod dgos pa dang / dngul sgo brgya re skye da ba tang ba la lo re la skyed sgor nyer lnga nas sum cu bar sprod dgos zhes bkod pas sde 'khor dud ha cang mang po yod pa mtshon no/ /de star dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi dgon 281

lag dang grwa rgyun yong khungs kyi dgon lag khag gi mtshan tho ni/sngon sde dge'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa la/ a lo dngal 'byor dgon dang / rdzong shod dgon/ chos dbu dgon/ dgon phu dgon/ wam dgon/ ri 'go dgon/ chos nyi da dgon/gur phu dgon/ rtis phu dgon/ gter ston dgon/ tshes skrub dgon/ 'dzi sgar dgon/ rgyu sne dgon/ drung ram dgon/skyabs che dgon/ si mda' dgon/ chos dpal dgon/khyung ngu dgon/ rtse re dgon/ rin chen gling / dmar dris dgon/ rdza stod pad rnying dgon/ dka' phu dgon/ 'dan dre thang dgon/ 'dan rna ma rgyal gling / shug ra dgon/ sāts+tsha dgon/ zog pa bstan 'phel dgon/ bstan 'phel dgon/mgon gzigs ja chu dgon/ rdza smad ri 'gu dgon/ hor ban nu/na dgon ba cas dang / chab mdo dang skye dgu phyogs la/ karma dgon dang — karma lha steng dgon/ smyo kha gnas mdo dgon/lha thog dkar legs dgon/ tsha ba sgrol ma lha khang dgon/ spom bug dgon/ rat+na dgon/ gnas mdo dgon/ gter chen dgon/ 'khro ru dgon/ mdzo rdzi dgon/ kye la dgon/ nyab rlung dgon/ khams pa dgon/ 'bang ga dgon/ bla gro dgon1'bru tshe dgon/ spo bo phu lung dgon/ spo bo stong 'jug dgon/spo bo ga g.yas dgon/ khyung po gru ya ba dgon/ khyung po zhag 282

ga rtsad dgon/ go lcags dgon/ gter ston mchog gling dgon/smar khams rgya skag dgon/ dil yag dgon/ 'brong gsar dgon/ rab 'byor dgon/ ja pa dgon/ khra 'gu dgon/ 'dam dkar dgon/ nang chen 'ga' 'bang dgon/skyo brag dgon/ dad pa dgon/ ra gad phyag chen dgon/gdam kha gnas mdo dgon/ dge rgyan rje drung dgon/ dge rgyan zu ru dgon/ dge rgyan khru rug dgon/ zur mang bdud rtsi mthil/ zur mang dz+wa ma rgyal rtso/ ri che kong sprul dgon/ khru legs ri khrod/ zhang 'gu dgon/ stong nag bla chen dgon/stong nag bla chung dgon/ dbal me dgod/ bskal bzang dgon/mgon po dgon/ tshes bcu dgon/ byang rta rna dgon/ sge'u sna dgon/ lung dkar dgon/ ben chen dgon/ ri ba stod smad bar gsum la dgon khag gsum/ go che dgon/ g.yang 'khyil dgon/ co brag dgon/ bde mo dgon/ chos gling dgon/tshang gsar dgon/ bkra shis dgon bcas so/ /mi nyag phyogs la/ 'bo gangs dkar dgon/ 'dab spang phug dgon/ nyag chu phag mo dgon/ ke po gan nang dgon/ li thang 'brug rje dgon1 'jang sa spum rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su mi 'gyur dgon dang / gnyan dgon/ khu 'bur dgon lha shis dgon/bkra shis chos 'phel gling / 'og min gling / phun tshogs gling /283

'jang ri sprug po dgon/ shāka thub gling sogs 'jang dgon khag bcu gsum yod par grags/ rgyal rong dang rdo stod sma da la rgyud sde dgon dang g.yu thog dgon ba cas du ma yod/ 'di dag ni bod chen po'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i dgon khag rna mas yin/gzhan 'brug 'bras ljongs dang la dgas/ rgya nag cang zhi zhing chen dang / si khron yā an bcas la mi rigs mi gcig pa'i dgon sde mang po yod pa'ang lo rgyus kyis grub/ de ltar kho bos gang shes su bsdus te bkod kyi/ 'on kya nga ma shes lus pa dang / nor ba/ tha na yig 'bru ma dag pa sogs yod nges la mkhyen spyan yangs pa rnams kyis dag bcos dang kha bskang mdzad rgyu yang yang gsol lo/ /bdun pa/ deng gi gnas tshul skor/krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes rjes dpal spungs dgon ni si khron zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ste spung skyob bya rgyu'i bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig gi gras su bzhagabazhi rgol 'gul skyod ces pa'i skabs 'du khang tshogs chen gyi rten dang brten pa ba cas srid gzhung gis spung skyob gnang ba dang chabs cig dge 'dun pa bcu gnyis sgrig 'dzugs byas nas de dag gis 284

rgyun ldan gyi chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel/ de skabs 'brel yod kyi yig char bltas na dgon du sku 'dra rigs sna tshogs che chung dgu brgya tsam dang / bris spung che chung chig khri la nye ba dang / mdo rgyud gzhung dang bcas pa pod sum khri nyis stong bzhi brgya las bris ma dpe dkon du ma bcas dang / par shing par shar khri bdun lhag dang / gzhan yang dung chen dang / rgya gling / dngul gyi dbu bum/ las bum/ rkang gling / hor sbub dang rgya spub legs cha/ sil snyan che chung sogs gser dngul bcas rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i chos byad sna tshogs/ ka 'phan dang /gnam yol/ bla bres/ phye 'phur/ dgu gtor dang tshes bcu sogs 'cham pa dag gi 'cham chas cha tshang bcas rgya dkar nag gi yul nas byung ba'i gos chen mi nga 'dog mi shes pa du mas byas pa yod ces bkod mod/ rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i skabs gtor gshig tshabs chen phogs nas rtsa med lta bur gyur rung /rab byub bcu drug pa'i sa rta spyi lo7ku4ra lo hor zla 1pa tshes ka'i nyin snyabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzom gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun/ tang krung dbyang gi thugs khur 'og zang zing yo srong byas pa brgyud rim pa khag gi srid gzhung gis mi rigs dang /chos lugs bcas kyi sbod jus don khyol byas te/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya spyi lo1khyar7lor si khron zhing chen mi dmangs srid 285

gzhung gis dpal spungs dgon pas chos sgo phye chog pa'i chog mchan gnang bar brten lo de'i zla ba6pa'i tshes ldan nyin slar yang dgon sgo dngos su phye/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyis chos lugs byed sgo spel ba'i khe dbang la bca' khrims kyis 'gan len byung yod/de nas 'brel yod srid gzhung gis rten gsum gas kyi ra bzhengs byed yas mi dmangs shog sgor khri nyi shu lhag gnang ba dang / dad ldan ser skya dmangs tshogs kyis zhabs 'degs su phul ba bcas la brten chu phag spyi lo1⑫ra re lo zla bkyi pa'i tshes ka la skrub sde 'og ma gsar bzhengs kyi dbu tshugs te phyi lo bod zla1༷pa'i gsar tshes la sprub bla bcu dgu dang rdor slob bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas bcas sprub thengs dang po bzhugs nas deng bar sprub thengs gsum song /shing glang spyi lo1⑫ra5lo'i dbyar tshes la yang khrod sprub khang gsar bzhengs dbu btsugs te rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me yos spyi lo1⑫ra4lo'i ston zla gsar tshes ar las grub ste lo de'i zla ba 1༷pa'i tshes kar sprub pa po nyer gnyis dang rdor slob bla ma karma rnam rgya4bcas sprub thengs dang po bzhugs nas deng skrub thengs gnyis song / /sa sbrul spre lo1⑫ra⑫lo bod zla༄pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin bshad grwa dbu brnyes nas da lta bshad grwa ba lnga bcu dang mkhan po blo chos dang gzhon nu nyi ma gnyis so/ /da bar rten gsum gsar bzhengs byas pa ni ga rtsa khang spug 286

tu byams pa'i snab brnyan zangs gser las grub pa thog brtsegs bzhi lngan rgyab yol rgyan drug bzhugs khri bcas pa dang / de'i g.ya sa su si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i sku gdung mchod rten zangs gser las grub pa dang / g.yon du zangs gser las grub pa'i mnyam med shākya thub pa'i snang brnyan thog tshad bcas bzhugs/tshogs chen 'du khang chen rma'i gdong gral gyi dbus phugs su rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dang dbyer med pa'i tā yi si tu na rim mnga' gsol ba'i zhugs khri mi 'jigs gdong lnga brgyad kyis ba tegs pa'i byin rlabs kyi g.yung drung rab tu brtan pa khri dmar ma zhes bya ba'i g.yas gral du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / g.yon gral du rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo zangs gser las grub pa'i snang brnyan thog tshad ma dang tshogs chen gyi ldebs ris bcas gsar bzhengs/ gyen rtse lha khang du rje btsun mi la ras pa'i 'dra sku nyams can lus tshad can dang / par khang gi lha khang du— 'od dpag med dang / spran ras gzigs/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas gsum thog tshad can/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po lus tshad ma bcas 'dam las gsar bzhengs/ ga kar gdung lha khang du si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sku gdung mchod rten gsar bzhengs la sngon ltar sangs rgyas stong sku'i ldebs jis bzhugs/ yang khrod skrub khang du sku rten te ru ka gsum gyi snang brnyan 'dam las bskrub pa 287

thog tshad re dang / 'jam mgon rin po che sku phreng gsum gyi gdung rten gcig mthong kun 'dus gser dngul bka ma thog tshad bcas gong smos kyi rten gsar bzhengs de dag ni nang bzhugs la byang sems chos 'phags kyi tshems dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'phel gdung / skrub rgyud shing rta che brgyad kyi skyes chen rna mas kyi dbu thod dang / dbu skra/ tshems/ na bza'/ gdu nga rus kyi cha shas sogs ring bsrel rnam bzhis byur bu gtams pa la gzungs bzhugs rab gnas khyad 'bags grub/ gsung rten la rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel/ skrub rgyud shing rta brgyad kyi gsung rab bcas so/ /gzhan yang gnam rgyan dang / 'phan dar/rgyal mtshan/ yon chab mar me ga rtsas mchod pa'i yo byad/ rnga sil snyan/ spub chol/ du nga dkar dmar/ rgya gling / rkang dung bcas rol mo'i jigs/ 'bag 'cham gos/ tshogs pa'i grwa gdan/ gnyer khang dang thab tshang rnams su khro zangs rtib sogs kyis mtshon pa'i nyer mkho rnams mi dman tsam mo/ /'dus pa'i 'khor gong zhus shog bzhi las byung ba'i bla grwa sum brgya tsam dang / sprul sku gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon gsum1mkhan po gnyis/ dbu mdzad che chung bzhi/ chos khrims gcigadage g.yog gsum/ mchod g.yog gsum/ gnyer phyag ba cas las sne so so'i dgos mkho'i mi sna cha tshang tsam 'dug288

de ltar krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes rjes dpal spungs dgon pa mi khron zhing chen gyis zhing chen yongs gyi ga rtsa gnad rig dngos spung skyong sde tshan gras su khyab bsgrogs gnang zin pa ltar gal che'i spung skyob kyi khongs su brtsis nas/ rgyal khab kyis gron dngul 'os 'tshams zhig gnang ste sngon ma'i bkod dbyibs gzhir bzung slar gso byas dang byed bzhin pa rtsa ba'i cha nas legs sgrub zin nyer yod pas/ dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs rnams kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa dang / rgyal khab khag gi yul bskor spro 'cham pa rnams kyi 'dren byed kyi dbang du gyur pa'i po ta la gnyis par gyur cig /brgyad pa/ dgon pa'i bca' yigade'ang dge tshul slong zhig yin phyin gzhis byes gang du 'gro sdod byed kyang 'dul khrims mtha' dag dang / sdom pa gong ma gnyis thob nas de dag gi sdom pa rnams bsrung dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang tha na'ang 'di tsam zhig ma byung na grwa pa'i grangs su mi 'gro bas rgyun gyi spyod lam du zhogs par sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor nas yi dam gang yin gyi mngon rtogs dang bcas pa'i bzlas pa dang chu gtor sogs dang / dgong mor gtor bsngos lus mchod sbyin 289

bsngo ba smon lam sogs chag med dang / rab gzan sham/ 'bring gzan dang 'gag ring / spu na'ang gzan dkris dang gos dmar tsam ni dus kun dka' las skyid sdug ci byung nga 'di ga'i sgrig la zhugs phyin rang yul du song ba yin yang 'bral med bya dgos pa dang / dge btsun gang gis kyang 'phru spong ba'i grwa pa'i zhwa dmar ser gang rung gon dgos rgyu dang / tshogs su bsgrigs lhum yang snga srol gang yod de rigs las ko nag gi stum ba cas dgon dang gzhi byes gang la'ang gyon mi chog bsnyen rdzogs ma bzhugs pa yin yang rtags mi bor ba dang / slob gnyer la rtson pa dang /rab byung gi rtags dang 'gal ba'i tshong khe spogs dang / khyad par dmar tshong dang / mgo skor ba/ 'phrog brtsom/ hor chas/chang 'thung ba/ glu bro sogs skye bo pho mo dang ma nyam du spyod pa dang / khyim pa'i g.yog byed pa sogs rgyal bstan la sma 'bebs shing sbyin bdag gi dad pa log pa'i rkyen byed/ dad rdzas chud gsan tshe 'dir rang nyid ser skya gang gi mi'i khyu nas bud/ phyi ma nga na song gi sa bon du gyur pa'i las kyi rigs mtha' dag spang bya yin la/ khyad par dge sbyor chag med tha na'ang gong gi de tsam ma chag pa ma byas na dge sbyor sor ma chud kyi bar spyi rdzas spong ba'i 'tshams 'os bab byed du bcug rang gi 'tsho cha la dgos pa'i tshwa rgyab bdu na phan gyi tshwa khe sgogs kyi don du lho byang tshong du 'gro ba 290

sogs la mang ja brgya phyag bla ma/ dbu chos gsum la rnam bzhag kang chen gang gi tshe 'bar sogs kyi chad pa gca da /khyad par du dmar tshong byas na bo/nga gi chad pa'i steng du nor lug gang bsad pa'i grangs kyi ja 'phrug re gcad/ gzha na mgo skor ba dang 'phrog bcom byas pa sogs la nyes pa dang bstun pa'i mang ja brgya phyag rnam bzhag sogs ba cad nas 'os 'bab bzhin dngos po sprod len byed du 'jug gos dkar sngo na spyon nas gzan spong ba dang / zhwa ja la sogs gyon nas skye chas kyis 'gro 'dug gang du byas kyang mang ja brgya phyag rnam bzhag ba ca' mtshams gcig hril por skye chas bag med byas na ja 'khor drug gi chad pa gcad/chang dang gru bro sogs skye bo'i nganaXsmras 'phyas dogs kyi rgyu byas na nyes tshabs dang bstun pa'i mang ja brgya phyag rnam bzhag sogs gcad/khyim pa'i g.yog rtswa 'thu ba dang / nas rngod pa/ rmo na rmo ba/'u lag rgyug pa sogs byas na mang ja brgya phyag rnam bzhag gcad/gten gyi ba ca' ba de rnams dgun ba ca' tshogs dus rang rang gi grogs dang ba cas par bla ma dbu chos kyis dri rtsad zhib tu bcad pa'i steng du tshags su tshud par byed/ khyad par sdom pa gsum ga'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba bzhir grags pa'i mi bsad pa dang 1 gser zho lnga yan gyi ri na thang dang ma nyam pa'i dngos po brkus pa dang / bud med spyad pa dang / lha mthong 'dre 291

rig sogs bzang brdzus gzhan mgo skor ba'i mi chos bla ma'i rdzun te bzhi ni shing tā la'i mgo bcad na 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang 1sngon por 'gyur du mi rung bzhin du gsungs pas sdom pa rtsa nas nyams pa yin pas so/ /de rnams kyi steng du rtsa ba bzhi dang phal cher mtshungs pa'i dge 'dun dkrug sel gyi dbyen byed pa bcas/de dag gi khrims yul srol gyi rgyal khrims kung 'dug gshis 'di smos mi dgos na'ang / rgyal khrims la ma thug pa'i bshags pa byed 'dod can/ phyis sdom pa len par 'dod pa byung na gnas gsum mjal nas jo shāka gi bskor ba phyi nang bar gsum gang yin bsags thub na'ang / lo gsum stan thog gcig tu stobs bzhi'i bshags pa byas pa'i mjug tu mang ja dang / rnam bzhag brgya phyag bcas kye gnang ba zhus nas bslab pa skrur bas sor chud rtsis dang / yang lu sa log kyang sems ma log pa'i bla grwa tshang ma la zhu bshags tshad ldan 'dod can byung na/ rten ga rtsa la snyan dar lus tshad dang /tshe 'bar kong chen gang / bla brang la kha btags/ ja 'khor drug bcu'i bab/ grwa tshang la mang ja dang rnam bzhag ja 'khor drug lnga'i bab/ dbu chos la ja 'khor re'i bab bcas zla ba gsum tshun tu rjes gtsang bskrub dgos pa bcas dus nam kun gyi bca' ba yin zhing / dgon du bud med nyi ma ma shar gong dang nyi ma grib nas dgongs pa zhus pa'i sku drag thag ring gi mjal mi lta bur 292

dmigs bsal ma gtogs 'gro sdod bya mi chog cing / gal srid nyi ma ma shar gong da nyi ma grib nas grwa shag tu 'gro sdod byed pa mthong na grwa pas mang ja dang brgya phyag zhag tu bldad na grwa par mi tshangs spyod kyi skyon yod med rtsad bcad la med na mang ja/ rnam bzhag brgya phyag ja 'khor drug gi chad pa sogs gcad/bud med rang bzhin gling gseb nyi ma ma shar gong dang rdub tu 'gro 'dug byas pa mthong mkhan rnams kyis phyir bskrad/ zhag tu 'dug na rgyu mtshan dris la dngos po 'phrog nas phyir bskrad/ chang grwa khang du mi brtsa ba'i khrims sngon nas yod kyang zhol du brtsa bcug pa 'di'ang gzhan ngo mi mdzes pas dgon dang zhol la bla bung gi chang phud/ ri mo'i tshon rtsi'i skyob lta bu mi brtsa ka med ma gtogs chang ba tso mi chog cing / grwa shag tu chang brtsa ba byung na mang ja dang ja bar khag gcig zhol du brtsa bcug na brtsa bcug mi dang 'tshod mkhan gnyis la thun mong la gong ltar gyi chad pa'o/ /spu ma kha dud 'di slob dpon chen pos dus ngan gyi kha zas ngan song gi rgyu gsungs pas gtan nas 'then mi chog cing / gal srid lkog 'then byas pa byung na ja khag gcig gi grwa skal chag bcugamangon mtshan dang ldan par 'then na ja bar khag gnyis chag bcugasna tha'ang bcad thub na rab1 tshogs su gtan nas 'grim mi chogade'i skyon gyis 'don brjod chad bun che ba dang / de tshod kyi nyes 293

pa'i gzhir gyur rngos pas bag yong ci nas kyang gam che'o/ /'thab rtsod gzhan gyis tshor ba byas na brgya phyag gcig nas bzhi'i bar dang / lag 'dzib chung na mang ja dam bzhag brgya phyag ja khag nas 'khor drug gi bar nyes che chung dang len pa yod med zhib bltas lus chad sogs phyi lam khegs pa gcad/brkus pa gser zho lnga phyin chad che chung 'os babaXlha ba'i lag gis 'dzing ba dang 'dra ba'i chad pa gcad/ chos khrims kyis ji ltar 'os pa'i bkod pa la ma nyan pa'i ngan khreb byas na brgya phyag nas mang ja rnam bzhag gi bar nyes dang bstun pa'i chad pa gcad/ kha lan byas na mang ja brgya phyag bla brang la ja khag chos khrims la nas khal gcig gis bshags pa bskrub bcug lag len byas na lus mnar ba dang gnas nas dbyung ba/ dge g.yog bzhi'i 'os pa'i bkod pa byas pa kha la ma nyan na brgya phyag sogs 'os pa'i bab dang / kha len mtshang 'bru sma 'bebs bzhad 'ur ba tshogs dang gling gseb gang la byas kyang mang ja rnam bzhag brgya phyag ja 'khor drug gcig gi chad pa bcad pa'i phyed dge g.yog bzhir ster/chos khrims dang dge g.yog grwa pa nang phan tshun gang la phyogs langs byed na nyes bstun chad pa che nges so sor bcad/ ngan pa'i rgyab she da blo ston gros gcig byas na ngan pa gang yin de dang nyes che chung 'dra ba gcad/294

rgyun tshogs skabs dgongs pa ma zhus pa tshogs la ma 'ong na tshogs thun re la brgya phyag re/ brda rdzogs nas chegs gzhug lus na yun ring thung dang bstun pa'i phyag bcu grangs re phul bcugatshogs chen la brda btang skabs gling stod smad ma/ nges pa dang /tshogs thebs skabs kung tshogs pa'i 'gros dang bstu na las brda ha cang thung ba mi legs pas dge 'du na rnams rgyugs mchong dbos pa deXskyon che ba rnam kun bag yod dgos/ 'tshogs nas dgongs zhu chab ma btang bar langs na brgya phyag gcig phul/ dge slong la sham thabs med na brgya phyag gsum phul/ tshogs su zhugs tshe yang cho ga gang yin gyi dbyangs gdangs phyag rgya rnga rdung dril bsil lha sngags te nga ting nge 'dzin la sems rtse gcig tu gtod de lus drang por gnas pa las 'don pa dkrug pa'i skad mi ma nyam pa brgyag pa dang / mgo gtums/ gtam lab/ gnyi da yur/rang bzhin du sdod pa/ phar tshur lta sogs byed mi chog cing zhogs gung sogs tshogs skabs dge 'dun rnams gzan rlum khyer dang /blo gros 'phel ba'i rten 'brel gyi gang blo ma 'ur 'don dgos/tshogs phyir grol dus dang chab gsang skabs snying rje chen po 'gro ba'i don du 'byung ba'i rten 'brel phreng ba 'dren bzhin ma ṇi 'ur 'don gyis byon pa las gtam lab pa dang / rgyug mchong / lag sprel sogs kyis 'gro mi chog pas de 'dra'i rigs 'gal ba byed pa la 295

chos khrims dang dge dpon g.yog gis bslab bya dmas pa las btang stoms su mi bzhag pa'o/ /tshogs dgos pa'i dus mchod ni tshes brgyad kyi snga dror sgrol ljang maṇ+ḍal dang / phyi dror rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ tshes bcu'i snga dror gsang 'dus le'u brgyad ma dang / phyi dror rdo rje phag mo/ tshes bcu bzhir tshe chog bco lngar kun rig tshes nyer lngar bde mchog dang phya ga bzhi pa/ nyer brgyad la tshe zhing / nyer dgur bkang gso rgyas pa/ gnam stong la mi 'khrugs pa dang sngon gyi 'don srol gang yod kyi chos spyod rab gsal cha tshang 'don dgos pa bcas dang / nya stong gi gso spyong 'di rang re rnams ston pa'i rjes 'jug yin pa'i brda rtags snyigs dus 'dir yang skal ba bzang snyam gyi spro ba bskyed nas tshogs la 'byon pa las dgongs zhu sogs byed pa 'brel mi chags/ nad kyis mnar ba'i rigs ma gtogs rgyun pa zhogs tshogs la rnam rgyal 'joms dang chos spyod 'don res kyis gang 'gro dang / sgrol dkar mngon rtogs dang bcas pa bsnyen pa phreng skor gsum dang zhabs rten gyi rigs/dgong chegs la lhung bshags dang / tshe bzung / sgrol ma/ sher snying / gdugs dkar mngon rtogs dang ldan pa/ cha gsum sogs skabs dang bstun/skrub mchod la chos spyod dang / zhi khro/ phag mo/ rgyal ba 296

rgya mtsho— bde mchog tshes bcu ga nga 'dus/ mi 'khrugs pa/ kun rig lo mjug gi mgon po'i sku rim sogs/ de rnams kyi gdon bya'i rigs thams cad dang / khyad par dkyil chog rnams kyi sta gon sa chog sogs kyi skor dang 'cham sogs kyi skabs gdon bya gang yod dang / gzhan yang rang gzhan gyi rim gro'i don du yig drug dang / sid+dhi/ seng gdong ma bcas kyi mngon rtogs/ rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs kyang blor yod pa'i rgyug 'phrod nges bya ba dang / zhi khro dang / 'bar ma/ sgar bsang chen mo/ dgra chos sogs dpe cha tshang zhing lag len shes pa sogs te de dag skabs ḍa ri la yang zi na tho ltar las gang byung mi rung /dgu tshes kyi gar 'cham dbyangs gdangs 1 rol mo/ kha 'bud rigs sta gon dang thig tshon sogs kyi lag len/ phyag 'grigs/gtor bzo/ bsham bkod/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len/ nang brtag rgyud gsum sogs phyi nang gi slob gnyer bya 'os rnams rang rang gi blo gros la dpags pa'i gang shes byed pa las btang stoms su mi bzhag khyad par du dkyil 'khor gyi skrub mchod dang / rab gnas sbyin sreg ro sreg dang dgu zhag gtor rgyag sogs la bsnyen song ma gtogs slob dpon mi byed / dge 'dun lhag ma'i lhung ba sogs la bag yod dran shes kyis 'dzem par bya zhing /chang 'di nyid nyes pa kun gyi rtsa bar gsungs pas rtsa ba nas btung 297

mi rung la sha yang rab na spang / 'bring rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi'am tha na nya stong tshes brgyad la sgang ba gal che/ phyi dro'i rigs kun rig dang mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe chog dang sgrol ma sogs 'don dgos skangs dkar spyad bag yod gal che/ lar 'dul khrims dang 'gal rigs phran tshegs la'ang ji mi stoms su 'jog par gso sbyong gi skabs su snying thag pa nas bshags par byed dgos1 dgon pa 'dir brten pa spums cad kyis gtor bzo sigs gang 'don ci dran mi byed pa 'di nas bslab pa'i /bangs ldan gyi dpe 'gre dkyus gcig tu dgos pa sogs dgon 'di nang gi rgyun gyi ba ca sgyu sgrig yin zhing / rgyun spyod de rnams kyang 'di dang gtan du bde ba'i rgyu yin snyam pa'i lhag bsam la brten nas bsgrub pa las/ 'jig rten chos kyi skrul blong la brten pa ni shin tu mi mthun pas/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar la slob dgos zhes ngag nas 'byung ba lhar bslab cing spyod lam kun tu lta stangs dang / sdod tshe lus bsrung /chos gos rnam gsum sogs yul la ma grub kyang 'gag ring stod dmar sogs las skya gos phu dung ca na dang pags rigs zhwa phru can sogs mi spyon/ sha chang mi spyod la rang gi nang dang nye bar gtogs pa'i kha la nyan tshad la srog gcod byed mi bcug rang gnas kyi nye logs rngon rgya ci thub dang dkor la chog shes kyis 'tsho ba ngan ngon la brten pa de dag la legs par brtags nas yar dpe 'dren 298

pa'i gnas byu byas nas tshul bzang po la bsgab pa'o/ /khyad par grwa tshang thams cad ma 'dus pa dang 'dus pa phyir log med pa dgun zla 'bring po bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzang po'i bar zhag brgya dang / dbyar zla gsum pa'i yar tshes gcig bzang po nas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bar bca' dus tshes de dag gi gong du lto chas me shing sogs bca' ba'i nang du dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshags su tshud pa byed pa las bca' ba bldams tshar nas shing bsags long ma byung zer ba med cing /tho 'dzugs tshar nas shing 'thu ba sogs dmigs bsal dgongs pa zhus pa ma btogs nang mi phyir mi 'gro/ spru mi nang du mi 'jugadagongs zhus nas khrol nges ma gtogs don che chung ci yin yang tho rtsar mi gtug cing 1 zhogs thun dang po'i bzhengs brda byung ba nas dge slong yin phyin phyag chen gyi khrid rim byung ba'i thun mong dang thun min gyi sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyi skyabs 'gro sogs tshar bdun gsum las mi nyung ba skad gsang bstad nas thun nyul mkhan gyis thos par 'don/ de rjes rang re'i brgyud pa 'di'i bka' phab pa'i yi dam gyi lha sbul sbyin rlabs kyi drod ma yal zhing dbang khrid kyi chu bo ma nyams pa ni nag rgyal phag gsum yin pa ltar rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang phag mo gang rung gi mngon rtogs bsgom bzlas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len sbyor1 gtor brda btang nas thun 299

bsdus te chu gtor gang stogs re btang nas tsha ba bskol zhing tshogs la byon gyi bar du thun dang po'o/ /snga tshogs la byon nas grol ba'i thun bar gung gseng dang / phyi dro'i tshogs bar yang gong mtshungs kyi thun bar dang / dgongs thun bsnams nas sngon gyi bskyed rim 'phro mthud nas zung 'jug gi nyams len skyong ba'am phyag chen zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor la brtson zhing mtha' bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab sogs gang lcogs/ btsun pa rnams nas blo len shar sbyong byed cing mgon thun grol bstun ma mgon gyi gtor bsngo btang /lus mchod sbyin sogs bsngo smon gyis mtha' rgyan/ thun grol brda byung nas da dung dge sbyor 'phro mthud pa dang / de min dal 'byor dang ldan pas nyal ba las mab gsang ma gtogs 'gro 'dug sgo dbye 'dan/ gtam lab gleng / me 'bud pa/ zas za ba sogs mi byed/ yang dmigs bsal rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor sbyong mkhan yin na'ang gsang sgrog dang gzhan la bsam gtan gyi tsher ma song ba dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen skrub grangs dang dus tshad ldan pa bsam mkhan yin na'ang rung gzhung ltar bsnyen grangs ma tshang bar bsags pa dang / btsun pa slob gnyer sbyong mkhan yin na'ang sbyor klog gdangs che chung mi mnyam pa dang mi go ba min pa'i ran pas gzhan la mi gnod par thun hril por lhod med gshar sbyong byed dgos shing / thun mgo dang thun mjug ma 300

gtogs thun gzhung la sku rim byed mkhan dmigs bsal can las rnga rol ḍā dril sogs rang gar don med mi byed/ de dag gi thun bzhi'i thun 'og tshugs nas ma grol bar chos khrims dang thun nyul ba dmigs bsal can ma gtogs su yin yang stan gcig tu 'dug pa las langs 'dug byed mi chog gung dgong gi thun bar me 'bud ltobaskol zas za ba las thun mgo tshugs rjes me rgyun mi bcad pa dang zas za ba bag yangs su sdod pa sogs byed mi chog cing 1 sāts+tsha phyag skor sogs dge las yin yang thun nang mi byed/ byes nas gsar slebs sogs kyi rta nor khyi rnams zhag gsum phan la dgon nang bla brang ma gtogs bzhag mi chog thun bzhir thun nyul ba mi spur ba'i sgo brgyab pa dang skas phab pa sogs byed mi chog cing de las 'gal ba'i bca' ba'i gong du ma slebs na zhag re la nas bre bzhi re/ me shing tshags su ma tshud phyir log nas sprub na mang ja brgya phyag tho phyir dgongs pa ma zhus pa song na nas 'dong gang 1 zhag bsdad na nas bre do/ tho rtsar dgongs pa khrol nges min pa gzhan la gtugs pa dang / gtam 'drin brgya phyag gcig thun nang 'gro 'dug sogs byas na brgya phyag gsum/ bag yangs su bsnad na brgya phyag gcig phyi log khang kha sogs la 'gro 'dug byas na nas bre gang / shing gse ba/ sgo dbye ba sogs sgra gzhan gyis go ba byas pa dang gtam lab na nas 'dong gang / dus min du me 301

'bud pa dang me rgyun mi bcad pa dang / rta nor khye sogs zhag gsum phyin la nyar na zhag re la nas bre gang re/ thun nyul ba mi thar ba'i sgo skas bsdams na nas 'dong gang sogs kyi chad pa bcad/tshes bcu grol nas re zhig pha yul sogs la 'byon dgos pa yod na ci bder gshegs shing gro bzhin zla ba'i ches gcig nas khrums zla ba'i tshes 'go bar ston tshogs la lho 'brog pa rnams ma gtogs par yul grwa rnams 'du nges bya dgos/ snga ma dbyar dgun bca' zhabs 'don pa ma tshar rigs dang / dmigs bsal de gar byung rigs tshogs gal che ba snga srol dus zla ba di'i nang du 'dzom sa nas dgon du bsdad dgos zer ba star zhag re ma 'dzom pa dang /'dzoms yang gzhan du 'gro ba sogs gtan sdod ma byas na zhag bre nyi 'dong gi chad pa yod/ dbyar dgun bca' ba gnyis dang ston tshogs skabs kyi sgrig lam bcas rags pa'o/ /las sne rnams kyi so so'i mdzad pa las chos khrims pas grwa mang rnams la ngo che chung nye ring phyogs lhung med pa'i bstan pa la rgya'i don la bca' khrims che phra skor 'di do na rgyun par stod med kyi lha khang gtsos grwa khang rnams tshags bkod kyi bslab bya/ gdungs btags chad pa sogs ci 'os tang / dkor skal yang gzhung thub kyi rgyal pham med pa gtad de yon bdag gi gdon bya la ngo che chung gi dbang du ma song ba gsung skul gang drag bla brang gzhung gi 302

phyag gnyer nas kung ches dus kyi mchod pa/ sprub mchod sogs gtong sgo rigs sngar srol bzhin du subs dang bstun ba1'i thabs gang gzab gtsug lag gtsos tshags sri zhu lhod bral/ yon bdag ba mchog dman ngo len dang / mchod thebs yul 'brog gi 'khor dud rnams skyong bran/ shog dpon so sor tshags bkod— de rigs nas kyang 'di phyi thub pa'i gzhung bsam mi ldan pa gal che/ las sne mtho dman bskos bzhag ska sa dus phyis dgongs zhus kyi gsho ngan 'di rigs ga5na nas mi chob lar nyam ba gzhig 'grol ba ni smos ma dbos/dbu mdzad nas sngar gyi gsung rgyun mthong ba brgyud pa rigs nyams med 'gan khur las/ rang bzo dang gzhan phyogs khungs med kyis bslad pa'i rjes 'brangs sogs byung rgyal spyod pa nam yang mi chog gar 'cham dbyangs rol tshogs 'don sgrig lam gyi gzhung 'tsho rgyun par tshor 'dzin dang / tshes bcu chen mo sne gdong rtse lugs/ tshe reng ma nyi lde'i lugs dang / zhing skyong chog grwa'i lugs/ gzhan phag—mo dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sngags grwa dang /karma gdan sa bar ma/ zur mang lugs kyi zhi khro dang gcod gdangs sogs kha shas ma gtogs 'don chos ka tshang ma 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar rje brgyad pa'i bzhed pa lhar dpal ldan zur ri'i lugs ga rtsar bton yin pa ltar 'og bskul dang dbyangs rol la 303

sogs pa thams cad de bzhin gyi sor gnas 'gyur med las gang tshor gang dran mi byed ci nga dal la 'bol zhing ldir ba sogs kyis sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang zhing tshogs yun yang ha cang mi thung zhing bsnyen sngags sogs grangs 'gro nges chad bun med pa dang / cho ga so so'i sta gon nas rdul tshon gshegs pa'i bar gyi phyag len phyi nang gi gnad rnams rang blos gang dpog btang stoms ma song ba lag len du khel zhing gzhan la slob nus pa dang brtson par byed1mchod g.yog pas gtor mchod kyi rgyu sha chang mar nas mchod phye sogs la gtsang sbra dang ldan par gtor mchod du 'gro nges las/lhag ma 'phri ba'i za 'dod dang gtsang thro med pa dang phyag len mthong rgyun ltar gyi bcas bsham gso bran sogs tshul bzhin byed pa las sla chos chog bsam pa/ mkhas khyad sogs byas na 'os bab kyi chad pa yod/ rtsis sprod len gyi skabs dbon sprul rtser bzhugs dang / mchod gnyer sogs bsam yod rnams dang mchod g.yog gsar rnying nas zhib bltas/ rgyun par rten gsum dang gtan bzhag gi mchod rdzas sogs la gtsang sbra dang bca' kha gang 'thagamachod me yon chab ma chag pa dang byi dor legs pa sogs dgos shing / rtsis sprod kyi dngos po ma tshang ba dang skyon byung na tshab sprad dgos/ tshogs kyi rnga brda snga nas rang lugs kyi srol la yod pa ltar so so'i spun 'dren gyi rol mo dang mthun dgos pas/304

bskang gso 'i rnga brda la 'ur brdung dang thog mar shin tu dal ma rim par brel ba'i rnga sil yun ring po'i mthar sum rdung dal la 'dzag rjes ma med pas mtshams bcad/ zhing skyong la 'ur rdung nyis 'bebs dang mthar 'dra/ lha bsang mthib rdung nyis 'bebs mthar gong bzhin du byas te mchod gang yin gyis/kha 'bud pa noms las du dkar pas thog mar dkon mchog gsum la phyag gsum 'tshal nas zhwa gos dang ba cas te dung brda gsum btang nas smon thung tshar gcig dang zla med ma 'don/de nas dung chen kun 'jog mthong brgyud ltar lan gsum 'bud cing snga phyi dang skad mi 'grig pa med par byed dgos/ rag dung pa noms kyis kyang bskang gso'i spyan sogs so so la so so'i 'bud tshul nges pa dang / 'dor rgyang ) sogs la dngor 'dzer skad 'khyar med par 'jam snyan 'grigs pa zhig gal che bas lo ltar gyi tshes bcu'i rgya rol skor dang / dgu chen skabs bkra shis dgu brtsegs 'bud pa'i rgya gling dang bcas gang mos byung rgyal du ma song bar slob dpon gyis nan tan grub ma thub bar bslab cing so so nas sbyangs pa'i grwa sa thub nges dgos rgyu yin/ rkang gling pa rna mas kyis kyang bskang gso la sogs 'os bab gang yod kyi 'bud lugs la spyangs nas legs par shes pa'i tshe/ rna ma sras/ spugs bdag sogs de rigs dang 1 gzhi bdag dkar gtor/ bstod 305

pa/ rjes chog sogs ma yin pa'i 'bud dgos rna mas su 'grig gcib/ legs pa shes dgos/dge g.yog bzhi nas gong du gsal ba'i ba ca' khrims 'di dag dang gzhan yang mi 'os pa'i rigs su gyur tshad la bla ma dang chos khrims kyis gsung bkod ci gnang ltar bya ra bsgrim zhing bca' ba'i dus su dgong zhogs nyul nas thun mtshams su'ang tho rtsar 'grim gtug gtam lab gzan med pa/ khyad par dgong thun grol nas 'gro 'dug byed pa sogs nyul zhing bya ra dang ang nyan byed pa sogs ma chags par bya dgos/ tshogs pa yod phyi na rgyun par gral yangs dogs bsgrigs pa dang tshogs su mgo gtum gnyid yur/ gtam lab/'phya bag rang gar 'dug pa/ 'dug tshul dang 'don pa phyag rgya sogs mi 'grig pa rna mas lta rtogs byed nas 'phral du chos tshogs gros dus dang / ja 'dren pa sogs kyis sgo 'gag tu rtsed mo ku rtsa 'a spub rtsod sogs byed mi 'jug cing byas na 'phral du rjes non byed/ ba ca' mtshams su'ang ba/ ga med du mi bor bar lta rtog ba ca' ba'i dus dang khyadaXmed byed/ dgong zhogs su bud med e 'dug lta ba dang / dus rgyun zla re zla phyed ma chag par cha shor byed pa sogs mdor na dgon pa'i bsgrig dam lhod tshul dang mthun mi mthun dge dpon g.yog la rag lus pas brje mtshams su chad pa gcad 'os kyi rigs rna mas btang stoms su zhag pa dang 1306

chos khrims la gsang ba sigs byas rigs bca' khrims tshul bzhin las ngo che chung phyogs cha nye ring byas pa dri'i dag pa byas nas brje len skabs tshogs gsham du dag pa phul ba las dag thon ma byas na 'os bab kyi chad pa 'phral du bcad dgos/ma byin gyis lhag bsam bzang ngo sa gtsang sbra dang / me 'bud pa/ gsol ja phyar sogs bzang zhim ci thon dang / mtshams pa/ nad pa/ 'khor 'then/ shing pa sogs dang bla brang las ka'i skabs skal ba dgos rigs ma gtogs par ja thug 'thor zag tu ma song ba dang / dmyal rgyu'i sdig pa mi zad pa yin pas ja mar 'phri ba sogs gtan nas mi rung / thab chas sogs kyang bor gtor ma song ba'i bca' kha dgos shing / de dag dang 'gal na chad pa 'os bab gcad do/ /dge rgan slob dpon du 'os pas rang rang gi slob phrug dang cha bo sogs rang la bcar ba'i rigs gang yin kung / khri rdung bye'u gam da pa sogs mig stos spyod ngan las slog cing sgrig lam mi 'gal zhing blo chos la bsgyur ba'i lag phreng ba dang mi bral ba ma ṇi 'don pa/ rgyab grwa gos dang gzan chas dang mi bral ba 'gro sdod byed 'jug pa sogs bzang po'i bslab bya ci thub bya/ 'bru ded nas slob gnyer ma rdzogs bar pha mas bu tsha lta bu skyong / slob mas kyang pha ma las lhag par bkur shing bslab bya bzang por nyan 'jog 307

nan tan byed pa las slob dpon gyis bzang po'i zhal ta med cing slob mas gus 'dud med pa bya chog rgyu min pa sogs so1 /mdor na sdom pa gsum las ji ltar byung ba'i spang blang gi tshul la khyam skyur ji mi snyam du mi 'jog par bsam pa yar ldan gyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bskrub ci nus la 'bad par bya zhing / de'ang skrub brgyud mchog gi ring lugs dri med mi nyams gong 'phel gyi ched dang / rang nyid bstan pa la zhugs pa'i dgos pa 'di phyi'i bde ba bsgrub pa'i don yin pas/ lhag bsam bzang pos mchod thob rtsa ba spyi las dgos gus khur thang sogs la bya mig gyen star/ phya ba gru 'gyogs bya bar gal che/ de lhar na bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dang rang rang gi 'phral yun gyi legs pa mtham dag mi nub gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar si tu chos 'byung gi bca' yig chen mo la si tu pad+ma nyin byed kyis cung zad zhal gsal go bde bkod pa las so// //308

mjug byang / ke tshang yab sras dang dpal spungs dgon pa〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di brjod bya'i dbang du byas na ke tshang yab sras rim byon gyi rna ma thar dang / mdo khams gdan sa chen mo shar dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi lo rgyus rags bsdus bcas yin pa la/ dang po/ ke tshang yab sras kyi rnam thar dngas gsal shel gyi me long 〉ni/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i 'gor ke tshang chos brgyud 'dzin pa karma gzhan phan rgya mtsho zhes pas brtsams gnang ba la gzhir bcol te kho bos gang shes kha skong byas pa dang /dpyad bsdur gzab na na gyis dag tu brtsas pa/ sngon byon dam pa mang po'i phyogs ris dgag pa'i gsung thor bu phyungs te bkod pa ba cas/ gnyis pa/ rje btsun bla ma si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar dad pa'i sa bon〉ni/ dus rabs bco brgyad par sde dge rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring gi drung yig 'tsho byed mkhas pa gu ru 'phel zhes pas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung rnam thar la lo tshigs sogs si tu'i bka' 'bum las rnam thar rgyas pa dang go bsdur yang yang byas te kha gsal go bde byas khul bgyis/ gsum 309

pa/ mdo khams gdan sa chen mo dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling 〉ni/ kho bos 'brel yod chos 'byung dang / lo rgyus tshad ldan rnams gzhir bzhag thog dam pa'i rnam thar dang / dgon gnas dang rten gyi dkar chag de bzhin brgal lan sogs yig rigs du ma dpyad gzhi byas nas lung rig dang mthun pa'i dpyad khul gyis bris/ rjod byed kyi dbang du byas na snyan ngag dang brda rnying gis ma brgyan par go bde phal skad du bris ba sa na mkhas dbang dgyes —pa'i mchod sprin du ma gyur kung / blo gsar rnams kyi dga' ston gsol lags/ de ltar tshad ldan mkhas pa'i yig cha dang / /rang gi mthong thos gzhan zer gtam rgyun rnams/ /rang blos gang grub dpyad kyis 'dir bris pas/ /'ol tshod kho na ma yin yid rton rung //'on kyang kho bo sngon sbyangs mkhas min zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i blo gros nyam chung bas/ /byis blo'i skyon gyi nor 'khrul ji snyed pa//chos spyan mnga' ba rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /ces dus mthar dar mdo mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sbyong slob grwa'i dge ming 'dzin pa karma rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me byi gnam lo gsar tshes la rgyal rong rgyal mo rngul chu'i 'gram ngogs gur drag ces pa'i yul grur dris te rgyal khab yun brtan bkra shis bde legs zhu/ /310

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ dbyangs lha/ke tshang yab sras dab dpal spungs dkon pa/karma rgyal mtshaka gyis bsgrigs/mi khron mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis skrun nas bkram /si khron zhing chen phu rdzong shis phug pa ra 'debs bzo grwas dpar/1ci257—6409—1664—87ya 138 dpe rin sgor/ 13 00
